## Food and Drug Regulations {#food-and-drug-regulations .Title-of-Act}

[C.R.C.]{.abbr title="Consolidated Regulations of Canada"}, c. 870
:::

[FOOD AND DRUGS ACT](/eng/acts/F-27)

Regulations Respecting Food and Drugs
::::

:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: section
## [PART A]{.HLabel1}[Administration]{.HTitleText1} {#h-567728 .Part}

### [General]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567729 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.001 .sectionLabel}** These
Regulations may be cited as the [Food and Drug
Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870).

**[[A.01.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.002 .sectionLabel}** These
Regulations, where applicable, prescribe the standards of composition,
strength, potency, purity, quality or other property of the article of
food or drug to which the standards refer.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 1](#1497011-1503794){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497011-1503794.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.002-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.002"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.003 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/94-289, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567733 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.010 .sectionLabel}** In these
Regulations,

[[acceptable method]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[acceptable method]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a method of analysis
    or examination designated by the Minister as acceptable for use in
    the administration of the Act and these Regulations; ([méthode
    acceptable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the [Food and Drugs
    Act](/eng/acts/F-27), except in Parts G and
    J; ([Loi]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[common-law partner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[common-law partner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
    in section 2 of the [Criminal Code](/eng/acts/C-46); ([conjoint de
    fait]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[cubic centimetre]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[cubic centimetre]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} and its abbreviation
    [[cc.]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} shall be deemed to be interchangeable
    with the term [[millilitre]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} and its
    abbreviation [[ml.]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}; ([centimètre
    cube]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Director]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Director]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2018-69, s.
    1\]]{.Repealed}

[[inner label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[inner label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the label on or affixed to
    an immediate container of a food or drug; ([étiquette
    intérieure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Lot number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Lot number]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any combination of letters,
    figures, or both, by which any food or drug can be traced in
    manufacture and identified in distribution; ([numéro de
    lot]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/97-12, s.
    1\]]{.Repealed}

[[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
    [[distributor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person, including an
    association or partnership, who under their own name, or under a
    trade-, design or word mark, trade name or other name, word or mark
    controlled by them, sells a food or
    drug; ([fabricant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} or
    [distributeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[official method]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[official method]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a method of analysis
    or examination designated as such by Minister for use in the
    administration of the Act and these Regulations; ([méthode
    officielle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[outer label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[outer label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the label on or affixed to
    the outside of a package of a food or drug; ([étiquette
    extérieure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[prescription drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[prescription drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that is set
    out in the Prescription Drug List, as amended from time to time, or
    a drug that is part of a class of drugs that is set out in
    it; ([drogue sur ordonnance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Prescription Drug List]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Prescription Drug List]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the list
    established by the Minister under section 29.1 of the Act; ([Liste
    des drogues sur ordonnance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[principal display panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[principal display panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
    as in the [Consumer Packaging and Labelling
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._417); ([espace
    principal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[security package]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[security package]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a package having a
    security feature that provides reasonable assurance to consumers
    that the package has not been opened prior to purchase. ([emballage
    de sécurité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-300, s. 1(F)
- SOR/85-141, s. 1
- SOR/89-455, s. 1
- SOR/97-12, s. 1
- SOR/2000-353, s. 1
- SOR/2001-272, s. 5
- SOR/2003-135, s. 1
- SOR/2013-122, s. 1
- SOR/2018-69, ss. 1, 27
- [SOR/2022-197, s. 1](#1375613-1376789){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1375613-1376789.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.010-20180404.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.010"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.011 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall, upon request, furnish copies of official methods.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.011-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.011"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.012 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall, upon request, indicate that a method is acceptable or otherwise
upon its submission to him for a ruling.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.012-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.012"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.013 .sectionLabel}** Where a food,
drug, vitamin or cosmetic has more than one name, whether proper or
common, a reference in these Regulations to the food, drug, vitamin or
cosmetic by any of its names is deemed to be a reference to the food,
drug or vitamin by all of its names.

**[[A.01.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.014 .sectionLabel}** When a lot
number is required by these Regulations to appear on any article,
container, package or label it shall be preceded by one of the following
designations:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} "Lot number";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} "Lot No.";

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} "Lot"; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} "(L)".

<!-- -->

- **[[A.01.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), any
  statement, information or declaration that is required by these
  Regulations to appear on the label of any drug shall be in either the
  French or the English language in addition to any other language.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The adequate directions for use required to be shown
  on the inner and outer labels of a drug under subparagraph
  C.01.004(1)(c)(iii) or paragraph C.04.009(2)(f) shall be in English
  and French if the drug is available for sale without prescription in
  an open self-selection area.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-140, s. 1
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 1](#1496718-1533619){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496718-1533619.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.015-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.015"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.016 .sectionLabel}** All
information that is required by these Regulations to appear on a label
of a food or a drug, other than a drug for human use in dosage form,
shall be

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} clearly and prominently displayed on the label; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} readily discernible to the purchaser or consumer
  under the customary conditions of purchase and use.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-158, s. 1
- [SOR/2022-143, s. 1(F)](#1361977-1367152){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1361977-1367152.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.016-20150613.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.016"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.017 .sectionLabel}** Every label
of a drug for human use in dosage form shall meet the following
conditions:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information that is required by these Regulations
  to appear on the label shall be

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} prominently displayed on it,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} readily discernible to the purchaser or consumer
    under the customary conditions of purchase and use, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} expressed in plain language; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the format of the label, including the manner in
  which its text and any graphics are displayed on it, shall not impede
  comprehension of the information referred to in paragraph (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-158, s. 2
:::

### [Analysts; Inspectors]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567782 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.020 and A.01.021]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.020_and_A.01.021
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/81-935, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

**[[A.01.022]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.022 .sectionLabel}** An inspector
shall perform the functions and duties and carry out the
responsibilities in respect of foods and drugs prescribed by the Act,
and these Regulations.

**[[A.01.023]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.023 .sectionLabel}** The authority
of an inspector extends to and includes the whole of Canada.

**[[A.01.024]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.024 .sectionLabel}** The
certificate of designation required pursuant to subsection 22(2) of the
Act shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} certify that the person named therein is an inspector
  for the purpose of the Act; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} be signed by

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the Minister and the person named in the
    certificate, in the case of an inspector on the staff of the
    Department.

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2000-184, s. 60\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-500, s. 1
- SOR/92-626, s. 1
- SOR/95-548, s. 5
- SOR/2000-184, s. 60
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.024-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.024"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.025]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.025 .sectionLabel}** If authorized
by a regulation made pursuant to the [Broadcasting
Act](/eng/acts/B-9.01), inspectors shall act as representatives of the
Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission for the
purpose of enforcing the provisions of regulations made by the Canadian
Radio-Television and Telecommunications Commission concerning the
advertising of any article to which the [Food and Drugs
Act](/eng/acts/F-27) applies, or concerning recommendations for the
prevention, treatment or cure of a disease or ailment.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-197, s. 2](#1375615-1376792){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1375615-1376792.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.025-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.025"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.026]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.026 .sectionLabel}** An inspector
may, for the proper administration of the Act or these Regulations, take
photographs of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} any article that is referred to in subsection 23(2)
  of the Act;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} any place where, on reasonable grounds, he believes
  any article referred to in paragraph (a) is manufactured, prepared,
  preserved, packaged or stored; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} anything that, on reasonable grounds, he believes is
  used or capable of being used for the manufacture, preparation,
  preservation, packaging or storing of any article referred to in
  paragraph (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/90-814, s. 1
:::

### [Importations]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567800 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.040]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.040 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section A.01.044, no person shall import into Canada for sale a food or
drug the sale of which in Canada would constitute a violation of the Act
or these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/92-626, s. 2(F)
:::

**[[A.01.041]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.041 .sectionLabel}** An inspector
may examine and take samples of any food or drug sought to be imported
into Canada.

**[[A.01.042]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.042 .sectionLabel}** If an
inspector examines or takes a sample of a food or drug under section
A.01.041, the inspector may submit it to an analyst for analysis or
examination.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-18, s. 1(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.042-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.042"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.043]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.043 .sectionLabel}** If an
inspector, on examination of a sample of a food or drug or on receipt of
a report of an analyst of the result of an analysis or examination of
the sample, is of the opinion that the sale of the food or drug in
Canada would constitute a violation of the Act or these Regulations, the
inspector shall so notify in writing the collector of customs concerned
and the importer.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-300, s. 2(E)
- SOR/2017-18, s. 2
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.043-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.043"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[A.01.044]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.044
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a person seeks to import a
  food or drug into Canada for sale and the sale would constitute a
  violation of the Act or these Regulations, that person may, if the
  sale of the food or drug would be in conformity with the Act and these
  Regulations after its relabelling or modification, import it into
  Canada on condition that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person gives to an inspector notice of the
    proposed importation; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the food or drug will be relabelled or modified as
    may be necessary to enable its sale to be lawful in Canada.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a food or drug that has been
  imported into Canada under subsection (1) unless the food or drug has
  been relabelled or modified within three months after the importation
  or within such longer period as may be specified by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug, the Minister; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of food, the Minister or the President
    of the Canadian Food Inspection Agency.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/92-626, s. 3
- SOR/95-548, s. 5
- SOR/2000-184, s. 61
- SOR/2000-317, s. 18
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.044-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.044"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Exports]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567820 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.045]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.045 .sectionLabel}** A certificate
referred to in section 37 of the Act shall be signed and issued by the
exporter in the form set out in Appendix III.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-318, s. 1
- SOR/90-814, s. 2
:::

**[[A.01.046]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.046 .sectionLabel}** An exporter
that issues a certificate referred to in paragraph 37(1)(c) of the Act
in respect of a drug shall retain a copy of the certificate for five
years after the day on which the drug is exported.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-100, s. 1](#1347458-1380818){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1347458-1380818.html"}
:::

- **[[A.01.047]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.047
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraph
  37(1)(d) of the Act, a drug that, by virtue of paragraph A.01.048(a),
  is required to be fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested, distributed
  or wholesaled in accordance with an establishment licence must be
  fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested, distributed or wholesaled by
  the holder of such a licence that has paid fees in connection with the
  licence in accordance with the [Fees in Respect of Drugs and Medical
  Devices Order](/eng/regulations/SOR-2019-124).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Words and expressions used in this section have the
  same meaning as in subsection C.01A.001(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-100, s. 1](#1347458-1380823){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1347458-1380823.html"}
:::

**[[A.01.048]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.048 .sectionLabel}** For the
purposes of subsection 37(1.2) of the Act, the following provisions are
prescribed in relation to drugs:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the provisions of Division 1A of Part C;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the provisions of Division 2 of Part C, except
  section C.02.003.2 and paragraphs C.02.009(5)(b), C.02.016(3)(b) and
  C.02.018(3)(c);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} sections C.03.001 to C.03.013; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} sections C.04.001 to C.04.006.

### [Transhipments]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1380836 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.049]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.049 .sectionLabel}** For the
purposes of paragraph 38(c) of the Act, all drugs must be in bond.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-100, s. 1](#1347458-1380839){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1347458-1380839.html"}
:::

### [Sampling]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567824 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.050]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.050 .sectionLabel}** When taking a
sample of an article under paragraph 23(2)(i) of the Act, an inspector
shall inform the owner of the article or the person from whom the sample
is being obtained of the inspector's intention to submit the sample or a
part of it to an analyst for analysis or examination, and

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} where, in the opinion of the inspector, division of
  the procured quantity would not interfere with analysis or examination

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} divide the quantity into three parts,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} identify the three parts as the owner's portion,
    the sample, and the duplicate sample and where only one part bears
    the label, that part shall be identified as the sample,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} seal each part in such a manner that it cannot be
    opened without breaking the seal, and

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} deliver the part identified as the owner's portion
    to the owner or the person from whom the sample was obtained and
    forward the sample and the duplicate sample to an analyst for
    analysis or examination; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where, in the opinion of the inspector, division of
  the procured quantity would interfere with analysis or examination

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} identify the entire quantity as the sample,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} seal the sample in such a manner that it cannot be
    opened without breaking the seal, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} forward the sample to an analyst for analysis or
    examination.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/90-814, s. 3
- [SOR/2021-46, s. 1](#1288890-1290066){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1288890-1290066.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.050-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.050"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[A.01.051]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.051 .sectionLabel}** Where the
owner or the person from whom the sample was obtained objects to the
procedure followed by an inspector under section A.01.050 at the time
the sample was obtained, the inspector shall follow both procedures set
out in that section if the owner or the person from whom the sample was
obtained supplies him with a sufficient quantity of the article.

### [Tariff of Fees]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567838 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.060]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.060 .sectionLabel}** The cost of
analysing a sample other than for the purpose of the Act, for a
department of the Government of Canada for the purpose of legal action
is \$15.

### [Labelling of Food and Drugs in Pressurized Containers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567840 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.060.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.060.1 .sectionLabel}** In
sections A.01.061 and A.01.062,

[[flame projection]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[flame projection]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ability of the
    pressurized contents of an aerosol container to ignite and the
    length of that ignition, when tested in accordance with official
    method DO-30, Determination of Flame Projection, dated October 15,
    1981; ([projection de flamme]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[flashback]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[flashback]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means that part of the flame
    projection that extends from its point of ignition back to the
    aerosol container when tested in accordance with official method
    DO-30, Determination of Flame Projection, dated October 15,
    1981; ([retour de flamme]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[principal display panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[principal display panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2000-353, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/92-15, s. 1
- SOR/2000-353, s. 2
- SOR/2001-272, s. 6
:::

- **[[A.01.061]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.061
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section A.01.063, in the
  case of a food or a drug packaged in a disposable metal container
  designed to release pressurized contents by use of a manually operated
  valve that forms an integral part of the container, the principal
  display panel of the inner and outer labels of the food or drug shall
  display, in accordance with sections 15 to 18 of the Consumer
  Chemicals and Containers Regulations, as they read on September 30,
  2001, the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the hazard symbol set out in Column II of item 10
    of Schedule II to those Regulations, accompanied by the signal word
    "CAUTION / [ATTENTION]{.otherLang lang="fr"}"; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the primary hazard statement "CONTAINER MAY EXPLODE
    IF HEATED. / [CE CONTENANT PEUT EXPLOSER S'IL EST
    CHAUFFÉ]{.otherLang lang="fr"}.".

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section A.01.063, one panel of the inner
  and outer labels of a food or drug referred to in subsection (1) shall
  display, in the size required by paragraph 19(1)(b) of the Consumer
  Chemicals and Containers Regulations, as they read on September 30,
  2001, the following additional hazard statement:

  > ::: QuotedText
  > "Contents under pressure. Do not place in hot water or near
  > radiators, stoves or other sources of heat. Do not puncture or
  > incinerate container or store at temperatures over 50°C.
  >
  > [Contenu sous pression. Ne pas mettre dans l'eau chaude ni près des
  > radiateurs, poêles ou autres sources de chaleur. Ne pas percer le
  > contenant, ni le jeter au feu, ni le conserver à des températures
  > dépassant 50 °C.]{.otherLang lang="fr"}"
  > :::

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The requirements of subsections (1) and (2) do not
  apply in relation to a drug or food if the Minister determines that
  the design of the container, the materials used in its construction or
  the incorporation of a safety device eliminate its potential hazard.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-616, s. 1
- SOR/85-1023, s. 1
- SOR/92-15, s. 2
- SOR/2001-272, s. 7
- SOR/2018-69, s. 2
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.061-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.061"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[A.01.062]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.062
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section A.01.063, if a
  food or drug is packaged in a container described in subsection
  A.01.061(1) and has a flame projection of a length set out in column I
  of any of items 1 to 3 of the table to this subsection or a flashback
  as set out in column I of item 4 of that table, as determined by
  official method DO-30, Determination of Flame Projection, dated
  October 15, 1981, the principal display panel of the inner and outer
  labels of the food or drug shall display, in accordance with
  sections 15 to 18 of the Consumer Chemicals and Containers
  Regulations, as they read on September 30, 2001, the following
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the hazard symbol set out in Column II of the same
    item;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in both official languages, the signal word set out
    in Column III of the same item; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in both official languages, the primary hazard
    statement set out in Column IV of the same item.

  TABLE IS NOT DISPLAYED, SEE SOR/81-616, S. 2; SOR/92-15, S. 3

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the requirements of subsection (1),
  one panel of the inner label and outer labels of a food or drug
  referred to in that subsection shall display, in the size required by
  paragraph 19(1)(b) of the Consumer Chemicals and Containers
  Regulations, as they read on September 30, 2001, the following
  additional hazard statement:

  > ::: QuotedText
  > "Do not use in presence of open flame or spark.
  >
  > [Ne pas utiliser en présence d'une flamme nue ou
  > d'étincelles]{.otherLang lang="fr"}."
  > :::

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-616, s. 2
- SOR/82-429, s. 1
- SOR/85-1023, s. 2
- SOR/92-15, s. 3
- SOR/2001-272, s. 8

- **[[A.01.063]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.063
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the labelled net contents of a
  container of a food or drug described in subsection A.01.061(1) or
  A.01.062(1) does not exceed 60 millilitres or 60 grams, the inner
  label may show only the information described in paragraph
  A.01.061(1)(a) or paragraphs A.01.062(1)(a) and (b), as the case may
  be.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the labelled net contents of a container of a
  food or drug described in subsection A.01.061(1) or A.01.062(1)
  exceeds 60 millilitres or 60 grams but does not exceed 120 millilitres
  or 120 grams, the inner label may show only the information described
  in subsection A.01.061(1) or subsection A.01.062(1), as the case may
  be.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the labelled net quantity, in a container, of a
  food or drug referred to in subsection A.01.061(1) or A.01.062(1) is
  less than 30 mL or 30 g, the hazard symbol shall be of such size as to
  be capable of being circumscribed by a circle with a diameter of at
  least 6 mm.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where a container of a food or drug, described in
  subsection (1) or (2) is sold in a package, the outer label may show
  only the information described in subsection A.01.061(2) and, where
  applicable, subsection A.01.062(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-616, s. 2
- SOR/92-15, s. 4

**[[A.01.064]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.064 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,

### [Security Packaging]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567872 .Subheading}

- **[[A.01.065]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.065
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[drug for human
  use]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that is intended for human use,
  whether the drug is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a mouthwash;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to be inhaled, ingested or inserted into the body;
    or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} for ophthalmic use.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), no person shall sell or
  import a drug for human use that is packaged and available to the
  general public in a self-service display, unless the drug is contained
  in a security package.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to lozenges.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (5), a statement or
  illustration that draws attention to the security feature of the
  security package referred to in subsection (2) shall be carried

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} on the inner label of the package; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the security feature is a part of the outer
    package, on the outer label.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (4) does not apply if the security feature
  of a security package is self-evident and is an integral part of the
  immediate product container.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-141, s. 2
- SOR/88-323, s. 1
- SOR/92-664, s. 1
:::

### [Exemptions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-567886 .Subheading}

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-567887 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.066]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.066 .sectionLabel}** Sections
A.01.067 and A.01.068 do not apply to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a drug included in Schedule I, II, III, IV or V to
  the [Controlled Drugs and Substances Act](/eng/acts/C-38.8); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a prescription drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2007-288, s. 1
- SOR/2013-122, s. 2
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.066-20080601.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.066"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Advertising]{.HTitleText3} {#h-567893 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.067]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.067 .sectionLabel}** A drug is
exempt from subsection 3(1) of the Act with respect to its advertisement
to the general public as a preventative, but not as a treatment or cure,
for any of the diseases, disorders or abnormal physical states referred
to in Schedule A.1 to the Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2007-288, s. 1
- [SOR/2021-46, s. 10](#1288913-1290083){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1288913-1290083.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-A.01.067-20080601.html "Link to previous version of section A.01.067"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Sale]{.HTitleText3} {#h-567897 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.068]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.068 .sectionLabel}** A drug is
exempt from subsection 3(2) of the Act with respect to its sale by a
person where the drug is represented by label or is advertised by that
person to the general public as a preventative, but not as a treatment
or cure, for any of the diseases, disorders or abnormal physical states
referred to in Schedule A.1 to the Act.

::: HistoricalNote

#### [Non-application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1531728 .Subheading}

**[[A.01.069]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-A.01.069 .sectionLabel}** These
Regulations do not apply to a drug referred to in paragraph (b) or (c)
of the definition [[biocide]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 1(1)
of the [Biocides Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2024-110).

## [PART B]{.HLabel1}[Foods]{.HTitleText1} {#h-567901 .Part}

### [DIVISION 1]{.HLabel2} {#h-567902 .Subheading}

#### [General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-567903 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Part,

  [[agricultural chemical]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[agricultural chemical]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any substance
      that is used, or represented for use, in or on a food during its
      production, storage or transport, and whose use results, or may
      reasonably be expected to result, in a residue, component or
      derivative of that substance in or on a food and includes any pest
      control product as defined in subsection 2(1) of the [Pest Control
      Products Act](/eng/acts/P-9.01), plant growth regulator,
      fertilizer or any adjuvant or carrier used with that substance.
      This definition does not include any

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} food additive that is set out in, and used in
        accordance with, the Lists of Permitted Food Additives,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} nutritive substance that is used, recognized or
        commonly sold as food or as an ingredient of food,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} vitamin, mineral nutrient or amino acid,

      - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} supplemental ingredient,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} essential oil, flavouring preparation, natural
        extractive, oleoresin, seasoning or spice,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} food packaging material or any substance of
        which that material is composed, or

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} drug recommended for administration to animals
        that may be consumed as food; ([produit chimique
        agricole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[available display surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[available display surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a
      prepackaged product, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bottom of an ornamental container or the
        total surface area of both sides of a tag attached to the
        ornamental container, whichever is greater,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the total surface area of both sides of a tag
        attached to a package to which a label cannot be physically
        applied or on which information cannot be legibly set out and
        easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under the customary
        conditions of purchase, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the total surface area of any other package,
        excluding the bottom if the contents of the package leak out or
        are damaged when the package is turned over,

      but does not include

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any area of a package on which a label cannot
        be physically applied or on which information cannot be legibly
        set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under the
        customary conditions of purchase,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any part of a package that is intended to be
        destroyed when it is opened, other than a package of a food that
        is intended to be consumed by one person at a single eating
        occasion, or

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the area occupied by the universal product
        code; ([surface exposée disponible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[close proximity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[close proximity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of information
      that is shown on a label or a sign, means immediately adjacent to
      the information and without any intervening printed, written or
      graphic material; ([à proximité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[common name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[common name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a food, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the food printed in boldface type,
        but not in italics, in a section of the Food Compositional
        Standards Document;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name of the food printed in boldface type,
        but not in italics, in a section of the [[Standards of Identity
        Document]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section 1 of the
        [Safe Food for Canadians
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108); or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, the name by which it is
        generally known or a name that is not generic and that describes
        the food; ([nom usuel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Common Names for Ingredients and Components Document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Common Names for Ingredients and Components
      Document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document entitled Common
      Names for Ingredients and Components, prepared by the Canadian
      Food Inspection Agency and published on its website, as amended
      from time to time; ([document sur les noms usuels d'ingrédients et
      de constituants]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[component]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[component]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an individual unit of food
      that is combined as an individual unit of food with one or more
      other individual units of food to form an
      ingredient; ([constituant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[daily value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[daily value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
      nutrient, the quantity applicable to the nutrient according to
      subsection B.01.001.1(2); ([valeur quotidienne]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[Directory of NFT Formats]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Directory of NFT Formats]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      document entitled Nutrition Labelling -- Directory of Nutrition
      Facts Table Formats published by the Government of Canada on its
      website, as amended from time to time; ([Répertoire des modèles de
      TVN]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Directory of Nutrition Symbol Specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Directory of Nutrition Symbol
      Specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document entitled
      Nutrition Labelling --- Directory of Nutrition Symbol
      Specifications, published by the Government of Canada on its
      website, as amended from time to time; ([Répertoire des
      spécifications des symboles nutritionnels]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[durable life]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[durable life]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the period, commencing
      on the day on which a prepackaged product is packaged for retail
      sale, during which the product, when it is stored under conditions
      appropriate to that product, will retain, without any appreciable
      deterioration, its normal wholesomeness, palatability, nutritional
      value and any other qualities claimed for it by the
      manufacturer; ([durée de conservation]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[durable life date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[durable life date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the date on which
      the durable life of a prepackaged product ends; ([date limite de
      conservation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[energy value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[energy value]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a food,
      the amount of energy made available to a person's body when the
      chemical constituents of the food, including protein, fat,
      carbohydrate and alcohol, are metabolized following ingestion of
      the food by the person; ([valeur énergétique]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[extended meat product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[extended meat product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a meat product
      to which a meat product extender has been added; ([produit de
      viande avec allongeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[extended poultry product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[extended poultry product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a poultry
      product to which a poultry product extender has been
      added; ([produit de volaille avec allongeur]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[fish product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fish product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means fish or prepared
      fish; ([produit de poisson]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flavouring preparation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flavouring preparation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes any food
      for which a standard is set out in Volume 9 of the Food
      Compositional Standards Document; ([préparation
      aromatisante]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[food additive]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[food additive]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any substance the use
      of which results, or may reasonably be expected to result, in it
      or its by-products becoming a part of or affecting the
      characteristics of a food, but does not include

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any nutritive material that is used, recognized
        or commonly sold as an article or ingredient of food;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} vitamins, mineral nutrients and amino acids,
        other than those substances set out in the Lists of Permitted
        Food Additives;

      - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} supplemental ingredients;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} spices, seasonings and flavouring preparations;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} agricultural chemicals, other than those
        substances set out in the Lists of Permitted Food Additives;

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} food packaging materials and components
        thereof; and

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} drugs recommended for administration to animals
        that may be consumed as food; ([additif
        alimentaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[food colour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[food colour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any food additive used
      to add or restore colour to a food; ([colorant
      alimentaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Food Compositional Standards Document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Food Compositional Standards
      Document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document entitled
      Canadian Food Compositional Standards, prepared by the Canadian
      Food Inspection Agency and published on its website, as amended
      from time to time; ([Document sur les normes de composition des
      aliments]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fully hydrogenated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fully hydrogenated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a fat or
      oil, means a fat or oil that is hydrogenated and has an iodine
      value of 4 or less; ([entièrement hydrogénée]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[functional substitute for a sweetening agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[functional substitute for a sweetening
      agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a prepackaged
      product, a food --- other than any sweetener or sweetening agent,
      including any sugars --- that replaces a sweetening agent and that
      has one or more of the functions of the sweetening agent
      including, sweetening, thickening, texturing or
      caramelizing; ([substitut fonctionnel d'un agent
      édulcorant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[gelling agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      supplémentés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Lists of Permitted Food Additives]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Lists of Permitted Food Additives]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      one or more of the following lists that are published by the
      Government of Canada on its website, as they are amended from time
      to time:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Acidity Regulators and
        Acid-Reacting Materials;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Anticaking Agents;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Food Colours;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Emulsifying, Gelling,
        Stabilizing or Thickening Agents;

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Firming Agents;

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Flour Treatment Agents;

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Food Additives with Other
        Purposes of Use;

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Food Enzymes;

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Glazing Agents;

      - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Preservatives;

      - [(k)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Sequestering Agents;

      - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Solvents;

      - [(m)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Starch-Modifying Agents;

      - [(n)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Sweeteners;

      - [(o)]{.lawlabel} the List of Permitted Yeast Foods; ([Listes des
        additifs alimentaires autorisés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[main dish]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[main dish]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a combination dish, as set
      out in the Table of Reference Amounts, that does not require the
      addition of ingredients, other than water, for its preparation and
      that contains food from at least two of the following categories:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} dairy products and their alternatives, except
        butter, cream, sour cream, ice cream, ice milk, sherbet and
        alternatives for those foods;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meat products, poultry products, marine and
        fresh water animal products, and their alternatives such as
        eggs, tofu, legumes, nuts, seeds, nut or seed butters and
        spreads made from legumes;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} fruits and vegetables except pickles, relishes,
        olives and garnishes; and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} breads, breakfast cereals, rice and other
        grains, and alimentary pastes; ([plat
        principal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[marketing authorization]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[marketing authorization]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2024-244, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

  [[meal replacement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[meal replacement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a formulated food
      that, by itself, can replace one or more daily meals; ([substitut
      de repas]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[meat product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[meat product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means meat, meat by-product,
      prepared meat or prepared meat by-product; ([produit de
      viande]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[meat product extender]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      viande]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mechanically tenderized beef]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      uncooked solid cut beef that is prepared in either of the
      following ways:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the integrity of the surface of the beef is
        compromised by being pierced by blades, needles or other similar
        instruments; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the beef is injected with a marinade or other
        tenderizing solution; ([boeuf attendri
        mécaniquement]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  :   [[monounsaturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},

      monoinsaturées]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [gras
      monoinsaturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [lipides
      monoinsaturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [monoinsaturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mutiple-serving prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      product; ([produit préemballé à portions
      multiples]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[nutritional supplement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[nutritional supplement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food sold
      or represented as a supplement to a diet that may be inadequate in
      energy and essential nutrients. It does not include a human milk
      fortifier; ([supplément nutritif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[nutrition facts table]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[nutrition facts table]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the nutrition
      facts table that is required by subsection B.01.401(1) to be
      carried on the label of a prepackaged product; ([tableau de la
      valeur nutritive]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[nutrition symbol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[nutrition symbol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a symbol that is
      carried on the principal display panel of a prepackaged product
      under subsection B.01.350(1); ([symbole
      nutritionnel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},
      [[omega-3 polyunsaturated fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[omega-3
      polyunsaturates]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[omega-3
      polyunsaturated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
      [[omega-3]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 9-*cis*, 12-*cis*, 15-*cis* octadecatrienoic
        acid or α-linolenic acid,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 8-*cis*, 11-*cis*, 14-*cis*, 17-*cis*
        eicosatetraenoic acid,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 5-*cis*, 8-*cis*, 11-*cis*, 14-*cis*, 17-*cis*
        eicosapentaenoic acid or EPA,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} 7-*cis*, 10-*cis*, 13-*cis*, 16-*cis*, 19-*cis*
        docosapentaenoic acid, or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} 4-*cis*, 7-*cis*, 10-*cis*, 13-*cis*, 16-*cis*,
        19-*cis* docosahexaenoic acid or DHA; ([acides gras
        polyinsaturés oméga-3]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [graisses
        polyinsaturées oméga-3]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [gras
        polyinsaturés oméga-3]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [lipides
        polyinsaturés oméga-3]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"},
        [polyinsaturés oméga-3]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
        [oméga-3]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},
      [[omega-6 polyunsaturated fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[omega-6
      polyunsaturates]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[omega-6
      polyunsaturated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
      [[omega-6]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 9-*cis*, 12-*cis* octadecadienoic acid or
        linoleic acid,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 6-*cis*, 9-*cis*, 12-*cis* octadecatrienoic
        acid,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 8-*cis*, 11-*cis*, 14-*cis* eicosatrienoic acid
        or di-homo-γ-linolenic acid,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} 5-*cis*, 8-*cis*, 11-*cis*, 14-*cis*
        eicosatetraenoic acid or arachidonic acid,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} 7-*cis*, 10-*cis*, 13-*cis*, 16-*cis*
        docosatetraenoic acid, or

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} 4-*cis*, 7-*cis*, 10-*cis*, 13-*cis*, 16-*cis*
        docosapentaenoic acid; ([acides gras polyinsaturés
        oméga-6]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [graisses polyinsaturées
        oméga-6]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [gras polyinsaturés
        oméga-6]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [lipides polyinsaturés
        oméga-6]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [polyinsaturés
        oméga-6]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
        [oméga-6]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ornamental container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ornamental container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a container

      name and that, because of any design appearing on its surface or

      ornament and is sold as a decorative ornament in addition to being
      sold as the container of a product; ([emballage
      décoratif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[overage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[overage]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the amount of a vitamin or
      mineral nutrient that is, within the limits of good manufacturing
      practice, added to a food in excess of the amount declared on the
      label, in order to ensure that the amount of the vitamin or
      mineral nutrient declared on the label is maintained throughout
      the durable life of the food; ([surtitrage]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[parts per million]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[parts per million]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,

      [[p.p.m.]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s.
      2\]]{.Repealed}

      unless otherwise stated; ([parties par million]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"}, [p.p.m.]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou

      0.3527777778 mm; ([point]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[polyunsaturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[polyunsaturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},
      [[polyunsaturated fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm},
      [[polyunsaturates]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
      [[polyunsaturated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means *cis*-methylene

      polyinsaturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [graisses
      polyinsaturées]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [gras
      polyinsaturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [lipides
      polyinsaturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [polyinsaturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[poultry product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[poultry product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means poultry meat,
      prepared poultry meat, poultry meat by-product or prepared poultry
      meat by-product; ([produit de volaille]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[poultry product extender]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[poultry product extender]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food that
      is a source of protein and that is represented as being for the
      purpose of extending poultry products; ([allongeur de produit de
      volaille]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[prepackaged meal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[prepackaged meal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a prepackaged
      selection of foods for one individual that requires no preparation
      other than heating and that contains at least one serving, as
      described in Canada's Food Guide to Healthy Eating, published in
      1992 by the Department of Supply and Services by authority of the
      Minister of National Health and Welfare, of

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} meat, fish, poultry, legumes, nuts, seeds, eggs
        or milk or milk products other than butter, cream, sour cream,
        ice-cream, ice milk and sherbet; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} vegetables, fruit or grain products; ([repas
        préemballé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any food that is
      contained in a package in the manner in which it is ordinarily
      sold to or used or purchased by a person; ([produit
      préemballé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[principal display panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[principal display panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, despite the
      meaning assigned to that term in section A.01.010,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a label that is applied to a
        [[consumer prepackaged]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} food within the
        meaning of section 1 of the [Safe Food for Canadians
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108), the [[principal
        display panel]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as described in
        paragraphs (a) to (c) of the definition of that term in that
        section,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a label that is applied to a
        prepackaged product other than a consumer prepackaged food
        subject to the [Safe Food for Canadians
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108), the part of the
        label that is applied to all or part of any side or surface of
        the container that is displayed or visible under normal or
        customary conditions of sale or use and, if the container does
        not have such a side or surface, the part of the label that is
        applied to any part of the container except on the bottom, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a label that is applied to a
        food that is not a prepackaged product, the part of the label
        that is applied to all or part of the side or surface of the
        food that is displayed or visible under normal or customary
        conditions of sale or use; ([espace principal]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[principal display surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[principal display surface]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a
      prepackaged product, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the package has a surface that is displayed
        or visible under customary conditions of sale or use, the total
        area of that surface, excluding any surface that is the top of
        the package,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the package has a lid that is the part of
        the package that is displayed or visible under customary
        conditions of sale or use, the total area of the top surface of
        the lid,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the package does not have a particular
        surface that is displayed or visible under customary conditions
        of sale or use, 40% of the total surface area of the package,
        excluding any surface area that is its top and bottom, if it is
        possible for that proportion of the total surface area to be
        displayed or visible under customary conditions of sale or use,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the package is a bag with surfaces of equal
        dimensions, the total area of one of the surfaces,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} if the package is a bag with surfaces of
        different dimensions, the total area of one of the largest
        surfaces,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} despite paragraphs (a) to (e), if the package
        does not have a surface that is displayed or visible under
        customary conditions of sale or use to which a label can be
        applied, the total area of one side of a tag that is attached to
        the package,

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} despite paragraphs (a) to (e), if the package
        contains wine that is exposed for sale, any part of the surface
        of the package, excluding its top and bottom, that can be seen
        without having to turn the package, and

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} if the package is a wrapper or confining band
        that is so narrow in relation to the size of the food that it
        cannot reasonably be considered to have any surface that is
        displayed or visible under customary conditions of sale or use,
        the total area of one side of a tag that is attached to the
        package; ([principale surface exposée]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[reasonable daily intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reasonable daily intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a

      amount of that food set out in Column II of that item; ([ration
      quotidienne raisonnable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[recommended daily intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[recommended daily intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2016-305, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[reference amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reference amount]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a

      amount of that food set out in column 2; ([quantité de
      référence]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[reference standard]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reference standard]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2016-305, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[saturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[saturated fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[saturated
      fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[saturates]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
      [[saturated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all fatty acids that
      contain no double bonds; ([acides gras saturés, graisses saturées,
      gras saturés, lipides saturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [saturés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[simulated meat product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[simulated meat product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any food that
      does not contain any meat product, poultry product or fish product
      but that has the appearance of a meat product; ([simili-produit de
      viande]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[simulated poultry product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[simulated poultry product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any food
      that does not contain any poultry product, meat product or fish
      product but that has the appearance of a poultry
      product; ([simili-produit de volaille]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[single-serving prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[single-serving prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      prepackaged product in respect of which the net quantity of food
      in the package is the serving of stated size for the food as set
      out in paragraph B.01.002A(1)(b); ([produit préemballé à portion
      individuelle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[solid cut meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[solid cut meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a whole cut of meat; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a product consisting of pieces of meat of which
        at least 80 per cent of the pieces weigh at least 25 g
        each; ([viande coupée solide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[solid cut poultry meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[solid cut poultry meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a whole cut of poultry meat; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a product consisting of pieces of poultry meat
        of which at least 80 per cent of the pieces weigh at least 25 g
        each; ([viande de volaille coupée solide]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[sugars]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[sugars]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all monosaccharides and
      disaccharides; ([sucres]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[sugars-based ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[sugars-based ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect
      of a prepackaged product,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an ingredient that is a monosaccharide or
        disaccharide or a combination of these;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an ingredient that is a sweetening agent other
        than one referred to in paragraph (a); and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other ingredient that contains one or more
        sugars and that is added to the product as a functional
        substitute for a sweetening agent; ([ingrédient à base de
        sucres]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[supplemental ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplemental ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a nutrient
      --- including a vitamin, mineral nutrient or amino acid --- or any
      other substance listed in column 1 of the List of Permitted
      Supplemental Ingredients and added as an ingredient to a food in
      accordance with the applicable conditions of use set out in
      columns 2 to 5; ([ingrédient supplémentaire]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[supplemented food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplemented food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a prepackaged
      product that belongs to a food category set out in column 1 of the
      List of Permitted Supplemented Food Categories and to which a
      supplemental ingredient has been added, but does not include 

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a [[food for special dietary
        use]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section B.24.001 and
        referred to in any of paragraphs B.24.003(1)(f) to (f.2) and (h)
        to (j), even if the food for special dietary use is also a
        gluten-free food referred to in paragraph B.24.003(1)(g);

      - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} infant food;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a food that is labelled or advertised for
        consumption by

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} children one year of age or older but less
          than four years of age, or

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} women who are pregnant or breastfeeding;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any of the following foods set out in column I
        of the Table to section D.03.002:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a food referred to in any of items 1, 2.1,
          2.2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9.1, 10 to 13, 15, 17 to 19, 21 to 25 and 27,
          and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged ice;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a food that has not been processed or that has
        been minimally processed; or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a beverage with an alcohol content of more than
        0.5%; ([aliment supplémenté]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[supplemented food caution identifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplemented food caution identifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      the identifier carried on the principal display panel of a
      supplemented food under subsection B.29.021(1); ([identifiant des
      aliments supplémentés avec mise en garde]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[supplemented food facts table]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplemented food facts table]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      supplemented food facts table required by subsection B.29.002(1)
      to be carried on the label of a supplemented food; ([tableau des
      renseignements sur les aliments supplémentés]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[sweetener]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[sweetener]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any food additive used to
      impart a sweet taste to a food; ([édulcorant]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[sweetening agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[sweetening agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes any food for
      which a standard is set out in Volume 15 of the Food Compositional
      Standards Document, but does not include a sweetener; ([agent
      édulcorant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Table of Chemical, Physical and Nutritional Characteristics of Food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Table of Chemical, Physical and Nutritional Characteristics of
      Food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Table of Chemical, Physical
      and Nutritional Characteristics of Food, published by the
      Government of Canada on its website, as amended from time to
      time; ([Tableau des caractéristiques chimiques, physiques et
      nutritionnelles des aliments]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Table of Daily Values]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Table of Daily Values]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document
      entitled Nutrition Labelling -- Table of Daily Values published by
      the Government of Canada on its website, as amended from time to
      time; ([Tableau des valeurs quotidiennes]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
      Claims]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document entitled Nutrition
      Labelling --- Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
      Claims, published by the Government of Canada on its website, as
      amended from time to time; ([Tableau des mentions et des
      allégations autorisées concernant la teneur
      nutritive]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Table of Reference Amounts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Table of Reference Amounts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      document entitled Nutrition Labelling -- Table of Reference
      Amounts for Food published by the Government of Canada on its
      website, as amended from time to time; ([Tableau des quantités de
      référence]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[trans fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[trans fatty acids]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[trans
      fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[trans]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      unsaturated fatty acids that contain one or more isolated or
      non-conjugated double bonds in a *trans*-configuration; ([acides
      gras trans]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [graisses
      trans]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [gras trans]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"}, [lipides trans]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [trans]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[unstandardized]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[unstandardized]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a food,
      means that a standard is not set out in the Food Compositional
      Standards Document for that food; ([non
      normalisé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[unstandardized food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[unstandardized food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2024-244, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

  [[weighted recommended nutrient intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[weighted recommended nutrient intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in
      respect of a vitamin or mineral nutrient set out in column I of
      Table II to Division 1 of Part D or in column I of Table II to
      Division 2 of Part D, means the amount set out in column
      III; ([apport nutritionnel recommandé pondéré]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[yolk-replaced egg]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[yolk-replaced egg]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} does not contain egg yolk but contains fluid,
        dried or frozen egg albumen or mixtures thereof,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is intended as a substitute for whole egg, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} meets the requirements of section
        B.22.032; ([oeuf à jaune substitué]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} A reference in these Regulations to any of the
  lists referred to in the definition [[Lists of Permitted Food
  Additives]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} is a reference to the list as
  published by the Government of Canada on its website, as amended from
  time to time.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The definitions in this subsection apply for the
  purposes of the Act.

  [[agricultural chemical]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[agricultural chemical]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as in subsection (1). ([produit chimique
      agricole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[food additive]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[food additive]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
      subsection (1). ([additif alimentaire]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in this Division.

  [[human milk fortifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[human milk fortifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as in section B.25.001. ([fortifiant pour lait
      humain]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[human milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[human milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as in section B.25.001. ([succédané de lait
      humain]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the definitions [[supplemental
  ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} and [[supplemented
  food]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection (1), if a supplemented food
  is used as an ingredient in the manufacture of a second supplemented
  food, a supplemental ingredient in the first supplemented food is
  deemed to also have been added as a supplemental ingredient to --- and
  not to be a component of an ingredient of --- the second supplemented
  food if it is contained in the second supplemented food in accordance
  with the applicable conditions of use set out in columns 2 to 5 of the
  List of Permitted Supplemental Ingredients.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the definition [[solid cut
  meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection (1),
  [[meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in section
  B.14.001.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the definition [[solid cut
  poultry meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection (1), [[poultry
  meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in section
  B.22.001.

- **[[B.01.001.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.001.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (2),
  the term [[fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} used in the Table of Daily
  Values means all fatty acids expressed as triglycerides.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The daily value for a nutrient in a food is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a nutrient set out in column 1 of
    Part 1 of the Table of Daily Values, the quantity

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} set out in column 2, if the food is intended
      solely for children one year of age or older but less than four
      years of age, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} set out in column 3, if the food is intended for
      children one year of age or older but less than four years of age
      or for children four years of age or older and adults; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a vitamin or mineral nutrient set
    out in column 1 of Part 2 of the Table of Daily Values, the quantity

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} set out in column 2, if the food is intended
      solely for infants six months of age or older but less than one
      year of age,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} set out in column 3, if the food is intended for
      infants six months of age or older but less than one year of age
      or for children one year of age or older but less than four years
      of age, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} set out in column 4, in any other case.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply if the food is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a human milk fortifier; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a human milk substitute intended solely for infants
    less than six months of age.

**[[B.01.001.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.001.2 .sectionLabel}** For the
purposes of interpreting any food-related document published by the
Government of Canada on its website and incorporated by reference into
parts A, B or D, words and expressions that are used but not defined in
that document have the same meaning as in those parts.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 3](#1497041-1503851){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497041-1503851.html"}
:::

**[[B.01.001.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.001.3 .sectionLabel}** For the
purposes of interpreting the Lists of Permitted Food Additives, a
reference in those lists to a food that is subject to a standard set out
in the Food Compositional Standards Document means that food for which
the standard is set out in that document.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 3](#1497041-1503854){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497041-1503854.html"}
:::

**[[B.01.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.002 .sectionLabel}** The Food
Compositional Standards Document sets out the standards of composition,
strength, potency, purity, quality or other property of the foods that
are referred to in that document.

- **[[B.01.002A]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.002A
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, a
  serving of stated size of a food shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} based on the food as offered for sale;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in either of the following cases, the net quantity
    of the food in the package:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the quantity of food in the package can
      reasonably be consumed by one person at a single eating occasion,
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the package contains less than 200% of the
      reference amount for the food; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in all other cases, the amount indicated for the
    food according to the criteria set out in column 3A of the Table of
    Reference Amounts.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A serving of stated size of a food shall be expressed
  as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a single-serving prepackaged product
    to which paragraph (1)(b) applies, per package and using the
    following units:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in grams, if the net quantity of the food is
      shown on the label by weight or by count, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in millilitres, if the net quantity of the food
      is shown on the label by volume; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a multiple-serving prepackaged
    product to which paragraph (1)(c) applies, according to the
    following units set out in column 3B of the Table of Reference
    Amounts and according to the manner set out in that column:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the household measure that applies to the
      product, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the metric measure that applies to the product.

- **[[B.01.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following foods shall carry a
  label when offered for sale:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all prepackaged products other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged confections, commonly known as one
      bite confections, that are sold individually, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products consisting of fresh fruits
      or fresh vegetables that are packaged in a wrapper or confining
      band of less than 1/2 inch in width;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meat and meat by-products that are barbecued,
    roasted or broiled on the retail premises;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} poultry, poultry meat or poultry meat by-products
    that are barbecued, roasted or broiled on the retail premises;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} horse-meat or horse-meat by-product;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any substance or mixture of substances for use as a
    food additive or food additive preparation; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} flour and whole wheat flour that has been treated
    with gamma radiation from Cobalt 60 Source.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/79-23, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/79-23, s. 2
:::

- **[[B.01.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} All or part of the label referred to
  in section B.01.003 shall be applied

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a prepackaged product, to the
    container in which the prepackaged product is sold; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a food that is not a prepackaged
    product, to the food itself.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The label shall be applied in such a manner that the
  container of the prepackaged product or the food, as the case may be,
  will bear the label at the time it is sold.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-300, s. 3
:::

- **[[B.01.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (5),
  the information required to be shown on a label shall not be shown on
  that part of the label, if any, that is applied to the bottom of a
  food or container.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information required to be shown on a label may
  be shown on that part of the label, if any, that is applied to the
  bottom of a food or to the bottom of a container if such information
  is also shown in those parts of the label that are not applied to the
  bottom of the food or container.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), if the container of a
  prepackaged product is an ornamental container and the label is
  applied to the bottom of the container, the information required to be
  shown may be shown on the label that is applied to the bottom of the
  container.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), the information required by
  subparagraph B.01.007(1.1)(b)(i) and paragraphs B.24.103(g),
  B.24.202(d), B.24.304(h), B.25.020(1)(h) and B.25.057(1)(f) and (2)(f)
  may be shown on that part of the label that is applied to the bottom
  of the package if a reference to where that information is located on
  the label appears elsewhere on the label.

- [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), the information required by
  paragraph B.27.005(a) may be shown on that part of the label that is
  applied to the bottom of the package.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), the nutrition facts table,
  supplemented food facts table and list of cautionary statements may be
  shown on that part of the label that is applied to the bottom of the
  food or container if the available display surface includes the
  bottom.
