- **[[B.01.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The common name of the food shall be
  shown on the principal display panel.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), the common name of a
  fresh fruit or fresh vegetable that is prepackaged in such a manner
  that the fruit or vegetable is visible and identifiable in the package
  is not required to be shown on the label.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/79-23, s. 3
- SOR/92-626, s. 5
:::

**[[B.01.006.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.006.1 .sectionLabel}** Except as
otherwise provided in these Regulations or in the [Safe Food for
Canadians Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108), if a prepackaged
product is likely to be mistaken for another food, words describing the
true nature of the prepackaged product so as to distinguish it from the
other food shall appear on the principal display panel and may be in
regard to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its type of liquid packaging medium, including brine,
  vegetable oil or syrup;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its style or form, including firm, extra firm, whole,
  sliced or diced; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} its condition, including dried, concentrated,
  reconstituted, carbonated or smoked, which, if shown, shall form part
  of the common name.

- **[[B.01.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[packaging
  date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the date on which a food is placed for the first
    time in a package in which it will be offered for sale to a
    consumer; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date on which a prepackaged product is weighed
    by a retailer in a package in which it will be offered for sale for
    the first time to a consumer.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The following information shall be shown on any
  part of the label:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the identity and principal place of business of the
    person by or for whom the food was manufactured or produced;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where a prepackaged product having a durable life
    of 90 days or less is packaged at a place other than the retail
    premises from which it is to be sold,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the durable life date, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} instructions for the proper storage of the
      prepackaged product if it requires storage conditions that differ
      from normal room temperature; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where a prepackaged product having a durable life
    of 90 days or less is packaged on the retail premises from which it
    is to be sold,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the packaging date, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the durable life of the food, except when the
      durable life appears on a poster next to the food.

- [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} The packaging date referred to in
  paragraph (1.1)(c) shall be shown in the form and manner prescribed
  for the durable life date by subsections (4) and (5) and the terms
  "best before" and "[meilleur avant]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" on the
  label shall be replaced by the terms "packaged on" and "[empaqueté
  le]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1.1)(a) does not apply to fresh fruits or
  fresh vegetables that are prepackaged on retail premises in such a
  manner that the fruits or vegetables are visible and identifiable in
  the package.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1.1)(b) and (c) do not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products consisting of fresh fruits or
    fresh vegetables;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged individual portions of food that are
    served by a restaurant or other commercial enterprise with meals or
    snacks;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged individual servings of food that are
    prepared by a commissary and sold by automatic vending machines or
    mobile canteens; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged donuts.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The durable life date shall be shown in the following
  manner:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the words "best before" and "[meilleur
    avant]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" shall be shown grouped together with
    the durable life date unless a clear explanation of the significance
    of the durable life date appears elsewhere on the label;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where, for the sake of clarity, it is necessary to
    show the year in which the durable life date occurs, the year shall
    be shown first and shall be expressed by at least the last two
    numbers of the year;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the month shall be shown in words after the year,
    if the year is shown, and may be abbreviated as prescribed by
    subsection (5); and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the day of the month shall be shown after the month
    and shall be expressed in numbers.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The month of the durable life date, when abbreviated,
  shall be abbreviated as follows and only one such abbreviation shall
  be used for the English language and the French language:

  </ul>
  </figure>

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in these Regulations, no
  person shall use a durable life date marking system on the label of a
  prepackaged product or in advertising a prepackaged product other than
  the marking system set out in this section.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1.1)(b) does not apply to prepackaged
  fresh yeast, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the date on which it is estimated that the product
    has lost its effectiveness is shown on the label in the form and
    manner prescribed for the durable life date by subsections (4) and
    (5); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the terms "best before" and "[meilleur
    avant]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" are replaced by the terms "use by" and
    "[employez avant]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

- **[[B.01.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.008
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following information shall be
  shown grouped together on any part of the label:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any information required by these Regulations,
    other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information required to appear on the
      principal display panel, nutrition facts table or supplemented
      food facts table,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information required by subsection
      B.01.005(4), sections B.01.007, B.01.301, B.01.305, B.01.311,
      B.01.503, B.01.513 and B.01.601, paragraphs B.24.103(g),
      B.24.202(d), B.24.304(h), B.25.020(1)(e), (f) and (h),
      B.25.057(1)(f) and (2)(f), B.27.005(a) and sections B.29.020 and
      B.29.026, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any statement required to be shown on the label
      of a supplemented food in accordance with column 5 of the List of
      Permitted Supplemental Ingredients; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where a prepackaged product consists of more than
    one ingredient, a list of all ingredients, including, subject to
    section B.01.009, components, if any.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products packaged from bulk on retail
    premises, except prepackaged products that are a mixture of nuts;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged individual portions of food that are
    intended solely to be served by a restaurant or other commercial
    enterprise with meals or snacks;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged individual servings of food that are
    prepared by a commissary and sold by automatic vending machines or
    mobile canteens;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged meat and meat by-products that are
    barbecued, roasted or broiled on the retail premises;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged poultry, poultry meat or poultry meat
    by-products that are barbecued, roasted or broiled on the retail
    premises;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products that comply with the standards
    set out in sections 2.1.1 to 2.1.4, 2.2.1, 2.3.1, 2.3.2, 2.4.1 to
    2.4.7, 2.5.1, 2.6.1, 2.7.1 to 2.7.8, 2.8.1, 2.8.2 and 2.9.1 of
    Volume 2 of the Food Compositional Standards Document;

  - [(f.1)]{.lawlabel} Scotch whisky, Irish whisky, Armagnac brandy,
    Cognac brandy, Bourbon whisky, Tennessee whisky, Tequila and Mezcal;
    or

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products that comply with the standards
    set out in sections 16.1.1 to 16.1.5 of Volume 16 of the Food
    Compositional Standards Document.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (1)(b), the following items are not
  required to be shown on the label of a prepackaged product:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} wax coating compounds and their components, used as
    an ingredient or component of prepackaged fresh fruit or vegetables;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sausage casings, used as an ingredient or component
    of prepackaged sausages;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} hydrogen, used as an ingredient or component of a
    prepackaged product if used for hydrogenation purposes;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} components of ingredients of a sandwich, if the
    sandwich is made with bread; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} added water used as an ingredient that has been
    removed during the manufacture of the prepackaged product.

- [(4) to (10)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2016-305, s. 4\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.01.008.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.008.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Information appearing on the label
  of a prepackaged product according to sections B.01.008.2 to
  B.01.010.4, B.16.016 and B.29.020 must be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a single colour of type that is a visual
    equivalent of 100% solid black type on a white background or a
    uniform neutral background with a maximum 5% tint of colour;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in a single standard sans serif font that is not
    decorative and in a manner that the characters never touch each
    other or any differentiating feature under subsection B.01.008.2(2);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in type of normal or condensed width that is not
    scaled down so that the characters take up less space horizontally
    and, if a nutrition facts table or supplemented food facts table
    appears on the label, the width of type must be the same as that
    required for the type used to show the nutrients that appear in the
    nutrition facts table or the supplemental ingredients that appear in
    the supplemented food facts table, as the case may be;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in regular type, except as otherwise provided in
    those sections; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in type that is the same height that is not less
    than 1.1 mm with identical leading of not less than 2.5 mm, except
    as otherwise provided in this section or those sections.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (1)(a), a list of ingredients
  appearing on the label of the following prepackaged products is not
  required to be shown on a white background or a uniform neutral
  background with a maximum 5% tint of colour:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a prepackaged product that is intended solely for
    use as an ingredient in the manufacture of other prepackaged
    products intended for sale to a consumer at the retail level or as
    an ingredient in the preparation of food by a commercial or
    industrial enterprise or an institution; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a prepackaged product that is a ready-to-serve
    multiple-serving prepackaged product intended solely to be served in
    a commercial or industrial enterprise or an institution.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in subsection (4) and
  sections B.01.008.2 to B.01.010.4, if a nutrition facts table or
  supplemented food facts table appears on the label of a prepackaged
  product and the type size of the nutrients shown in the nutrition
  facts table or the supplemental ingredients shown in the supplemented
  food facts table is not less than 8 points, the information referred
  to in subsection (1) must be shown in type that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the same height as the type in which the nutrients
    are shown in the nutrition facts table or the supplemental
    ingredients are shown in the supplemented food facts table, as the
    case may be; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} of a height that is not less than 1.4 mm with
    identical leading of not less than 3.2 mm.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A title that introduces a list of ingredients, [[a
  food allergen source, gluten source and added sulphites
  statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in subsection
  B.01.010.1(1), a declaration referred to in subsection B.01.010.4(1)
  or a list of cautionary statements may be shown in type that is of a
  greater height than the type used to show the information in either of
  the lists, the statement or the declaration, as the case may be.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If more than one of the titles referred to in
  subsection (4) appears on a label, the characters of each title must
  be of the same height.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, the
  [[height]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} of type means the height of the lower
  case letter "x".

- **[[B.01.008.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.008.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A list of ingredients shall be
  introduced by a title that shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} consist of the term

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} "Ingredients", "Ingredients:" or "Ingredients :"
      in the English version of the list, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} "[Ingrédients]{.otherLang lang="fr"}",
      "[Ingrédients]{.otherLang lang="fr"}:" or
      "[Ingrédients]{.otherLang lang="fr"}:" in the French version of
      the list;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be shown in bold type; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be shown without any intervening printed, written
    or graphic material appearing between the title and the first
    ingredient shown in the list.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A list of ingredients shall be shown in a manner that
  clearly differentiates it on the label, by means of one or both of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} graphics in the form of a solid-line border around
    the list or one or more solid lines appearing immediately above,
    below or at the sides of the list that are the same colour as that
    of the type used to show the information referred to in subsection
    B.01.008.1(1); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a background colour that creates a contrast between
    the background colour of the list and the background colour used on
    the adjacent surface of the label, other than the surface used to
    display

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a [[food allergen source, gluten source and added
      sulphites statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
      subsection B.01.010.1(1),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a declaration referred to in subsection
      B.01.010.4(1),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any statement referred to in subsection
      B.16.016(1),

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a nutrition facts table,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a supplemented food facts table, or

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a list of cautionary statements.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} In a list of ingredients, ingredients shall be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in descending order of their proportion by weight
    of the prepackaged product, determined before they are combined to
    form the prepackaged product;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in lower case letters, except that upper case
    letters shall be used to show

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the first letter of each ingredient or, in the
      case of a food additive or supplemental ingredient shown in whole
      or in part by an acronym, the entire acronym, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the alpha-descriptor that forms a part of the
      common name for a food additive, vitamin, supplemental ingredient
      or microorganism; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} separated by a bullet point or a comma.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (3)(a), the following ingredients
  may be shown at the end of the list of ingredients, in any order:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} spices, herbs and other seasonings, other than salt
    added separately, if the total weight of those other seasonings is
    no more than two per cent of the total weight of ingredients used in
    the manufacture of the prepackaged product excluding added water
    used as an ingredient that has been removed during its manufacture;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} natural flavours and artificial flavours;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} flavour enhancers;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} food additives, except ingredients of food additive
    preparations or mixtures of substances for use as a food additive;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} vitamins;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} salts or derivatives of vitamins;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} mineral nutrients;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} salts of mineral nutrients; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} supplemental ingredients.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} In a list of ingredients, the components of an
  ingredient shall be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in parentheses, immediately after the ingredient,
    unless the source of a food allergen or gluten is shown immediately
    after the ingredient, in which case components of the ingredient
    shall be shown immediately after that source;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in descending order of their proportion by weight
    of the ingredient, determined before the components are combined to
    form the ingredient;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in lower case letters, except that upper case
    letters shall be used to show

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a food additive or supplemental
      ingredient shown in whole or in part by an acronym, the entire
      acronym, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the alpha-descriptor that forms a part of the
      common name for a food additive, vitamin, supplemental ingredient
      or microorganism; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} separated by a comma.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph B.01.008(1)(b) and paragraphs
  (5)(a) and (b), but subject to section B.01.009, if one or more
  components of an ingredient are required by these Regulations to be
  shown in a list of ingredients, the ingredient is not required to be
  shown in the list if all components of the ingredient are shown in the
  list by their common names and in accordance with subsection (3) as if
  they were ingredients.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} In a list of ingredients, the source of a food
  allergen or gluten shall be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} immediately after the ingredient or component to
    which it applies in accordance with subsections B.01.010.1(8) and
    (10);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} entirely in lower case letters; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} separated by a comma from any other source of a
    food allergen or gluten that is shown for the same ingredient or
    component.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} If the English and French versions of a list of
  ingredients appear on the label, they shall be displayed on a
  continuous surface of the available display surface, but need not be
  on the same continuous surface of the available display surface.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} If the English and French versions of a list of
  ingredients appear on the same continuous surface of the label, the
  version that follows the other version shall not begin on the same
  line as that on which the other version ends, except in the case of a
  prepackaged product that has an available display surface of less than
  100 cm^2^.

- **[[B.01.008.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.008.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product contains
  one or more sugars-based ingredients, despite the order of
  presentation referred to in paragraph B.01.008.2(3)(a), the
  sugars-based ingredient or ingredients shall be shown in the list of
  ingredients, in parentheses, immediately following the term

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "Sugars" in the English version of the list; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "[Sucres]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" in the French
    version of the list.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The term "Sugars" referred to in subsection (1) shall
  be shown in the list of ingredients

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in descending order of the proportion by weight of
    all the sugars-based ingredients in the prepackaged product, before
    they are combined to form the product; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} separated from other ingredients by a bullet point
    or a comma.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Each sugars-based ingredient mentioned immediately
  following the term "Sugars" shall be shown,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} despite paragraph B.01.008.2(3)(b), entirely in
    lower case letters; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of more than one sugars-based
    ingredient,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in descending order of its proportion by weight
      of the prepackaged product as prescribed by subsection
      B.01.008.2(3), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} separated by a comma.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) to (3) do not apply to the following
  prepackaged products:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a sweetening agent;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} fruit or vegetable juice or vegetable drink that
    does not contain any sweetening agent, as well as any mixture of
    those juices and drinks, including any of those juices and drinks

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to which fruit or vegetable purée or any mixture
      of those purées has been added,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that are reconstituted, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} that are a concentrate intended for dilution
      and consumption as juice or drink;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} fruit or vegetable purée that does not contain any
    sweetening agent as well as any mixture of those purées;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products that contain only one
    sugars-based ingredient that contains the word "sugar" in its common
    name;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} formulated liquid diets, human milk fortifiers and
    human milk substitutes; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products that contain less than 0.5 g
    of sugars per serving of stated size.

  </tr>
  <tr>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">26</td>
  <td class="noBorderBottom top alignleft">vegetable or animal fats or
  oils that comply with the standards set out in sections 8.1.1 to 8.1.9,
  8.2.1 to 8.2.4 and 8.3.1 to 8.3.3 of Volume 8 of the Food Compositional
  Standards Document, and modified, interesterified or fully hydrogenated
  vegetable or animal fats or oils, if the total amount of those fats and
  oils is less than 15 per cent of the prepackaged product</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">27</td>
  <td class="noBorderBottom top alignleft">prepared or preserved meat,
  fish, poultry meat, meat by-product or poultry by-product when the total
  amount of those ingredients is less than 10 per cent of a prepackaged
  product that consists of an unstandardized food</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>

  fluorinated water</td>

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), where a preparation or
  mixture set out in the table to this subsection is added to a food,
  the ingredients and components of the preparation or mixture are not
  required to be shown on the label of that food.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a preparation or mixture set out in the table
  to subsection (2) is added to a food, and the preparation or mixture
  contains one or more of the following ingredients or components, those
  ingredients or components shall be shown by their common names in the
  list of the ingredients of the food to which they are added as if they
  were ingredients of that food:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} salt;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} glutamic acid or its salts;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} hydrolyzed plant protein;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} aspartame;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} potassium chloride;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any ingredient or component that performs a
    function in, or has any effect on, that food; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} any supplemental ingredient.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsections (1) and (2), where any of
  the following components is contained in an ingredient set out in the
  tables to those subsections, that component shall be shown in the list
  of ingredients:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} peanut oil;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} fully hydrogenated peanut oil; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} modified peanut oil.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2011-28, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.01.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[common
  name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a name set out in the Common Names
  for Ingredients and Components Document.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An ingredient or component shall be shown in the list
  of ingredients by its common name.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the ingredient or component set out in the Common
    Names for Ingredients and Components Document shall be shown in the
    list of ingredients by the common name of that ingredient or
    component that is set out in that Document; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the ingredient or component set out in the Common
    Names for Ingredients and Components Document may be shown in the
    list of ingredients by the common name of that ingredient or
    component that is set out in that Document.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2) and subsection B.01.008.2(5),
  if a food contains ingredients of the same class, those ingredients
  may be shown by a class name if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} they consist of more than one component and are not
    listed in the table to subsection B.01.009(1); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} their components are shown

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} immediately after the class name of the
      ingredients of which they are components, in such a manner as to
      indicate that they are components of the ingredients, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in descending order of their collective
      proportion by weight of those ingredients.

- **[[B.01.010.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.010.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section and in sections B.01.010.2 to B.01.010.4.

  [[food allergen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[food allergen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any protein from any
      of the following foods, or any modified protein, including any
      protein fraction, that is derived from any of the following foods:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} almonds, Brazil nuts, cashews, hazelnuts,
        macadamia nuts, pecans, pine nuts, pistachios or walnuts;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} peanuts;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} sesame seeds;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} wheat or triticale;

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} eggs;

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} milk;

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} soybeans;

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} crustaceans;

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} molluscs;

      - [(j)]{.lawlabel} fish; or

      - [(k)]{.lawlabel} mustard seeds. ([allergène
        alimentaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[food allergen source, gluten source and added sulphites statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[food allergen source, gluten source and added sulphites
      statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a statement appearing on the
      label of a prepackaged product that indicates the source of a food
      allergen or gluten that is present in the product or the presence
      in the product of added sulphites in a total amount of 10 p.p.m.
      or more. ([mention des sources d'allergènes alimentaires ou de
      gluten et des sulfites ajoutés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[gluten]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[gluten]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any gluten protein from the grain of any of the
        following cereals or from the grain of a hybridized strain that
        is created from at least one of the following cereals:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} barley,

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} oats,

        - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} rye,

        - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} triticale,

        - [(v)]{.lawlabel} wheat; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any modified gluten protein, including any
        gluten protein fraction, that is derived from the grain of any
        of the cereals referred to in paragraph (a) or from the grain of
        a hybridized strain referred to in that
        paragraph. ([gluten]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[height]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[height]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of type, means the
      height of the lower case letter "x". ([hauteur]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a food allergen or gluten is present in a
  prepackaged product, the source of the food allergen or gluten, as the
  case may be, must be shown on the label of the product in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the list of ingredients; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in a food allergen source, gluten source and added
    sulphites statement.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to a food allergen or
  gluten that is present in a prepackaged product as a result of
  cross-contamination.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to a to a food allergen
  or gluten that is present in a prepackaged product referred to in
  paragraphs B.01.008(2)(a) to (e) unless a list of ingredients is shown
  on the product's label.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2019-98, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The source of a food allergen required to be shown
  under subsection (2) must be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for a food allergen from a food referred to in one
    of paragraphs (a), (b) and (e) of the definition [[food
    allergen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) or derived from
    that food, by the name of the food as shown in the applicable
    paragraph, expressed in the singular or plural;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for a food allergen from the food referred to in
    paragraph (c) of the definition [[food
    allergen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) or derived from
    that food, by the name "sesame", "sesame seed" or "sesame seeds";

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} for a food allergen from a food referred to in one
    of paragraphs (d) and (f) of the definition [[food
    allergen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) or derived from
    that food, by the name of the food as shown in the applicable
    paragraph;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} for a food allergen from the food referred to in
    paragraph (g) of the definition [[food
    allergen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) or derived from
    that food, by the name "soy", "soya", "soybean" or "soybeans";

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} for a food allergen from a food referred to in one
    of paragraphs (h) to (j) of the definition [[food
    allergen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) or derived from
    that food, by the common name of the food that is set out in the
    Common Names for Ingredients and Components Document; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} for a food allergen from the food referred to in
    paragraph (k) of the definition [[food
    allergen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) or derived from
    that food, by the name "mustard", "mustard seed" or "mustard seeds".

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} The source of gluten required to be shown under
  subsection (2) must be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for gluten from the grain of a cereal referred to
    in one of subparagraphs (a)(i) to (v) of the definition
    [[gluten]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) or derived from
    that grain, by the name of the cereal as shown in the applicable
    subparagraph; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for gluten from the grain of a hybridized strain
    created from one or more of the cereals referred to in subparagraphs
    (a)(i) to (v) of the definition [[gluten]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in
    subsection (1) or derived from that grain, by the names of the
    cereals as shown in the applicable subparagraphs.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph (2)(a), the source of
  the food allergen or gluten must be shown in the list of ingredients,
  in parentheses, as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} immediately after the ingredient that is shown in
    that list, if the food allergen or gluten

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is that ingredient,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is present in that ingredient, but is not a
      component of or present in a component of that ingredient, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} is, or is present in, a component of that
      ingredient and the component is not shown in the list of
      ingredients; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} immediately after the component that is shown in
    the list of ingredients, if the food allergen or gluten is that
    component or is present in that component.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), the source of the food
  allergen or gluten must be shown on the label of the product in the
  food allergen source, gluten source and added sulphites statement if
  the food allergen or gluten

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is, or is present in, an ingredient that is not
    shown in the list of ingredients, but is not a component of that
    ingredient or present in a component of that ingredient; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is, or is present in, a component and neither the
    component nor the ingredient in which it is present is shown in the
    list of ingredients.

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (8), the source of the food
  allergen or gluten is not required to be shown in parentheses
  immediately after the ingredient or component, as the case may be, if
  the source of the food allergen or gluten appears

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the list of ingredients

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} as part of the common name of the ingredient or
      component, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in parentheses, under subsection (8),
      immediately after another ingredient or component; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the food allergen source, gluten source and
    added sulphites statement.

- [(11)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, nothing in subsection (8)
  affects how an ingredient or component may be shown in the list of
  ingredients under paragraph B.01.010(3)(b).

- **[[B.01.010.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.010.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section and in section
  B.01.010.3, [[sulphites]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the food additives
  that are set out in the Common Names for Ingredients and Components
  Document and are present in a prepackaged product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the definition
  [[sulphites]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) includes only
  sulphites that are present in the prepackaged product as a result of
  being added.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If sulphites are present in a prepackaged product in
  a total amount of 10 parts per million or more and none are required
  to be shown in the list of ingredients under section B.01.008 or
  B.01.009, the sulphites must be shown on the label of the product in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the list of ingredients; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the food allergen source, gluten source and added
    sulphites statement that complies with the requirements of
    subsection B.01.010.3(1).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (3) does not apply to sulphites present in
  the prepackaged products referred to in paragraphs B.01.008(2)(a)
  to (e) unless a list of ingredients is shown on the product's label.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2019-98, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Sulphites that are shown on a label of the product
  under subsection (3) must be shown as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the sulphites are shown in the list of
    ingredients,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} by one of the common names "sulfites", "sulfiting
      agents", "sulphites" or "sulphiting agents", or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} individually by the name of the food additive
      that is set out in the Common Names for Ingredients and Components
      Document, except that the name "sodium dithionite", "sulphur
      dioxide" or "sulphurous acid" must be followed, in parentheses, by
      one of the common names "sulfites", "sulfiting agents",
      "sulphites" or "sulphiting agents"; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the sulphites are shown in a food allergen
    source, gluten source and added sulphites statement, by one of the
    common names "sulfites", "sulfiting agents", "sulphites" or
    "sulphiting agents".

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Sulphites that are shown in the list of ingredients
  under paragraph (6)(a) must be shown as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sulphites that are a component of an ingredient
    that is shown in the list of ingredients must be shown either in
    parentheses immediately after the ingredient or at the end of that
    list where they may be shown in any order with the other ingredients
    that are shown at the end of that list in accordance with subsection
    B.01.008.2(4); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in all other cases, the sulphites must be shown at
    the end of the list of ingredients where they may be shown in any
    order with the other ingredients that are shown at the end of that
    list in accordance with subsection B.01.008.2(4).

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} If sulphites are present in a prepackaged product in
  a total amount of 10 parts per million or more and any of them are
  required to be shown in the list of ingredients under section B.01.008
  or B.01.009, in the case of sulphites shown individually by the name
  "sodium dithionite", "sulphur dioxide" or "sulphurous acid", that name
  must be followed, in parentheses, by one of the common names
  "sulfites", "sulfiting agents", "sulphites" or "sulphiting agents".

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} If the total amount of sulphites present in the
  prepackaged product is 10 parts per million or more, sulphites that
  are required to be shown in a list of ingredients under section
  B.01.008 or B.01.009 may also be shown on the label of the product in
  a food allergen source, gluten source and added sulphites statement
  that complies with the requirements of subsection B.01.010.3(1).

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} Despite subparagraph (6)(a)(ii) and subsection (8),
  if sulphites are shown individually in a list of ingredients, by the
  name "sodium dithionite", "sulphur dioxide" or "sulphurous acid", that
  name is not required to be followed, in parentheses, by one of the
  common names "sulfites", "sulfiting agents", "sulphites" or
  "sulphiting agents" if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the list of ingredients,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the term "sulfite" or "sulphite" appears in the
      common name of another sulphite, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} one of the common names "sulfites", "sulfiting
      agents", "sulphites" or "sulphiting agents" is shown in
      parentheses following another sulphite; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} one of the common names "sulfites", "sulfiting
    agents", "sulphites" or "sulphiting agents" is shown in a food
    allergen source, gluten source and added sulphites statement on the
    label of the product.

- **[[B.01.010.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.010.3
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A food allergen source, gluten
  source and added sulphites statement must

  - [a)]{.lawlabel} be introduced by a title that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} consists of the terms

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} "Contains", "Contains:" or "Contains :" in the
        English version of the statement, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} "[Contient]{.otherLang lang="fr"}",
        "[Contient :]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" or "[Contient :]{.otherLang
        lang="fr"}" in the French version of the statement,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is shown in bold type,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} is shown without any intervening printed,
      written or graphic material appearing between it and the rest of
      the statement, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} if the statement is preceded by a statement
      referred to in subsection B.16.016(1) and begins on the line on
      which that statement ends, is shown in a type that is of a height
      that is at least 0.2 mm greater than the height of the type used
      in that statement;

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} appear, in respect of each linguistic version,
    immediately after any statement referred to in subsection
    B.16.016(1) appearing in the same language or, if there is no such
    statement, immediately after the list of ingredients appearing in
    the same language and, in either case, without any intervening
    printed, written or graphic material;

  - [(a.2)]{.lawlabel} appear on the same continuous surface as the
    statement or list that immediately precedes it and be shown in the
    same manner as the list of ingredients is shown under subsection
    B.01.008.2(2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include all of the following information, even if
    all or part of that information is also shown in the list of
    ingredients:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the source for each food allergen that is present
      in the prepackaged product,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} each source for the gluten that is present in
      the product, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} one of the common names "sulfites", "sulfiting
      agents", "sulphites" or "sulphiting agents", if the total amount
      of sulphites present in the product is 10 parts per million or
      more; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} show information entries in regular or bold type,
    using lower case letters except for the first letter of each entry,
    which shall be an upper case letter, and shall use a bullet point or
    comma to separate each entry.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (1)(b), the following information
  is not required to be shown in the statement more than once:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the same source of a food allergen;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the same source of gluten; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} one of the common names "sulfites", "sulfiting
    agents", "sulphites" or "sulphiting agents".

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the English and French versions of the statement
  appear on the same continuous surface of the label, the version that
  follows the other version shall not begin on the same line as that on
  which the other version ends, except in the case of a prepackaged
  product that has an available display surface of less than 100 cm^2^.

- **[[B.01.010.4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.010.4
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the label of a prepackaged
  product includes a declaration alerting consumers that, due to a risk
  of cross-contamination, the product may contain the source of a food
  allergen or gluten,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the declaration must appear immediately after

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the food allergen source, gluten source and added
      sulphites statement, if there is one,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any statement referred to in subsection
      B.16.016(1), if no food allergen source, gluten source and added
      sulphites statement appears on the label, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the list of ingredients, if neither of the
      statements referred to in subparagraph (ii) appears on the label;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the declaration must appear in both English and
    French if the statement or list immediately preceding it appears in
    both languages;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the declaration must appear on the same continuous
    surface as the statement or list that immediately precedes it and be
    shown in the same manner as the list of ingredients is shown under
    subsection B.01.008.2(2);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the declaration must appear without any intervening
    printed, written or graphic material between it and the statement or
    list that immediately precedes it, except that a solid line may
    appear before the declaration if the declaration begins on a
    different line than the line on which the statement or list ends;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the declaration must be shown in bold type if it
    begins on the line on which the statement or list that immediately
    precedes it ends and if it is not introduced by a title;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any title that introduces the declaration must be
    shown in bold type if the declaration begins on the line on which
    the statement or list that immediately precedes it ends; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} if the declaration is preceded by a statement
    referred to in subsection B.16.016(1) and begins on the line on
    which the statement ends, the title of the declaration --- or the
    declaration itself, if no title appears --- must be shown in a type
    that is of a height that is at least 0.2 mm greater than the height
    of the type used in the statement.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the English and French versions of the declaration
  appear on the same continuous surface of the label, the version that
  follows the other version must not begin on the line on which the
  other version ends unless the prepackaged product has an available
  display surface of less than 100 cm^2^.

- **[[B.01.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where it is an acceptable
  manufacturing practice for a manufacturer to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} omit from his prepackaged product any food that is
    ordinarily an ingredient or component, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} substitute in whole or in part in his prepackaged
    product any other food for a food that is ordinarily an ingredient
    or component,

  the list of ingredients for the 12-month period commencing from the
  time the label is applied to the prepackaged product may show as
  ingredients or components the foods that may be omitted and the foods
  that may be used as substitutes if

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} all the foods that may be used as ingredients or
    components throughout the 12-month period are shown in the list of
    ingredients;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} it is clearly stated as part of the list of
    ingredients that the food shown as an ingredient or component may
    not be present or that another food may be substituted for a food
    shown as an ingredient or component; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the foods that may be omitted or substituted are
    grouped with the same class of foods that are used as ingredients or
    components and the foods within each such group are listed in
    descending order of the proportion by weight in which they will
    probably be used during the 12-month period.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where it is an acceptable manufacturing practice for
  a manufacturer to vary the proportions of ingredients or components of
  his prepackaged product, the list of ingredients for the 12-month
  period commencing from the time the label is applied to the
  prepackaged product may show the ingredients or components in the same
  proportions throughout the 12-month period if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is clearly stated as part of the list of
    ingredients that the proportions indicated are subject to change;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the ingredients or components are listed in
    descending order of the proportion by weight in which they will
    probably be used during the 12-month period.

- **[[B.01.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.012
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section,

  [[local government unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[local government unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a city,
      metropolitan government area, town, village, municipality or other
      area of local government but does not include any local government
      unit situated within a bilingual district established under the
      [Official Languages Act](/eng/acts/O-3.01); ([collectivité
      locale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[local food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[local food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food that is
      manufactured, processed, produced or packaged in a local
      government unit and sold only in

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the local government unit in which it is
        manufactured, processed or packaged,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} one or more local government units that are
        immediately adjacent to the one in which it is manufactured,
        processed, produced or packaged, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the local government unit in which it is
        manufactured, processed, produced or packaged and in one or more
        local government units that are immediately adjacent to the one
        in which it is manufactured, processed, produced or
        packaged; ([produit alimentaire local]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[mother tongue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mother tongue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the language first
      learned in childhood by persons in any area of Canada and still
      understood by them as ascertained by the decennial census taken
      immediately preceding the date on which the food referred to in
      subsection (3) is sold to the consumer; ([langue
      maternelle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[official languages]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[official languages]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the English
      language and the French language; ([langues
      officielles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specialty food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specialty food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food --- other than
      a human milk fortifier or supplemented food --- that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has special religious significance and is used
        in religious ceremonies; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is an imported food

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that is not widely used by the population as
          a whole in Canada, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} for which there is no readily available
          substitute that is manufactured, processed, produced or
          packaged in Canada and that is generally accepted as being a
          comparable substitute; ([aliment spécial]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

  [[test market food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[test market food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food that, prior
      to the date of the notice of intention respecting that food
      referred to in subsection (5), was not sold in Canada in that form
      and that differs substantially from any other food sold in Canada
      with respect to its composition, function, state or packaging form
      and includes a food referred to in section B.01.054. ([produit
      alimentaire d'essai]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (9), (10) and (11), all
  information required by these Regulations to be shown on the label of
  a food shall be shown in both official languages.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4) to (6), subsection (2)
  does not apply to a local food or test market food if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is sold in a local government unit in which one
    of the official languages is the mother tongue of less than 10 per
    cent of the total number of persons residing in the local government
    unit; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information required by these Regulations to be
    shown on the label of a food is shown in the official language that
    is the mother tongue of at least 10 per cent of the total number of
    persons residing in the local government unit.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where one of the official languages is the mother
  tongue of less than 10 per cent of the total number of persons
  residing in a local government unit and the other official language is
  the mother tongue of less than 10 per cent of the total number of
  persons residing in the same local government unit, subsection (3)
  does not apply.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (3) does not apply to a test market food
  unless the person who intends to conduct the test marketing of the
  food has, six weeks prior to conducting the test marketing, filed with
  the President of the Canadian Food Inspection Agency a notice of
  intention in a form acceptable to the President.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} A test market food shall, for the purposes of
  subsection (3), cease to be a test market food upon the expiration of
  12 cumulative months after the date on which it was first offered for
  sale as a test market food but any test market food that was acquired
  for resale by a person, other than the person who filed the notice of
  intention referred to in subsection (5), before the expiration of
  those 12 cumulative months, shall continue to be a test market food
  for the purposes of subsection (3) until it is sold.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to a specialty food if
  the information required by these Regulations to be shown on the label
  thereon is shown in one of the official languages.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} Where there are one or more surfaces on the label of
  a food that are of at least the same size and prominence as the
  principal display panel, the information required by these Regulations
  to be shown on the principal display panel may be shown in one
  official language if such information is shown in the other official
  language on one of those other surfaces.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to the identity and
  principal place of business of the person by or for whom the food was
  manufactured, processed, produced or packaged for resale if this
  information is shown in one of the official languages.

- **[[B.01.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.013
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Unless specifically required by the
  Act or these Regulations, no reference, direct or indirect, to the Act
  or to these Regulations shall be made on any label of, or in any
  advertisement for, a food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), the label of, or an
  advertisement for, a food may include a statement that a food
  "complies with the standard for (naming the common name of the food in
  respect of which the claim is made) in the [Food and Drug
  Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870)" if the food complies
  with the standard prescribed by these Regulations for that food and
  the manufacturer of the food has substantiated, by means of the
  results of tests carried out before the statement is made or by other
  evidence that exists before the statement is made, that the food
  complies with the standard.

- **[[B.01.033]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.033
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except in the case of a formulated
  liquid diet, human milk fortifier or human milk substitute, it is
  prohibited to sell a food represented in any manner as containing
  hydrolyzed or partially hydrolyzed collagen, hydrolyzed or partially
  hydrolyzed gelatin or hydrolyzed or partially hydrolyzed casein unless
  the label carries the following statement on the principal display
  panel in the same size type used for the common name:

  > ::: QuotedText
  > "CAUTION, DO NOT USE AS SOLE SOURCE OF NUTRITION".
  > :::

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[formulated liquid
  diet]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food that meets the requirements of
  sections B.24.101 to B.24.103.

**[[B.01.034]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.034 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/88-559, s. 7\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.01.035]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.035
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (8), where an
  irradiated food referred to in column 1 of the table to Division 26 is
  offered for sale as a prepackaged product, the principal display panel
  of the label applied to the package shall carry the symbol described
  in subsection (5).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where an irradiated food referred to in column 1 of
  the table to Division 26 is not a prepackaged product and is offered
  for sale, a sign that carries the symbol described in subsection (5)
  shall be displayed immediately next to the food.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The symbol required pursuant to subsection (1) or (2)
  shall appear in close proximity on the principal display panel
  referred to in subsection (1) or on the sign referred to in
  subsection (2) to one of the following statements or a written
  statement that has the same meaning:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "treated with radiation";

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "treated by irradiation"; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} "irradiated".

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a food referred to in column 1
  of the table to Division 26 that has been irradiated in the manner set
  out in subsection B.26.003(2) unless the requirements of
  subsections (1) to (3) are met.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsections (1) to (3), the
  symbol that indicates the irradiated food shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} have an outer diameter

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case referred to in subsection (1), equal
      to or greater than the height of the numerical quantity prescribed
      by paragraph 229(1)(a) and subsections 229(2) and (3) of the [Safe
      Food for Canadians Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108) for
      the declaration of net quantity of the package, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case referred to in subsection (2), not
      less than 5 cm; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be in the following form:

    <figure>
    <div class="imageGroupcenter">
    <img src="/images/CRC870img/CRC870_ef003.jpg"
    alt="Symbol for irradiated food consisting of a plant in a circle in which the top half of the circle is dashed." />
    </div>
    </figure>

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection B.01.009(1), any food
  referred to in column 1 of the table to Division 26 that is an
  ingredient or component of a prepackaged product and that has been
  irradiated shall, if the food constitutes 10 per cent or more of the
  prepackaged product, be included in the list of ingredients and
  preceded by the statement "irradiated".

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} The label attached to a shipping container that
  contains a food set out in column 1 of the table to Division 26 that
  has been subjected to the maximum absorbed dose set out in column 5
  shall carry the statement that is required by subsection (3) and the
  statement "Do not irradiate again.".

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} Where a shipping container constitutes the package of
  the prepackaged product, the label attached to the shipping container
  shall carry the statement required by subsection (7) but need not
  carry the symbol required by subsection (5).

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} Any advertising of an irradiated food referred to in
  column 1 of the table to Division 26 shall identify the food as having
  been irradiated.

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} The statements referred to in subsections (3)
  and (6) to (8) shall be in both official languages in accordance with
  subsection B.01.012(2).

**[[B.01.042]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.042 .sectionLabel}** If a standard
for a food is set out in the Food Compositional Standards Document:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the food must contain only the ingredients set out in
  the standard for the food;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the food must contain each ingredient in a quantity
  within any limits set out in the standard for that ingredient;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the food must be labelled and advertised in
  accordance with any requirements set out in the standard; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the food must comply with any other requirements set
  out in the standard in relation to the composition, strength, potency,
  purity, quality or other property of the food.

paragraph B.01.042(a), if a substance --- other than a supplemental
ingredient --- is required or permitted by a provision of these
Regulations in a food for which a standard is set out in the Food
Compositional Standards Document, that food must contain the required
substance and may contain the permitted substance.

- **[[B.01.047.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.047.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section.

  [[BSE]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[BSE]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means Bovine Spongiform
      Encephalopathy. ([ESB]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[specified risk material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[specified risk material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the skull, brain, trigeminal ganglia, eyes,
        tonsils, spinal cord and dorsal root ganglia of cattle aged 30
        months or older; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the distal ileum of cattle of all
        ages. ([matériel à risque spécifié]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or import for sale food that
  contains specified risk material.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply in respect of food that
  originates from a country that is designated as being free from BSE in
  accordance with section 7 of the [Health of Animals
  Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._296).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply in respect of food that
  is packaged for sale or imported for sale before the day on which this
  subsection comes into force.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-265, s. 1
:::

- **[[B.01.048]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.048
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any animal intended for consumption as food if any
    product containing any drug listed in subsection (2) has been
    administered to the animal;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any food that is derived from an animal if any
    product containing a drug listed in subsection (2) has been
    administered to the animal; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any food that is derived from an animal if the food
    contains any residue of a drug listed in subsection (2).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The drugs referred to in subsection (1) are

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} chloramphenicol and its salts and derivatives;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a 5-nitrofuran compound;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} clenbuterol and its salts and derivatives;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a 5-nitroimidazole compound; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} diethylstilbestrol and other stilbene compounds.

**[[B.01.049]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.049 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall use, in labelling, packaging, advertising or selling a food that
does not meet the requirements of the kashruth applicable to it, the
word "kosher" or any letters of the Hebrew alphabet or any other word,
expression, depiction, sign, symbol, mark, device or other
representation that indicates or that is likely to create an impression
that the food is kosher.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-300, s. 8
:::

**[[B.01.050]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.050 .sectionLabel}** A person must
not use, in labelling, packaging, advertising or selling a food, the
word "halal" --- or any letters of the Arabic alphabet or any other
word, expression, depiction, sign, symbol, mark, device or other
representation that indicates or that is likely to create an impression
that the food is halal --- unless the name of the person or body that
certified the food as halal is indicated on the label or package or in
the advertisement or sale.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-76, s. 1
:::

**[[B.01.053]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.053 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a product represented as a ready breakfast or instant
breakfast or by any similar designation unless each serving of stated
size of the product contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} not less than 4.0 mg. iron;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} Vitamin A, thiamine, riboflavin, niacin or
  niacinamide and Vitamin C;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a good dietary source of protein; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} where consumed as directed, not less than 300
  calories.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 13
- SOR/2016-305, s. 75(F)
:::

- **[[B.01.054]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.054
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In order to generate information in
  support of an amendment to the Regulations, the Minister may issue to
  the manufacturer or distributor of a food, where the food or the
  packaging, labelling or advertising of the food does not comply with
  the requirements of these Regulations, a Temporary Marketing
  Authorization Letter that authorizes the sale of the food described
  therein or the packaging, labelling or advertising of the food
  described therein for a specified period of time, within a designated
  area and in a specified quantity, in the manner specified in the
  Letter if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer or distributor of the food has
    supplied to the Minister the following information:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the purpose for which the temporary marketing
      authorization of the food is required,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a description of the food including a sample and
      proposed label,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a description of any proposed variation from
      the requirements of these Regulations,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} adequate data to show that the use of the food
      will not be detrimental to the health of the purchaser or user,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the proposed quantity of the food to be sold,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the proposed period of time required for such
      sale,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} the proposed area designated for such sale, and

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} such other data as the Minister may require;
      and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer or distributor of the food has
    agreed to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} describe the food on a label or in an
      advertisement in a manner that is not false, misleading or
      deceptive,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} use such marks or statements on the label or in
      any advertisement as the Minister may require,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} on request, submit to the Minister results of
      the temporary marketing, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} on request, withdraw the product from sale where
      the Minister is of the opinion that it is in the public interest
      to do so.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall, in any Temporary Marketing
  Authorization Letter issued pursuant to subsection (1), set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the common name and description of the food to be
    sold;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the manufacturer or
    distributor of the food;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the purpose for which the temporary marketing of
    the food is authorized;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of the food that is authorized for
    sale;

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} the type of packaging, labelling or advertising
    authorized in respect of the food where the Letter is intended to
    authorize a variation from a requirement of any provision of the
    Regulations respecting packaging, labelling or advertising;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the period of time during which the food may be
    sold; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the designated area within which the food may be
    sold.

::: HistoricalNote

- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

- **[[B.01.055]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.055
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A manufacturer or distributor named
  in a Temporary Marketing Authorization Letter issued pursuant to
  subsection B.01.054(1) may, for the purpose set out in the Letter,
  sell the food in the manner authorized in the Letter and package,
  label or advertise that food in the manner authorized in the Letter
  for the period of time, within the designated area and in the quantity
  set out in the Letter.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No provision of these Regulations made pursuant to
  paragraph 30(1)(b) of the Act applies in respect of a food or the
  packaging, labelling or advertising of a food for which a Temporary
  Marketing Authorization Letter has been issued pursuant to subsection
  B.01.054(1) to the extent that the food, or the packaging, labelling
  or advertising of the food, as authorized in the Letter, does not
  comply with that provision.

**[[B.01.071]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.071 .sectionLabel}** Where a
prepackaged product is a mixture of nuts, the percentage and common name
of the nut that is present in the product in the greatest amount by
weight shall be applied to the principal display panel of the package in
close proximity to the common name of the product.

**[[B.01.072]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.072
.sectionLabel}** Notwithstanding any requirement prescribed in Part B, a
food product that has been subjected to heat in the presence of a
vaporized liquid solution of smoke derived from hardwood, hardwood
sawdust or corn cobs may be described as "smoked".

::: HistoricalNote

- **[[B.01.080]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.080
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section,
  [[frozen]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means preserved by freezing temperature
  and does not include any surface freezing that may occur during
  holding and transportation.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where meat, meat by-products, poultry meat, poultry
  by-products or fish, or meat of any marine or fresh water animal, that
  has been frozen is thawed prior to sale, the words "previously frozen"
  shall be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} on the principal display panel in close proximity
    to the common name of the food and in letters at least as legible
    and conspicuous as those used in the common name;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} anywhere on the principal display panel in letters
    of not less than 1/4 of an inch (6.4 millimetres) in height; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} on a sign displayed adjacent to the food in letters
    that are easily visible and legible to a prospective purchaser.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where part of a food referred to in subsection (2)
  has been frozen and thawed prior to sale, the words "Made from fresh
  and frozen portions" or "Made from fresh and frozen (naming the food)"
  shall be shown in the manner described in paragraph (2)(a), (b) or
  (c).

- **[[B.01.090]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.090
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall offer for sale at
  retail any solid cut meat or solid cut poultry meat to which phosphate
  salts or water has been added, unless that meat or poultry meat is
  contained in a package and carries a label.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The label referred to in subsection (1) shall contain
  a statement of the minimum percentage of meat protein as part of the
  common name of the product on the principal display panel of the
  package in type that is as legible and conspicuous as any other type
  on that display panel, and in letters that are at least one half of

- **[[B.01.100]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.100
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The common name of a simulated meat
  product or simulated poultry product shall be the common name of the
  meat product or poultry product that is simulated, modified by the
  word "simulated".

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The word "simulated" in the common name of a
  simulated meat product or simulated poultry product shall be shown in
  letters of at least the same size and prominence as those used in the
  remainder of the common name of that product.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a simulated meat product or a simulated poultry
  product is not a prepackaged product, the common name of the product
  and the other information required by this section to be shown on the
  label of a simulated meat product or simulated poultry product shall
  be shown on a sign displayed on or adjacent to the product in letters
  that are legible and conspicuous to a prospective purchaser.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The words

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "contains no meat", in the case of a simulated meat
    product, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "contains no poultry", in the case of a simulated
    poultry product,

  shall be shown on the principal display panel of the label of a
  simulated meat product or simulated poultry product in close proximity
  to the common name and in letters of at least the same size and
  prominence as those shown in the common name.

- [(5) to (7)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/88-559, s. 11\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/88-336, s. 3

:::

- **[[B.01.101]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.101
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section and
  section B.01.102, [[source of protein]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any
  food that contains protein, but does not include spices, seasonings,
  flavours, artificial flavours, flavour enhancers, food additives and
  similar foods that contain only small amounts of protein.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The common name of a meat product extender shall be
  the common name of each food in the meat product extender that is a
  source of protein, plus

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the word "meat", or the common name of the meat
    product that is to be extended, plus the word "extender"; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the words "extender for" plus the common name of
    the meat product that is to be extended.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The common name of a poultry product extender shall
  be the common name of each food in the poultry product extender that
  is a source of protein, plus

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the word "poultry", or the common name of the
    poultry product that is to be extended plus the word "extender"; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the words "extender for" plus the common name of
    the poultry product that is to be extended.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Foods that are a source of protein in the meat
  product extender or poultry product extender shall be shown by their
  common names in the common name of that meat product extender or
  poultry product extender

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in descending order of their proportion by weight
    of the meat product extender or poultry product extender; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in letters of at least the same size and prominence
    as those used in the remainder of the common name of the meat
    product extender or poultry product extender.

- [(5) and (6)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/88-559, s. 12\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.01.102]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.102
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The common name of an extended meat
  product or an extended poultry product shall be the common name of the
  meat product or poultry product that is extended, modified by the
  common name of each of the foods that are sources of protein in the
  extended meat product or extended poultry product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the word or words "meat", "meat product",
    "poultry", "poultry meat" or "poultry meat by-product" as the case
    may be, may be used in the common name of an extended meat product
    or extended poultry product as the common name of the food therein
    that is a source of protein derived from a meat product or poultry
    product; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where it is an acceptable manufacturing practice
    for a manufacturer to omit from his meat product extender or poultry
    product extender any source of protein derived from a plant that is
    ordinarily an ingredient of that meat product extender or poultry
    product extender, or to substitute in whole or in part in his meat
    product extender or poultry product extender any source of protein
    derived from a plant for a source of protein that is ordinarily an
    ingredient of that meat product extender or poultry product
    extender, the word "plant" may be used in the common name of an
    extended meat product or extended poultry product as the common name
    of the food therein that is a source of protein derived from a
    plant.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Foods that are a source of protein in an extended
  meat product or extended poultry product shall be shown by their
  common names in the common name of that product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in descending order of their proportion by weight
    of that product; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in letters of at least the same size and prominence
    as those used in the remainder of the common name of that product.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where an extended meat product or extended poultry
  product is not a prepackaged product, the common name of that product
  and the information required by this section to be shown on the label
  of an extended meat product or extended poultry product shall be shown
  on a sign displayed on or adjacent to that product in letters that are
  legible and conspicuous to a prospective purchaser.

- [(5) to (7)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/88-559, s. 13\]]{.Repealed}

**[[B.01.300]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.300 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2003-11, s. 15\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.01.301]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.301
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall, on the label of or
  in any advertisement for a food, other than in the nutrition facts
  table or supplemented food facts table, if any, include a declaration
  of the food's energy value or the amount of a nutrient or supplemental
  ingredient contained in the food unless it is declared in the
  following manner, per serving of stated size:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the energy value, in Calories;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a vitamin referred to in subsection
    D.01.002(1) that is not one of the following vitamins, in the
    applicable unit set out in subsection D.01.003(1):

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} beta-carotene as a form of vitamin A or retinol,
      including its derivatives, as a form of vitamin A, or both, if
      either is a supplemental ingredient, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} niacin, if it is a supplemental ingredient;

  - [(b.01)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the following vitamins, in the
    applicable unit set out in column 3 of the List of Permitted
    Supplemental Ingredients:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} beta-carotene as a form of vitamin A or retinol,
      including its derivatives, as a form of vitamin A, or both, if
      either is a supplemental ingredient, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} niacin, if it is a supplemental ingredient;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the following mineral nutrients:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} for sodium, potassium, calcium, phosphorus,
      magnesium, iron, zinc, chloride, copper and manganese, in
      milligrams, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} for iodide, chromium, selenium and molybdenum,
      in micrograms;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of cholesterol, in milligrams;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the mineral ion content of
    prepackaged water or ice, in parts per million;

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supplemental ingredient other
    than a vitamin or mineral nutrient referred to in this subsection,
    in the applicable unit referred to in column 3 of the List of
    Permitted Supplemental Ingredients; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, in grams.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection D.01.003(1) and for the purposes
  of this section, the amount in metric units of the vitamins referred
  to in paragraph (1)(b.01) must be determined in terms of their amount
  in the supplemented food in accordance with column 5 of the List of
  Permitted Supplemental Ingredients, as applicable.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a person may, on the label of
  or in any advertisement for a food, other than in the nutrition facts
  table or supplemented food facts table, if any, include a declaration
  of the percentage of the daily value of a nutrient contained in the
  food if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a food that is not a supplemented
    food, the nutrient is listed in column 1 of the table to section
    B.01.401 or the table to section B.01.402 and the percentage of the
    daily value of the nutrient is required or permitted to be declared
    in the nutrition facts table;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supplemented food, the nutrient is
    listed in column 1 of the table to section B.29.002 or the table to
    section B.29.003, or referred to in column 2 of item 18 of the table
    to section B.29.002, and the percentage of the daily value of the
    nutrient is required or permitted to be declared in the supplemented
    food facts table; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the percentage of the daily value of the nutrient
    is declared per serving of stated size.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A declaration referred to in subsection (1) or (2)
  that appears on the label of a food shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in English and French; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if in accordance with
    subsection B.01.012(3) or (7) the information that is required by
    these Regulations to be shown on the label of the food may be shown
    in that language only and is shown on the label in that language.
