**[[B.01.302]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.302 .sectionLabel}** If the label
of a multiple-serving prepackaged product indicates that the product
contains or, if prepared as directed in or on the package, provides a
specified number of servings or portions, that information must be based
on the serving of stated size set out in the nutrition facts table or
supplemented food facts table, as the case may be.

**[[B.01.303 and B.01.304]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.303_and_B.01.304
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/2003-11, s. 17\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.01.305]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.305
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall, on the label of or
  in any advertisement for a food, make a representation, express or
  implied, respecting a protein unless the food meets the conditions set
  out in column 2 of item 8 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content
  Statements and Claims for the subject "source of protein" set out in
  column 1.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall, on the label of or in any
  advertisement for a food, other than a supplemented food, make a
  representation, express or implied, respecting an amino acid unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the food meets the conditions set out in column 2
    of item 8 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
    Claims for the subject "source of protein" set out in column 1; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the label or advertisement includes a declaration
    of the amount of histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine,
    phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan and valine contained in the
    food, expressed in grams per serving of stated size.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a formulated liquid diet, human milk fortifier,
    human milk substitute or food represented as containing a human milk
    substitute;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} foods represented for use in gluten-free diets,
    protein restricted diets, low (naming the amino acid) diets and
    (naming the amino acid) free diets;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the word "protein" when used as part of the common
    name of an ingredient in the list of ingredients;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the declaration of amino acids in the list of
    ingredients;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the common names that are set out in the Common
    Names for Ingredients and Components Document, if shown in the list
    of ingredients in accordance with paragraph B.01.010(3)(a);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the common name of a single amino acid preparation
    that may be sold as a food;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} any statement referred to in subsection
    B.16.016(1);

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a statement or claim set out in column 4 of item 7
    of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims
    respecting the subject "low in protein" set out in column 1;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a declaration of the amount of protein in the
    nutrition facts table or supplemented food facts table, as the case
    may be;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the protein content of a food as
    required by paragraph B.24.103(c), subparagraph B.24.202(a)(ii),
    paragraph B.24.304(b) or B.25.057(1)(a) or subparagraph
    B.25.057(2)(c)(i) or (d)(i); or

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a statement that a food is not a source of protein.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A representation referred to in subsection (1) or (2)
  that appears on the label of a food shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in English and French; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if in accordance with
    subsection B.01.012(3) or (7) the information that is required by
    these Regulations to be shown on the label of the food may be shown
    in that language only and is shown on the label in that language.

**[[B.01.306 to B.01.310]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.306_to_B.01.310
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/2003-11, s. 19\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.01.311]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.311
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3),
  no person shall, on the label of or in any advertisement for a food,
  make a representation, express or implied, concerning the action or
  effect of the food's energy value or of a nutrient contained in the
  food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The label of or advertisement for a food may carry a
  statement or claim set out in column 1 of the table following section
  B.01.603.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section B.01.312, the label of or
  advertisement for a food may carry a statement or claim to the effect
  that the food's energy value or a nutrient contained in the food is
  generally recognized as an aid in maintaining the functions of the
  body necessary to the maintenance of good health and normal growth and
  development.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a statement or claim described in subsection (3)
  concerns a nutrient not listed in column 1 of the tables to sections
  B.01.401 and B.01.402 --- or, as the case may be, not listed in column
  1 of the tables to sections B.29.002 and B.29.003 and not referred to
  in column 2 of item 18 of the table to section B.29.002 --- the amount
  of the nutrient contained in the food must be expressed on any part of
  the label in grams per serving of stated size.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} A statement or claim referred to in subsection (2)
  or (3) that appears on the label of a food shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in English and French; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if in accordance with
    subsection B.01.012(3) or (7) the information that is required by
    these Regulations to be shown on the label of the food may be shown
    in that language only and is shown on the label in that language.

- **[[B.01.312]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.312
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a statement or claim described in
  subsection B.01.311(3) is made on the label of or in an advertisement
  for a food that is not a prepackaged product or in an advertisement
  for a prepackaged product that is not made or placed by or on the
  direction of the manufacturer of the product, the label or
  advertisement shall include a declaration, per serving of stated size,
  of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the energy value, if the energy value is the
    subject of the statement or claim; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the nutrient, if a nutrient is the
    subject of the statement or claim.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if the statement or
  claim is made on the label of or in the advertisement for a fresh
  vegetable or fruit or any combination of fresh vegetables or fruits
  without any added ingredients, an orange with added food colour or a
  fresh vegetable or fruit coated with mineral oil, paraffin wax,
  petrolatum or any other protective coating.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the statement or claim is made in an advertisement
  other than a radio or television advertisement, the declaration
  referred to in subsection (1) shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
    written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
    statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
    statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
    once; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shown in letters of at least the same size and
    prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
    claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
    if the statement or claim is made more than once.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the statement or claim is made in a radio
  advertisement or in the audio portion of a television advertisement,
  the declaration referred to in subsection (1) shall immediately
  precede or follow the statement or claim.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the statement or claim is made in a television
  advertisement, the declaration referred to in subsection (1) shall be
  communicated

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the audio mode, if the statement or claim is
    made only in the audio portion of the advertisement or in both the
    audio and visual portions; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the audio or visual mode, if the statement or
    claim is made only in the visual portion of the advertisement.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the declaration referred to in subsection (1) is
  communicated in the visual mode of a television advertisement, it
  shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} appear concurrently with and for at least the same
    amount of time as the statement or claim;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
    written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
    statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
    statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
    once; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be shown in letters of at least the same size and
    prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
    claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
    if the statement or claim is made more than once.

#### [Nutrition Symbols]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1371245 .Subheading}

##### [Mandatory Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1371246 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.350]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.350
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in this
  section, the principal display panel of a prepackaged product must
  carry a symbol that is set out in Schedule K.1 if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the product, as offered for sale, contains a
    nutrient that is set out in column 1 of the table to this section;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the nutrient, calculated as a
    percentage of the daily value, meets or exceeds the applicable
    threshold set out in columns 2 to 7 of that table.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the percentage of
  the daily value for the nutrient is calculated on the basis of the
  amount of the nutrient, by weight, per serving of stated size or per
  reference amount, whichever is greater.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), if the prepackaged product
  requires reconstitution with water or another liquid or the addition
  of any other ingredient for its preparation and the reference amount
  applicable to the product only refers to the food in its prepared
  form, the percentage of the daily value for the nutrient is calculated
  on the basis of the amount of the nutrient, by weight, per serving of
  stated size.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a prepackaged product referred to in
  subsection (3), the applicable threshold set out in columns 2 to 7 of
  the table to this section is determined on the basis of the product's
  serving of stated size rather than its reference amount.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shipping containers, unless the containers and
    their contents are sold as a one unit prepackaged product to a
    consumer at the retail level;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products with an available display
    surface of less than 15 cm^2^;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged individual portions of food that are
    intended solely to be served by a restaurant or other commercial
    enterprise with meals or snacks;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} ready-to-serve multiple-serving prepackaged
    products that are intended solely to be served in a commercial or
    industrial enterprise or an institution;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} prepackaged products that are intended solely for
    use as an ingredient in the manufacture of other prepackaged
    products intended for sale to a consumer at the retail level or as
    an ingredient in the preparation of food by a commercial or
    industrial enterprise or an institution;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} milk, partly skimmed milk, skim milk, goat's milk,
    partly skimmed goat's milk, skimmed goat's milk, (naming the
    flavour) milk, (naming the flavour) partly skimmed milk, (naming the
    flavour) skim milk or cream sold in a refillable glass container;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} sweetening agents, including maple sugar and maple
    syrup;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} salt for table or general household use, celery
    salt, garlic salt, onion salt and any other seasoning salt if "salt"
    forms part of the common name of the food;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} fats and oils, including fish and other marine fats
    and oils, butter, ghee and margarine and other similar substitutes
    for butter; or

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} individual rations intended for use by military
    personnel engaged in operations or exercises.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply, in respect of a
  nutrient, to the following prepackaged products if the only
  ingredients containing the nutrient are, in the case of saturated fat
  or sodium, ingredients set out in subsection (7) or, in the case of
  sugars, ingredients set out in subsection (8):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whole or cut fruits or vegetables, including
    frozen, canned or dried fruits or vegetables;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} milk obtained from any animal, in liquid or
    powdered form;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whole eggs, including liquid, frozen or dried eggs,
    or whole egg mixes;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} nuts, seeds or nut or seed butters in which less
    than 30% of the total fat content consists of saturated fat;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} vegetable oils or marine oils in which less than
    30% of the total fat content consists of saturated fat;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} marine and fresh water animal products in which
    less than 30% of the total fat content consists of saturated fat; or

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} any combination of the foods referred to in
    paragraphs (a) to (f).

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (6) in relation to
  saturated fat and sodium, the ingredients are the following
  ingredients to which no saturated fat or sodium has been added:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whole or cut fruits or vegetables, including
    frozen, canned or dried fruits or vegetables;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} milk obtained from any animal, in liquid or
    powdered form;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} whole eggs, including liquid, frozen or dried eggs,
    or whole egg mixes;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} nuts, seeds or nut or seed butters in which less
    than 30% of the total fat content consists of saturated fat;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} vegetable oils or marine oils in which less than
    30% of the total fat content consists of saturated fat; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} marine and fresh water animal products in which
    less than 30% of the total fat content consists of saturated fat.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (6) in relation to
  sugars, the ingredients are the following ingredients to which no
  sugars have been added:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the ingredients set out in paragraphs (7)(a), (b)
    and (d);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} dairy products other than those referred to in
    paragraph (7)(b);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} grains; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} legumes.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply, in respect of
  saturated fat and sugars, to prepackaged products that are cheese or
  yogurt -- including drinkable yogurt -- that are made from dairy
  products, kefir or buttermilk unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of saturated fat, the product contains
    an ingredient, other than any of the following ingredients, that
    contains saturated fat:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} milk ingredients,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} modified milk ingredients,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} nuts or seeds in which less than 30% of the
      total fat content consists of saturated fat,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} vegetable oils or marine oils in which less than
      30% of the total fat content consists of saturated fat, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} marine and fresh water animal products in which
      less than 30% of the total fat content consists of saturated fat;
      and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of sugars, the product contains an
    ingredient, other than any of the following ingredients, that
    contains sugars or the product contains any of the following
    ingredients to which sugars have been added:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} whole or cut fruits or vegetables, including
      frozen, canned or dried fruits or vegetables,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} dairy products,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} grains,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} legumes, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} nuts or seeds.

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs (6)(a) and (7)(a),
  fruit does not include coconut.

- [(11)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply, in respect of sodium,
  to prepackaged products that are cheese made from dairy products.

- [(12)]{.lawlabel} For the application of subsections (9) and (11), the
  prepackaged products must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} have a reference amount of 30 g or 30 mL or less
    and contain 10% or more of the daily value for calcium per serving
    of stated size or per reference amount, whichever is greater; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} have a reference amount greater than 30 g or 30 mL
    and contain 15% or more of the daily value for calcium per serving
    of stated size or per reference amount, whichever is greater.

- [(13)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to the following
  prepackaged products unless they are required to carry a nutrition
  facts table on their label:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a beverage with an alcohol content of more than
    0.5%;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a raw single ingredient meat, meat by-product,
    poultry meat or poultry meat by-product that is not ground;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a raw single ingredient marine or fresh water
    animal product;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a product sold only in the retail establishment
    where it is prepared and processed from its ingredients, including
    from a pre-mix if an ingredient other than water is added to the
    pre-mix during the preparation and processing of the product;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a product sold only at a road-side stand, craft
    show, flea market, fair, farmers' market or sugar bush by the
    individual who prepared and processed the product;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} an individual serving that is sold for immediate
    consumption and that has not been subjected to a process to extend
    its durable life, including special packaging;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a product sold only in the retail establishment
    where it is packaged, if it is labelled by means of a sticker and
    has an available display surface of less than 200 cm^2^; or

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a product with an available display surface of less
    than 100 cm^2^.

- [(13.01)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a prepackaged
  product that is a raw single ingredient meat, meat by-product, poultry
  meat or poultry meat by-product that is ground unless it meets any of
  the conditions that are set out in paragraph B.01.401(3)(a), (b) or
  (e).

- [(13.1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (13.2), subsection (1) does
  not apply to a supplemented food that has an available display surface
  of less than 100 cm^2^ other than a supplemented food that is referred
  to in paragraph B.29.018(2)(b).

- [(13.2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a supplemented
  food that has an available display surface of less than 100 cm^2^,
  whether or not the supplemented food is referred to in paragraph
  B.29.018(2)(b), if the supplemented food carries a supplemented food
  caution identifier.

- [(14)]{.lawlabel} If, as a result of the application of any provision
  in subsections (5) to (13.2), subsection (1) does not apply to a
  prepackaged product or does not apply to a prepackaged product in
  respect of a particular nutrient, that provision prevails over any
  other provision in subsections (5) to (13.2) that indicates otherwise.

- [(15)]{.lawlabel} Despite any other provision in this section, the
  label of the following prepackaged products must not carry a symbol
  referred to in subsection (1):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a prepackaged product intended solely for infants
    six months of age or older but less than one year of age;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a human milk fortifier;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a human milk substitute or a food represented as
    containing a human milk substitute;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a [[formulated liquid diet]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
    as defined in section B.24.001;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a meal replacement;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a nutritional supplement;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a food represented for protein-restricted diets;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a food represented for low (naming the amino acid)
    diets; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a food represented for use in a [[very low energy
    diet]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section B.24.001.

##### [Presentation of Nutrition Symbol]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1371333 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.351]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.351
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nutrition symbol must be displayed
  in black and white and must be in accordance with the applicable
  symbol set out in Schedule K.1.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), a nutrition symbol must be
  presented in one of the following formats:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} unilingual horizontal format, where two separate
    versions of the symbol are shown, one in English (EH) and one in
    French (FH); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} bilingual horizontal format (BH), where the symbol
    is shown in both official languages.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the principal display surface is less than or
  equal to 450 cm^2^ and the width of the nutrition symbol in either of
  the horizontal formats that could apply exceeds the width of the
  principal display panel, the symbol must be presented in one of the
  following formats:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} unilingual vertical format, where two separate
    versions of the symbol are shown, one in English (EV) and one in
    French (FV); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} bilingual vertical format (BV), where the symbol is
    shown in both official languages.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If, in accordance with subsection B.01.012(3) or (7),
  the information required by these Regulations may be shown on the
  label of a prepackaged product in English only or in French only and
  is shown in that language, the nutrition symbol may be displayed on
  the principal display panel of the product in that language only on a
  continuous surface of the available display surface.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If a nutrition symbol is presented in a bilingual
  format, the order in which the languages appear may be reversed from
  the order shown in the applicable symbol set out in Schedule K.1.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-168, s. 13](#1370125-1371345){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1370125-1371345.html"}
:::

- **[[B.01.352]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.352
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The version of the nutrition symbol
  that must be carried on a prepackaged product that has a principal
  display surface that is within a range set out in column 1 of the
  table to this section and that contains a nutrient set out in column 2
  in an amount that meets or exceeds the applicable threshold referred
  to in subsection B.01.350(1) is the version that is referred to in
  column 3 or 5 of the table or, if applicable, column 4 or 6 of the
  table.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a prepackaged product that
  has a principal display surface that is greater than 250 cm^2^ may
  carry the applicable version of the nutrition symbol that is referred
  to in item 4, column 2, of Table 1 or 3 in the Directory of Nutrition
  Symbol Specifications if the product is sold only in the retail
  establishment where it is packaged and is labelled by means of a
  sticker.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A nutrition symbol must be displayed in accordance
  with the applicable specifications set out in the Directory of
  Nutrition Symbol Specifications.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (3), a nutrition symbol may be
  displayed with larger dimensions than those set out in column 3 of the
  applicable table in the Directory of Nutrition Symbol Specifications
  if the symbol is enlarged in a proportional manner vertically and
  horizontally.

- **[[B.01.353]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.353
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if a
  prepackaged product contains an assortment of foods and one or more of
  the foods requires a nutrition symbol, the nutrition symbols must be
  displayed in a manner that clearly indicates the applicable nutrients
  that are contained in each food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product contains ingredients that
  are intended to be combined together or foods that are intended to be
  consumed together, the nutrition symbol must display the nutrients
  that are contained in the product as a whole.

::: HistoricalNote

  ajax-after="1370125-1371364.html"}
:::

**[[B.01.354]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.354 .sectionLabel}** The
characters and other elements of a nutrition symbol must not touch each
other.

##### [Location of Nutrition Symbol]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1371368 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.355]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.355
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A nutrition symbol must be displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a prepackaged product with a
    principal display panel whose height is less than its width, on the
    right half of the panel; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any other prepackaged product, on
    the upper half of the principal display panel.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition symbol must be surrounded by a buffer
  that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a width that is equal to or greater than that
    set out in column 4 of the applicable table in the Directory of
    Nutrition Symbol Specifications; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} does not contain any text or other graphic
    material.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product is cylindrical in shape, the
  outer edge of the buffer must be a minimum distance of 10% of the
  width of the principal display surface from the edge of the left or
  right side of that surface.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If it is impossible to comply with both paragraph
  (1)(a) and subsection (3), the nutrition symbol may be displayed
  partially in the left half of the principal display panel but only to
  the extent necessary to comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-168, s. 13](#1370125-1371379){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1370125-1371379.html"}
:::

**[[B.01.356]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.356 .sectionLabel}** A nutrition
symbol must be oriented in the same manner as most of the other
information that appears on the principal display panel unless the panel
is displayed in the vertical plane and most of the other information is
not displayed parallel with the base of the package, in which case the
symbol must be oriented in such a manner that the words appearing in it
are parallel with the base.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-168, s. 13](#1370125-1371382){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1370125-1371382.html"}
:::

##### [Prominence of Health-related Representations]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1371383 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.357]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.357
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If both a nutrition symbol and a
  health-related representation appear on the principal display panel of
  a prepackaged product and the representation relates to a nutrient
  that is referred to in the nutrition symbol,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the height of the upper case letters in the
    representation must not exceed the height of the upper case letters,
    excluding any accents, in the nutrition symbol, other than in the
    words "Health Canada" and "Santé Canada"; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the height of the tallest ascender of the lower
    case letters in the representation must not exceed the height of the
    tallest ascender of the lower case letters in the nutrition symbol,
    other than in the words "Health Canada" and "Santé Canada".

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If both a nutrition symbol and a health-related
  representation appear on the principal display panel of a prepackaged
  product and the representation does not relate to a nutrient that is
  referred to in the nutrition symbol,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the height of the upper case letters in the
    representation must not exceed two times the height of the upper
    case letters, excluding any accents, in the nutrition symbol, other
    than in the words "Health Canada" and "Santé Canada"; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the height of the tallest ascender of the lower
    case letters in the representation must not exceed two times the
    height of the tallest ascender of the lower case letters in the
    nutrition symbol, other than in the words "Health Canada" and "Santé
    Canada".

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[health-related
  representation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a declaration referred to in subsection B.01.301(1)
    or (2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement or claim referred to in subsection
    B.01.311(2) or (3);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a representation referred to in any of sections
    B.01.503 to B.01.513;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement or claim referred to in subsection
    B.01.601(1); or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any other health-related statement, logo, symbol,
    seal of approval or mark, other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name or product name of a prepackaged
      product, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a statement or claim referred to in any of
      sections D.01.004 to D.01.007 and D.02.002 to D.02.005.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-168, s. 13](#1370125-1371400){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1370125-1371400.html"}
:::

##### [Prohibitions --- Resemblance to Nutrition Symbol]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1371401 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.358]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.358
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} label a prepackaged product with any
    representation, including a word, phrase, illustration, sign, mark,
    symbol or design, that is likely to be mistaken for a nutrition
    symbol; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} advertise or sell a prepackaged product that is
    labelled with a representation referred to in paragraph (a).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), a representation
  does not include a supplemented food caution identifier.

::: HistoricalNote

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-568840 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.400]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.400
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of sections B.01.401
  to B.01.603, [[fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} means all fatty acids
  expressed as triglycerides.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of sections B.01.401 to B.01.603, the
  amount of vitamins shall be determined in accordance with section
  D.01.003.

#### [Nutrition Labelling]{.HTitleText3} {#h-568846 .Subheading}

##### [Core Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-568847 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.401]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.401
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in this
  section and sections B.01.402 to B.01.406 and B.01.467 to B.01.469,
  the label of a prepackaged product shall carry a nutrition facts table
  that contains only the information set out in column 1 of the table to
  this section, expressed using a description set out in column 2, in
  the unit set out in column 3 and in the manner set out in column 4.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (1), the serving of
  stated size set out in a nutrition facts table for a prepackaged
  product, as expressed in a metric unit, shall be used as the basis for
  determining the information appearing in the nutrition facts table in
  respect of the energy value and nutrient content of the product.

- [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} The percentage of the daily value for a mineral
  nutrient shown in the nutrition facts table for a prepackaged product
  in accordance with subsection (1) shall be established on the basis of
  the amount, by weight, of the mineral nutrient per serving of stated
  size for the product, rounded off in the applicable manner set out in
  column 4 of the table to this section.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a prepackaged
  product if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all the information set out in column 1 of the
    table to this section, other than in respect of item 1 ("Serving of
    stated size"), may be expressed as "0" in the nutrition facts table
    in accordance with this section;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the product is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a beverage with an alcohol content of more than
      0.5%,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2016-305, s. 18\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a raw single ingredient meat, meat by-product,
      poultry meat or poultry meat by-product,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a raw single ingredient marine or fresh water
      animal product,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} sold only in the retail establishment where the
      product is prepared and processed from its ingredients, including
      from a pre-mix if an ingredient other than water is added to the
      pre-mix during the preparation and processing of the product,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} sold only at a road-side stand, craft show, flea
      market, fair, farmers' market or sugar bush by the individual who
      prepared and processed the product,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} an individual serving that is sold for
      immediate consumption and that has not been subjected to a process
      to extend its durable life, including special packaging, or

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} sold only in the retail establishment where
      the product is packaged, if the product is labelled by means of a
      sticker and has an available display surface of less than
      200 cm^2^; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the product is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a fresh vegetable or fruit or any combination of
      fresh vegetables or fruits without any added ingredients, an
      orange with added food colour or a fresh vegetable or fruit coated
      with mineral oil, paraffin wax, petrolatum or any other protective
      coating,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a prepackaged individual portion of food that is
      intended solely to be served by a restaurant or other commercial
      enterprise with meals or snacks, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} milk, partly skimmed milk, skim milk, goat's
      milk, partly skimmed goat's milk, skimmed goat's milk, (naming the
      flavour) milk, (naming the flavour) partly skimmed milk, (naming
      the flavour) skim milk or cream sold in a refillable glass
      container.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraphs (2)(a) and (b), subsection (1)
  applies to a prepackaged product if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the product contains an added vitamin or mineral
    nutrient;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a vitamin or mineral nutrient is declared as a
    component of one of the product's ingredients other than flour;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2022-168, s. 14\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the product is a meat, meat by-product, poultry
    meat or poultry meat by-product that is ground; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the label of the product, or any advertisement for
    the product that is made or placed by or on the direction of the
    manufacturer of the product, contains

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a reference to the energy value, a nutrient set
      out in column 1 of the table to this section or in column 1 of the
      table to section B.01.402 or a constituent of such a nutrient,
      other than information required by Division 12 or a reference to
      the common name of an ingredient in the list of ingredients for
      the product,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a representation that expressly or implicitly
      indicates that the product has particular nutritional or
      health-related properties, including any statement or claim set
      out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content
      Statements and Claims or column 1 of the table following section
      B.01.603 or referred to in section B.01.311, D.01.006 or D.02.004,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a health-related name, statement, logo, symbol,
      seal of approval or mark, or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the phrase "nutrition facts", "[valeur
      nutritive]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" or "[valeurs
      nutritives]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a formulated liquid
  diet, human milk fortifier, human milk substitute, food represented as
  containing a human milk substitute, meal replacement, nutritional
  supplement, food represented for use in a very low energy diet or
  supplemented food.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The label of, or an advertisement for, a formulated
  liquid diet, human milk fortifier, human milk substitute, food
  represented as containing a human milk substitute, meal replacement,
  nutritional supplement, food represented for use in a very low energy
  diet or supplemented food shall not contain a nutrition facts table or
  the phrase "nutrition facts", "[valeur nutritive]{.otherLang
  lang="fr"}" or "[valeurs nutritives]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} If, for a prepackaged product other than one intended
  solely for infants six months of age or older but less than one year
  of age, the information in respect of six or more of the energy value
  and nutrients referred to in column 1 of items 2 to 5 and 7 to 15 of
  the table to this section may be expressed as "0" in the nutrition
  facts table in accordance with this section, the nutrition facts table
  need only include the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the serving of stated size;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the energy value;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of fat;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the amount of carbohydrate;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the amount of protein;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient that is the subject of a
    representation referred to in subparagraph (3)(e)(ii);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any sugar alcohol, vitamin or mineral
    nutrient added to the prepackaged product, other than iodide added
    to salt for table or general household use or fluoride added to
    prepackaged water or ice;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any vitamin or mineral nutrient that
    is declared as a component of one of the prepackaged product's
    ingredients other than flour;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient referred to in column 1
    of any of items 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11 and 13 to 15 of the table to this
    section that may not be expressed as "0" in the nutrition facts
    table; and

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the statement "Not a significant source of (naming
    each nutrient that is omitted from the nutrition facts table in
    accordance with this subsection)" or, if the prepackaged product
    meets the condition specified in subsection B.01.455(3), the
    statement "Not a significant source of other nutrients".

- [(6.1)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition facts table of a single-serving
  prepackaged product, other than one that is a prepackaged meal, need
  only include the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the serving of stated size;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the energy value;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of fat;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the amount of carbohydrate;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the amount of protein;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient that is the subject of a
    representation referred to in subparagraph (3)(e)(ii);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any sugar alcohol, vitamin or mineral
    nutrient added to the prepackaged product, other than iodide added
    to salt for table or general household use or fluoride added to
    prepackaged water or ice;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient referred to in column 1
    of item 4 or 5 of the table to this section and the sum of saturated
    fatty acids and *trans* fatty acids if any of the amounts or the sum
    may not be expressed as "0" in the nutrition facts table; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient referred to in column 1
    of item 8 or 11 of the table to this section that may not be
    expressed as "0" in the nutrition facts table;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the % Daily Value interpretative statement.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a prepackaged
  product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is intended solely for use as an ingredient in
    the manufacture of other prepackaged products intended for sale to a
    consumer at the retail level or as an ingredient in the preparation
    of food by a commercial or industrial enterprise or an institution;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is a multiple-serving ready-to-serve
    prepackaged product intended solely to be served in a commercial or
    industrial enterprise or an institution.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} If the nutrition facts table on the label of a
  prepackaged product corresponds to Figure 6.5(B), 6.6(B), 6.5.1(B),
  6.6.1(B), 7.3(B), 7.4(B), 7.3.1(B), 7.4.1(B), 17.2(E) and (F),
  17.2.1(E) and (F), 24.1 (E) and (F) to 24.6(E) and (F), 25.1 (B) to
  25.6(B), 26.1(B) to 26.4(B), 32.1(E) and (F) or 32.2(E) and (F) of the
  Directory of NFT Formats, the nutrition facts table is not required to
  show the % Daily Value interpretative statement referred to in item 16
  of the table to this section.

  <td class="noBorderBottom top alignleft"><ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(1)</span> The size when expressed in a

  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if it is less than 10 g or

  </ul></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(2)</span> The size when expressed as a
  fraction is represented by a numerator and a denominator separated by a

  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(3)</span> The size shall include the

  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">6</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft" scope="row">The
  sum of saturated fatty acids and <em>trans</em> fatty acids</td>

  Trans Fat”, “Saturated Fatty Acids + Trans Fatty Acids”, “Saturated +

##### [Additional Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-568914 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.402]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.402
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition facts table may also
  contain information set out in column 1 of the table to this section.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If information set out in column 1 of the table to
  this section is included in the nutrition facts table, it shall be
  expressed using a description set out in column 2, in the unit set out
  in column 3 and in the manner set out in column 4.

- [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection (2), the serving of
  stated size set out in a nutrition facts table for a prepackaged
  product, expressed in the metric unit, shall be used as the basis for
  determining the information appearing in the nutrition facts table in
  respect of the energy value and nutrient content of the product.

- [(2.2)]{.lawlabel} The percentage of the daily value for a vitamin or
  mineral nutrient shown in the nutrition facts table for a prepackaged
  product in accordance with subsection (2) shall be established on the
  basis of the amount, by weight, of the vitamin or mineral nutrient per
  serving of stated size for the product, rounded off in the applicable
  manner set out in column 4 of the table to this section.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The amount of omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids,
  omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids and monounsaturated fatty acids
  shall be in the nutrition facts table if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any of those groups of fatty acids or
    the amount of polyunsaturated fatty acids is in the nutrition facts
    table or is shown on the label of the prepackaged product or in any
    advertisement for the product that is made or placed by or on the
    direction of the manufacturer of the product; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any specific fatty acid is shown on
    the label of the prepackaged product or in any advertisement for the
    product that is made or placed by or on the direction of the
    manufacturer of the product.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the label of a prepackaged product, or any
  advertisement for the product that is made or placed by or on the
  direction of the manufacturer of the product, contains a
  representation, express or implied, that includes information that is
  set out in column 1 of the table to this section, that information
  shall also be in the nutrition facts table.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2016-305, s. 19\]]{.Repealed}

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition facts table shall show the amount of
  any sugar alcohol, vitamin or mineral nutrient added to the
  prepackaged product, except in the case of iodide added to salt for
  table or general household use or fluoride added to prepackaged water
  or ice.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition facts table shall show the amount of
  any vitamin or mineral nutrient that is declared as a component of one
  of the prepackaged product's ingredients other than flour.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2018-108, s. 395\]]{.Repealed}

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} If information set out in column 1 of the table to
  this section is included in the nutrition facts table, it shall be
  shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in English and French; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if in accordance with
    subsection B.01.012(3) or (7) the information that is required by
    these Regulations to be shown on the label of the product may be
    shown in that language only and is shown on the label in that
    language.

    nearest multiple of 1%.</p></li>
    </ul></li>

    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(2)</span> The percentage is rounded
    off</p>
    <ul>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if the amount is declared as
    0 µg, to “0%”; and</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> in all other cases, to the
    nearest multiple of 1%.</p></li>
    </ul></li>
    </ul></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
    <td class="noBorderRight alignleft">37</td>
    <td class="noBorderRight alignleft" scope="row">Amount of chloride</td>
    <td class="noBorderRight alignleft">“Chloride”</td>
    <td class="noBorderRight alignleft"><p>The amount is expressed</p>
    <ul>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> in milligrams per serving of
    stated size; and</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> as a percentage of the daily
    value per serving of stated size.</p></li>
    </ul></td>
    <td class="alignleft"><ul>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(1)</span> The amount is rounded off</p>
    <ul>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if it is less than 5 mg, to
    “0 mg”;</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> if it is 5 mg or more but
    less than 50 mg, to the nearest multiple of 10 mg;</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> if it is 50 mg or more but
    less than 250 mg, to the nearest multiple of 25 mg; and</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(d)</span> if it is 250 mg or more, to
    the nearest multiple of 50 mg.</p></li>
    </ul></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(2)</span> The percentage is rounded
    off</p>
    <ul>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if the amount is declared as
    0 mg, to “0%”; and</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> in all other cases, to the
    nearest multiple of 1%.</p></li>
    </ul></li>
    </ul></td>
    </tr>
    </tbody>
    </table>

##### [Foods for Infants Six Months of Age or Older but Less Than One Year of Age]{.HTitleText4} {#h-568940 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2016-305, s. 20

\]
:::

- **[[B.01.403]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.403
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  prepackaged product that is intended solely for infants six months of
  age or older but less than one year of age.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition facts table of the prepackaged product
  shall not contain the percentage of the daily value of fat, fibre,
  sugars, cholesterol or sodium or of the sum of saturated fatty acids
  and *trans* fatty acids.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition facts table of the product may omit the
  amount of saturated fatty acids, *trans* fatty acids and cholesterol.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (3), if the amount of cholesterol
  is in the nutrition facts table, the amounts of saturated fatty acids
  and *trans* fatty acids shall also be in the nutrition facts table.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the information in respect of five or more of the
  energy value and nutrients referred to in column 1 of items 2, 3 and 8
  to 15 of the table to section B.01.401 may be expressed as "0" in the
  nutrition facts table of the prepackaged product in accordance with
  that section, the nutrition facts table need only include the
  following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the serving of stated size;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the energy value;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of fat;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the amount of carbohydrate;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the amount of protein;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient that is the subject of a
    representation referred to in subparagraph B.01.401(3)(e)(ii);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any sugar alcohol, vitamin or mineral
    nutrient added to the product, other than fluoride added to
    prepackaged water or ice;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any vitamin or mineral nutrient that
    is declared as a component of one of the product's ingredients other
    than flour;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient referred to in column 1
    of any of items 8, 10 or 11 and 13 to 15 of the table to section
    B.01.401 that may not be expressed as "0" in the nutrition facts
    table;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} except in the case described in paragraph (k), the
    statement "Not a significant source of (naming each nutrient that is
    omitted from the nutrition facts table in accordance with this
    subsection)", but such a statement may be omitted in respect of
    saturated fatty acids, *trans* fatty acids and cholesterol; and

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} if the product meets the condition specified in
    subsection B.01.462(3), the statement "Not a significant source of
    other nutrients" or the statement referred to in paragraph (j).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
- SOR/2016-305, ss. 21, 75(F)
:::

##### [Food for Use in Manufacturing Other Foods]{.HTitleText4} {#h-568962 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.404]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.404
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section B.29.004, this
  section applies to a prepackaged product intended solely for use as an
  ingredient in the manufacture of other prepackaged products intended
  for sale to a consumer at the retail level or as an ingredient in the
  preparation of food by a commercial or industrial enterprise or an
  institution.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell the product unless written
  nutrition information concerning the product accompanies the product
  when it is delivered to the purchaser.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition information

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shall include the information that would, but for
    subsection B.01.401(7), be required by sections B.01.401 and
    B.01.402 to be included in a nutrition facts table for the product;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may include other information that is permitted by
    section B.01.402 to be included in that nutrition facts table; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} shall be expressed in accordance with sections
    B.01.401 and B.01.402, subject to the following modifications,
    namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} information for vitamins referred to in
      subsection D.01.002(1) shall be expressed in the applicable unit
      referred to in subsection D.01.003(1), and information for mineral
      nutrients referred to in paragraphs D.02.001(1)(a) to (j), (l)
      to (n) and (p) shall be expressed in milligrams for sodium,
      potassium, calcium, phosphorus, magnesium, iron, zinc, chloride,
      copper and manganese and in micrograms for iodide, chromium,
      selenium and molybdenum,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} per gram or 100 grams of the food, if the net
        quantity of the food is declared on the label by weight or by
        count, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} per millilitre or 100 millilitres of the food,
        if the net quantity of the food is declared on the label by
        volume,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} information for other nutrients and the energy
      value set out in column 1 of the table to section B.01.401 or in
      column 1 of the table to section B.01.402 shall be expressed in
      the units referred to in column 3,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} per gram or 100 grams of the food, if the net
        quantity of the food is declared on the label by weight or by
        count, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} per millilitre or 100 millilitres of the food,
        if the net quantity of the food is declared on the label by
        volume,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} percentages of daily values and information on
      servings of stated size may be omitted, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the nutrition information shall be stated with a
      degree of precision that corresponds to the accuracy of the
      analytical methodology used to produce the information.

##### [Foods for Enterprise or Institution]{.HTitleText4} {#h-568980 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.405]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.405
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  prepackaged product, other than a supplemented food, that is a
  ready-to-serve multiple-serving prepackaged product intended solely to
  be served in a commercial or industrial enterprise or an institution.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell the product unless written
  nutrition information concerning the product accompanies the product
  when it is delivered to the purchaser.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The nutrition information

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shall include the information that would, but for
    subsection B.01.401(7), be required by sections B.01.401 and
    B.01.402 to be included in a nutrition facts table for the product;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may include other information that is permitted by
    section B.01.402 to be included in that nutrition facts table; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} shall be expressed in accordance with sections
    B.01.401 and B.01.402.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
- SOR/2016-305, s. 23

##### [Basis of Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-568990 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.406]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.406
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (8),
  the information in the nutrition facts table shall be set out only on
  the basis of the prepackaged product as offered for sale.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product contains separately packaged
  ingredients or foods that are intended to be consumed together, the
  information in the nutrition facts table shall be set out for each
  ingredient or food or for the entire product.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product contains an assortment of
  foods of the same type and the typical serving consists of only one of
  those foods, the information in the nutrition facts table shall be set
  out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} on the basis of each of the foods contained in the
    product, if the nutrition information set out in column 1 of the
    table to section B.01.401 for each of those foods is different; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on the basis of one of the foods contained in the
    product, if the nutrition information set out in column 1 of the
    table to section B.01.401 for each of those foods is the same.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product contains an assortment of
  foods of the same type and the typical serving consists of more than
  one of those foods, the information in the nutrition facts table shall
  be set out for each of the foods contained in the product or as a
  composite value.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product contains a food that is to
  be prepared in accordance with directions provided in or on the
  package or that is commonly combined with other ingredients or another
  food or cooked before being consumed, the nutrition facts table may
  also set out information for the food as prepared, in which case

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nutrition facts table shall set out the
    following information for the food as prepared, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} except in the case described in subparagraph
      (ii), the amount of the food expressed using the unit referred to
      in column 3 of subparagraph 1(b)(i) of the table to section
      B.01.401 as "about (naming the serving size)" or "about (naming
      the serving size) prepared" and, if applicable, in the manner
      specified in column 4 of subitems 1(1) and (2), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the food is commonly served combined with
      another food, the amount of the other food expressed using the
      unit referred to in column 3 of subparagraph 1(b)(i) of the table
      to section B.01.401,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the energy value, expressed using a description
      set out in column 2 of item 2 of the table to section B.01.401, in
      the unit set out in column 3 and in the manner set out in column
      4, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3,
      6 to 8, 11 and 13 to 15 of the table to section B.01.401 and in
      column 1 of items 14 to 37 of the table to section B.01.402 that
      is declared as a percentage of the daily value in the nutrition
      facts table for the food as sold, expressed using a description
      set out in column 2, as a percentage of the daily value per
      serving of stated size and in the manner specified in column 4;
      and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2016-305, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the nutrition facts table may also set out the
    following information for the added ingredients or the other food,
    if it is declared in the nutrition facts table for the food as sold,
    namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3 to
      5 and 7 to 12 of the table to section B.01.401, expressed using a
      description set out in column 2, in milligrams for the information
      set out in column 1 of items 7 and 8 and in grams for the
      information set out in column 1 of items 3 to 5 and 9 to 12 and in
      the manner specified in column 4,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 5
      to 8 and 10 to 13 of the table to section B.01.402, expressed
      using a description set out in column 2, in grams and in the
      manner specified in column 4; and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of item 2
      of the table to section B.01.401, expressed using a description
      set out in column 2, in the unit set out in column 3 per serving
      of stated size of the food as prepared, and in the manner
      specified in column 4.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (5) does not apply in respect of a
  prepackaged product that is intended solely for infants six months of
  age or older but less than one year of age.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (8), the information in the
  nutrition facts table may also be set out on the basis of other
  amounts of a food that reflect different uses or different units of
  measurement of a food, in which case

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nutrition facts table shall set out the
    following information for each of the other amounts of food, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the food expressed in a household
      measure and a metric measure and in the manner specified in column
      4 of subitems 1(1) and (2) of the table to section B.01.401,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the energy value, expressed using a description
      set out in column 2 of item 2 of the table to section B.01.401, in
      the unit set out in column 3 and in the manner set out in column
      4, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3,
      6 to 8, 11 and 13 to 15 of the table to section B.01.401 and in
      column 1 of items 14 to 37 of the table to section B.01.402 that
      is declared as a percentage of the daily value in the nutrition
      facts table for the first amount of food for which information is
      declared, expressed using a description set out in column 2, as a
      percentage of the daily value per serving of stated size and in
      the manner specified in column 4; and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2016-305, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2016-305, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the nutrition facts table is set out in a
    version of the aggregate format specified in section B.01.459 or
    B.01.464, it shall also set out the following information for each
    of the other amounts of food, if that information is declared in the
    nutrition facts table for the first amount of food for which
    information is declared, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2016-305, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3
      to 5 and 7 to 12 of the table to section B.01.401, expressed using
      a description set out in column 2, in milligrams for the
      information set out in column 1 of items 7 and 8 and in grams for
      the information set out in column 1 of items 3 to 5 and 9 to 12
      and in the manner specified in column 4, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 5
      to 8 and 10 to 13 of the table to section B.01.402, expressed
      using a description set out in column 2, in grams and in the
      manner specified in column 4.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} If the nutrition facts table of a prepackaged product
  that is intended solely for infants six months of age or older but
  less than one year of age sets out information in accordance with
  subsection (7), it shall set out the information referred to in
  paragraphs (7)(a) and (c).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
- SOR/2016-305, s. 24
:::

##### [Presentation of Nutrition Facts Table]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569025 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.450]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.450
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (6),
  the nutrition facts table shall be presented in accordance with the
  format specified in the applicable figure in the Directory of NFT
  Formats, having regard to matters such as order of presentation,
  dimensions, spacing and the use of upper and lower case letters and
  bold type.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The characters and rules in the nutrition facts table
  shall be displayed in a single colour that is a visual equivalent of
  100% solid black type on a white background or on a uniform neutral
  background with a maximum 5% tint of colour.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The characters in the nutrition facts table

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shall be displayed in a single standard sans serif
    font that is not decorative and in such a manner that the characters
    never touch each other or the rules; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may be displayed with larger dimensions than those
    specified in the applicable figure in the Directory of NFT Formats
    if all the characters in the table are enlarged in a uniform manner.

- [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} The type size shown in parentheses for a version
  referred to in a table to sections B.01.454 to B.01.459 or sections
  B.01.461 to B.01.464 is the minimum type size that may be used in a
  nutrition facts table to show nutrients set out in the tables to
  sections B.01.401 and B.01.402 in accordance with that version.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A rule that is specified in the applicable figure in
  the Directory of NFT Formats as being a 1 point rule or a 2 point rule
  may be displayed with larger dimensions in the nutrition facts table.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The information in the nutrition facts table shall be
  in accordance with sections B.01.400 to B.01.403 and B.01.406.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} In a nutrition facts table consisting of a table in
  both English and French, the order of languages may be reversed from
  the order shown in the applicable figure in the Directory of NFT
  Formats.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
- SOR/2016-305, ss. 25, 74
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.01.450-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.01.450"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Location of Nutrition Facts Table]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569038 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.451]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.451
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  nutrition facts table shall be displayed on the label of the
  prepackaged product

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a table in English and a table in French on the
    same continuous surface of the available display surface;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in a table in both English and French on a
    continuous surface of the available display surface; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in a table in English on a continuous surface of
    the available display surface and a table in French on another
    continuous surface of the available display surface that is of the
    same size and prominence as the first surface.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If in accordance with subsection B.01.012(3) or (7)
  the information required by these Regulations may be shown on the
  label of a prepackaged product in English only or in French only and
  is shown in that language, the nutrition facts table may be displayed
  on the label of the prepackaged product in a table in that language
  only on a continuous surface of the available display surface.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
:::

##### [Orientation of Nutrition Facts Table]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569047 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.452]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.452
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  nutrition facts table shall be oriented in the same manner as other
  information appearing on the label of the prepackaged product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be
  oriented in the same manner as other information appearing on the
  label of the prepackaged product, it shall be oriented in another
  manner if there is sufficient space to do so and the food contained in
  the package does not leak out and is not damaged when the package is
  turned over.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a
  nutrition facts table that is set out on the top or bottom of a
  prepackaged product.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
:::

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569054 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.453]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.453
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Sections B.01.454 to B.01.460 apply
  to prepackaged products other than those that are intended solely for
  infants six months of age or older but less than one year of age.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Sections B.01.461 to B.01.465 apply to prepackaged
  products that are intended solely for infants six months of age or
  older but less than one year of age.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
- SOR/2016-305, s. 26
:::

Version](section-B.01.453-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.01.453"){.PITLink}

##### [Standard and Horizontal Formats]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569060 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.454]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.454
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  prepackaged product unless any of sections B.01.455 to B.01.459
  applies to the product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the nutrition facts table
  of the prepackaged product shall be set out in a version that is
  listed in column 1 of the table to this section and in respect of
  which the condition specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual standard format in accordance with
    Figure 3.5(B), 3.6(B) or 3.7(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual horizontal format in accordance with
    Figure 4.3(B), 4.4(B) or 4.5(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the linear format in accordance with Figures
    16.1(E) and (F) or 16.2(E) and (F) of the Directory of NFT Formats;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.01.466.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be displayed in
  accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the available
  display surface of the prepackaged product, the nutrition facts table
  shall include only the information that is required by these
  Regulations to be included in that table.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the prepackaged
  product is sold only in the retail establishment where the product is
  packaged, is labelled by means of a sticker and has an available
  display surface of 200 cm^2^ or more, its nutrition facts table shall
  be set out in a version that is listed in column 1 of items 1 to 3 of
  Parts 1 to 3 of the table to this section, without regard to any
  condition specified in column 2.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the nutrition
  facts table of the prepackaged product is set out on a tag attached to
  an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package to which a
  label cannot be physically applied or on which information cannot be
  legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under
  the customary conditions of purchase, it shall be set out in a version
  that is described in paragraph (3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in
  column 1 of the table to this section, without regard to any condition
  specified in column 2.

##### [Simplified Formats]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569104 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.455]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.455
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  prepackaged product if it satisfies the condition set out in
  subsection B.01.401(6) and its nutrition facts table includes only the
  information referred to in paragraphs B.01.401(6)(a) to (j).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the nutrition facts table
  of the prepackaged product shall be set out in a version that is
  listed in column 1 of the table to this section and in respect of
  which the condition specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table containing only the
  information referred to in paragraphs B.01.401(6)(a) to (j) in any of
  the versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section,
  the nutrition facts table shall be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified standard format in
    accordance with Figure 6.5(B) or 6.6(B) of the Directory of NFT
    Formats;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified horizontal format in
    accordance with Figure 7.3(B) or 7.4(B) of the Directory of NFT
    Formats;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the simplified linear format in accordance with
    Figures 17.1(E) and (F) or 17.2(E) and (F) of the Directory of NFT
    Formats;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.01.466.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the prepackaged
  product is sold only in the retail establishment where the product is
  packaged, is labelled by means of a sticker and has an available
  display surface of 200 cm^2^ or more, its nutrition facts table shall
  be set out in a version that is listed in column 1 of items 1 to 3 of
  Parts 1 and 2 of the table to this section, without regard to any
  condition specified in column 2.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the nutrition
  facts table of the prepackaged product is set out on a tag attached to
  an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package to which a
  label cannot be physically applied or on which information cannot be
  legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under
  the customary conditions of purchase, it shall be set out in a version
  that is described in paragraph (3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in
  column 1 of the table to this section, without regard to any condition
  specified in column 2.

##### [Simplified Formats --- Single-serving Prepackaged Products]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569140 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.455.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.455.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  single-serving prepackaged product, other than one that is a
  prepackaged meal, whose nutrition facts table includes only the
  information referred to in paragraphs B.01.401(6.1)(a) to (j).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the nutrition facts table
  of the single-serving prepackaged product shall be set out in a
  version that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section and in
  respect of which the condition specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations, on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the single-serving prepackaged product a nutrition facts table
  containing only the information referred to in paragraphs
  B.01.401(6.1)(a) to (j) in any of the versions that is listed in
  column 1 of the table to this section, the nutrition facts table shall
  be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified standard format in
    accordance with Figure 6.5.1(B) or 6.6.1(B) of the Directory of NFT
    Formats;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified horizontal format in
    accordance with Figure 7.3.1(B) or 7.4.1(B) of the Directory of NFT
    Formats;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the simplified linear format in accordance with
    Figures 17.1.1(E) and (F) or 17.2.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of
    NFT Formats;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.01.466.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the
  single-serving prepackaged product is sold only in the retail
  establishment where the product is packaged, is labelled by means of a
  sticker and has an available display surface of 200 cm^2^ or more, its
  nutrition facts table shall be set out in a version that is listed in
  column 1 of items 1 to 3 of Part 1 of the table to this section,
  without regard to any condition specified in column 2.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the nutrition
  facts table of the single-serving prepackaged product is set out on a
  tag attached to an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package
  to which a label cannot be physically applied or on which information
  cannot be legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or
  consumer under the customary conditions of purchase, it shall be set
  out in a version that is described in paragraph (3)(a), (b) or (c) or
  that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, without
  regard to any condition specified in column 2.

##### [Dual Format --- Foods Requiring Preparation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569169 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.456]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.456
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  nutrition facts table of a prepackaged product includes information
  referred to in subsection B.01.406(5), the nutrition facts table shall
  be set out in a version that is listed in column 1 of the table to
  this section and in respect of which the condition specified in column
  2 is satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual dual format in accordance with Figure
    9.5(B) or 9.6(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be displayed in
  accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the available
  display surface of the prepackaged product, the nutrition facts table
  shall include only the information that is required by these
  Regulations to be included in the table, together with the information
  referred to in subsection B.01.406(5).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), if the nutrition
  facts table of the prepackaged product is set out on a tag attached to
  an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package to which a
  label cannot be physically applied or on which information cannot be
  legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under
  the customary conditions of purchase, it shall be set out in a version
  that is described in paragraph (2)(a) or that is listed in column 1 of
  the table to this section, without regard to any condition specified
  in column 2.
