##### [Aggregate Format --- Different Kinds of Foods]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569194 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.457]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.457
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  nutrition facts table of a prepackaged product includes separate
  information for each food or ingredient as provided in subsection
  B.01.406(2), paragraph B.01.406(3)(a) or subsection B.01.406(4), the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out in a version that is listed in
  column 1 of the table to this section and in respect of which the
  condition specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in subsection
    B.01.406(2) or (4), in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
      Figure 11.5(B) or 11.6(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the
      table to this section, even though more than 15% of the available
      display surface would be required to display the nutrition facts
      table, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in paragraph
    B.01.406(3)(a), in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
      Figure 11.5(B) or 11.6(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the
      table to this section, even though more than 15% of the available
      display surface would be required to display the nutrition facts
      table, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.01.466.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be displayed in
  accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the available
  display surface of the prepackaged product, the nutrition facts table
  shall include only the information that is required by these
  Regulations to be included for each food or ingredient for which
  separate information is set out in the table.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), if the nutrition
  facts table of the prepackaged product is set out on a tag attached to
  an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package to which a
  label cannot be physically applied or on which information cannot be
  legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under
  the customary conditions of purchase, it shall be set out in a version
  that is described in subparagraph (2)(a)(i) or that is listed in
  column 1 of the table to this section, without regard to any condition
  specified in column 2.

##### [Dual Format --- Different Amounts of Food]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569224 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.458]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.458
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  nutrition facts table of a prepackaged product includes separate
  information for different amounts of the food as provided in paragraph
  B.01.406(7)(a) without including the information referred to in
  paragraph B.01.406(7)(c), the nutrition facts table shall be set out
  in a version that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section
  and in respect of which the condition specified in column 2 is
  satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual dual format in accordance with Figure
    13.5(B) or 13.6(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be displayed in
  accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the available
  display surface of the prepackaged product, the nutrition facts table
  shall include only the information that is required by these
  Regulations to be included for each amount of the food for which
  separate information is set out in the table.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), if the nutrition
  facts table of the prepackaged product is set out on a tag attached to
  an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package to which a
  label cannot be physically applied or on which information cannot be
  legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under
  the customary conditions of purchase, it shall be set out in a version
  that is described in paragraph (2)(a) or that is listed in column 1 of
  the table to this section, without regard to any condition specified
  in column 2.

##### [Aggregate Format --- Different Amounts of Food]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569249 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.459]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.459
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  nutrition facts table of a prepackaged product includes separate
  information for different amounts of the food as provided in
  paragraphs B.01.406(7)(a) and (c), the nutrition facts table shall be
  set out in a version that is listed in column 1 of the table to this
  section and in respect of which the condition specified in column 2 is
  satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
    Figure 15.5(B) or 15.6(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be displayed in
  accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the available
  display surface of the prepackaged product, the nutrition facts table
  shall include only the information that is required by these
  Regulations to be included for each amount of the food for which
  separate information is set out in the table.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), if the nutrition
  facts table of the prepackaged product is set out on a tag attached to
  an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package to which a
  label cannot be physically applied or on which information cannot be
  legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under
  the customary conditions of purchase, it shall be set out in a version
  that is described in paragraph (2)(a) or that is listed in column 1 of
  the table to this section, without regard to any condition specified
  in column 2.

##### [Presentation of Additional Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569274 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.460]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.460
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If information referred to in column
  1 of the table to section B.01.402 is included in a nutrition facts
  table that is set out in a version consisting of a table in English
  and a table in French or a table in English or French, that
  information shall be displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with the order of presentation, the
    use of indents and the presentation of footnotes illustrated in
    Figures 18.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of NFT Formats; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of matters other than those referred to
    in paragraph (a), in accordance with the format that is specified in
    the applicable figure in the Directory of NFT Formats.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If information referred to in column 1 of the table
  to section B.01.402 is included in a nutrition facts table that is set
  out in a version consisting of a table in both English and French,
  that information shall be displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with the order of presentation, the
    use of indents and the presentation of footnotes illustrated in
    Figure 19.1(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of matters other than those referred to
    in paragraph (a), in accordance with the format that is specified in
    the applicable figure in the Directory of NFT Formats.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (1)(a), the use of indents
  illustrated in Figures 18.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of NFT Formats
  is not applicable if information referred to in column 1 of the table
  to section B.01.402 is set out in the linear format referred to in
  paragraph B.01.454(3)(c) or the simplified linear format referred to
  in paragraph B.01.455(3)(c).

- SOR/2016-305, s. 74

##### [Standard and Horizontal Formats --- Infants Six Months of Age or Older but Less Than One Year of Age]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569285 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
- err.(E), Vol. 137, No. 5
- SOR/2016-305, s. 34

\]
:::

- **[[B.01.461]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.461
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  prepackaged product that is intended solely for infants six months of
  age or older but less than one year of age unless section B.01.462,
  B.01.463 or B.01.464 applies to the product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the nutrition facts table
  of the prepackaged product shall be set out in a version that is
  listed in column 1 of the table to this section and in respect of
  which the condition specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual standard format in accordance with
    Figure 22.5(B), 22.6(B) or 22.7(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual horizontal format in accordance with
    Figure 23.3(B) or 23.4(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the linear format in accordance with Figures
    31.1(E) and (F) or 31.2(E) and (F) of the Directory of NFT Formats;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.01.466.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be displayed in
  accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the available
  display surface of the prepackaged product, the nutrition facts table
  shall include only the information that is required by these
  Regulations to be included in that table.

##### [Simplified Formats --- Infants Six Months of Age or Older but Less Than One Year of Age]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569329 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2016-305, s. 36

\]
:::

- **[[B.01.462]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.462
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  prepackaged product that is intended solely for infants six months of
  age or older but less than one year of age if it satisfies the
  condition set out in subsection B.01.403(5) and its nutrition facts
  table includes only the information referred to in paragraphs
  B.01.403(5)(a) to (k).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the nutrition facts table
  of the prepackaged product shall be set out in a version that is
  listed in column 1 of the table to this section and in respect of
  which the condition specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table containing only the
  information referred to in paragraphs B.01.403(5)(a) to (k) in any of
  the versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section,
  the nutrition facts table shall be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified standard format in
    accordance with Figure 25.5(B) or 25.6(B) of the Directory of NFT
    Formats;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified horizontal format in
    accordance with Figure 26.3(B) or 26.4(B) of the Directory of NFT
    Formats;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the simplified linear format in accordance with
    Figures 32.1(E) and (F) or 32.2(E) and (F) of the Directory of NFT
    Formats;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.01.466.

##### [Aggregate Format --- Different Kinds of Foods --- Infants Six Months of Age or Older but Less Than One Year of Age]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569365 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2016-305, s. 38

\]
:::

- **[[B.01.463]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.463
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  nutrition facts table of a prepackaged product that is intended solely
  for infants six months of age or older but less than one year of age
  includes separate information for each food or ingredient as provided
  in subsection B.01.406(2), paragraph B.01.406(3)(a) or subsection
  B.01.406(4), the nutrition facts table shall be set out in a version
  that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section and in respect
  of which the condition specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in subsection
    B.01.406(2) or (4), in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
      Figure 28.5(B) or 28.6(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the
      table to this section, even though more than 15% of the available
      display surface would be required to display the nutrition facts
      table, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in paragraph
    B.01.406(3)(a), in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
      Figure 28.5(B) or 28.6(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the
      table to this section, even though more than 15% of the available
      display surface would be required to display the nutrition facts
      table, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.01.466.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be displayed in
  accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the available
  display surface of the prepackaged product, the nutrition facts table
  shall include only the information that is required by these
  Regulations to be included for each food or ingredient for which
  separate information is set out in the table.

##### [Aggregate Format --- Different Amounts of Food --- Infants Six Months of Age or Older but Less Than One Year of Age]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569396 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2016-305, s. 40

\]
:::

- **[[B.01.464]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.464
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  nutrition facts table of a prepackaged product that is intended solely
  for infants six months of age or older but less than one year of age
  includes separate information for different amounts of the food as
  provided in subsection B.01.406(8), the nutrition facts table shall be
  set out in a version that is listed in column 1 of the table to this
  section and in respect of which the condition specified in column 2 is
  satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a nutrition facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  nutrition facts table shall be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
    Figure 30.5(B) or 30.6(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the nutrition facts table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a nutrition facts table cannot be displayed in
  accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the available
  display surface of the prepackaged product, the nutrition facts table
  shall include only the information that is required by these
  Regulations to be included for each amount of the food for which
  separate information is set out in the table.

##### [Presentation of Additional Information --- Infants Six Months of Age or Older but Less Than One Year of Age]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569422 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2016-305, s. 42

\]
:::

- **[[B.01.465]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.465
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  prepackaged product that is intended solely for infants six months of
  age or older but less than one year of age.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If information referred to in column 1 of the table
  to section B.01.402 is included in a nutrition facts table that is set
  out in a version consisting of a table in English and a table in
  French or a table in English or French, that information shall be
  displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with the order of presentation, the
    use of indents and the presentation of footnotes illustrated in
    Figures 33.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of NFT Formats; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of matters other than those referred to
    in paragraph (a), in accordance with the format that is specified in
    the applicable figure in the Directory of NFT Formats.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If information referred to in column 1 of the table
  to section B.01.402 is included in a nutrition facts table that is set
  out in a version consisting of a table in both English and French,
  that information shall be displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with the order of presentation, the
    use of indents and the presentation of footnotes illustrated in
    Figure 34.1(B) of the Directory of NFT Formats; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of matters other than those referred to
    in paragraph (a), in accordance with the format that is specified in
    the applicable figure in the Directory of NFT Formats.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (2)(a), the use of indents
  illustrated in Figures 33.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of NFT Formats
  is not applicable if information referred to in column 1 of the table
  to section B.01.402 is set out in the linear format referred to in
  paragraph B.01.461(3)(c) or the simplified linear format referred to
  in paragraph B.01.462(3)(c).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
- SOR/2016-305, ss. 43, 74
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.01.465-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.01.465"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Alternative Methods of Presentation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569436 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.466]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.466
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section A.01.016, the
  nutrition facts table of a prepackaged product that meets the
  condition specified in subsection B.01.454(3) or B.01.455(3),
  paragraph B.01.457(2)(b), subsection B.01.461(3) or B.01.462(3) or
  paragraph B.01.463(2)(b) may be set out on

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a tag attached to the package;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a package insert;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the inner side of a label;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a fold-out label; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an outer sleeve, overwrap or collar.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the nutrition facts table is set out in a manner
  described in paragraph (1)(b) or (c), the outer side of the label of
  the package shall indicate in a type size of not less than 8 points
  where the nutrition facts table is located.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the nutrition facts table is set out in a manner
  described in subsection (1), it shall be set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in subsection
    B.01.454(3), in a version that is described in paragraph
    B.01.454(3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column 1 of the
    table to section B.01.454;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in subsection
    B.01.455(3), in a version that is described in paragraph
    B.01.455(3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column 1 of the
    table to section B.01.455;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in paragraph
    B.01.457(2)(b), in a version that is described in subparagraph
    B.01.457(2)(b)(i) or that is listed in column 1 of the table to
    section B.01.457;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in subsection
    B.01.461(3), in a version that is described in paragraph
    B.01.461(3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column 1 of the
    table to section B.01.461;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in subsection
    B.01.462(3), in a version that is described in paragraph
    B.01.462(3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column 1 of the
    table to section B.01.462; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product described in paragraph
    B.01.463(2)(b), in a version that is described in subparagraph
    B.01.463(2)(b)(i) or that is listed in column 1 of the table to
    section B.01.463.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
- SOR/2018-69, s. 3(F)
:::

##### [Small Packages]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569454 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.467]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.467
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section A.01.016 and subject
  to subsection (2), if the available display surface of a prepackaged
  product is less than 100 cm^2^, the label of the product need not
  carry a nutrition facts table if the outer side of the label contains
  an indication of how a purchaser or consumer may obtain the nutrition
  information that would otherwise be required to be set out in a
  nutrition facts table on the label of the product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a prepackaged
  product that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} described in paragraph B.01.401(3)(a), (b) or (e);
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contained in a package to which a label cannot be
    physically applied or on which information cannot be legibly set out
    and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under the customary
    conditions of purchase.

- [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} However, subsection (1) applies to a prepackaged
  product that is referred to in subparagraph B.01.401(3)(e)(ii) and
  that meets the conditions set out in item 37, column 2, of the Table
  of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims for the subject
  "Free of sugars" set out in column 1 if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the product does not contain an added vitamin or
    mineral nutrient;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the energy value expressed in Calories per serving
    of stated size and the amount of sugar alcohols expressed in grams
    per serving of stated size are shown immediately after whichever of
    the following elements appears last on the label:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the list of ingredients,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a [[food allergen source, gluten source and
      added sulphites statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
      subsection B.01.010.1(1),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a declaration referred to in subsection
      B.01.010.4(1), or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any statement referred to in subsection
      B.16.016(1); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any statement or claim that is set out in item 37,
    column 4, of the table for the subject "Free of sugars" set out in
    column 1 and that appears on the label is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} legibly set out on the principal display panel,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in lower case letters except for the first
      letter of each word of the statement or claim, which may be an
      upper case letter,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} of at least the same size and prominence as the
      letters used in the numerical portion of the declaration of net
      quantity as required under paragraph 229(1)(a) and subsections
      229(2) and (3) of the [Safe Food for Canadians
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108), and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} displayed in a colour contrasting with the
      background of the label.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} An indication referred to in subsection (1)

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shall be set out in a type size of not less than 8
    points;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shall include a postal address or a toll-free
    telephone number; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} shall be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in English and French, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if in accordance with
      subsection B.01.012(3) or (7) the information that is required by
      these Regulations to be shown on the label of the product may be
      shown in that language only and is shown on the label in that
      language.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of the prepackaged product shall
  provide the information referred to in subsection (1) to a purchaser
  or consumer on request

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} without charge;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the following manner, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the official language in which the information
      is requested or, if specified by the purchaser or consumer, in
      both official languages, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in one of the official languages, if in
      accordance with subsection B.01.012(3) or (7) the information that
      is required by these Regulations to be shown on the label of the
      product may be shown in that language only and is shown on the
      label in that language; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the form of a nutrition facts table that is set
    out

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in a format, other than a horizontal format, that
      is specified in any of sections B.01.454 to B.01.459 or B.01.461
      to B.01.464 and that would otherwise be carried on the label of
      the product in accordance with these Regulations, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in a version of that format that is listed in
      column 1 of item 1 of any Part of the table to the applicable
      section referred to in subparagraph (i).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[official
  languages]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the English language and the
  French language.

- **[[B.01.468]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.468
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if a
  prepackaged product has an available display surface of less than
  100 cm^2^ and has a nutrition facts table on its label, the nutrition
  facts table need only include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the serving of stated size;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the energy value and, subject to subsection (2),
    the amount of nutrients referred to in column 1 of items 2 to 15 of
    the table to section B.01.401 if the amount shown in the nutrition
    facts table may not be expressed as "0" according to the manner set
    out in column 4; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any sugar alcohol, vitamin or mineral
    nutrient added to the prepackaged product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the label of a prepackaged product, or any
  advertisement for the product that is made or placed by or on the
  direction of the manufacturer of the product, contains a
  representation, express or implied, that includes information that is
  set out in column 1 of the table to section B.01.401 or B.01.402, that
  information shall also be in the nutrition facts table.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2016-305, s. 45
:::

**[[B.01.469]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.469 .sectionLabel}** Despite
subsection B.01.401(1), the label of a prepackaged product that has an
available display surface of less than 15 cm^2^ need not carry a
nutrition facts table.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2016-305, s. 45
:::

**\[B.01.470 to B.01.499 reserved\]**

#### [Nutrient Content Claims]{.HTitleText3} {#h-569497 .Subheading}

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569498 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.500]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.500
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section and in the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements
  and Claims.

  [[combination foods]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[combination foods]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the category of
      food to which belong foods that contain as ingredients foods from
      more than one food group, or foods from one or more food groups
      mixed with foods from the category of other foods, such as pizza
      or lasagna. ([aliments composés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[food group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[food group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means one of the following
      categories of foods:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} milk products, and milk product alternatives
        such as fortified plant-based beverages;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} meat, poultry and fish, and alternatives such
        as legumes, eggs, tofu or peanut butter;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} bread and grain products; or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} vegetables and fruit. ([groupe
        alimentaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[other foods]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[other foods]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the category of food to
      which belong foods that are not part of any food group, including

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} foods that are mostly fats, such as butter,
        margarine, oil or lard;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} foods that are mostly sugars, such as jam,
        honey, syrup or confectionery;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} snack foods, such as potato chips or pretzels;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} beverages, such as water, tea, coffee or soft
        drinks; and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} herbs, spices and condiments, such as pickles,
        mustard or ketchup. ([autres aliments]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[reference food of the same food group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reference food of the same food
      group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food that can be substituted
      in the diet for the food to which it is compared and that belongs
      to

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the same food group as the food to which it is
        compared, such as cheese as a reference food for milk, or
        chicken as a reference food for tofu;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the category of other foods, if the food to
        which it is compared also belongs to that category, such as
        pretzels as a reference food for potato chips; or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the category of combination foods, if the food
        to which it is compared also belongs to that category, such as
        pizza as a reference food for lasagna. ([aliment de référence du
        même groupe alimentaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[similar reference food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[similar reference food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food of the
      same type as the food to which it is compared and that has not
      been processed, formulated, reformulated or otherwise modified in
      a manner that increases or decreases the energy value or the
      amount of a nutrient that is the subject of the comparison, such
      as whole milk as a similar reference food for partly skimmed milk
      or regular chocolate chip cookies as a similar reference food for
      fat-reduced chocolate chip cookies. ([aliment de référence
      similaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The similar reference food referred to in column 3 of
  item 45 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
  Claims, with respect to the subject "light in energy or fat" set out
  in column 1, shall have a nutrient value that is representative of
  foods of that type that have not been processed, formulated,
  reformulated or otherwise modified in a manner that increases the
  energy value or the amount of fat.

##### [Languages]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569521 .Subheading}

**[[B.01.501]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.501 .sectionLabel}** The
representations provided for in sections B.01.503 to B.01.513 that
appear on the label of a food shall be

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in English and French; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if in accordance with
  subsection B.01.012(3) or (7) the information that is required by
  these Regulations to be shown on the label of the food may be shown in
  that language only and is shown on the label in that language.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
:::

##### [Statements or Claims]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569527 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.502]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.502
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall, on the label of or
  in any advertisement for a food, make a representation, express or
  implied, that characterizes the energy value of the food or the amount
  of a nutrient contained in the food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a representation otherwise provided for in these
    Regulations, including one that is in the form of a nutrition
    symbol;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a representation provided for by section 273 of the
    [Safe Food for Canadians
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a representation provided for by column 1 of Table
    2 to Volume 7 of the [[Standards of Identity
    Document]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section 1 of the
    [Safe Food for Canadians
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a representation that characterizes the amount of
    lactose in a food;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a representation that characterizes the addition of
    salt to a food, other than any statement or claim set out in column
    4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a representation that characterizes the addition of
    sugars to a food, other than any statement or claim set out in
    column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
    Claims;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a representation that characterizes the amount of
    starch in a food, if the food is intended solely for infants six
    months of age or older but less than one year of age;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the representations "defatted (naming the food)",
    "demineralized (naming the food)" and "high (naming the
    monosaccharide or disaccharide) (naming the syrup)";

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a representation that characterizes the amount of a
    fatty acid in a vegetable oil and forms part of its common name;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a representation that characterizes the amount of
    alcohol in a beverage;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} the representation "light salted" with respect to
    fish; or

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the English representation "lean" with respect to a
    prepackaged meal represented for use in a weight reduction diet or a
    weight maintenance diet.

- **[[B.01.503]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.503
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person may, on the label of or in
  any advertisement for a food, make a statement or claim set out in
  column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
  Claims, with respect to a subject set out in column 1, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the food meets the applicable conditions set out in
    column 2;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the label or advertisement meets the conditions, if
    any, set out in column 3, in accordance with sections B.01.504 to
    B.01.506; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a food that is not a prepackaged
    product, or a prepackaged product for which an advertisement is not
    made or placed by or on the direction of the manufacturer of the
    product, the label or advertisement includes, per serving of stated
    size, and in accordance with section B.01.505 or B.01.506 if
    applicable,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the declaration of the energy value, if the
      energy value is the subject of the statement or claim, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the nutrient, if a nutrient is the
      subject of the statement or claim.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), no person shall, on the
  principal display panel of a prepackaged product, make a statement or
  claim that is set out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient
  Content Statements and Claims and that relates to a nutrient that is
  referred to in a nutrition symbol that appears on the panel unless it
  is a statement or claim respecting one of the following subjects set
  out in column 1:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in saturated fatty acids", set out in item
    20;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in sodium or salt", set out in item 33; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in sugars", set out in item 38.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), no person shall, on the label
  of or in any advertisement for a food that is intended solely for
  children under four years of age, make a statement or claim set out in
  column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
  Claims unless it is a statement or claim respecting one of the
  following subjects set out in column 1:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "source of protein", set out in item 8;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "excellent source of protein", set out in item 9;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} "more protein", set out in item 10;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} "no added sodium or salt", set out in item 35; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} "no added sugars", set out in item 40.

- [(2.01)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), it is prohibited,
  on the label of or in any advertisement for a human milk fortifier, to
  make a statement or claim set out in column 4 of the Table of
  Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims.

- [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} The information required by paragraph (1)(c) need
  not be included on the label of or in any advertisement for a fresh
  vegetable or fruit or any combination of fresh vegetables or fruits
  without any added ingredients, an orange with added food colour or a
  fresh vegetable or fruit coated with mineral oil, paraffin wax,
  petrolatum or any other protective coating, if a statement or claim
  set out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content
  Statements and Claims is made on the label or advertisement.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a statement or claim set out in column 4 of the
  Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims is made on
  the label of or in any advertisement for a food, all the words,
  numbers, signs or symbols that constitute the statement or claim shall
  be of the same size and prominence.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} In the English version of the statements or claims,
  the word "fibre" may be spelled as "fiber".

**[[B.01.504]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.504 .sectionLabel}** If a
statement or claim set out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted
Nutrient Content Statements and Claims is made on the label of a food,
the information required under the conditions set out in column 3 shall
be

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} adjacent to, without any intervening printed, written
  or graphic material,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the statement or claim, if the statement or claim
    is made only once, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the most prominent statement or claim on the
    principal display panel or, if none appears there, the most
    prominent statement or claim elsewhere on the label, if the
    statement or claim is made more than once; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} shown in letters of at least the same size and
  prominence as

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} those of the statement or claim, if the statement
    or claim is made only once, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} those of the most prominent statement or claim on
    the principal display panel or, if none appears there, the most
    prominent statement or claim elsewhere on the label, if the
    statement or claim is made more than once.

**[[B.01.505]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.505 .sectionLabel}** If a
statement or claim set out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted
Nutrient Content Statements and Claims is made in an advertisement for a
food, other than a radio or television advertisement, the information
required under the conditions set out in column 3 and, if applicable,
the information required by paragraph B.01.503(1)(c), shall be

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} adjacent to, without any intervening printed, written
  or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the statement or claim
  is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim, if the
  statement or claim is made more than once; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} shown in letters of at least the same size and
  prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
  claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim, if
  the statement or claim is made more than once.

- **[[B.01.506]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.506
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a statement or claim set out in
  column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
  Claims is made in a radio or television advertisement, the information
  required under the conditions set out in column 3 and, if applicable,
  the information required by paragraph B.01.503(1)(c), shall be
  provided in the advertisement, except for the information required
  under the condition set out in paragraph (a) of column 3, in respect
  of the following subjects set out in column 1, which may be on the
  label:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in energy", set out in item 3;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in fat", set out in item 13;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in saturated fatty acids", set out in item
    20;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in *trans* fatty acids", set out in item
    23;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in cholesterol", set out in item 29;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in sodium or salt", set out in item 33;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} "lightly salted", set out in item 36;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in sugars", set out in item 38; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} "light in energy or fat", set out in item 45.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), if the statement or claim is
  made in a radio or television advertisement that is not made or placed
  by or on the direction of the manufacturer of the food, the
  information required under the condition set out in paragraph (a) of
  column 3 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
  Claims, in respect of the subjects set out in paragraphs (1)(a) to
  (i), shall be provided in the advertisement.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the information required under the conditions set
  out in column 3 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements
  and Claims and the information required by paragraph B.01.503(1)(c) is
  provided in a radio advertisement or in the audio portion of a
  television advertisement, that information shall immediately precede
  or follow the statement or claim.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a television advertisement, the
  information required under the conditions set out in column 3 of the
  Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims and, if
  applicable, the information required by paragraph B.01.503(1)(c),
  shall be communicated

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the audio mode, if the statement or claim is
    made only in the audio portion of the advertisement or in both the
    audio and visual portions; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the audio or visual mode, if the statement or
    claim is made only in the visual portion of the advertisement.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the information required under the conditions set
  out in column 3 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements
  and Claims and the information required by paragraph B.01.503(1)(c) is
  communicated in the visual mode of a television advertisement, it
  shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} appear concurrently with and for at least the same
    amount of time as the statement or claim;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
    written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
    statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
    statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
    once; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be shown in letters of at least the same size and
    prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
    claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
    if the statement or claim is made more than once.

**[[B.01.507]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.507 .sectionLabel}** A person may,
on the label of or in any advertisement for a food, make a
representation, express or implied, that the food is for use in an
energy-reduced diet, if a statement or claim set out in column 4 of the
Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims, in respect of
any of the following subjects set out in column 1, is made on the label
of or in the advertisement for the food, in accordance with section
B.01.503:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} "free of energy", set out in item 1;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} "low in energy", set out in item 2;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in energy", set out in item 3;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} "lower in energy", set out in item 4; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} "free of sugars", set out in item 37.

- **[[B.01.508]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.508
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person may, on the label of or in
  any advertisement for a food, make a representation, express or
  implied, that the food is for use in a sodium-restricted diet, if a
  statement or claim set out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted
  Nutrient Content Statements and Claims, in respect of any of the
  following subjects set out in column 1, is made on the label of or in
  the advertisement for the food, in accordance with section B.01.503:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "free of sodium or salt", set out in item 31;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "low in sodium or salt", set out in item 32;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in sodium or salt", set out in item 33; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} "lower in sodium or salt", set out in item 34.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), no person shall, on the
  principal display panel of a prepackaged product, make a
  representation, express or implied, that the product is for use in a
  sodium-restricted diet if a nutrition symbol referring to sodium
  appears on the panel.

- **[[B.01.509]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.509
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person may, on the label of or in
  any advertisement for a food, make the statement or claim that the
  food is "unsweetened" if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the food meets the conditions set out in item 40,
    column 2, of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
    Claims for the subject "No added sugars" set out in column 1; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the food does not contain a sweetener.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), no person shall, on the
  principal display panel of a prepackaged product, make a statement or
  claim that the product is "unsweetened" if a nutrition symbol
  referring to sugars appears on the panel.

**[[B.01.510]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.510 .sectionLabel}** A statement
or claim set out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content
Statements and Claims, respecting the following subjects set out in
column 1, that is made on the label of or in an advertisement for a
breakfast cereal with milk, shall be accompanied by an indication that
it refers to 30 g of the breakfast cereal combined with 125 mL of milk:

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} "excellent source of protein", set out in item 9; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} "more protein", set out in item 10.

- **[[B.01.511]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.511
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty and subject to
  subsections (2) to (4), a statement or claim set out in column 4 of
  the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims that is
  made on the label of or in any advertisement for a food may be
  preceded or followed by other words, numbers, signs or symbols, but
  none of those shall be interposed between the words, numbers, signs or
  symbols of the statement or claim.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The words "very", "ultra" and "extra", and all other
  words, numbers, signs or symbols that modify the nature of a statement
  or claim, shall not precede or follow the statement or claim.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A statement or claim that is made on the label of or
  in any advertisement for a food that has not been processed,
  formulated, reformulated or otherwise modified to meet the conditions
  set out in column 2 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content
  Statements and Claims shall not be accompanied by the brand name of
  the food.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Any words, numbers, signs or symbols preceding or
  following the statement or claim referred to in subsection (3) shall
  accompany the statement or claim in such a manner that the statement
  or claim characterizes all foods of that type, and not only the
  specific food.

**[[B.01.512]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.512 .sectionLabel}** If a food
meets the conditions set out in column 2 of the Table of Permitted
Nutrient Content Statements and Claims for more than one of the subjects
set out in column 1, it is not necessary to repeat the common element of
the statements or claims set out in column 4 that are used on the label
of or in the advertisement for the food, and the remaining elements may
be joined by means of a conjunction or punctuation, as appropriate.

##### [Sensory Characteristic]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569633 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.513]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.513
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall, on the label of or
  in any advertisement for a food, make the statement or claim "light"
  or "[léger]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" --- including any phonetic
  rendering of that statement or claim --- respecting a sensory
  characteristic of the food unless the following conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the statement or claim "light" or
    "[léger]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" is made on the label of a food, the
    sensory characteristic shall be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
      written or graphic material,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the statement or claim, if the statement or
        claim is made only once, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the most prominent statement or claim on the
        principal display panel or, if none appears there, the most
        prominent statement or claim elsewhere on the label, if the
        statement or claim is made more than once, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shown in letters of at least the same size and
      prominence as

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} those of the statement or claim, if the
        statement or claim is made only once, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} those of the most prominent statement or claim
        on the principal display panel or, if none appears there, the
        most prominent statement or claim elsewhere on the label, if the
        statement or claim is made more than once;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the statement or claim "light" or
    "[léger]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" is made in an advertisement for a
    food, other than a radio or television advertisement, the sensory
    characteristic shall be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
      written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
      statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
      statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
      once, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shown in letters of at least the same size and
      prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
      claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
      if the statement or claim is made more than once;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the statement or claim "light" or
    "[léger]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" is made in a radio advertisement or
    in the audio portion of a television advertisement, the sensory
    characteristic shall immediately precede or follow the statement or
    claim; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the statement or claim "light" or
    "[léger]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" is made in the visual portion of a
    television advertisement, the sensory characteristic shall

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} appear concurrently with and for the same amount
      of time as the statement or claim,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} be adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
      written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
      statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
      statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
      once, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} be shown in letters of at least the same size
      and prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the
      statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
      statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
      once.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to the statement or
  claim "light" or "[léger]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" when it is used with
  respect to rum.

##### [Languages]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569664 .Subheading}

**[[B.01.600]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.600 .sectionLabel}** A statement
or claim set out in column 1 of the table following section B.01.603
that appears on the label of a food shall be

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in English and French; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if in accordance with
  subsection B.01.012(3) or (7) the information that is required by
  these Regulations to be shown on the label of the food may be shown in
  that language only and is shown on the label in that language.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20

##### [Statements or Claims]{.HTitleText4} {#h-569670 .Subheading}

- **[[B.01.601]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.601
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A food with a label or advertisement
  that carries a statement or claim set out in column 1 of the table
  following section B.01.603 is exempt from the provisions of the Act
  and its Regulations with respect to drugs, and from subsections 3(1)
  and (2) of the Act, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the food meets the applicable conditions set out in
    column 2;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the label of or the advertisement for the food
    meets the applicable conditions set out in column 3; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the food is not

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} intended solely for children under four years of
      age, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a food represented for use in a very low energy
      diet.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a food that comes
  within the definition of [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} as defined in
  section 2 of the Act for a reason other than the fact that its label
  or advertisement carries a statement or claim referred to in that
  subsection.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) applies even if the word "graisses" in
  the French version of the statement or claim is replaced by the word
  "lipides".

- **[[B.01.602]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.602
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The information required under the
  conditions set out in column 3 of the table following section B.01.603
  that appears in an advertisement for a food that is not a prepackaged
  product, or in an advertisement for a prepackaged product that is not
  made or placed by or on the direction of the manufacturer of the
  product, shall,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an advertisement, other than a radio
    or television advertisement, be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
      written or graphic material, the statement or claim set out in
      column 1, if the statement or claim is made only once, or the most
      prominent statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made
      more than once, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shown in letters of at least the same size and
      prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
      claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
      if the statement or claim is made more than once;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a radio advertisement or the audio
    portion of a television advertisement, immediately precede or follow
    the statement or claim set out in column 1; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a television advertisement, be
    communicated

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the audio mode, if the statement or claim set
      out in column 1 is made only in the audio portion of the
      advertisement or in both the audio and visual portions, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the audio or visual mode, if the statement or
      claim set out in column 1 is made only in the visual portion of
      the advertisement.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The information that is communicated in the visual
  mode of a television advertisement in accordance with subparagraph
  (1)(c)(ii) shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} appear concurrently with and for at least the same
    amount of time as the statement or claim;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
    written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
    statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
    statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
    once; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be shown in letters of at least the same size and
    prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
    claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
    if the statement or claim is made more than once.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 20
:::

- **[[B.01.603]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.01.603
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, a statement
  or claim set out in column 1 of the table following this section that
  is made on the label of or in any advertisement for a food may be
  preceded or followed by other words, numbers, signs or symbols, but
  none of those shall be interposed between the words, numbers, signs or
  symbols of the statement or claim.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a food meets the conditions set out in column 2 of
  the table following this section for more than one item of that table,
  it is not necessary to repeat the common element of the statements or
  claims set out in column 1 that are used on the label of or in the
  advertisement for the food, and the remaining elements may be joined
  by means of a conjunction or punctuation, as appropriate.

**[[B.02.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.002 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

[[absolute alcohol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[absolute alcohol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2024-244, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

[[age]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[age]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the period during which an
    alcoholic beverage is kept under such conditions of storage as may
    be necessary to develop its characteristic flavour and
    bouquet; ([âge]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[alcohol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[alcohol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means ethyl
    alcohol; ([alcool]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[flavouring]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[flavouring]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a spirit,
    any other spirit or wine, domestic or imported, added as a
    flavouring to that spirit as authorized under the [Excise
    Act](/eng/acts/E-14); ([substance aromatique]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[grain spirit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[grain spirit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s.
    24\]]{.Repealed}

[[malt spirit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[malt spirit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s.
    24\]]{.Repealed}

[[molasses spirit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[molasses spirit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s.
    24\]]{.Repealed}

[[small wood]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[small wood]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means wood casks or barrels of
    not greater than 700 L capacity. ([petit fût]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[sweetening agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[sweetening agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2024-244, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

**[[B.02.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.003 .sectionLabel}** If an
alcoholic beverage contains 1.1% or more alcohol by volume, the
percentage by volume of alcohol present in the alcoholic beverage shall
be shown on the principal display panel

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} followed by the words "alcohol by volume" or the
  abbreviation "alc./vol." or "alc/vol"; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} preceded by the abbreviation "alc." or "alc" and
  followed by the abbreviation "vol." or "vol".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/88-418, s. 1
- SOR/93-145, s. 5(F)
- SOR/2014-9, s. 1
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.02.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.02.003"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.02.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell flavoured
  purified alcohol in a container with a capacity of 1,000 mL or less
  unless it contains 25.6 mL or less of alcohol.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to flavoured purified
  alcohol that is sold in a glass container with a capacity of at least
  750 mL.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, [[flavoured
  purified alcohol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an alcoholic beverage

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is obtained from an alcohol base that has been
    purified during the course of manufacture through a process other
    than distillation and from which most of the naturally occurring
    substances other than alcohol and water have been removed; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to which has been added during the course of
    manufacture any substance or mixture of substances that imparts
    flavour.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-147, s. 1](#1129612-1130947){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1129612-1130947.html"}
:::

**[[B.02.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.017 .sectionLabel}** No person

purpose of bottling and sale in Canada as Scotch whisky except by

  to adjust to a required strength, or

  (1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s. 29\]]{.Repealed}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), no person shall make any
  claim with respect to the age of Canadian whisky, other than for the
  period during which the whisky has been held in small wood.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where Canadian whisky has been aged in small wood for

  during which that whisky was held in other containers may be claimed
  as age.

**[[B.02.059]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.059 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall blend or modify brandy that is imported in bulk for the purpose of
bottling and sale in Canada as imported brandy, except by

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} blending with other imported brandy;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the addition of caramel; and

  to adjust the brandy to a required strength.

**[[B.02.060]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.060 .sectionLabel}** Where brandy
is wholly distilled in a country other than Canada, the label shall
indicate the country of origin.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-300, s. 13(F)
- SOR/93-145, s. 16
:::

- **[[B.02.061]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.061
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell brandy unless
  it has been aged for at least one year in wooden containers or at
  least six months in small wood.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Nothing in subsection (1) applies in respect of
  flavouring contained in brandy, but no person shall sell brandy
  containing any flavouring, other than wine, that has not been aged for
  a period of at least one year in wooden containers or at least six
  months in small wood.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply in respect of
  Armagnac brandy, Cognac brandy or any other brandy that complies with
  the standards set out in sections 2.4.2 to 2.4.7 of Volume 2 of the
  Food Compositional Standards Document.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person shall make any claim with respect to the
  age of brandy other than for the period during which the brandy has
  been held in wooden containers or in small wood.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/93-145, s. 16

**[[B.02.108]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.108 .sectionLabel}** A clear
indication of the country of origin shall be shown on the principal
display panel of a wine.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-300, s. 16(E)
:::

**[[B.02.123]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.02.123 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell cider unless it has an amount of volatile acidity, expressed
as acetic acid, that is equal to or less than that set out in column 3
for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and Nutritional
Characteristics of Food, as determined by the corresponding method set
out in column 4.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-768, s. 3

**[[B.08.001.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.001.1
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s. 46\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink

**[[B.08.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.002 .sectionLabel}** Except as
provided in these Regulations, a dairy product that contains a fat other
than milk fat is adulterated.

**[[B.08.002.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.002.1
.sectionLabel}** Paragraphs B.08.002.3(a) to (i) and sections B.08.003
to B.08.028 do not apply to a lacteal secretion obtained from the
mammary gland of any animal other than a cow, genus [Bos]{.otherLang
lang="la"}, or a product or derivative of such secretion.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-623, s. 1
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 47](#1497160-1504092){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497160-1504092.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.08.002.1-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.08.002.1"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.08.002.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.002.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall sell the normal lacteal secretion obtained from the mammary
  gland of the cow, genus [Bos]{.otherLang lang="la"}, or of any other
  animal, or sell a dairy product made with any such secretion, unless
  the secretion or dairy product has been pasteurized by being held at a
  temperature and for a period that ensure the reduction of the alkaline
  phosphatase activity so as to meet the tolerances specified in
  official method MFO-3, Determination of Phosphatase Activity in Dairy
  Products, dated November 30, 1981.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} cheese; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any food that is sold for further manufacturing or
    processing in order to pasteurize it in the manner described in
    subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/91-549, s. 1
- SOR/95-499, s. 1
:::

**[[B.08.002.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.002.3 .sectionLabel}** The
percentage of milk fat contained in the following dairy products must be
shown on the principal display panel followed by the words "milk fat" or
the abbreviation "B.F." or "M.F.":

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} partly skimmed milk;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} partly skimmed milk with added milk solids;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} evaporated partly skimmed milk;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) milk;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) partly skimmed milk;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) partly skimmed milk with added
  milk solids;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} cream;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} canned cream;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} sour cream;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} yogurt;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} cottage cheese; and

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} creamed cottage cheese.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 48](#1497162-1504107){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497162-1504107.html"}
:::

#### [Milk]{.HTitleText3} {#h-570804 .Subheading}

**[[B.08.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.003 .sectionLabel}** Despite
sections D.01.009 to D.01.011, no person shall sell any of the following
dairy products for which a standard is set out in Volume 7 of the Food
Compositional Standards Document unless the food contains 2 μg of
vitamin D per 100 mL:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} milk;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} sterilized milk; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) milk.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/95-499, s. 2
- [SOR/2022-168, s. 22](#1370170-1371452){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1370170-1371452.html"}
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 49](#1497164-1504112){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497164-1504112.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.08.003-20220720.html "Link to previous version of section B.08.003"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.08.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.004 .sectionLabel}** Despite
sections D.01.009 to D.01.011, no person shall sell milk powder for
which a standard is set out in Volume 7 of the Food Compositional
Standards Document unless it contains 2 μg of vitamin D per 100 mL when
reconstituted according to directions for use.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-656, s. 1
- [SOR/2022-168, s. 23](#1370172-1371454){.wb-lbx

- **[[B.08.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a food referred
  to in subsection (2) unless it contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} despite sections D.01.009 and D.01.010, vitamin A
    in such an amount that a reasonable daily intake of the food
    contains at least 1,200 I.U. and not more than 2,500 I.U. of vitamin
    A; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} despite sections D.01.009 to D.01.011, 2 μg of
    vitamin D per 100 mL.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The foods to which subsection (1) applies are the
  following dairy products for which a standard is set out in Volume 7
  of the Food Compositional Standards Document:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} skim milk;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} partly skimmed milk;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) skim milk;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) partly skimmed milk;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} skim milk with added milk solids;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} partly skimmed milk with added milk solids;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) skim milk with added milk
    solids; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) partly skimmed milk with added
    milk solids.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-656, s. 2

**[[B.08.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.010 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell evaporated milk for which a standard is set out in Volume 7
of the Food Compositional Standards Document unless it contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} despite sections D.01.009 to D.01.011, vitamin C in

  contains at least 60 mg and not more than 75 mg of vitamin C; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} despite sections D.01.009 to D.01.011, 2 μg of
  vitamin D per 100 mL when reconstituted to its original volume.

- **[[B.08.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a food referred
  to in subsection (2) in which the content of vitamin D has been
  increased by either addition or irradiation unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the addition of vitamin D, the
    menstruum containing the vitamin D contributes not more than 0.01
    per cent fat foreign to milk; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in cases where the vitamin D content is increased
    by irradiation, the principal display panel carries the statement
    "Vitamin D Increased" immediately preceding or following the name of
    the food, without intervening written, printed or graphic matter.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The foods to which subsection (1) applies are the
  following dairy products for which a standard is set out in Volume 7
  of the Food Compositional Standards Document:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} milk;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} skim milk;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} partly skimmed milk;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} skim milk with added milk solids;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} partly skimmed milk with added milk solids;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) milk;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) skim milk;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) partly skimmed milk;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) skim milk with added milk
    solids;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} (naming the flavour) partly skimmed milk with added
    milk solids;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} condensed milk;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} evaporated milk;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} evaporated skim milk;

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} evaporated partly skimmed milk;

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} milk powder; and

  - [(p)]{.lawlabel} skim milk powder.

**[[B.08.024]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.024 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell milk for manufacture into dairy products unless the milk
contains an amount of sediment equal to or less than that set out in
column 3 of the Table of Chemical, Physical and Nutritional
Characteristics of Food, as determined by the corresponding method set
out in column 4.

**[[B.08.027]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.027 .sectionLabel}** Despite
anything contained in these Regulations, the following dairy products
for which a standard is set out in Volume 7 of the Food Compositional
Standards Document are not required to contain added vitamins if they
are used in or sold for the manufacture of other foods:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} milk;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} skim milk;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} partly skimmed milk;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} sterilized milk;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} evaporated milk;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} evaporated skim milk;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} evaporated partly skimmed milk;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} milk powder;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} skim milk powder;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} skim milk with added milk solids; and

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} partly skimmed milk with added milk solids.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-656, s. 13

#### [Goat's Milk]{.HTitleText3} {#h-571006 .Subheading}

**[[B.08.028.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.028.1 .sectionLabel}** A lacteal
secretion obtained from themammary gland of any animal other than a cow,
genus Bos, and a product or derivative of such secretion shall be
labelled so as to identify that animal.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-623, s. 2
:::

- **[[B.08.029]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.029
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell goat's milk or
  goat's milk powder to which vitamin D has been added unless 100 mL of
  that food, when ready-to-serve, contains 2 μg of vitamin D.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell skimmed or partly skimmed goat's
  milk or skimmed or partly skimmed goat's milk powder to which vitamin
  A or D has been added unless 100 mL of that food, when ready-to-serve,
  contains both vitamin A and D in the following amounts:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} not less than 140 I.U. and not more than 300 I.U.
    of vitamin A; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 2 μg of vitamin D.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell evaporated goat's milk to which
  any of the following vitamins have been added unless 100 mL of that
  food, when reconstituted to its original volume, contains each of the
  following vitamins in the following amounts:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} not less than 7 mg and not more than 9 mg of
    vitamin C;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 2 μg of vitamin D; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} not less than 10 μg and not more than 20 μg of
    folic acid.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell evaporated partly skimmed goat's
  milk or evaporated skimmed goat's milk to which any of the following
  vitamins have been added unless 100 mL of that food, when
  reconstituted to its original volume, contains each of the following
  vitamins in the following amounts:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} not less than 140 I.U. and not more than 300 I.U.
    of vitamin A;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} not less than 7 mg and not more than 9 mg of
    vitamin C;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 2 μg of vitamin D; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} not less than 10 μg and not more than 20 μg of
    folic acid.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-623, s. 2
- [SOR/2022-168, s. 38](#1370202-1371500){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1370202-1371500.html"}
:::

#### [Cheese]{.HTitleText3} {#h-571017 .Subheading}

- **[[B.08.030]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.030
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Division, when used with
  respect to cheese,

  [[pasteurized source]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pasteurized source]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means milk, skim milk,
      cream, reconstituted milk powder, reconstituted skim milk powder
      or any combination thereof that has been pasteurized by being held
      at a temperature of not less than 61.6°C for a period of not less
      than 30 minutes, or for a time and a temperature that is
      equivalent thereto in phosphatase destruction, as determined by
      official method MFO-3, Determination of Phosphatase Activity in
      Dairy Products, November 30, 1981; ([matière première
      pasteurisée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pickles and relishes]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pickles and relishes]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2024-244, s. 54\]]{.Repealed}

  [[stored]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[stored]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means to have been kept or held at
      a temperature of 2°C or more for a period of 60 days or more from
      the date of the beginning of the manufacturing
      process; ([entreposé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[whole]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[whole]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means of the original size and shape
      as manufactured. ([entier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s. 54\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/79-752, s. 2
- SOR/82-768, s. 20

:::
