**[[B.08.031]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.031 .sectionLabel}** A cheese made
from milk that is the normal lacteal secretion of the mammary gland of
animals other than the cow, genus [Bos]{.otherLang lang="la"}, must be
labelled to show the source of the milk on the principal display panel.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/79-752, s. 2
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 55](#1497182-1504208){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497182-1504208.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.08.031-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.08.031"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.08.032]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.032
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Cheeses, other than cottage cheese
  and creamed cottage cheese, must be labelled to show on the principal
  display panel a statement of the percentage of milk fat in the food
  followed by the words "milk fat" or the abbreviation "B.F." or "M.F.",
  and the percentage of moisture in the food followed by the word
  "moisture" or "water".

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection B.01.301(1), no person shall
  make any direct or indirect reference on the label of a food referred
  to in subsection (1) to the milk fat content or moisture content of
  the food except as required by subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote

**[[B.08.042]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.042 .sectionLabel}** No
manufacturer shall sell whole cheese that is not made from a pasteurized
source unless the date of the beginning of the manufacturing process is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} marked or branded thereon within three days thereof;
  or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} marked on the label at the time of packaging, if the
  cheese is such that, because of its texture, consistency, or physical
  structure, such date cannot be effectively branded or marked on the
  cheese.

**[[B.08.043]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.043 .sectionLabel}** No
manufacturer shall sell cheese that is not made from a pasteurized
source if it has been cut into smaller portions unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} it has been duly stored; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} each portion of cut cheese is marked, branded or
  labelled with the date of the beginning of the manufacturing process.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 56](#1497184-1504232){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497184-1504232.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.08.043-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.08.043"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.08.044]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.044
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall sell cheese, including cheese curd, that is not made from a
  pasteurized source unless it has been stored.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Cheese, including cheese curd, that is not made from
  a pasteurized source may be used as an ingredient in any food
  providing such food is manufactured or processed so as to pasteurize
  the cheese in the manner described in the definition [[pasteurized
  source]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in section B.08.030(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-405, s. 1
- SOR/79-752, s. 3
:::

**[[B.08.045]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.045
.sectionLabel}** Notwithstanding B.08.044, cheese that has not been
manufactured from a pasteurized source and has not been stored but is
marked or branded with the date of the beginning of the manufacturing
process, may be sold to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a wholesaler;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a jobber; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in quantities of not less than 900 pounds, to a
  retailer.

**[[B.08.046]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.046 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell any whole cheese that has not been made from a pasteurized
source unless there is stamped thereon the date of the beginning of the
manufacturing process.

**[[B.08.047]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.08.047 .sectionLabel}** Every
manufacturer, wholesaler, or jobber who sells cheese not made from a
pasteurized source and which has not been stored shall keep a record of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the registered number of the cheese factory,

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date of manufacture of the cheese,

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the vat number or vat numbers,

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the person to whom the cheese
  is sold, and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the weight sold from each vat,

for each lot of cheese sold.

- **[[B.09.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.09.016
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell margarine or
  calorie-reduced margarine for which a standard is set out in Volume 8
  of the Food Compositional Standards Document unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the margarine or calorie-reduced margarine contains
    at least 3,300 I.U. of vitamin A per 100 g; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} despite sections D.01.009 to D.01.011, the
    margarine or calorie-reduced margarine contains 26 μg of vitamin D
    per 100 g.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell margarine or calorie-reduced
  margarine for which a standard is set out in Volume 8 of the Food
  Compositional Standards Document and to which vitamin E has been added
  unless the finished product contains at least 0.6 I.U. of
  alpha-tocopherol per gram of linoleic acid.

**[[B.11.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.11.001 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

[[acid ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[acid ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s.
    64\]]{.Repealed}

[[fruit juice]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fruit juice]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the unfermented liquid
    expressed from sound ripe fresh fruit, and includes any such liquid
    that is heat treated and chilled; ([jus de fruit]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[sweetening ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[sweetening ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means sugar, invert
    sugar, honey, dextrose, glucose or glucose solids or any combination
    thereof in dry or liquid form. ([ingrédient
    édulcorant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

#### [Vegetables]{.HTitleText3} {#h-572134 .Subheading}

**[[B.11.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.11.002 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell canned vegetables unless they

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} have been obtained by heat processing fresh
  vegetables; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} are packaged in hermetically sealed containers.

#### [Fruit Flavoured Drinks]{.HTitleText3} {#h-572404 .Subheading}

**[[B.11.150]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.11.150 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall label, package, sell or advertise a fruit flavoured drink in a
manner that is likely to create an impression that the fruit flavoured
drink contains vitamins or has any other nutritional value commonly
associated with any fruit juice unless the following requirements are
met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is sold as a substitute for fruit juice or as a
  breakfast drink;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is not carbonated;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} it is not represented to be or is not commonly known
  as

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a soft drink, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a thirst-quenching or refreshment drink; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} notwithstanding sections D.01.009, D.01.011 and
  D.02.009,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} it contains vitamin C in an amount not less than 24
    milligrams and not more than 48 milligrams, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it contains

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} where folic acid has been added, an amount of
      folic acid of not less than 40 micrograms and not more than 80
      micrograms,

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} where thiamine has been added, an amount of
      thiamine of not less than 0.08 milligram and not more than 0.11
      milligram,

    - [(C)]{.lawlabel} where iron has been added, an amount of iron of
      not less than 0.56 milligram and not more than 0.80 milligram, or

    - [(D)]{.lawlabel} where potassium has been added, an amount of
      potassium of not less than 100 milligrams and not more than 200
      milligrams,

per 100 millilitres when the drink is ready to serve.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-478, s. 2
:::

**[[B.11.151]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.11.151 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall label, package, sell or advertise a base, concentrate or mix that
is used for making a fruit flavoured drink in a manner that is likely to
create an impression that the drink made therefrom will contain vitamins
or have any other nutritional value commonly associated with fruit juice
unless the following requirements are met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the base, concentrate or mix

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is sold for the purpose of making a breakfast drink
    or a substitute for fruit juice,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is not represented to be or is not commonly known
    as a product that is used for making a soft drink or a
    thirst-quenching or refreshment drink; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where a drink is made therefrom as directed, the
  drink meets the requirements described in paragraph B.11.150(d).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-478, s. 2
:::

obtained by boiling the fruit or rhubarb, as the case may be, with water

### [DIVISION 12]{.HLabel2}[Prepackaged Water and Ice]{.HTitleText2} {#h-572554 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/80-633, s. 1

\]
:::

- **[[B.12.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.12.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell water
  represented as mineral water or spring water unless it is potable
  water obtained from an underground source and not from a public
  community water supply.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell water represented as mineral
  water or spring water for which a standard is set out in Volume 11 of
  the Food Compositional Standards Document, to which fluoride has been
  added unless the total fluoride ion content is equal to or less than
  one part per million.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-633, s. 2
- SOR/82-768, s. 34
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 75](#1497216-1504390){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497216-1504390.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.12.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.12.001"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.12.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.12.002 .sectionLabel}** The label on
a container of water represented as mineral water or spring water shall
carry a statement

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} of the geographical location of the underground
  source from which it is obtained;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} of the total dissolved mineral salt content expressed
  in parts per million; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} of the total fluoride ion content expressed in parts
  per million.

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2022-143, s. 22\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-300, s. 39(F)
- SOR/88-336, s. 3
- SOR/92-626, s. 14(F)
- [SOR/2022-143, s. 22](#1362052-1367538){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1362052-1367538.html"}
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 76(F)](#1497218-1504391){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497218-1504391.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.12.002-20220621.html "Link to previous version of section B.12.002"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.12.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.12.003 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2022-143, s. 23\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.12.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.12.003"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.12.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.12.004 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell water in sealed containers, other than water represented as
mineral water or spring water, if it contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s. 77\]]{.Repealed}

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s. 77\]]{.Repealed}

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} naturally occurring fluoride ion in an amount that
  exceeds its naturally occurring amount; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} added fluoride in such an amount that the total
  amount of fluoride ion exceeds one part per million.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-633, s. 3
- SOR/82-768, s. 35
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 77](#1497220-1504395){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497220-1504395.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.12.004-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.12.004"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.12.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.12.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell prepackaged ice
  if it contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s. 78\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} naturally occurring fluoride ion in an amount that
    exceeds its naturally occurring amount; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} added fluoride in such an amount that the total
    amount of fluoride ion exceeds one part per million.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall manufacture prepackaged ice for sale
  if the water from which it is made

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is not potable;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contains naturally occurring fluoride ion in an
    amount that exceeds its naturally occurring amount; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} contains added fluoride in such an amount that the
    total amount of fluoride ion exceeds one part per million.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-633, s. 3
- SOR/82-768, s. 36
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 78](#1497226-1504402){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497226-1504402.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.12.005-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.12.005"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.12.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.12.006 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2022-143, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.12.006-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.12.006"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.12.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.12.007 .sectionLabel}** Despite
section B.01.008, chlorine or any compounds of chlorine need not be
shown as ingredients on any part of the label on a sealed container of
water, other than water represented as mineral water or spring water,
when chlorine or any compounds of chlorine have been used in the
treatment of the water and subsequently removed from the water together
with any chlorine and compounds of chlorine produced in the water.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-633, s. 3
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 79](#1497232-1504404){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497232-1504404.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.12.007-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.12.007"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.12.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.12.008 .sectionLabel}** A statement
of the total fluoride ion content expressed in parts per million shall
appear on the principal display panel of the label on a sealed container
of water, other than water represented as mineral water or spring water
and on the label on a container of prepackaged ice.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-633, s. 3
- SOR/2000-353, s. 5(E)

SOR/2022-143, s. 25\]]{.Repealed}

### [DIVISION 13]{.HLabel2}[Grain and Bakery Products]{.HTitleText2} {#h-572619 .Subheading}

- **[[B.13.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.13.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell white flour for
  which a standard is set out in Volume 12 of the Food Compositional
  Standards Document unless the white flour contains, per 100 g,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 0.64 mg of thiamine;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 0.40 mg of riboflavin;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 5.30 mg of niacin or niacinamide;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} 0.15 mg of folic acid; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} 4.4 mg of iron.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell white flour for which a standard
  is set out in Volume 12 of the Food Compositional Standards Document
  and to which any of the following vitamins or mineral nutrients have
  been added unless each 100 g of the white flour contains, in total,
  the following amount of the added vitamin or mineral nutrient:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 0.31 mg of vitamin B~6~;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 1.3 mg of d-pantothenic acid;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 190 mg of magnesium; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} 140 mg of calcium from one or any combination of
    the following sources:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} calcium carbonate,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} edible bone meal,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} chalk (B.P.),

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} ground limestone,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} calcium sulphate.

::: HistoricalNote

#### [Bread]{.HTitleText3} {#h-572728 .Subheading}

**[[B.13.021]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.13.021 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2024-244, s. 84\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.13.022]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.13.022
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell enriched white
  bread for which a standard is set out in Volume 12 of the Food
  Compositional Standards Document unless the enriched white bread
  contains, per 100 g,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 0.40 mg of thiamine;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 0.24 mg of riboflavin;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 3.3 mg of niacin or niacinamide;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} 0.10 mg of folic acid; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} 2.76 mg of iron.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell enriched white bread for which a
  standard is set out in Volume 12 of the Food Compositional Standards
  Document and that is made from white flour to which any of the
  following vitamins or mineral nutrients have been added unless each
  100 g of the enriched white bread contains, in total, the following
  amount of the added vitamin or mineral nutrient:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 0.14 mg of vitamin B~6~;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 0.6 mg of d-pantothenic acid;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 90 mg of magnesium; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} 66 mg of calcium.

#### [Alimentary Paste]{.HTitleText3} {#h-572800 .Subheading}

**[[B.13.051]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.13.051 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell macaroni, spaghetti, noodles or similar alimentary pastes, as
egg macaroni, egg spaghetti, egg noodles or egg alimentary pastes,
respectively, unless they contain, on the dry basis, not less than four
per cent, egg-yolk solids derived from whole egg, dried egg, frozen egg
or frozen egg-yolk.

- **[[B.13.052]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.13.052
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding sections D.01.009,
  D.01.011 and D.02.009, no person shall sell an alimentary paste to
  which a vitamin or a mineral nutrient set out in column I of any item
  of the table to this section has been added unless each 100 g of the
  alimentary paste contains the added vitamin or mineral nutrient in an
  amount not less than the minimum amount set out in column II of that
  item and not more than the maximum amount set out in column III of
  that item.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall represent an alimentary paste as
  "enriched" unless the alimentary paste contains added thiamine,
  riboflavin, niacin, folic acid and iron, in accordance with the table
  to this section.

### [DIVISION 14]{.HLabel2}[Meat, Its Preparations and Products]{.HTitleText2} {#h-572823 .Subheading}

**[[B.14.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.001 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

[[animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any animal used as food, but
    does not include marine and fresh water
    animals; ([animal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[filler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[filler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any vegetable material (except
    tomato or beetroot), milk, egg, yeast or any derivative or
    combination thereof that is acceptable as food. ([agent de
    remplissage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the edible part of

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the skeletal muscle of an animal; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the muscle that is found in the tongue,
      diaphragm, heart or oesophagus of an animal.

    This definition also applies to the muscle tissue when it is
    overlaid with or includes fat, portions of bone, skin, sinew, nerve
    or blood vessels that are normally attached to it and are not
    separated from it in the process of dressing. This definition does
    not include muscle found in the lips, snout, scalp or
    ears; ([viande]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[meat by-product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[meat by-product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any edible part of an
    animal, other than meat. ([sous-produit de viande]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-768, s. 39
- SOR/86-875, s. 1

**[[B.14.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.002 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell meat, a meat by-product or edible bone meal unless it is
derived from animals that were healthy at the time of slaughter.

**[[B.14.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.004 .sectionLabel}** Meat, meat
by-products, preparations of meat or preparations of meat by-products
are adulterated if any organ or portion of an animal that is not
commonly sold as food --- including mucous membranes, organs or portions
of the genital system, black gut, spleens, udders and lungs --- is
present in or has been added to the food.

**[[B.14.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.006 .sectionLabel}** Powdered
fully hydrogenated cottonseed oil may be applied as a release agent to
the surface of meat, meat by-product, prepared meat, prepared meat
by-product, extended meat product and simulated meat product in an
amount not greater than 0.25% of the product.

**[[B.14.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.008 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a meat binder, filler or preparations for pumping pickle,
cover pickle or dry cure represented for use in meat products unless its
label sets out directions for use that, when followed, produces a food

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} that complies with the requirements of section
  B.14.030 in relation to the filler; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that does not contain food additives, if any, in
  excess of the maximum level of use or maximum level of residue for
  that food set out in the Lists of Permitted Food Additives.

**[[B.14.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.010 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell as food a dead animal or any part thereof.

**[[B.14.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.011 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell as food, meat, meat by-products, preparations containing meat
or meat derivatives obtained, prepared or manufactured from a dead
animal.

**[[B.14.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.012 .sectionLabel}** For the
purpose of Sections B.14.010 and B.14.011, [[dead
animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a dead animal that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} was not killed for the purpose of food in accordance
  with commonly accepted practice of killing animals for the purpose of
  food, which shall include exsanguination; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} was affected with disease at the time it was killed.

**[[B.14.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.016 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell horse-meat or horse-meat by-product, or any food containing
horse-meat or horse-meat by-product unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is labelled as such when offered or exposed for
  sale; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} when in package form, the principal display panel of
  the label carries a declaration of the presence of horse-meat or of
  horse-meat by-product in type at least as legible and conspicuous as
  any other type upon such principal display panel.

**[[B.14.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.017 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2003-292, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.14.018]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.018
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if a
  carcass of beef or veal, or a portion of a carcass of beef or veal
  that weighs 7 kg or more, is advertised for sale, the advertisement
  shall indicate

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a carcass other than an imported
    carcass, the grade that was assigned to the carcass under the [Safe
    Food for Canadians Act](/eng/acts/S-1.1) or a provincial law;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an imported beef carcass, the grade
    that was assigned to the carcass under the [Safe Food for Canadians
    Act](/eng/acts/S-1.1) or a provincial law or the grade that was
    assigned to the carcass by a grading authority established under the
    laws of the country from which the carcass was imported;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an imported veal carcass, the grade
    that was assigned to the carcass by a grading authority established
    under the laws of the country from which the carcass was imported;
    and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a beef carcass, the yield class, if
    any, that was assigned to the carcass under the [Safe Food for
    Canadians Act](/eng/acts/S-1.1).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where, in the case of a carcass referred to in
  subsection (1), no grade has been assigned thereto as described in
  that subsection and the carcass or portion thereof that weighs 7 kg or
  more is advertised for sale, the advertisement shall clearly indicate
  that the carcass has not been graded.

- **[[B.14.019]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.019
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a carcass of beef, veal, pork
  or lamb or a portion thereof that weighs 7 kg or more is advertised
  for sale and a selling price is stated in the advertisement, the
  advertisement shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contain the words "price per kilogram is based on
    carcass weight before cutting, boning and trimming" or the words
    "price per kilogram is based on the weight of the meat after
    cutting, boning and trimming", whichever words are applicable; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where in addition to the selling price a charge is
    payable for cutting, boning, trimming, wrapping or freezing the
    carcass or portion thereof, indicate

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the additional charge, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where the additional charge is payable on a
      price per unit weight basis, whether the additional charge is
      based on the weight of the carcass or portion thereof before or
      after the carcass has been cut, boned and trimmed.

  in an advertisement shall be located therein immediately adjacent to
  the selling price stated therein, without any intervening written,
  printed or graphic matter.

**[[B.14.022]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.022 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell mechanically tenderized beef unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the beef is identified as mechanically tenderized
  when it is offered or exposed for sale; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the beef has a label on it with a principal display
  panel that, subject to section B.01.012, includes all of the following
  information:

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in type at least as legible and prominent as that
    of the common name,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the expression "mechanically tenderized" in the
      English version of the label, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the expression "[attendri
      mécaniquement]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", with any necessary
      grammatical modifications, in the French version of the label, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in type at least as legible and prominent as that
    of any other information other than the common name,

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} in the English version of the label,

      - [(I)]{.lawlabel} the message "Cook to a minimum internal
        temperature of 63°C (145°F).", and

      - [(II)]{.lawlabel} in the case of steak, the additional message
        "Turn steak over at least twice during cooking.", and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} in the French version of the label,

      - [(I)]{.lawlabel} the message "[Faire cuire jusqu'à ce que la
        température interne atteigne au moins 63 °C
        (145 °F).]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", and

      - [(II)]{.lawlabel} in the case of steak, the additional message
        "[Retourner le bifteck au moins deux fois durant la
        cuisson.]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-99, s. 2
:::

#### [Prepared Meats, Prepared Meat By-Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-572962 .Subheading}

- **[[B.14.030]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.030
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3)
  and section B.14.030A, no person shall sell a prepared meat or
  prepared meat by-product with a meat protein content of less than 1.5
  percentage points below the total protein requirement for that food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to an extended meat
  product.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where gelatin is an ingredient of a prepared meat or
  prepared meat by-product, that gelatin shall not be included when
  calculating the total protein content of the prepared meat or prepared
  meat by-product.

**[[B.14.030A]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.030A .sectionLabel}** For the
purposes of sections B.14.030 and B.14.074 to B.14.077 and Division 13.3
of Volume 13 of the Food Compositional Standards Document, if any
non-meat ingredients are present in a prepared meat or a prepared meat
by-product in pieces that are distinguishable from the other
ingredients, those non-meat ingredients must be excluded when
calculating the total fat or protein content of the prepared meat or
prepared meat by-product.

**[[B.14.040]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.040 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
Division 13.3 of Volume 13 of the Food Compositional Standards Document,
no person shall sell a food that consists of a mixture of ground meat
and filler, of ground meat by-product and filler or of ground meat,
ground meat by-product and filler unless that food

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a total protein content of not less than 13 per
  cent;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a fat content of not more than that set out in
  column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
  Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
  corresponding method set out in column 4, in the case of a mixture
  containing pork meat or pork meat by-product or both; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} has a fat content of not more than that set out in
  column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
  Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
  corresponding method set out in column 4, in the case of any other
  meat mixture.

**[[B.14.041]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.041 .sectionLabel}** Subject to

and spices and seasonings, of ground meat by-product and spices and

  column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and

  containing pork meat or pork meat by-product or both; and

#### [Sale of Barbecued, Roasted or Broiled Meat or Meat By-Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573144 .Subheading}

**[[B.14.072]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.072 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell meat or a meat by-product that has been barbecued, roasted or
broiled and is ready for consumption unless the cooked meat or meat
by-product

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} at all times

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has a temperature of 40°F (4.4°C) or lower, or
    140°F (60°C) or higher, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} has been stored at an ambient temperature of 40°F
    (4.4°C) or lower, or 140°F (60°C) or higher; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} carries on the principal display panel of the label a
  statement to the effect that the food must be stored at a temperature
  of 40°F (4.4°C) or lower, or 140°F (60°C) or higher.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-403, s. 4(F)
- SOR/88-336, s. 3
:::

#### [Meat Product Extender]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573152 .Subheading}

**[[B.14.073]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.073 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a meat product extender intended to be used in a food
consisting of a mixture described in section B.14.074, B.14.075,
B.14.076, B.14.077 or B.14.078, unless that extender

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has, in the rehydrated state,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a total protein content of not less than 16 per
    cent, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a protein quality of not less than that set out in
    column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
    Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
    corresponding method set out in column 4;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} contains, notwithstanding sections D.01.009 and
  D.02.009, each vitamin and mineral nutrient listed in Column I of the
  Table to this Division in an amount not less than the amount shown in
  Column II of that Table opposite each such vitamin and mineral
  nutrient respectively; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} where isolated essential amino acids have been added,
  contains those acids in an amount not exceeding an amount that
  improves the nutritional quality of the protein.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-768, s. 48
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 97](#1497273-1504556){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497273-1504556.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-B.14.073-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.14.073"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Extended Meat Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573161 .Subheading}

**[[B.14.074]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.074 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
sections B.14.075 to B.14.079, no person shall sell a food that consists
of a mixture of meat product and meat product extender, unless that food

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a total protein content of not less than 16 per
  cent;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a fat content of not more than that set out in
  column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
  Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
  corresponding method set out in column 4; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of the meat product extender, meets the
  requirements of paragraphs B.14.073(a) to (c).

**[[B.14.077]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.077 .sectionLabel}** No person

#### [Simulated Meat Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573201 .Subheading}

**[[B.14.085]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.14.085 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
sections B.14.086 to B.14.090 no person shall sell a simulated meat
product unless that product

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has, in the rehydrated state,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a total protein content of not less than 16 per
    cent,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a protein quality of not less than that set out in
    column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
    Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
    corresponding method set out in column 4, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a fat content of not more than that set out in
    column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
    Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
    corresponding method set out in column 4;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} contains, notwithstanding sections D.01.009 and
  D.02.009, each vitamin and mineral nutrient listed in Column I of the
  Table to this Division in an amount not less than the amount shown in
  Column II of that Table opposite each such vitamin and mineral
  nutrient respectively; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} where isolated essential amino acids have been added,
  contains those acids in an amount not exceeding an amount that
  improves the nutritional quality of the protein.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-768, s. 55

### [DIVISION 15]{.HLabel2}[Contaminants]{.HTitleText2} {#h-573261 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2024-244, s. 110

\]
:::

- **[[B.15.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.15.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A food referred to in column 2 of
  Part 1 of the List of Contaminants and Other Adulterating Substances
  in Foods is adulterated if the corresponding substance referred to, by
  name or class, in column 1 is present in or on the food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A food referred to in column 2 of Part 2 of the List
  of Contaminants and Other Adulterating Substances in Foods is
  adulterated if the corresponding substance referred to, by name or
  class, in column 1 is present in or on the food in an amount that
  exceeds the maximum level set out in column 3.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a substance referred to, by name or class, in
  column 1 in Part 2 the List of Contaminants and Other Adulterating
  Substances in Foods is present in or on the corresponding food
  referred to in column 2, the food is, in respect of the presence of
  the substance, exempt from the application of paragraph 4(1)(a) of the
  Act if the amount of the substance does not exceed the maximum level
  set out in column 3.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) to (3) do not apply to a substance
  that is present in or on a food as

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a food additive;

  - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a supplemental ingredient;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a pest control product as defined in subsection
    2(1) of the [Pest Control Products Act](/eng/acts/P-9.01) or its
    components or derivatives; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a veterinary drug or its metabolites.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-404, s. 1
- SOR/79-249, s. 1
- SOR/2016-74, s. 7

- **[[B.15.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.15.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), a food is
  adulterated if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a pest control product as defined in subsection
    2(1) of the [Pest Control Products Act](/eng/acts/P-9.01) or its
    components or derivatives, for which no maximum residue limit has
    been specified under sections 9 or 10 of that Act for that food, are
    present in or on the food, singly or in any combination, in an
    amount exceeding 0.1 part per million; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an agricultural chemical or its components or
    derivatives, other than a pest control product as defined in
    subsection 2(1) of the [Pest Control Products Act](/eng/acts/P-9.01)
    or its components or derivatives, are present in or on the food,
    singly or in any combination, in an amount exceeding 0.1 part per
    million.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A food is exempt from paragraph 4(1)(d) of the Act if
  the following agricultural chemicals, or their components or
  derivatives, are the only agricultural chemicals, or components or
  derivatives of agricultural chemicals, that are present in or on the
  food, singly or in any combination:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a fertilizer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an adjuvant or a carrier of an agricultural
    chemical;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an inorganic bromide salt;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} silicon dioxide;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} sulphur;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} viable spores of [Bacillus thuringiensis
    Berliner]{.otherLang lang="la"}; or

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} Kaolin.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to a food if there is
  present in or on the food an agricultural chemical, or a component or
  derivative of that agricultural chemical, referred to in that
  subsection that is a pest control product as defined in subsection
  2(1) of the [Pest Control Products Act](/eng/acts/P-9.01), or a
  component or derivative of that product, in respect of which a maximum
  residue limit has been specified under sections 9 or 10 of that Act
  for that food.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2008-181, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

### [DIVISION 16]{.HLabel2}[Food Additives]{.HTitleText2} {#h-573289 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1504598 .Subheading}

**[[B.16.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.001 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[dye]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dye]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a synthetic colour,
    means the principal dye and associated subsidiary and isomeric dyes
    contained in the synthetic colour. ([pigment]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[synthetic colour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[synthetic colour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any organic food
    colour, other than caramel, that is produced by chemical synthesis
    and that has no counterpart in nature. ([colorant
    synthétique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504604){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504604.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.16.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.16.001"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Adulteration]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1504605 .Subheading}

**[[B.16.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.002 .sectionLabel}** A food is
adulterated if a food additive is present in or on, or has been added
to, the food.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27

#### [Exemptions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1504608 .Subheading}

**[[B.16.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.003 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
sections B.16.005 and B.16.006, if a food additive set out in column 1
of the Lists of Permitted Food Additives is added to a corresponding
food set out in column 3, that food does not have a poisonous or harmful
substance in or on it for the purposes of paragraph 4(1)(a) of the Act
--- or is not adulterated for the purposes of paragraph 4(1)(d) of the
Act --- by reason only that the food additive is in or on it, or has
been added to it, if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the food additive is obtained from any corresponding
  source set out in column 2;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the food additive is used for any corresponding
  purpose of use set out in column 4;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the food additive does not exceed

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any corresponding maximum level of use and any
    corresponding maximum level of residue set out in column 5, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the amount that is required to accomplish the
    purpose for which it is added, in the case where the words "Good
    Manufacturing Practice" appear in column 5 for that food additive in
    the food; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} any other corresponding condition set out in column 5
  is met.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504617){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504617.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.16.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.16.003"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.16.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.004 .sectionLabel}** If a food
additive set out in column 1 of the Lists of Permitted Food Additives is
combined with other ingredients to manufacture a pre-mix --- other than
a pre-mix set out in column 3 --- the pre-mix is not adulterated for the
purposes of paragraph 4(1)(d) of the Act by reason only that the food
additive is in or on it if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the pre-mix is intended solely for use as an
  ingredient in the manufacture of another food intended for sale to a
  consumer at the retail level or as an ingredient in the preparation of
  another food by a commercial or industrial enterprise or an
  institution;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the pre-mix is not intended for sale to a consumer at
  the retail level;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the food additive is obtained from any corresponding
  source set out in column 2; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the food additive is intended for any corresponding
  purpose of use set out in column 4 in relation to a corresponding food
  set out in column 3.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504624){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504624.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.16.004-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.16.004"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.16.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.005 .sectionLabel}** If a food
that, under section B.16.003, does not contain a poisonous or harmful
substance in or on it for the purposes of paragraph 4(1)(a) of the Act
--- or is not adulterated for the purposes of paragraph 4(1)(d) of the
Act --- is used as an ingredient in another food, that other food also
does not contain a poisonous or harmful substance in or on it for the
purposes of paragraph 4(1)(a) of the Act and is not adulterated for the
purposes of paragraph 4(1)(d) of the Act by reason only that the food
additive referred to in section B.16.003 is present in or on that other
food, or has been added to the ingredient.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504627){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504627.html"}
:::

- **[[B.16.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (4),
  sections B.16.003 and B.16.005 do not apply to an infant food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Sections B.16.003 and B.16.005 apply to an infant
  food if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is a bakery product; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the food additive in or on the food is citric acid.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Section B.16.003 applies to an infant food if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the word "infant" is mentioned in column 3 of the
    Lists of Permitted Food Additives in relation to a food set out in
    that column; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is a human milk fortifier set out in column 3 of
    the Lists of Permitted Food Additives.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Section B.16.005 applies to an infant food if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it contains, as an ingredient, a food set out in
    column 3 of the Lists of Permitted Food Additives to which a
    corresponding food additive set out in column 1 has been added, and
    the use of that ingredient in that infant food is mentioned in
    column 3; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is an infant formula that contains, as an
    ingredient, a food set out in column 3 of the List of Permitted Food
    Enzymes that contains a corresponding food additive set out in
    column 1.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504640){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504640.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.16.006-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.16.006"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.16.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Sections B.16.003, B.16.005 and
  B.16.006 apply to the foods referred to in those sections if the other
  requirements of these Regulations that apply with respect to the food
  additive referred to in those sections are met.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Section B.16.004 applies to the pre-mix referred to
  in that section if the other requirements of these Regulations that
  apply with respect to the food additive referred to in that section
  are met.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/87-640, s. 5
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504644){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504644.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.16.007-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.16.007"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Prohibitions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1504645 .Subheading}

**[[B.16.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.008 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell any fresh fruit or vegetable, except grapes, to which
sulphurous acid or any of its salts has been added and that is intended
to be consumed raw.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504648){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504648.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.16.008-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.16.008"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.16.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.009 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a substance as a food additive unless the substance is set
out in column 1 of the Lists of Permitted Food Additives.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504651){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504651.html"}
:::

**[[B.16.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.010 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell vanilla extract or vanilla flavour for which a standard is
set out in Volume 9 of the Food Compositional Standards Document to
which a food colour has been added.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504654){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504654.html"}
:::

#### [Specifications]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1504655 .Subheading}

- **[[B.16.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A food additive set out in column 1
  of the Table of Food Additive Specifications must meet the
  specifications set out in column 2 for that food additive.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a food additive is not listed in the Table of Food
  Additive Specifications, but specifications are set out for the food
  additive in one of the following publications, the food additive must
  meet the specifications set out for it in that publication:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Food Chemicals Codex, published by the United
    States Pharmacopeial Convention, including its supplements, as
    amended from time to time; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Combined Compendium of Food Additive
    Specifications, prepared by the Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on
    Food Additives and published by the Food and Agriculture
    Organization of the United Nations on its website, as amended from
    time to time.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the specifications referred to
  in subsection (1) may incorporate portions of the publications
  referred to in paragraphs (2)(a) and (b).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[Table of Food Additive
  Specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Table of Food Additive
  Specifications, published by the Government of Canada on its website,
  as amended from time to time.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504664){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504664.html"}
:::

**[[B.16.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.012 .sectionLabel}** If a food
additive is a water soluble synthetic colour, its lake must be the
calcium or aluminum salt of the synthetic colour adsorbed or
precipitated on alumina.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504667){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504667.html"}
:::

#### [Labelling and Packaging]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1504668 .Subheading}

**[[B.16.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.013 .sectionLabel}** A
quantitative statement of the amount of each food additive present or
directions for use that, if followed, will produce a food that does not
contain these food additives in excess of the maximum levels of use or
maximum levels of residue prescribed by these Regulations must be shown,
grouped together with the list of ingredients, in respect of any
substance or mixture of substances for use as a food additive.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504671){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504671.html"}
:::

**[[B.16.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.014 .sectionLabel}** A
quantitative statement of the amount of each food additive referred to
in section B.16.004 and directions for use that, if followed, will
produce a corresponding food set out in column 3 of the Lists of
Permitted Food Additives that does not contain these food additives in
excess of the maximum levels of use or maximum levels of residue
prescribed by these Regulations must be shown, grouped together with the
list of ingredients, in respect of a pre-mix referred to in that
section.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504674){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504674.html"}
:::

**[[B.16.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.015 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell for household use in or on a food, a food colour preparation
containing one or more synthetic colours unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the words "Food Colour Preparation" appear on the
  principal display panel;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a liquid food colour preparation, the
  container has a capacity of 60 mL or less and permits dropwise
  discharge only; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the food colour preparation contains less than 3%
  dye.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504680){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504680.html"}
:::

- **[[B.16.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.016
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The label of a food that contains
  aspartame must carry a statement warning individuals with
  phenylketonuria that the food contains phenylalanine or a statement to
  the effect that aspartame contains phenylalanine.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The statement must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be shown in bold type;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} appear, in respect of each linguistic version,
    immediately after the list of ingredients appearing in the same
    language, either on the same line as the last ingredient in the list
    or on the following line, without any intervening printed, written
    or graphic material; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} appear on the same continuous surface as the list
    of ingredients and be shown in the same manner as that list is shown
    in accordance with subsection B.01.008.2(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504688){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504688.html"}
:::

**[[B.16.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.017 .sectionLabel}** The label of
a food that contains polydextrose must indicate the amount of
polydextrose, expressed in grams per serving of stated size.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504691){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504691.html"}
:::

- **[[B.16.018]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.018
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The label of a food that contains
  erythritol must carry a statement indicating the amount of erythritol,
  expressed in grams per serving of stated size, unless the label
  carries a nutrition facts table or supplemented food facts table.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The statement of the amount of erythritol must be
  grouped together with the statement of the amount of any other sugar
  alcohols and the amount of polydextrose.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504696){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504696.html"}
:::

**[[B.16.019]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.019 .sectionLabel}** The label of
a table-top sweetener that contains aspartame, sucralose,
acesulfame-potassium or neotame must carry a statement of the sweetness
per serving, expressed in terms of the amount of sugar required to
produce an equivalent degree of sweetness.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504699){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504699.html"}
:::

- **[[B.16.020]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.020
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The label of cured beef, the cuts of
  which have been cured with pumping pickle that contains any
  proteolytic food enzyme, must carry, on the principal display panel,
  immediately preceding or following the common name, the statement
  "Tenderized with (naming the proteolytic food enzyme)".

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[food enzyme]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
  means any enzyme that is a food additive used to catalyze a chemical
  reaction in a food.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 112](#1497318-1504704){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497318-1504704.html"}
:::

**[[B.16.100]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.16.100 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2024-244, s. 112\]]{.Repealed}

  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell, for table or
  general household use, salt for which a standard is set out in Volume
  14 of the Food Compositional Standards Document unless the salt
  contains 0.01% potassium iodide.

  display panel.

**[[B.17.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.17.004 .sectionLabel}** Salt for
table or general household use referred to in section B.17.003 may
contain dextrose to stabilize potassium iodide.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 113](#1497320-1504714){.wb-lbx

### [DIVISION 19]{.HLabel2}[Vinegar]{.HTitleText2} {#h-573625 .Subheading}

**[[B.19.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.19.001 .sectionLabel}** Vinegar shall
be the liquid obtained by the acetous fermentation of an alcoholic
liquid and shall contain not less than 4.1 per cent and not more than
12.3 per cent acetic acid.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/92-626, s. 16
- SOR/93-243, s. 2
:::

**[[B.19.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.19.002 .sectionLabel}** The
percentage of acetic acid by volume contained in vinegar must be shown
on the principal display panel followed by the words "acetic acid".

**[[B.19.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.19.008 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall name any of the varieties of vinegar forming a blended vinegar
unless the label of such blended vinegar carries a complete list of all
the varieties of vinegar present, in descending order of proportionate
content, based on acetic acid.

**[[B.19.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.19.009 .sectionLabel}** The maximum
limits for the acetic acid content of a vinegar described in section
B.19.001 do not apply to vinegar sold only for manufacturing use if the
words "For Manufacturing Use Only" are shown on the principal display
panel and upon all documents pertaining to such vinegar.

### [DIVISION 21]{.HLabel2}[Marine and Fresh Water Animal Products]{.HTitleText2} {#h-573655 .Subheading}

**[[B.21.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.001 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2024-244, s. 117\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.21.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Division,

  [[filler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[filler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} flour or meal prepared from grain or potato,
        but not from a legume,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} processed wheat flour containing an amount of
        reducing sugars, expressed as dextrose equivalent, of not less
        than that set out in column 3 for that item of the Table of
        Chemical, Physical and Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as
        determined by the corresponding method set out in column 4,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} bakery products, except those containing a
        legume,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} milk powder, skim milk powder, buttermilk
        powder or whey powder, and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} starch; ([agent de
        remplissage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[marine and fresh water animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[marine and fresh water animal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} fish,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} crustaceans, molluscs, other marine
        invertebrates,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} marine mammals, and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} frogs; ([animaux marins et animaux d'eau
        douce]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the clean and dressed flesh of
      crustaceans, molluscs, other marine invertebrates and marine
      mammals. ([chair]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of sections B.21.005, B.21.008 and
  B.21.020, except the terms fish protein and fish binder,
  [[fish]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means clean and dressed fish.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-768, s. 62

**[[B.21.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.005 .sectionLabel}** Fish or fish
preparations, except fish protein, and meat products or meat product
preparations are adulterated if any mucous membranes, any organ or
portion of the genital system or any other organ or portion of a marine
or fresh water animal that is not commonly sold as food is present in or
has been added to them.

**[[B.21.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.008 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell filler or a fish binder represented for use in fish products
either by label or in any advertisement unless the label carries
adequate directions for use in accordance with the requirements of
sections B.21.020 and B.21.021, as the case may be.

fully hydrogenated cottonseed oil may be applied as a release agent to

greater than 0.25% of the product.

#### [Prepared Fish]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573720 .Subheading}

**[[B.21.020]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.020 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell prepared fish that contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} more than that amount of filler, fish binder and
  other ingredients that is represented by an amount of reducing sugars,
  expressed as dextrose equivalent, that is set out in column 3 for that
  item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and Nutritional
  Characteristics of Food, as determined by the corresponding method set
  out in column 4; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} more than 70% moisture, in the case of prepared fish
  that contains filler.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-768, s. 63
- SOR/2017-18, s. 20(F)

**[[B.21.021]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.021 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell prepared meat that contains more than that amount of filler,
fish binder and other ingredients that is represented by an amount of
reducing sugars, expressed as dextrose equivalent, that is set out in
column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the corresponding
method set out in column 4.

**[[B.21.024]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.024 .sectionLabel}** Despite
section B.21.021, lobster paste must not contain more than 2% filler or
fish binder.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 121](#1497342-1504790){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497342-1504790.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.21.024-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.21.024"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.21.025]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.025 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell marine and fresh water animals, or marine and fresh water
animal products, that are packed in a container that has been sealed to
exclude air and that are smoked or to which liquid smoke flavour or
liquid smoke flavour concentrate has been added, unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the container has been heat-processed after sealing
  at a temperature and for a time sufficient to destroy all spores of
  the species [Clostridium botulinum]{.otherLang lang="la"};

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the contents of the container contain an amount of
  salt not less than that set out in column 3 for that item of the Table
  of Chemical, Physical and Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as
  determined by the corresponding method set out in column 4;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the contents of the container are customarily cooked
  before eating; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the contents of the container are frozen and the
  principal display panel of the label of the container carries the
  statement "Keep Frozen Prior to Use" in the same size type used for
  the common name of the contents of the container.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-13, s. 10
- SOR/82-566, s. 5
- SOR/82-768, s. 64
- SOR/89-198, s. 17
- SOR/94-567, s. 4
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 122](#1497344-1504792){.wb-lbx

:::

:::

**[[B.21.027]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.21.027 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell fish protein unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} it has a total protein content of at least 75%; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the quality of the protein is not less than that set
  out in column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
  Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
  corresponding method set out in column 4.

### [DIVISION 22]{.HLabel2}[Poultry, Poultry Meat, Their Preparations and Products]{.HTitleText2} {#h-573757 .Subheading}

**[[B.22.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.001 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[poultry]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[poultry]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any bird that is commonly used
    as food. ([volaille]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[poultry meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[poultry meat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means poultry flesh, including
    the heart and gizzard. ([viande de volaille]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[poultry meat by-product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[poultry meat by-product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any part of
    poultry, other than poultry meat, commonly used as food, including
    the liver and skin but excluding the oesophagus, feet and
    head. ([sous-produit de viande de volaille]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 124](#1497348-1504804){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497348-1504804.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.22.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.22.001"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.22.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.002 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell poultry meat or a poultry meat by-product unless it is clean,
dressed and derived from eviscerated poultry that was healthy at the
time of slaughter.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-13, s. 11
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 124](#1497348-1504806){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497348-1504806.html"}

poultry that is not commonly sold as food is present in or has been

**[[B.22.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.009 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} any poultry intended for consumption as food if any
  preparation having oestrogenic activity has been administered to the
  poultry; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} poultry meat or poultry meat by-product that contains
  any residues of exogenous oestrogenic substances.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/87-626, s. 2
:::

**[[B.22.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.010 .sectionLabel}** Powdered
fully hydrogenated cottonseed oil may be applied as a release agent to
the surface of poultry meat, poultry meat by-product, prepared poultry
meat, prepared poultry meat by-product, extended poultry product and
simulated poultry product in an amount not greater than 0.25% of the
product.

- SOR/2010-142, s. 59(F)

- **[[B.22.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.012
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell solid cut
  poultry meat to which food additives or water have been added unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case where the meat is cooked, it has a meat
    protein content of at least 12 per cent; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case where the meat is uncooked, it has a
    meat protein content of at least 10 per cent.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A bone or visible fat layer is excluded in
  calculating the meat protein content.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/94-262, s. 14
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 126](#1497352-1504825){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497352-1504825.html"}

**[[B.22.026]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.026 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell poultry, poultry meat or poultry meat by-product that has
been barbecued, roasted or broiled and is ready for consumption unless
the cooked poultry, poultry meat or poultry meat by-product

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} at all times

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has a temperature of 40°F (4.4°C) or lower, or
    140°F (60°C) or higher, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} has been stored at an ambient temperature of 40°F
    (4.4°C) or lower, or 140°F (60°C) or higher; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} carries on the principal display panel of the label a
  statement to the effect that the food must be stored at a temperature
  of 40°F (4.4°C) or lower, or 140°F (60°C) or higher.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-403, s. 28(F)
- SOR/88-336, s. 3
:::

#### [Poultry Product Extender]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573884 .Subheading}

**[[B.22.027]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.027 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a poultry product extender unless that extender

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has, in the rehydrated state,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a total protein content of not less than 16 per
    cent; and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a protein quality of not less than that set out in
    column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
    Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
    corresponding method set out in column 4;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} has, notwithstanding sections D.01.009 and D.02.009,
  each vitamin and mineral nutrient listed in Column I of the Table to
  Division 14 in an amount not less than the amount shown in Column II
  of that Table opposite each such vitamin and mineral nutrient
  respectively; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} where isolated essential amino acids have been added,
  contains those acids in an amount not exceeding an amount that
  improves the nutritional quality of the protein.

#### [Extended Poultry Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573893 .Subheading}

**[[B.22.028]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.028 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a food that consists of a mixture of poultry product and
poultry product extender, unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the food has a total protein content of at least 16%;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the food has a protein quality of not less than that
  set out in column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical
  and Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
  corresponding method set out in column 4; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the poultry product extender meets the requirements
  of paragraphs B.22.027(a) to (c).

#### [Simulated Poultry Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573898 .Subheading}

**[[B.22.029]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.029 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a simulated poultry product unless that product

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a total protein content of not less than 16 per
  cent;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a protein quality of not less than that set out
  in column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
  Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
  corresponding method set out in column 4;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} has a fat content of not more than 15 per cent;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} contains, notwithstanding sections D.01.009 and
  D.02.009, each vitamin and mineral nutrient listed in Column I of the
  Table to Division 14 in an amount not less than the amount shown in
  Column II of that Table opposite each such vitamin and mineral
  nutrient respectively; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} where isolated essential amino acids have been added,
  contains those acids in an amount not exceeding an amount that
  improves the nutritional quality of the protein.

#### [Egg Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-573907 .Subheading}

**[[B.22.032]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.22.032 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell any product simulating whole egg unless that product

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is made from liquid, dried or frozen egg albumen or
  mixtures thereof;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} has a protein quality of not less than that set out
  in column 3 for that item of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
  Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as determined by the
  corresponding method set out in column 4;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} notwithstanding sections D.01.009 and D.02.009,
  contains, per 100 grams on a ready-to-use basis,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} not less than

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} 50 milligrams calcium,

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} 2.3 milligrams iron,

    - [(C)]{.lawlabel} 1.5 milligrams zinc,

    - [(D)]{.lawlabel} 130 milligrams potassium,

    - [(E)]{.lawlabel} 1000 International Units Vitamin A,

    - [(F)]{.lawlabel} 0.10 milligram thiamine,

    - [(G)]{.lawlabel} 0.30 milligram riboflavin,

    - [(H)]{.lawlabel} 3.60 milligrams niacin,

    - [(I)]{.lawlabel} 1.60 milligrams pantothenic acid,

    - [(J)]{.lawlabel} 0.20 milligram Vitamin B~6′~,

    - [(K)]{.lawlabel} 0.50 microgram Vitamin B~12′~,

    - [(L)]{.lawlabel} 0.02 milligram folic acid, and

    - [(M)]{.lawlabel} 2.0 International Units alpha tocopherol, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not more than 3 milligrams cholesterol;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} has a calcium to phosphorous ratio of not less than
  one part calcium to four parts phosphorous; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} contains in the total fat of any fat or oil used not
  less than 40 per cent cis-cis methylene interrupted polyunsaturated
  fatty acids and not more than 20 per cent saturated fatty acids.

### [DIVISION 23]{.HLabel2}[Food Packaging Materials]{.HTitleText2} {#h-573968 .Subheading}

**[[B.23.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.23.001 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell any food in a package that may yield to its contents any
substance that may be injurious to the health of a consumer of the food.

**[[B.23.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.23.002 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section B.23.003 no person shall sell any food in a package that has
been manufactured from a polyvinyl chloride formulation containing an
octyltin chemical.

**[[B.23.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.23.003 .sectionLabel}** A person may
sell food, other than milk, skim milk, partly skimmed milk, sterilized
milk, malt beverages and carbonated non-alcoholic beverage products, in
a package that has been manufactured from a polyvinyl chloride
formulation containing any or all of the octyltin chemicals, namely,
di(n-octyl)tin S,S′-bis(isooctylmercaptoacetate), di(n-octyl)tin maleate
polymer and (n-octyl)tin S,S′,S″-tris(isooctylmercaptoacetate) if the
proportion of such chemicals, either singly or in combination, does not
exceed a total of three per cent of the resin, and the food in contact
with the package contains not more than one part per million total
octyltin.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-60, s. 13
- SOR/86-1125, s. 4
:::

- **[[B.23.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.23.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Di (n-octyl)tin S,S′-bis
  (isooctylmercaptoacetate) shall be the octyltin chemical made from di
  (n-octyl)tin dichloride and shall contain 15.1 to 16.4 per cent of tin
  and 8.1 to 8.9 per cent of mercapto sulfur.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Division, di (n-octyl)tin
  dichloride shall be the chemical having an organotin composition of
  not less than 95 per cent di (n-octyl)tin dichloride and shall contain
  no more than

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} five per cent total of n-octyltin trichloride or
    tri(n-octyl)tin chloride or both;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 0.2 per cent total of other eight (8) carbon
    isomeric alkyltin derivatives; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 0.1 per cent total of the higher and lower
    homologous alkyltin derivatives.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/86-1125, s. 5
:::

**[[B.23.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.23.005
.sectionLabel}** Di(n-octyl)tin maleate polymer shall be the octyltin
chemical made from di(n-octyl)tin dichloride and shall have the formula
((C~8~H~17~)~2~ SnC~4~H~2~O~4~)n (where n is between 2 and 4 inclusive),
and a saponification number of 225 to 255, and shall contain 25.2 to
26.6 per cent of tin.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/86-1125, s. 6(F)
:::

- **[[B.23.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.23.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} (n-octyl)tin S,S′,S″-tris
  (isooctylmercaptoacetate), being an octyltin chemical having the
  formula n-C~8~H~17~Sn(SCH~2~CO~2~C~8~H~17~)~3~, shall be made from
  (n-octyl)tin trichloride and shall contain 13.4 to 14.8 per cent of
  tin and 10.9 to 11.9 per cent of mercapto sulfur.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Division, (n-octyl)tin
  trichloride shall be the chemical having an organotin composition of
  not less than 95 per cent (n-octyl)tin trichloride and shall contain
  not more than

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} five per cent total of di(n-octyl)tin dichloride,
    tri(n-octyl)tin chloride or the higher (more than eight (8) carbons)
    alkyltin chlorides or any combination of the foregoing;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 0.2 per cent total of alkyltin derivatives; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} 0.1 per cent of the lower (less than eight carbons)
    homologous alkyltin derivatives.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/86-1125, s. 7
:::

**[[B.23.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.23.007 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a food in a package that may transfer to the food any amount
of vinyl chloride or acrylonitrile, as determined by the corresponding
method set out in column 4 of the Table of Chemical, Physical and
Nutritional Characteristics of Food.
