### [DIVISION 24]{.HLabel2} {#h-573999 .Subheading}

#### [Foods for Special Dietary Use]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574000 .Subheading}

**[[B.24.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.001 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

[[expiration date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[expiration date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a
    formulated liquid diet, a food represented for use in a very
    low-energy diet, a meal replacement or a nutritional supplement, the
    date

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} after which the manufacturer does not recommend
      that it be consumed, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} up to which it maintains its microbiological and
      physical stability and the nutrient content declared on the
      label; ([date limite d'utilisation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[food for special dietary use]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[food for special dietary use]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means food that
    has been specially processed or formulated to meet the particular
    requirements of a person

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in whom a physical or physiological condition
      exists as a result of a disease, disorder or injury, or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for whom a particular effect, including but not
      limited to weight loss, is to be obtained by a controlled intake
      of foods; ([aliment à usage diététique spécial]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[formulated liquid diet]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[formulated liquid diet]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is sold for consumption in liquid form, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is sold or represented as a nutritionally
      complete diet for oral or tube feeding of a person described in
      paragraph (a) of the definition "food for special dietary
      use"; ([préparation pour régime liquide]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[hospital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[hospital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a facility

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is licensed, approved or designated as a
      hospital by a province, in accordance with the laws of the
      province, to provide care or treatment to persons suffering from
      any form of disease or illness, or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is owned or operated by the government of
      Canada or of a province and that provides health
      services; ([hôpital]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[major change]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[major change]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a food
    that is represented for use in a very low energy diet, any change in
    any of the following, where the manufacturer's experience or
    generally accepted theory would predict an adverse effect on the
    levels or availability of nutrients in, the microbiological or
    chemical safety of or the safe use of the food:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an ingredient or the amount of an ingredient in
      the food,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturing process or the packaging of the
      food, or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the directions for the preparation and use of the
      food; ([changement majeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[meal replacement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[meal replacement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/95-474,
    s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

[[pharmacist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[pharmacist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is registered
    and entitled under the laws of a province to practise pharmacy and
    who is practising pharmacy under those laws in that
    province; ([pharmacien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[physician]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[physician]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is registered
    and entitled under the laws of a province to practise medicine and
    who is practicing medicine under those laws in that
    province; ([médecin]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[prepackaged meal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[prepackaged meal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/95-474,
    s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

[[target body weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[target body weight]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the anticipated
    body weight at the end of the weight reduction diet, as determined
    by the physician before the weight reduction diet begins; ([poids
    corporel cible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[very low energy diet]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[very low energy diet]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a diet for weight
    reduction that provides less than 900 kilocalories per day when
    followed as directed. ([régime à très faible teneur en
    énergie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-64, s. 1
- SOR/78-698, s. 4
- SOR/94-35, s. 1
- SOR/95-474, s. 3
:::

- **[[B.24.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall label, package, sell
  or advertise a food in a manner likely to create an impression that it
  is a food for special dietary use unless the food is

  - [(a) to (e)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2003-11, s.
    21\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a formulated liquid diet that meets the
    requirements contained in sections B.24.101 and B.24.102;

  - [(f.1)]{.lawlabel} a meal replacement for special dietary use that
    meets the requirements contained in section B.24.200;

  - [(f.2)]{.lawlabel} a nutritional supplement that meets the
    requirements contained in section B.24.201;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a gluten-free food that meets the requirements
    contained in section B.24.018;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} represented for protein-restricted diets;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} represented for low (naming the amino acid) diets;
    or

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a food represented for use in a very low energy
    diet, where the food meets the requirements contained in section
    B.24.303.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a person may label,
  package, sell or advertise a food in a manner likely to create an
  impression that it is a food for special dietary use if its label
  carries a statement or claim set out in column 4 of the Table of
  Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims, in accordance with
  section B.01.503, in respect of any of the following subjects set out
  in column 1:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "free of energy", set out in item 1;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "low in energy", set out in item 2;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} "free of sodium or salt", set out in item 31;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} "low in sodium or salt", set out in item 32; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} "free of sugars", set out in item 37.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a [[human milk
  fortifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} or [[human milk
  substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section B.25.001.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person shall label, package, sell or advertise a
  food in a manner likely to create an impression that it is for use in
  a weight reduction diet unless that food is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a meal replacement that meets the compositional
    requirements contained in section B.24.200;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a prepackaged meal;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a food sold by a weight reduction clinic to clients
    of the clinic for use in a weight reduction program supervised by
    the staff of the clinic; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a food represented for use in a very low-energy
    diet that meets the compositional requirements contained in section
    B.24.303.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise permitted by these Regulations,
  no person shall label, package, sell or advertise a food as "dietetic"
  or "diet", or use those words as part of the brand name of the food,
  unless its label carries a statement or claim set out in column 4 of
  the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims, in
  accordance with section B.01.503, in respect of any of the following
  subjects set out in column 1:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} "free of energy", set out in item 1;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} "low in energy", set out in item 2;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} "reduced in energy", set out in item 3;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} "lower in energy", set out in item 4; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} "free of sugars", set out in item 37.

**[[B.24.015 and B.24.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.015_and_B.24.016
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/88-559, s. 6\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.24.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.017
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the manufacturer of a
  formulated liquid diet, a meal replacement or a food represented for
  use in a very low energy diet is requested in writing by the Minister
  to submit, on or before a specified day, evidence with respect to that
  product, the manufacturer shall make no further sales of that product
  after that day unless the manufacturer has submitted the evidence
  requested.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister determines that the evidence
  submitted by a manufacturer under subsection (1) is not sufficient, he
  or she shall so notify the manufacturer in writing.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to subsection (2), a manufacturer is
  notified that the evidence with respect to a formulated liquid diet, a
  meal replacement or a food represented for use in a very low energy
  diet is not sufficient, the manufacturer shall make no further sales
  of that product unless the manufacturer submits further evidence and
  is notified in writing by the Minister that the further evidence is
  sufficient.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A reference in this section to evidence with respect
  to a formulated liquid diet, a meal replacement or a food represented
  for use in a very low energy diet means evidence to establish that the
  food is nutritionally adequate to be used as the sole source of
  nutrition in meeting the nutritional needs of a person for whom it is
  intended, when the food is consumed in accordance with the directions
  for use.

**[[B.24.019]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.019 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2003-11, s. 23\]]{.Repealed}

#### [Formulated Liquid Diets]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574069 .Subheading}

**[[B.24.100]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.100 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall advertise a formulated liquid diet to the general public.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-64, s. 7
- SOR/78-698, s. 7
:::

**[[B.24.101]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.101 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a formulated liquid diet unless the food

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if sold ready to serve, or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if not sold ready to serve, when diluted with water,
  milk, or water and milk,

is a complete substitute for the total diet in meeting the nutritional
requirements of a person.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-64, s. 7
:::

- **[[B.24.102]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.102
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), a
  formulated liquid diet shall contain, when ready to serve,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} either

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at least 20 g of protein, the quality of which is
      not less than that set out in column 3 for that item of the Table
      of Chemical, Physical and Nutritional Characteristics of Food, as
      determined by the corresponding method set out in column 4, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} such an amount and quality of protein, including
      those proteins to which amino acids are added, that, when the
      quality of the protein is expressed as a fraction of the quality
      of casein,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the fraction will not be less than 85/100, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the result obtained by multiplying the fraction
        by the gram weight of the protein will not be less than 20; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} not less than one gram linoleic acid in the form of
    a glyceride.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding sections D.01.009, D.01.011 and
  D.02.009, a formulated liquid diet shall contain, when ready to serve,
  the vitamins and minerals named in Column I of the table to this
  section in amounts,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the recommended intake of the food is 2,500
    kilocalories per day or less, not less than the amounts set out in
    Column II and not more than the amounts, if any, set out in Column
    III of that table opposite those vitamins and minerals; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the recommended intake of the food is greater
    than 2,500 kilocalories per day, not less than the amounts set out
    in Column IV and not more than the amounts, if any, set out in
    Column V of the table opposite those vitamins and minerals.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The amounts of the nutrients specified in paragraphs
  (1)(a) and (b) and subsection (2) shall be calculated

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} per 1,000 available kilocalories, where the
    recommended intake of the food is 2,500 kilocalories per day or
    less; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} per 1,500 available kilocalories, where recommended
    intake of the food is greater than 2,500 kilocalories per day.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(a) does not apply to a formulated
  liquid diet represented as being for a protein restricted diet or a
  low (named amino acid) diet.

**[[B.24.103]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.103 .sectionLabel}** The label of
a formulated liquid diet shall carry the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement that the food is intended to be consumed
  orally or by tube feeding;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the energy value of the food,
  expressed in Calories

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} per 100 grams or per 100 millilitres of the food as
    offered for sale, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} per unit of ready-to-serve food;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the content in the food of protein or
  protein equivalent, fat, linoleic acid, available carbohydrate and,
  where present, crude fibre, expressed in grams

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} per 100 grams or per 100 millilitres of the food as
    offered for sale, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} per unit of ready-to-serve food;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the content of vitamins and mineral
  nutrients that are listed in the table to section B.24.102, expressed
  in International Units, milligrams or micrograms

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} per 100 grams or per 100 millilitres of the food as
    offered for sale, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} per unit of ready-to-serve food;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the content of any vitamin or mineral
  nutrient that is not listed in the table to section B.24.102,
  expressed in milligrams or micrograms

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} per 100 grams or per 100 millilitres of the food as
    offered for sale, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} per unit of ready-to-serve food;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} complete directions for the preparation and use of
  the food and for its storage after the container has been opened; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the formulated liquid diet.

#### [Meal Replacements, Nutritional Supplements, Prepackaged Meals and Foods Sold by Weight Reduction Clinics]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574120 .Subheading}

- **[[B.24.200]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.200
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise a
  meal replacement unless, when in a ready-to-serve form or when
  prepared according to directions for use, with water, milk, partially
  skim milk or skim milk, or a combination thereof, it meets the
  following requirements:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the meal replacement provides a minimum of 225 kcal
    or 945 kJ per serving;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} not less than 15 per cent and not more than 40 per
    cent of the energy available from the meal replacement is derived
    from its protein content, except that a meal replacement for use in
    a weight reduction diet shall derive not less than 20 per cent of
    its available energy from its protein content;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (2), not more than 35 per
    cent of the energy available from the meal replacement is derived
    from its fat content;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} not less than 3.0 per cent of the energy available
    from the meal replacement is derived from linoleic acid in the form
    of a glyceride and not less than 0.5 per cent of the energy
    available from the meal replacement is derived from n-3 linolenic
    acid in the form of a glyceride, and the ratio of linoleic acid to
    n-3 linolenic acid is not less than 4 to 1 and not more than 10 to
    1;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the proteins present in the meal replacement are

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of a nutritional quality equivalent to that of
      casein, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} of a nutritional quality and in an amount
      sufficient to yield a result of not less than 15 per cent, or not
      less than 20 per cent in the case of a meal replacement for use in
      a weight reduction diet, when the nutritional quality of those
      proteins is divided by the nutritional quality of casein and
      multiplied by the percentage of energy available from the proteins
      present in the meal replacement; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} each serving of the meal replacement contains each
    vitamin and mineral nutrient listed in column I of the table to this
    section

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (3), in an amount not less
      than the minimum amount shown for that vitamin or mineral nutrient
      in column II of the table, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsections (4) and (5), in an amount
      that, including overage, is not more than the maximum amount shown
      for that vitamin or mineral nutrient in column III of the table.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise a meal replacement
  that is represented as a replacement for all daily meals unless, when
  in a ready-to-serve form or when prepared according to directions for
  use, with water, milk, partially skim milk or skim milk, or a
  combination thereof, it meets the following requirements:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} not more than 30 per cent of the energy available
    from the meal replacement is derived from its fat content; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} not more than 10 per cent of the energy available
    from the meal replacement is derived from its saturated fatty acid
    content.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The minimum amount required under subparagraph
  (1)(f)(i) for selenium, chromium or molybdenum does not apply in
  respect of a meal replacement that is not represented as a replacement
  for all daily meals and that does not contain added selenium, chromium
  or molybdenum, as the case may be.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A vitamin or mineral nutrient that is not an added
  ingredient in the meal replacement shall not be taken into account for
  the purposes of subparagraph (1)(f)(ii).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The maximum amount shown for vitamin C in column III
  of the table to this section does not include overage.

- **[[B.24.201]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.201
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise a
  nutritional supplement that contains less than 225 kcal or 945 kJ per
  serving, unless it meets the following requirements:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nutritional supplement contains at least
    150 kcal or 630 kJ per serving;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} not less than 15 per cent and no more than 40 per
    cent of the energy available from the nutritional supplement is
    derived from its protein content;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the proteins present in the nutritional supplement
    are

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of a nutritional quality equivalent to that of
      casein, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} of a nutritional quality and in an amount
      sufficient to yield a result of not less than 15 per cent when the
      nutritional quality of those proteins is divided by the
      nutritional quality of casein and multiplied by the percentage of
      energy available from the proteins present in the nutritional
      supplement; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the nutritional supplement contains, per 100 kcal
    or 420 kJ, each vitamin and mineral nutrient listed in column I of
    the table to this section

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (3), in an amount not less
      than the minimum amount shown for that vitamin or mineral nutrient
      in column II of the table, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsections (4) and (5), in an amount
      that, including overage, is not more than the maximum amount shown
      for that vitamin or mineral nutrient in column III of the table.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise a nutritional
  supplement that provides 225 kcal or 945 kJ, or more, per serving
  unless, when in a ready-to-serve form or when prepared according to
  directions for use, with water, milk, partially skim milk, skim milk,
  or a combination thereof, it meets the following requirements:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nutritional supplement provides at least
    225 kcal or 945 kJ per serving;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} not more than 35 per cent of the energy available
    from the nutritional supplement is derived from its fat content;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} not less than 3.0 per cent of the energy available
    from the nutritional supplement is derived from linoleic acid in the
    form of a glyceride and not less than 0.5 per cent of the energy
    available from the nutritional supplement is derived from n-3
    linolenic acid in the form of a glyceride, and the ratio of linoleic
    acid to n-3 linolenic acid is not less than 4 to 1 and not more than
    10 to 1;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} not less than 15 per cent and not more than 40 per
    cent of the energy available from the nutritional supplement is
    derived from its protein content;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the proteins present in the nutritional supplement
    are

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of a nutritional quality equivalent to that of
      casein, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} of a nutritional quality and in an amount
      sufficient to yield a result of not less than 15 per cent when the
      nutritional quality of those proteins is divided by the
      nutritional quality of casein and multiplied by the percentage of
      energy available from the proteins present in the nutritional
      supplement; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the nutritional supplement contains, per 100 kcal
    or 420 kJ, each vitamin and mineral nutrient listed in column I of
    the table to this section

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (3), in an amount not less
      than the minimum amount shown for that vitamin or mineral nutrient
      in column II of the table, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsections (4) and (5), in an amount
      that, including overage, is not more than the maximum amount shown
      for that vitamin or mineral nutrient in column III of the table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The minimum amount required under subparagraph
  (1)(d)(i) or (2)(f)(i) for selenium, chromium or molybdenum does not
  apply in respect of a nutritional supplement that does not contain
  added selenium, chromium or molybdenum, as the case may be.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A vitamin or mineral nutrient that is not an added
  ingredient in the nutritional supplement shall not be taken into
  account for the purposes of subparagraphs (1)(d)(ii) and (2)(f)(ii).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The maximum amount shown for vitamin C in column III
  of the table to this section does not include overage.

**[[B.24.202]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.202 .sectionLabel}** The label of
a meal replacement or nutritional supplement shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} show the following information per serving of stated
  size and per stated quantity of food, when prepared according to the
  directions for use:

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the energy value of the food, expressed in Calories
    (Calories or Cal) and kilojoules (kilojoules or kJ),

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the protein, fat, linoleic acid, n-3 linolenic
    acid, saturated fatty acid and carbohydrate contents of the food,
    expressed in grams,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the vitamin A, vitamin D, vitamin E, vitamin C,
    thiamin or vitamin B~1~, riboflavin or vitamin B~2~, niacin, vitamin
    B~6~, vitamin B~12~, folate and pantothenic acid or pantothenate
    contents of the food, expressed

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a meal replacement, as a
      percentage of the daily value specified in column 4 of Part 2 of
      the Table of Daily Values for that vitamin, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a nutritional supplement, in the
      applicable unit referred to in subsection D.01.003(1),

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the calcium, phosphorus, iron, iodide, magnesium
    and zinc contents of the food, expressed

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a meal replacement, as a
      percentage of the daily value specified in column 4 of Part 2 of
      the Table of Daily Values, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a nutritional supplement, in
      milligrams for calcium, phosphorus, iron, magnesium and zinc and
      in micrograms for iodide,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the copper, potassium, sodium and manganese
    contents of the food, expressed in milligrams, and

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the biotin, selenium, chromium and molybdenum
    contents of the food, expressed in micrograms;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a meal replacement or a nutritional
  supplement to which milk, partially skim milk or skim milk is to be
  added, carry a statement that the nutrient content of the food has
  been determined taking into consideration the milk, partially skim
  milk or skim milk that will be added according to the directions for
  use;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a meal replacement that is sold or
  advertised as a replacement for all daily meals in a weight reduction
  diet, include directions for use that would result in a daily energy
  intake of at least 900 kcal or 3 780 kJ;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} include the expiration date of the meal replacement
  or nutritional supplement;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a meal replacement for use in a weight
  reduction diet, carry the statement "USEFUL IN WEIGHT REDUCTION ONLY
  AS PART OF AN ENERGY-REDUCED DIET / [UTILE POUR PERDRE DU POIDS
  SEULEMENT DANS LE CADRE D'UN RÉGIME À TENEUR RÉDUITE EN
  ÉNERGIE]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" prominently displayed on the principal
  display panel; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a meal replacement for use in a weight
  reduction diet that is not represented as a replacement for all daily
  meals in a diet, include the information required under section
  B.24.204.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-698, s. 9
- SOR/88-559, s. 28
- SOR/95-474, s. 5
- SOR/2016-305, ss. 59, 75(F)
:::

**[[B.24.203]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.203 .sectionLabel}** The label of
a prepackaged meal for use in a weight reduction diet or of a food to be
sold in a weight reduction clinic shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2003-11, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} carry the statement "USEFUL IN WEIGHT REDUCTION ONLY
  AS PART OF AN ENERGY-REDUCED DIET / [UTILE POUR PERDRE DU POIDS
  SEULEMENT DANS LE CADRE D'UN RÉGIME À TENEUR RÉDUITE EN
  ÉNERGIE]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" prominently displayed on the principal
  display panel; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} include the information required under section
  B.24.204.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-698, s. 9
- SOR/88-559, s. 29
- SOR/95-474, s. 5
- SOR/2003-11, s. 24
:::

**[[B.24.204]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.204 .sectionLabel}** The label of
a prepackaged meal, or of a meal replacement other than a meal
replacement represented as a replacement for all daily meals in a diet,
that is packaged, sold or advertised for use in a weight reduction diet,
or of a food to be sold in a weight reduction clinic, shall include, in
the directions for use, a sample seven-day menu in which the prepackaged
meal, meal replacement or food is used and which meets the following
requirements:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} each daily meal includes a minimum of one serving, as
  described in Canada's Food Guide to Healthy Eating, published in 1992
  by the Department of Supply and Services by authority of the Minister
  of National Health and Welfare, of one food from each of the following
  groups:

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} milk, milk products or their alternatives,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} meat and meat alternatives,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} bread and grain products, and

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} vegetables and fruit;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the daily energy intake provided for is not less than
  1 200 kcal or 5 040 kJ;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} not more than 30 per cent of the total daily energy
  intake of the seven-day menu is derived from its fat content and not
  more than 10 per cent of the total daily energy intake of the menu is
  derived from its saturated fatty acid content;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the mean daily intake of each nutrient listed in
  column I of the table to this section is not less than the amount
  shown in column II, in the case of a menu recommended for men, or in
  column III, in the case of a menu recommended for women; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the menu does not include any reference to vitamin or
  mineral supplements.

- **[[B.24.205]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.205
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall label, package, sell
  or advertise a prepackaged meal or meal replacement for use in a
  weight reduction diet, or a food to be sold in a weight reduction
  clinic, in a manner likely to create an impression that consumption of
  a vitamin or mineral supplement must be part of a weight reduction
  diet.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall, on a label of or in an advertisement
  for a prepackaged meal or meal replacement for use in a weight
  reduction diet, or a food to be sold in a weight reduction clinic,
  make any direct or indirect reference to a vitamin or mineral
  supplement.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Every person who advertises a prepackaged meal or
  meal replacement for use in a weight reduction diet, or a food to be
  sold in a weight reduction clinic, shall include in the advertisement
  the statement "USEFUL IN WEIGHT REDUCTION ONLY AS PART OF AN
  ENERGY-REDUCED DIET / [UTILE POUR PERDRE DU POIDS SEULEMENT DANS LE
  CADRE D'UN RÉGIME À TENEUR RÉDUITE EN ÉNERGIE]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-698, s. 9
- SOR/95-474, s. 5
:::

#### [Foods Represented for Use in Very Low Energy Diets]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574228 .Subheading}

**[[B.24.300]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.300 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall advertise to the general public a food represented for use in a
very low energy diet.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/94-35, s. 4
:::

- **[[B.24.301]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.301
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell, without a
  written order from a physician, a food represented for use in a very
  low energy diet.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), a person may sell,
  without a written order from a physician, a food represented for use
  in a very low energy diet to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a physician;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a wholesale druggist;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a pharmacist; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a hospital.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person other than a pharmacist shall sell to the
  general public a food represented for use in a very low energy diet.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/94-35, s. 4
:::

**[[B.24.302]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.302 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall retain the written order of a physician for a food represented for
use in a very low energy diet for at least two years after the date on
which the order is filled.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/94-35, s. 4
:::

- **[[B.24.303]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.303
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A food represented for use in a very
  low energy diet, whether ready to serve or diluted with water
  according to the manufacturer's directions, shall provide, per daily
  allowance recommended by the manufacturer

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} either

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} not less than 60 g of protein of a nutritional
      quality equivalent to that of casein, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} such an amount and quality of protein that, when
      the quality of the protein is expressed as a fraction of the
      quality of casein,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the fraction is not less than 85/100, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the product obtained by multiplying the
        fraction by the gram weight of the protein is not less than 60;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} each vitamin or mineral nutrient named in column I
    of an item of the table to this subsection, in an amount not less
    than the minimum amount per day set out in column II of that item;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any nutritive substance added to the food other
    than those referred to in paragraph (a) or (b), in an amount that is
    appropriate for the purpose of the substance in the food as
    determined from clinical trials.

    </tbody>
    </table>
    <figcaption><p>TABLE</p></figcaption>
    </figure>

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding paragraph (1)(a), a food represented
  for use in a very low energy diet shall be accompanied by directions
  for use that when followed would result in the daily intake by a
  person of at least 1.2 g of protein per kilogram target body weight.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/94-35, s. 4
:::

**[[B.24.304]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.304 .sectionLabel}** The label of
a food represented for use in a very low energy diet shall carry the
following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the energy value of the food,
  expressed in Calories (Calories or Cal) and kilojoules (kilojoules or
  kJ) per 100 g or 100 mL of the food as offered for sale and per unit
  of ready-to-serve food;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the content in the food of protein,
  fat, carbohydrate and, where present, fibre expressed in grams per 100
  g or 100 mL of the food as offered for sale and per unit of
  ready-to-serve food;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the content in the food of all those
  vitamins and mineral nutrients that are listed in the table to
  subsection B.24.303(1) expressed in milligrams, in the case of vitamin
  A expressed in retinol equivalents (RE), per 100 g or 100 mL of the
  food as offered for sale and per unit of ready-to-serve food;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the content in the food of any other
  nutritive substance added to the food in an amount described in
  paragraph B.24.303(1)(c), expressed in milligrams or in grams per 100
  g or 100 mL of the food as offered for sale and per unit of
  ready-to-serve food;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the statement "USE ONLY UNDER MEDICAL SUPERVISION"
  prominently displayed on the principal display panel;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} directions for use of the food, including

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the rationale for the use of the
    food,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} criteria to be used for the selection of the
    persons to whom the food may be prescribed,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} instructions for consultation with and evaluation
    of the patient and patient follow-up, and

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a statement concerning adequate precautions and
    contra-indications;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} directions for the preparation of the food, and
  storage instructions for the food before and after the container has
  been opened; and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the food.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/94-35, s. 4
:::

- **[[B.24.305]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.305
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise
  for sale a food represented for use in a very low energy diet unless
  the manufacturer, at least 90 days before the sale or advertisement,
  notifies the Minister in writing of the intention to sell the food or
  advertise the food for sale.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notification referred to in subsection (1) shall
  be signed by the manufacturer and shall include, in respect of the
  food represented for use in a low energy diet, the following
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name under which the food is to be sold or
    advertised for sale;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the principal place of
    business of the manufacturer;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each establishment in which
    the food is manufactured;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a list of the ingredients of the food, stated
    quantitatively;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the specifications for nutrient, microbiological
    and physical quality for each ingredient and for the food;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} details of quality control procedures respecting
    the testing of the ingredients and of the food;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} details of the manufacturing process and quality
    control procedures used throughout the process;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the results of tests carried out to determine the
    expiration date of the food;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the evidence relied on to establish that the food
    meets the nutritional requirements, other than energy requirements,
    of a person for whom it is intended, when the food is consumed in
    accordance with the directions for use;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a description of the type of packaging to be used;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} directions for use;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the written text of all labels, including package
    inserts, to be used in connection with the food; and

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} the name and title of the person who signed the
    notification and the date of signature.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), a person may sell or
  advertise for sale a food represented for use in a very low energy
  diet, if the Minister, after having been notified by the manufacturer
  pursuant to that subsection, has informed the manufacturer in writing
  that the notification meets the requirements of subsection (2).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/94-35, s. 4
- SOR/2018-69, ss. 27, 29(F)
:::

Version](section-B.24.305-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.24.305"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.24.306]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.24.306
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise
  for sale a food represented for use in a very low energy diet that has
  undergone a major change, unless the manufacturer, at least 90 days

  the intention to sell or advertise for sale the food that has
  undergone the major change.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notification referred to in subsection (1) shall
  be signed by the manufacturer and shall include, in respect of the

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name under which the food is to be sold or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the principal place of
    business of the manufacturer;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a description of the major change;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the evidence relied on to establish that the food
    meets the nutritional requirements, other than energy requirements,
    of a person for whom it is intended, when the food is consumed in
    accordance with the directions for use;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the evidence relied on to establish that the major
    change has no adverse effect on the food or its use;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the written text of all labels, including package
    inserts, to be used in connection with the food; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name and title of the person who signed the
    notification and the date of signature.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), a person may sell or
  advertise for sale a food represented for use in a very low energy
  diet that has undergone a major change, if the Minister, after having
  been notified by the manufacturer pursuant to that subsection, has
  informed the manufacturer in writing that the notification meets the
  requirements of subsection (2).

### [DIVISION 25]{.HLabel2} {#h-574310 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574311 .Subheading}

**[[B.25.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.001 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

[[expiration date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[expiration date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a human
    milk fortifier or human milk substitute, the date

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} after which the manufacturer does not recommend
      that it be consumed, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} up to which it maintains its microbiological and
      physical stability and the nutrient content declared on the
      label; ([date limite d'utilisation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[human milk fortifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[human milk fortifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} includes at least one added vitamin, mineral
      nutrient or amino acid, and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is labelled or advertised as intended to be added
      to human milk to increase its nutritional value in order to meet
      the particular requirements of an infant in whom a physical or
      physiological condition exists as a result of a disease, disorder
      or abnormal physical state; ([fortifiant pour lait
      humain]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[human milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[human milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any food that is
    labelled or advertised

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for use as a partial or total replacement for
      human milk and as intended for consumption by infants, or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for use as an ingredient in a food referred to in
      paragraph (a); ([succédané de lait humain]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[infant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[infant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s.
    137\]]{.Repealed}

[[infant food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[infant food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s.
    137\]]{.Repealed}

[[junior (naming a food)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[junior (naming a food)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the named food
    where it contains particles of a size to encourage chewing by
    infants, but may be readily swallowed by infants without
    chewing; ([(nom d'un aliment) pour enfants en bas
    âge]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[major change]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[major change]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a human
    milk fortifier or human milk substitute, any change of an
    ingredient, the amount of an ingredient or the processing or
    packaging of the human milk fortifier or human milk substitute where
    the manufacturer's experience or generally accepted theory would
    predict an adverse effect on the levels or availability of nutrients
    in, or the microbiological or chemical safety of, the human milk
    fortifier or human milk substitute; ([changement
    majeur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[new human milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[new human milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a human milk
    substitute that is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} manufactured for the first time,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sold in Canada for the first time, or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} manufactured by a person who manufactures it for
      the first time; ([succédané de lait humain
      nouveau]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[strained (naming a food)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[strained (naming a food)]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the named
    food where it is of a generally uniform particle size that does not
    require and does not encourage chewing by infants before being
    swallowed. ([(nom d'un aliment) en purée ou tamisé]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-637, s. 5
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
- SOR/90-174, s. 1
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 12](#1290606-1291540){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290606-1291540.html"}
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 137](#1497374-1504898){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497374-1504898.html"}
:::

#### [Infant Foods]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574330 .Subheading}

**[[B.25.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.002 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell or advertise for sale an infant food that is set out in
Column I of an item of Table I to this Division and contains more than
the amount of sodium set out in Column II of that item.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
:::

- **[[B.25.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall sell infant food that contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} strained fruit,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} fruit juice,

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} fruit drink, or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} cereal,

  if sodium chloride has been added to that food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to strained desserts
  containing any of the foods mentioned in paragraphs (1)(a) to (d).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
:::

#### [Human Milk Fortifiers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1291541 .Subheading}

**[[B.25.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.010 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section B.25.013, it is prohibited to sell or advertise for sale a human
milk fortifier unless the Minister has notified the manufacturer under
paragraph B.25.012(1)(a) or (3)(a) that those activities are authorized.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291544){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291544.html"}
:::

**[[B.25.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.011 .sectionLabel}** An
application to sell or advertise for sale a human milk fortifier shall
be submitted by the manufacturer and signed by the manufacturer or an
individual authorized to sign on their behalf and shall include the
following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the brand name and product name under which the human
  milk fortifier will be sold or advertised for sale;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer's name and address;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each establishment in which
  the human milk fortifier is manufactured;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a list of all of the human milk fortifier's
  ingredients, stated quantitatively;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the scientific rationale for the formulation of the
  human milk fortifier;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the specifications for nutrient, microbiological and
  physical quality for the human milk fortifier and its ingredients;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} details of the quality control procedures respecting
  the testing of the human milk fortifier and its ingredients;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} details of the human milk fortifier's manufacturing
  process and the quality control procedures used throughout the
  process;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} the results of the tests carried out to determine the
  expiration date of the human milk fortifier;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} the evidence that establishes that the human milk
  fortifier is nutritionally adequate to promote acceptable growth and
  development in infants when consumed in accordance with the directions
  for use;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} a description of the type of packaging to be used for
  the human milk fortifier;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} directions for use for the human milk fortifier;

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} the written text of all labels, including package
  inserts, to be used in connection with the human milk fortifier; and

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} the name and title of the individual who signed the
  application and the date of signature.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291561){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291561.html"}
:::

- **[[B.25.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.012
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After having conducted an assessment
  of the information submitted under section B.25.011 and any other
  information related to the assessment of the application, the Minister
  shall notify the manufacturer in writing that the sale or
  advertisement for sale of the human milk fortifier that is the subject
  of the application

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is authorized if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the application meets the requirements set out in
      section B.25.011, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information is sufficient to establish the
      safety of the human milk fortifier; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is not authorized, in any other case.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the conditions set out in paragraph (1)(a) are not
  satisfied, the Minister may request the manufacturer to submit in
  writing the additional information that is necessary to satisfy the
  conditions.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} After having conducted an assessment of any
  additional information that is submitted by the manufacturer, the
  Minister shall notify the manufacturer in writing that the sale or
  advertisement for sale of the human milk fortifier

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is authorized, if the conditions set out in
    paragraph (1)(a) are satisfied; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is not authorized, in any other case.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraphs (1)(a) and (3)(a), the Minister
  shall not authorize the sale or advertisement for sale of the human
  milk fortifier if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  any of the information that the manufacturer has submitted is false,
  misleading or deceptive.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291574){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291574.html"}
:::

**[[B.25.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.013 .sectionLabel}** The
prohibition set out in section B.25.010 does not apply in respect of a
human milk fortifier that is set out in the List of Human Milk
Fortifiers Sold in Canada as of March 25, 2021 that is published on a
Government of Canada website if, on or before April 30, 2022,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer of the human milk fortifier submits
  to the Minister

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an attestation signed and dated by the
    manufacturer, or by an individual authorized to sign on their
    behalf, confirming that the human milk fortifier has not undergone a
    major change since the date set out in the List in connection with
    the human milk fortifier, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the written text of all labels, including package
    inserts, that will be required to be used in connection with the
    human milk fortifier after the second anniversary of the day on
    which section B.25.020 comes into force; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister notifies the manufacturer under
  subsection B.25.014(1) or paragraph B.25.014(3)(a) that they are
  authorized to continue to sell or advertise for sale the human milk
  fortifier.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291581){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291581.html"}
:::

- **[[B.25.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.014
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall notify the
  manufacturer in writing that they are authorized to continue to sell
  or advertise for sale the human milk fortifier if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer has submitted the information
    referred to in paragraph B.25.013(a) in sufficient time for the
    Minister to assess the information before April 30, 2022; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the written text of the labels submitted under
    subparagraph B.25.013(a)(ii) satisfies the relevant requirements of
    these Regulations.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the information that is submitted is insufficient
  to satisfy the conditions set out in subsection (1), the Minister may
  request the manufacturer to submit in writing the additional
  information that is necessary to satisfy the conditions.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} After having conducted an assessment of any
  additional information that is submitted by the manufacturer, the
  Minister shall notify the manufacturer in writing that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} they are authorized to continue to sell or
    advertise for sale the human milk fortifier, if the conditions set
    out in subsection (1) are satisfied; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} they are not authorized to continue to sell or
    advertise for sale the human milk fortifier, in any other case.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291591){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291591.html"}
:::

- **[[B.25.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited to sell or
  advertise for sale a human milk fortifier that has undergone a major
  change unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer of the human milk fortifier
    submits to the Minister an application in accordance with
    subsection (2) that reflects the major change; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister notifies the manufacturer under
    paragraph B.25.016(1)(a) or (3)(a) that the sale or advertisement
    for sale of the human milk fortifier is authorized.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application shall be signed by the manufacturer
  or an individual authorized to sign on their behalf and shall include
  the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the brand name and product name under which the
    human milk fortifier will be sold or advertised for sale;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer's name and address;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a description of, and the rationale for, the major
    change;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the evidence that establishes that the human milk
    fortifier is nutritionally adequate to promote acceptable growth and
    development in infants when consumed in accordance with the
    directions for use;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the evidence that establishes that the major change
    has had no adverse effect on the human milk fortifier;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the written text of all labels, including package
    inserts, to be used in connection with the human milk fortifier; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name and title of the individual who signed the
    application and the date of signature.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291605){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291605.html"}
:::

- **[[B.25.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.016
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} After having conducted an assessment
  of the information submitted under subsection B.25.015(2) and any
  other information related to the assessment of the application, the
  Minister shall notify the manufacturer in writing that the sale or
  advertisement for sale of the human milk fortifier that is the subject
  of the application

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is authorized if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the application meets the requirements set out in
      subsection B.25.015(2), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information is sufficient to establish the
      safety of the human milk fortifier; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is not authorized, in any other case.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the conditions set out in paragraph (1)(a) are not
  satisfied, the Minister may request the manufacturer to submit in
  writing the additional information that is necessary to satisfy the
  conditions.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} After having conducted an assessment of any
  additional information that is submitted by the manufacturer, the
  Minister shall notify the manufacturer in writing that the sale or
  advertisement for sale of the human milk fortifier

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is authorized, if the conditions set out in
    paragraph (1)(a) are satisfied; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is not authorized, in any other case.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraphs (1)(a) and (3)(a), the Minister
  shall not authorize the sale or advertisement for sale of the human
  milk fortifier if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  any of the information that the manufacturer has submitted is false,
  misleading or deceptive.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291618){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291618.html"}
:::

**[[B.25.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.017 .sectionLabel}** A
manufacturer named in the List of Human Milk Fortifiers Sold in Canada
as of March 25, 2021 referred to in section B.25.013 is not entitled to
submit an application referred to in paragraph B.25.015(1)(a) in respect
of a human milk fortifier set out in the List unless the Minister has

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} notified them under paragraph B.25.012(1)(a) or
  (3)(a) that the sale or advertisement for sale of the human milk
  fortifier is authorized; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} notified them under subsection B.25.014(1) or
  paragraph B.25.014(3)(a) that they are authorized to continue to sell
  or advertise for sale the human milk fortifier.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291623){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291623.html"}
:::

- **[[B.25.018]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.018
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the manufacturer of a human milk
  fortifier is requested in writing by the Minister to submit evidence
  with respect to the human milk fortifier within a time limit specified
  by the Minister, the manufacturer shall make no further sales of the
  human milk fortifier --- and shall not advertise it for sale --- after
  the expiry of the time limit unless they have submitted the requested
  evidence.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The time limit cannot be less than 24 hours after the
  request is made unless the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe
  that there is a serious and imminent risk of injury to human health.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister determines that the evidence
  submitted by the manufacturer is insufficient, the Minister shall
  notify the manufacturer accordingly in writing.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the manufacturer is notified that the evidence
  with respect to the human milk fortifier is insufficient, the
  manufacturer shall make no further sales of the human milk fortifier
  -- and shall not advertise it for sale --- unless they submit
  additional evidence and are notified in writing by the Minister that
  the additional evidence is sufficient.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[evidence with respect to the human
  milk fortifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} evidence that establishes that the human milk
    fortifier is nutritionally adequate to promote acceptable growth and
    development in infants when consumed in accordance with the
    directions for use; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the results of tests carried out to determine the
    expiration date of the human milk fortifier.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291633){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291633.html"}
:::

- **[[B.25.019]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.019
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Even if the Minister has notified
  the manufacturer of a human milk fortifier that the sale or
  advertisement for sale of the human milk fortifier is authorized, it
  may only be sold in the following situations:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is sold by the manufacturer to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a hospital, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an individual, if

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the individual has received a written order for
        a human milk fortifier from a physician or from a nurse
        practitioner or dietitian who is authorized to write the order
        under the laws of a province, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer has received a written request
        from a hospital that specifies the product name and quantity of
        the human milk fortifier that needs to be provided to the
        individual; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is sold by a hospital to an individual who has
    received a written order for a human milk fortifier from a physician
    or from a nurse practitioner or dietitian who is authorized to write
    the order under the laws of a province.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in this section.

  [[dietitian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[dietitian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is registered
      and entitled under the laws of a province to practise as a
      dietitian and who is practising as a dietitian under those laws in
      that province. ([diététiste]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[hospital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[hospital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
      section B.24.001. ([hôpital]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[nurse practitioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[nurse practitioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
      in section 1 of the [New Classes of Practitioners
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2012-230). ([infirmier
      praticien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[physician]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[physician]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
      section B.24.001. ([médecin]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291648){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291648.html"}
:::

- **[[B.25.020]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.020
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following information is
  required to be displayed on the outer label of a human milk fortifier:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the quantity, expressed in grams, of
    protein, fat, available carbohydrate and, where present, fibre in a
    quantity of human milk fortifier specified in the directions for
    use;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the energy value, expressed in
    Calories, in a quantity of human milk fortifier specified in the
    directions for use;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the quantity, expressed in
    milligrams, micrograms or International Units, of all vitamins,
    mineral nutrients and amino acids set out in item 6, Column II, of
    the table to section D.03.002 that are present in a quantity of
    human milk fortifier specified in the directions for use;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the quantity, expressed in grams,
    milligrams, micrograms or International Units, of any other
    nutritive substance that is present in a quantity of human milk
    fortifier specified in the directions for use;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} directions for the storage of the human milk
    fortifier before and after the package has been opened;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the directions for use for the human milk
    fortifier, including directions for the preparation, use and storage
    of the mixture of human milk fortifier and human milk;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a statement indicating that the human milk
    fortifier is to be used only under medical supervision;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the human milk fortifier;
    and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the lot number of the human milk fortifier.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the human milk fortifier does not have an outer
  label,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in subsection (1) is
    required to be displayed on the inner label, except as otherwise
    provided in paragraph (b); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in paragraphs (1)(e)
    and (f) may, despite section A.01.016, be displayed on a leaflet
    that is affixed or attached to the container that is in direct
    contact with the human milk fortifier.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the human milk fortifier has an outer label, the
  information referred to in paragraphs (1)(h) and (i) is also required
  to be displayed on the inner label.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 13](#1290611-1291665){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1290611-1291665.html"}
:::

**[[B.25.021]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.021 .sectionLabel}** It is
prohibited, on the label of or in any advertisement for a human milk
fortifier, to make any statement or claim relating to the content in the
human milk fortifier of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the percentage of the daily value of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} fat,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} saturated fatty acids and *trans* fatty acids,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} sodium,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} potassium,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} sugars,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} fibre, or

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} cholesterol; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of Calories from

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} fat, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} saturated fatty acids and *trans* fatty acids.

#### [Human Milk Substitutes and Food Containing Human Milk Substitutes]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574344 .Subheading}

**[[B.25.045]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.045 .sectionLabel}** The common
name of a human milk substitute or a new human milk substitute shall be
[[infant formula]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}. (*préparation pour nourrissons*)

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/90-174, s. 2
:::

- **[[B.25.046]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.046
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise
  for sale a new human milk substitute unless the manufacturer, at least
  90 days before the sale or advertisement, notifies the Minister in
  writing of the intention to sell or advertise for sale the new human
  milk substitute.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notification referred to in subsection (1) shall
  be signed and shall include, in respect of the new human milk
  substitute, the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name under which it will be sold or advertised
    for sale;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and the address of the principal place of
    business of the manufacturer;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the names and addresses of each establishment in
    which it is manufactured;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a list of all of its ingredients, stated
    quantitatively;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the specifications for nutrient, microbiological
    and physical quality for the ingredients and for the new human milk
    substitute;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} details of quality control procedures respecting
    the testing of the ingredients and of the new human milk substitute;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} details of the manufacturing process and quality
    control procedures used throughout the process;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the results of tests carried out to determine the
    expiration date of the new human milk substitute;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the evidence relied on to establish that the new
    human milk substitute is nutritionally adequate to promote
    acceptable growth and development in infants when consumed in
    accordance with the directions for use;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a description of the type of packaging to be used;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} directions for use;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the written text of all labels, including package
    inserts, to be used in connection with the new human milk
    substitute; and

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} the name and title of the person who signed the
    notification and the date of signature.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), a person may sell or
  advertise for sale a new human milk substitute if the manufacturer has
  notified the Minister pursuant to subsection (1) and is informed in
  writing by the Minister that the notification is satisfactory.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/90-174, s. 2
- SOR/2018-69, ss. 27, 30(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.25.046-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.25.046"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.25.047]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.047 .sectionLabel}** Sections
B.25.051 to B.25.059 apply in respect of new human milk substitutes.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/90-174, s. 2
- SOR/2003-11, s. 25
:::

- **[[B.25.048]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.048
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise
  for sale a human milk substitute that has undergone a major change
  unless the manufacturer of the human milk substitute, at least 90 days
  before the sale or advertisement, notifies the Minister in writing of
  the intention to sell or advertise for sale the human milk substitute.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notification referred to in subsection (1) shall
  be signed and shall include, in respect of the human milk substitute,
  the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name under which it will be sold or advertised
    for sale;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and the address of the principal place of
    business of the manufacturer;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a description of the major change;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the evidence relied on to establish that the human
    milk substitute is nutritionally adequate to promote acceptable
    growth and development in infants when consumed in accordance with
    the directions for use;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the evidence relied on to establish that the major
    change has had no adverse effect on the human milk substitute;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the written text of all labels, including package
    inserts, to be used in connection with the human milk substitute;
    and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name and title of the person who signed the
    notification and the date of signature.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), a person may sell or
  advertise for sale a human milk substitute that has undergone a major
  change if the manufacturer has notified the Minister pursuant to
  subsection (1) and is informed in writing by the Minister that the
  notification is satisfactory.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/90-174, s. 2
- SOR/2018-69, ss. 27, 30(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.25.048-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.25.048"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[B.25.050]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.050 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/90-174, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[B.25.051]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.051
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise
  for sale a human milk substitute unless, when prepared according to
  directions for use, it complies with the provisions of this Division
  respecting human milk substitutes.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise for sale a food
  that is represented as containing a human milk substitute unless the
  human milk substitute portion of the food complies with the
  nutritional requirements set out in this Division for human milk
  substitutes.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
:::

- **[[B.25.052]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.052
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise
  for sale a human milk substitute unless it meets the nutritional
  requirements of infants with normal or special dietary needs and it is
  of such a consistency that, when ready-to-serve, it passes freely
  through a nursing bottle nipple.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise for sale a food
  that is represented as containing a human milk substitute unless the
  human milk substitute portion of the food meets the nutritional
  requirements of infants with normal or special dietary needs.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-637, s. 6
- SOR/82-768, s. 76
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
:::

- **[[B.25.053]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.053
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise
  for sale a human milk substitute that requires, when prepared
  according to directions for use, the addition of a nutritive
  substance, other than water or a source of carbohydrate or both.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise for sale a food
  represented as containing a human milk substitute that requires, when
  prepared according to directions for use, the addition of a nutritive
  substance other than water.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-637, s. 7
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
:::

- **[[B.25.054]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.054
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in this
  Division, no person shall sell or advertise for sale a human milk
  substitute unless it contains, when prepared according to directions
  for use,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} per 100 available kilocalories

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} not less than 3.3 and not more than 6.0 grams of
      fat,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not less than 500 milligrams of linoleic acid in
      the form of a glyceride,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-244, s. 138\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} not less than 1.8 and not more than 4.0 grams of
      protein,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} not less than 1.8 grams of protein of nutritional
      quality equivalent to casein, or such an amount and quality of
      protein, including those proteins to which amino acids are added,
      that, when the quality of the protein is expressed as a fraction
      of the quality of casein,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the fraction will not be less than 85/100, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the product obtained by multiplying the
        fraction by the gram weight of the protein will not be less than
        1.8,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} notwithstanding sections D.01.010, D.01.011 and
      D.02.009, the vitamin and mineral nutrient set out in Column I of
      an item of Table II to this Division in an amount not less than
      the amount set out in Column II of that item and not more than the
      amount set out in Column III of that item, and

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} not less than 12 milligrams of choline; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a ratio of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} alpha-tocopherol to linoleic acid of not less
      than 0.6 International Units to one gram,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} calcium to phosphorus of not less than 1.2 grams
      to one gram and not more than 2.0 grams to one gram, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} vitamin B~6~ to protein of not less than 15
      micrograms to one gram.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise for sale a food
  that is represented as containing a human milk substitute unless the
  human milk substitute portion of the food complies with subsection
  (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-637, s. 7
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 138](#1497375-1504900){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497375-1504900.html"}
:::
