Version](section-B.25.054-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.25.054"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.25.055]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.055
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subparagraph B.25.054(1)(a)(i) does
  not apply to a human milk substitute represented as being for a
  fat-modified diet.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subparagraph B.25.054(1)(a)(iv), except that portion
  thereof that prescribes the maximum amount of protein, and
  subparagraph B.25.054(1)(a)(v) do not apply to a human milk substitute
  represented as being for a low (naming the amino acid) diet.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} All that portion of subparagraph B.25.054(1)(a)(vi)
  that prescribes the minimum amounts of vitamin D, calcium and
  phosphorus and subparagraph B.25.054(1)(b)(ii) do not apply to a human
  milk substitute represented as being for a low (naming the mineral)
  diet or a low vitamin D diet or both.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
:::

**[[B.25.056]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.056 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a human milk substitute or a food that is represented as
containing a human milk substitute

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} that contains an added nutritive substance that is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} normally contained in human milk, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not referred to in paragraph B.25.054(1)(a)

  unless the amount of that substance present per 100 available
  kilocalories of the human milk substitute or human milk substitute
  portion of the food, when prepared according to directions for use, is
  equal to the amount thereof present per 100 available kilocalories of
  human milk; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that contains added amino acids unless

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amino acids are required to improve the quality
    of the protein in the human milk substitute or human milk substitute
    portion of the food and are present in an amount not exceeding the
    minimum required for that purpose, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the protein content of the human milk substitute
    or human milk substitute portion of the food is supplied by isolated
    amino acids or by protein hydrolysate, or both

  and only the L forms of the amino acids have been added.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-637, s. 8
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
:::

- **[[B.25.057]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.057
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The label of a human milk substitute
  shall carry the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the content of protein, fat,
    available carbohydrate, ash and, where present, crude fibre in the
    food

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in grams per 100 grams or in grams per 100
      millilitres of the human milk substitute as offered for sale, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in grams in a stated quantity of the human milk
      substitute when ready-to-serve;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the energy value expressed in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} calories per 100 grams or calories per 100
      millilitres of the human milk substitute as offered for sale, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} calories in a stated quantity of the human milk
      substitute when ready-to-serve;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the quantity of all vitamins and
    mineral nutrients listed in Table II to this Division

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in International Units or milligrams per 100
      grams or in International Units or milligrams per 100 millilitres
      of the human milk substitute as offered for sale, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in International Units or milligrams in a stated
      quantity of the human milk substitute when ready-to-serve;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the quantity of choline and of any
    added nutritive substance normally contained in human milk and not
    referred to in paragraph B.25.054(1)(a)

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in milligrams or grams per 100 grams, or in
      milligrams or grams per 100 millilitres, of the human milk
      substitute as offered for sale, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in milligrams or grams in a stated quantity of
      the human milk substitute when ready-to-serve;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} adequate directions for the preparation, use and
    storage of the human milk substitute after the container has been
    opened; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the human milk substitute.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The label of a food that is represented as containing
  human milk substitute shall carry the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement on the principal display panel of the
    proportion of the human milk substitute contained in the food as
    offered for sale in close proximity to any claim regarding the
    presence of the human milk substitute and given equal prominence to
    such a claim;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the common name of the human milk substitute in the
    list of ingredients to be followed by a statement of all the
    components contained in the human milk substitute;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the content of protein, fat, available
      carbohydrate, ash and, where present, crude fibre contained in the
      human milk substitute portion of the food, expressed in grams per
      100 grams or per 100 millilitres of the human milk substitute
      portion of the food as offered for sale,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the energy value of the human milk substitute
      portion of the food expressed in calories per 100 grams or in
      calories per 100 millilitres of the human milk substitute portion
      of the food as offered for sale,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of all the vitamins and mineral
      nutrients set out in Table II to this Division that are contained
      in the human milk substitute portion of the food in International
      Units or milligrams per 100 grams or in International Units or
      milligrams per 100 millilitres of the human milk substitute
      portion of the food as offered for sale, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of choline and of any added
      nutritive substance normally contained in human milk and not
      referred to in paragraph B.25.054(1)(a) contained in the human
      milk substitute portion of the food in milligrams or grams per 100
      grams or in milligrams or grams per 100 millilitres of the human
      milk substitute portion of the food as offered for sale;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a statement of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the content of protein, fat, available
      carbohydrate, ash and, where present, crude fibre in grams per 100
      grams or per 100 millilitres of the food as offered for sale and
      in grams per stated quantity of ready-to-serve food,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the energy value expressed in calories per 100
      grams or in calories per 100 millilitres of the food as offered
      for sale and in grams per a stated quantity of the food when
      ready-to-serve,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of all vitamins and mineral
      nutrients set out in Table II to this Division in International
      Units or milligrams per 100 grams or in International Units or
      milligrams per 100 millilitres of the food as offered for sale and
      in International Units or milligrams in a stated quantity of the
      food when ready-to-serve, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of choline and of any added
      nutritive substance normally contained in human milk and not
      referred to in paragraph B.25.054(1)(a) in milligrams or grams per
      100 grams or in milligrams or grams per 100 millilitres of the
      food as offered for sale and in milligrams or grams in a stated
      quantity of the food when ready-to-serve;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} adequate directions for the preparation, use and
    storage of the food after the container has been opened; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the food.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
- SOR/88-559, s. 30
:::

**[[B.25.058]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.058
.sectionLabel}** Notwithstanding section D.02.005, no person shall make
any claim with respect to the iron content of a human milk substitute
except as required by paragraph B.25.057(1)(c), unless the human milk
substitute contains at least one milligram of iron per 100 available
kilocalories.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-637, s. 9(F)
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
:::

**[[B.25.059]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.059 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall, on the label of or in any advertisement for a human milk
substitute or a food represented as containing a human milk substitute,
make any statement or claim relating to the content in the food of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the percentage of the daily value of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} fat,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} saturated fatty acids and *trans* fatty acids,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} sodium,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} potassium,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} sugars,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} fibre, or

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} cholesterol; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of Calories from

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} fat, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} saturated fatty acids and *trans* fatty acids.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-11, s. 26
- SOR/2016-305, s. 60
:::

- **[[B.25.060]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.25.060
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the manufacturer of a human
  milk substitute or of a food that is represented as containing a human
  milk substitute is requested in writing by the Minister to submit on
  or before a specified day evidence with respect to the human milk
  substitute, the manufacturer shall make no further sales of that human
  milk substitute or food that is represented as containing human milk
  substitute after that day unless he has submitted the evidence
  requested.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister determines that the evidence
  submitted by a manufacturer under subsection (1) is not sufficient, he
  or she shall so notify the manufacturer in writing.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to subsection (2), a manufacturer is
  notified that the evidence with respect to the human milk substitute
  is not sufficient, he shall make no further sales of that human milk
  substitute or of that food that is represented as containing the human
  milk substitute unless he submits further evidence and is notified in
  writing by the Minister that the further evidence is sufficient.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[evidence with respect to the human
  milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} evidence that establishes that the human milk
    substitute is nutritionally adequate to promote acceptable growth
    and development in infants when consumed in accordance with the
    directions for use; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the results of tests carried out to determine the
    expiration date of the human milk substitute.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/83-933, s. 1
- SOR/88-424, s. 2
- SOR/90-174, s. 3
- SOR/2018-69, ss. 12, 27
:::

### [DIVISION 26]{.HLabel2}[Food Irradiation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-574534 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574535 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2017-16, s. 2(F)

\]
:::

**[[B.26.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.26.001 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division, [[irradiation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means treatment with
ionizing radiation.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/89-175, s. 3
- SOR/2017-16, s. 3
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.26.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.26.001"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574541 .Subheading}

**[[B.26.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.26.002 .sectionLabel}** This Division
does not apply to foods exposed to ionizing radiation from a measuring
instrument used to determine weight, estimate bulk solids, measure the
total solids in liquids or perform other inspection procedures.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/89-175, s. 3
:::

#### [General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574545 .Subheading}

- **[[B.26.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.26.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall sell a food that has been irradiated.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A food that is set out in column 1 of the table to
  this Division that has been irradiated may be sold if both of the
  following requirements are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the ionizing radiation is of a type and from a
    source set out in column 2 for the purpose of irradiation set out in
    column 3; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the ionizing radiation that is absorbed by the food
    is either within the range set out in columns 4 and 5 or, if there
    is no minimum absorbed dose set out in column 4, is not more than
    the maximum absorbed dose set out in column 5.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/89-175, s. 3
- SOR/2017-16, s. 4
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.26.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.26.003"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Records]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574553 .Subheading}

- **[[B.26.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.26.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A manufacturer who sells a food that
  has been irradiated shall keep on their premises, for at least two
  years after the date of the irradiation, a record that contains all of
  the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the food that was irradiated and the
    quantity and lot numbers of the food;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the purpose of the irradiation;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date of the irradiation;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the dose of ionizing radiation that was absorbed by
    the food;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the type and source of the ionizing radiation;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a statement that indicates whether the food was
    previously irradiated and, if it was previously irradiated, the
    information referred to in paragraphs (a) to (e) in respect of that
    previous irradiation.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who imports a food for sale in Canada that
  has been irradiated shall keep on their premises, for at least two
  years after the date of importation, a record of the information
  required by subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/89-175, s. 3
- SOR/2017-16, s. 5
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.26.004-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.26.004"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Changes to the Table]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574565 .Subheading}

**[[B.26.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.26.005 .sectionLabel}** A request
that a food be added or a change made to the table to this Division
shall be accompanied by a submission to the Minister containing the
following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the purpose and details of the proposed irradiation
  --- including the type and source of the ionizing radiation --- and
  the proposed number of treatments and the minimum and maximum absorbed
  doses of the ionizing radiation;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} data indicating that the minimum dose of ionizing
  radiation proposed to be used accomplishes the intended purpose of the
  irradiation and the maximum dose of ionizing radiation proposed does
  not exceed the amount required to accomplish the purpose of the
  irradiation;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} information on the nature of the dosimeter used, the
  frequency of the dosimetry on the food and data pertaining to the
  dosimetry and phantoms used to assure that the dosimetry readings
  reflect the dose absorbed by the food during irradiation;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} data indicating the effects, if any, on the
  nutritional quality of the food, raw and ready-to-serve, under the
  proposed conditions of irradiation and any other processes that are
  combined with the irradiation;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} data establishing that the irradiated food has not
  been significantly altered in chemical, physical or microbiological
  characteristics to render the food unfit for human consumption;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} where the Minister so requests, data establishing
  that the proposed irradiation is safe under the conditions proposed
  for the irradiation;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the recommended conditions of storage and shipment of
  the irradiated food including the time, temperature and packaging and
  a comparison of the recommended conditions for the same food that has
  not been irradiated;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} details of any other processes to be applied to the
  food prior to or after the proposed irradiation; and

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} such other data as the Minister may require to
  establish that consumers and purchasers of the irradiated food will
  not be deceived or misled as to the character, value, composition,
  merit or safety of the irradiated food.

### [DIVISION 27]{.HLabel2}[Low-Acid Foods Packaged in Hermetically Sealed Containers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-574584 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2024-244, s. 140(F)

\]
:::

**[[B.27.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.27.001 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

[[commercially sterile]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[commercially sterile]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the condition
    obtained in a food that has been processed by the application of
    heat, alone or in combination with other treatments, to render the
    food free from viable forms of microorganisms, including spores,
    capable of growing in the food at temperatures at which the food is
    designed normally to be held during distribution and
    storage; ([stérilité commerciale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[hermetically sealed container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[hermetically sealed container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2024-244, s. 141\]]{.Repealed}

[[low-acid food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[low-acid food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a food, other than an
    alcoholic beverage, where any component of the food has a pH greater
    than 4.6 and a water activity greater than 0.85; ([aliment peu
    acide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[refrigeration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[refrigeration]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means exposure to a
    temperature of 4°C or less but does not mean
    frozen; ([réfrigéré]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[shipping container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[shipping container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a receptacle,
    package or wrapper in which containers of food are placed for
    transportation; ([contenant d'expédition]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[water activity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[water activity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the ratio of the water
    vapour pressure of a food to the vapour pressure of pure water, at
    the same temperature and pressure. ([activité de
    l'eau]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/89-309, s. 1
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 141](#1497379-1504973){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497379-1504973.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.27.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.27.001"){.PITLink}

- **[[B.27.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.27.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a low-acid food
  packaged in a hermetically sealed container unless the food is
  commercially sterile.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a
  low-acid food packaged in a hermetically sealed container where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the low-acid food is kept under refrigeration and
    the statement "Keep Refrigerated" and "[Garder réfrigéré]{.otherLang
    lang="fr"}" is carried on the principal display panel of the label
    of its container, as well as on the label of its shipping container;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the low-acid food is kept frozen and the statement
    "Keep Frozen" and "[Garder congelé]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" is
    carried on the principal display panel of the label of its
    container, as well as on the label of its shipping container.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of tomatoes
  or tomato products packaged in hermetically sealed containers where
  the tomatoes or tomato products have a pH of 4.7 or less after heat
  processing.

**[[B.27.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.27.003 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a low-acid food packaged in a hermetically sealed container
where the container

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is swollen;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} is not properly sealed; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} has any defect that may adversely affect its hermetic
  seal.

Version](section-B.27.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.27.003"){.PITLink}

- **[[B.27.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.27.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where, in the opinion of the
  Minister, the sale of a low-acid food packaged in a hermetically
  sealed container may contravene section B.27.002 or B.27.003, the
  Minister may, by notice in writing, request that the manufacturer or
  importer of the food submit, on or before the date specified in the
  notice, evidence that establishes that the processes used to
  manufacture, process and package the food rendered and maintained the
  food commercially sterile.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a manufacturer or an importer receives a notice
  issued pursuant to subsection (1), the manufacturer or importer shall
  make no further sales of the food on or after the day specified in the
  notice until he has submitted the evidence requested in that notice.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister is of the opinion that the
  evidence submitted by a manufacturer or importer pursuant to
  subsection (1) is not sufficient, the Minister shall notify the
  manufacturer or importer in writing that the evidence is not
  sufficient.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to subsection (3), a manufacturer or
  importer is notified that the evidence he has submitted is not
  sufficient, the manufacturer or importer shall make no further sales
  of the food until he submits further evidence and is notified in
  writing by the Minister that the further evidence is sufficient.

**[[B.27.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.27.005 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a commercially sterile low-acid food packaged in a
hermetically sealed container unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the label or container of the food bears a code or
  lot number that identifies, in a legible and permanent manner,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the establishment in which the product was rendered
    commercially sterile, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the day, month and year on which the food was
    rendered commercially sterile; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the exact meaning of each item in any code or lot
  number referred to in paragraph (a) is available to an inspector at
  the establishment or, where the food is imported, from the importer.

### [DIVISION 28]{.HLabel2}[Novel Foods]{.HTitleText2} {#h-574622 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574623 .Subheading}

**[[B.28.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.28.001 .sectionLabel}** The
definitions in this section apply in this Division.

[[genetically modify]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[genetically modify]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means to change the
    heritable traits of a plant, animal or microorganism by means of
    intentional manipulation. ([modifier génétiquement]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[major change]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[major change]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a food, a
    change in the food that, based on the manufacturer's experience or
    generally accepted nutritional or food science theory, places the
    modified food outside the accepted limits of natural variations for
    that food with regard to

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the composition, structure or nutritional quality
      of the food or its generally recognized physiological effects;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manner in which the food is metabolized in
      the body; or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the microbiological safety, the chemical safety
      or the safe use of the food. ([changement majeur]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[novel food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[novel food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of the following
    substances and foods, other than a supplemental ingredient or
    supplemented food:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a substance, including a microorganism, that does
      not have a history of safe use as a food;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a food that has been manufactured, prepared,
      preserved or packaged by a process that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has not been previously applied to that food,
        and

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} causes the food to undergo a major change; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a food that is derived from a plant, animal or
      microorganism that has been genetically modified such that

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the plant, animal or microorganism exhibits
        characteristics that were not previously observed in that plant,
        animal or microorganism,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the plant, animal or microorganism no longer
        exhibits characteristics that were previously observed in that
        plant, animal or microorganism, or

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} one or more characteristics of the plant,
        animal or microorganism no longer fall within the anticipated
        range for that plant, animal or microorganism. ([aliment
        nouveau]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/99-392, s. 1

#### [Pre-Market Notification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574641 .Subheading}

- **[[B.28.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.28.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise
  for sale a novel food unless the manufacturer or importer of the novel
  food

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has notified the Minister in writing of their
    intention to sell or advertise for sale the novel food; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has received a written notice from the Minister
    under paragraph B.28.003(1)(a) or subsection B.28.003(2).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A notification referred to in paragraph (1)(a) shall
  be signed by the manufacturer or importer, or a person authorized to
  sign on behalf of the manufacturer or importer, and shall include the
  following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the common name under which the novel food will be
    sold;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the principal place of
    business of the manufacturer and, if the address is outside Canada,
    the name and address of the principal place of business of the
    importer;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a description of the novel food, together with

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} information respecting its development,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} details of the method by which it is
      manufactured, prepared, preserved, packaged and stored,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} details of the major change, if any,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} information respecting its intended use and
      directions for its preparation,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} information respecting its history of use as a
      food in a country other than Canada, if applicable, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} information relied on to establish that the
      novel food is safe for consumption;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} information respecting the estimated levels of
    consumption by consumers of the novel food;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the text of all labels to be used in connection
    with the novel food; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name and title of the person who signed the
    notification and the date of signing.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/99-392, s. 1
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-B.28.002-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section B.28.002"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[B.28.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.28.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Within 45 days after receiving a
  notification referred to in paragraph B.28.002(1)(a), the Minister
  shall review the information included in the notification and

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the information establishes that the novel food
    is safe for consumption, notify the manufacturer or importer in
    writing that the information is sufficient; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if additional information of a scientific nature is
    necessary in order to assess the safety of the novel food, request
    in writing that the manufacturer or importer submit that
    information.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Within 90 days after receiving the additional
  information requested under paragraph (1)(b) the Minister shall assess
  it and, if it establishes that the novel food is safe for consumption,
  notify the manufacturer or importer in writing that the information is
  sufficient.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/99-392, s. 1
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27

### [DIVISION 29]{.HLabel2}[Supplemented Foods]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1372185 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1372034 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this Division.

  [[Directory of SFFT Formats]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Directory of SFFT Formats]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      document entitled Directory of Supplemented Food Facts Table
      Formats, published by the Government of Canada on its website, as
      amended from time to time. ([Répertoire des modèles de
      TRAS]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Directory of Supplemented Food Caution Identifier Specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Directory of Supplemented Food Caution Identifier
      Specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document entitled
      Directory of Supplemented Food Caution Identifier Specifications,
      published by the Government of Canada on its website, as amended
      from time to time. ([Répertoire des spécifications sur
      l'identifiant des aliments supplémentés avec mise en
      garde]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fat]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means all fatty acids expressed as
      triglycerides. ([lipides]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Division and subject to
  subsection (3), the amount of vitamins must be determined in
  accordance with section D.01.003.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Division, the amount in
  metric units of the following vitamins must be determined in terms of
  their amount in the supplemented food in accordance with column 5 of
  the List of Permitted Supplemental Ingredients, as applicable, and
  expressed in the applicable unit set out in column 3 of the List of
  Permitted Supplemental Ingredients:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} beta-carotene as a form of vitamin A or retinol,
    including its derivatives, as a form of vitamin A, or both, if
    either is a supplemental ingredient; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} niacin, if it is a supplemental ingredient.

- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372045){.wb-lbx

#### [Nutrition Labelling]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1372046 .Subheading}

##### [Core Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372048 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except as otherwise provided in this
  section and sections B.29.003 to B.29.005, B.29.018 and B.29.019, the
  label of a supplemented food must carry a supplemented food facts
  table that contains only the information set out in column 1 of the
  table to this section, expressed using a description set out in column
  2, in the unit set out in column 3 and in the manner set out in column
  4.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the serving of
  stated size set out in the supplemented food facts table, as expressed
  in a metric unit, must be used as the basis for determining the
  information appearing in the supplemented food facts table in respect
  of the energy value of, and the content of nutrients and supplemental
  ingredients in, the supplemented food.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (8), the percentage of the
  daily value for a vitamin or mineral nutrient shown in the
  supplemented food facts table in accordance with subsection (1) must
  be established on the basis of the amount, by weight, of the vitamin
  or mineral nutrient per serving of stated size of the supplemented
  food, rounded off in the applicable manner set out in column 4 of the
  table to this section.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the information in respect of six or more of the
  energy value and nutrients referred to in column 1 of items 2 to 5 and
  7 to 15 of the table to this section may be expressed as "0" in the
  supplemented food facts table in accordance with this section, the
  supplemented food facts table need only include the following
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the serving of stated size;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the energy value;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of fat;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the amount of carbohydrate;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the amount of protein;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient that is the subject of a
    representation on the label of the supplemented food, or in any
    advertisement for the supplemented food that is made or placed by or
    on the direction of the manufacturer of the supplemented food, if
    the representation expressly or implicitly indicates that the
    supplemented food has particular nutritional or health-related
    properties, including any statement or claim set out in column 4 of
    the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims or
    column 1 of the table following section B.01.603 or referred to in
    section B.01.311, D.01.006 or D.02.004;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any added sugar alcohol;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any supplemental ingredient;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any vitamin or mineral nutrient that
    is declared as a component of an ingredient, other than flour, of
    the supplemented food;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient referred to in column 1
    of any of items 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11 and 13 to 15 of the table to this
    section that may not be expressed as "0" in the supplemented food
    facts table;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} the statement "Not a significant source of (naming
    each nutrient that is omitted from the supplemented food facts table
    in accordance with this subsection)" or, if the supplemented food
    meets the condition specified in subsection B.29.010(3), the
    statement "Not a significant source of other nutrients";

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the % Daily Value interpretative statement; and

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} the "Supplemented with" interpretative statement.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The supplemented food facts table of a supplemented
  food that is a single-serving prepackaged product need only include
  the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the serving of stated size;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the energy value;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of fat;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the amount of carbohydrate;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the amount of protein;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient that is the subject of a
    representation on the label of the supplemented food, or in any
    advertisement for the supplemented food that is made or placed by or
    on the direction of the manufacturer of the supplemented food, if
    the representation expressly or implicitly indicates that the
    supplemented food has particular nutritional or health-related
    properties, including any statement or claim set out in column 4 of
    the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims or
    column 1 of the table following section B.01.603 or referred to in
    section B.01.311, D.01.006 or D.02.004;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any added sugar alcohol;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any supplemental ingredient;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amounts of saturated fatty acids and *trans*
    fatty acids and the sum of saturated fatty acids and *trans* fatty
    acids, if any of the amounts or the sum may not be expressed as "0"
    in the supplemented food facts table;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any nutrient referred to in column 1
    of item 8 or 11 of the table to this section that may not be
    expressed as "0" in the supplemented food facts table;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} the % Daily Value interpretative statement; and

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the "Supplemented with" interpretative statement.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a supplemented food
  intended solely for use as an ingredient in the manufacture of other
  supplemented foods intended for sale to a consumer at the retail
  level.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} If the supplemented food facts table on the label of
  a supplemented food corresponds to Figure 6.5(B), 6.6(B), 6.5.1(B),
  6.6.1(B), 7.3(B), 7.4(B), 7.3.1(B), 7.4.1(B), 17.2(E) and (F) or
  17.2.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of SFFT Formats, the supplemented
  food facts table is not required to show the % Daily Value
  interpretative statement or the "Supplemented with" interpretative
  statement.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (10), if a substance has been
  added as a supplemental ingredient, the amount referred to in item 18
  of the table to this section includes the total amount of the
  substance in the supplemented food, unless otherwise provided in
  column 3 or 5 of the List of Permitted Supplemental Ingredients.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} If any amount of a nutrient referred to in column 1
  of the table to this section has been added as a supplemental
  ingredient, the amount of the nutrient may only be expressed in the
  supplemented food facts table in accordance with item 18 of the table
  to this section.

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} If a substance other than a nutrient has been added
  as a supplemental ingredient and the substance has one or more
  constituents for which a maximum amount is specified in column 3 of
  the List of Permitted Supplemental Ingredients, the amount of each
  constituent set out in the supplemented food facts table must include
  the total amount of the constituent in the supplemented food, unless
  otherwise provided in column 3 or 5 of the List of Permitted
  Supplemental Ingredients.

  <tbody>
  <tr>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">1</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft"
  scope="row">Serving of stated size</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">“Serving Size
  (naming the serving size)”, “Serving (naming the serving size)” or “Per
  (naming the serving size)”</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft"><p>The size is
  expressed</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> in the case of a supplemented
  food that is a single-serving prepackaged product,</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(i)</span> per package, and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(ii)</span> in grams or millilitres, in
  accordance with subparagraph B.01.002A(2)(a)(i) or (ii); and</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> in the case of a supplemented
  food that is a multiple-serving prepackaged product, in the following
  units set out in column 3B of the Table of Reference Amounts:</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(i)</span> the household measure that
  applies to the supplemented food, and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(ii)</span> the metric measure that
  applies to the supplemented food.</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  </ul></td>
  <td class="noBorderBottom top alignleft"><ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(1)</span> The size if expressed in a
  metric unit is rounded off</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if it is less than 10 g or
  10 mL, to the nearest multiple of 0.1 g or 0.1 mL; and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> if it is 10 g or more or
  10 mL or more, to the nearest multiple of 1 g or 1 mL.</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(2)</span> The size if expressed as a
  fraction is represented by a numerator and a denominator separated by a
  line.</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(3)</span> The size must include the
  word “assorted” if the information in the supplemented food facts table
  of a prepackaged product containing an assortment of supplemented foods
  is set out as a composite value.</p></li>
  </ul></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">2</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft"
  scope="row">Energy value</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">“Calories”,
  “Total Calories” or “Calories, Total”</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">The value is
  expressed in Calories per serving of stated size.</td>
  <td class="noBorderBottom top alignleft"><p>The value is rounded off</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if it is less than 5
  Calories,</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(i)</span> if the supplemented food
  meets the conditions set out in column 2 of item 1 of the Table of
  Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims for the subject “free
  of energy” set out in column 1, to “0” Calorie, and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(ii)</span> in all other cases, to the
  nearest multiple of 1 Calorie;</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> if it is 5 Calories or more
  but not more than 50 Calories, to the nearest multiple of 5 Calories;
  and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> if it is more than 50
  Calories, to the nearest multiple of 10 Calories.</p></li>
  </ul></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">3</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft"
  scope="row">Amount of fat</td>
  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom top alignleft">“Fat”, “Total
  Fat” or “Fat, Total”</td>

  expressed</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> in grams per serving of
  stated size; and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> as a percentage of the daily
  value per serving of stated size.</p></li>
  </ul></td>
  <td class="noBorderBottom top alignleft"><ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(1)</span> The amount is rounded off</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if it is less than 0.5 g,</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(i)</span> if the supplemented food
  meets the conditions set out in column 2 of item 11 of the Table of
  Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims for the subject “free
  of fat” set out in column 1 and the amounts of saturated fatty acids and
  <em>trans</em> fatty acids are declared as “0 g” in the supplemented
  food facts table or are omitted from that table in accordance with
  subsection B.29.002(4) and no other fatty acids are declared in an
  amount greater than 0 g, to “0 g”, and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(ii)</span> in all other cases, to the
  nearest multiple of 0.1 g;</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> if it is 0.5 g or more but
  not more than 5 g, to the nearest multiple of 0.5 g; and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> if it is more than 5 g, to
  the nearest multiple of 1 g.</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(2)</span> The percentage is rounded
  off</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if the amount is declared as
  “0 g”, to 0%; and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> in all other cases, to the
  nearest multiple of 1%.</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  </ul></td>

  <td class="noBorderRight noBorderBottom alignleft"><p>The amount is

  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> in milligrams per serving of

  to “0 mg”;</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> if it is 0.05 mg or more but
  less than 0.5 mg, to the nearest multiple of 0.1 mg;</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> if it is 0.5 mg or more but
  less than 2.5 mg, to the nearest multiple of 0.25 mg; and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(d)</span> if it is 2.5 mg or more, to
  the nearest multiple of 0.5 mg.</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(2)</span> The percentage is rounded
  off</p>
  <ul>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if the amount is declared as
  “0 mg”, to 0%; and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> in all other cases, to the
  nearest multiple of 1%.</p></li>
  </ul></li>
  </ul></td>

  <td class="noBorderRight alignleft" scope="row">Amount of supplemental

  <td class="noBorderRight alignleft"><p>The amount is expressed in</p>

  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> the applicable unit referred

  serving of stated size; and</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> in the case of a nutrient
  with a daily value, as a percentage of the daily value per serving of
  stated size.</p></li>
  </ul></td>
  <td class="alignleft"><ul>

  the nearest whole number and expressed in the manner set out in column 3

  Ingredients.</p></li>
  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(2)</span> Unless otherwise provided in

  <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> in all other cases, to the

##### [Additional Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372290 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  supplemented food facts table may also contain information set out in
  column 1 of the table to this section.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} This section does not apply in respect of a vitamin
  or mineral nutrient that is set out in the supplemented food facts
  table in accordance with subsection B.29.002(1) if any amount of that
  vitamin or mineral nutrient has been added as a supplemental
  ingredient.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If information set out in column 1 of the table to
  this section is included in the supplemented food facts table, it must
  be expressed using a description set out in column 2, in the unit set
  out in column 3 and in the manner set out in column 4.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (3), the serving of
  stated size set out in the supplemented food facts table, as expressed
  in a metric unit, must be used as the basis for determining the
  information appearing in the supplemented food facts table in respect
  of the energy value and nutrient content of the supplemented food.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The percentage of the daily value for a vitamin or
  mineral nutrient shown in the supplemented food facts table in
  accordance with subsection (3) must be established on the basis of the
  amount, by weight, of the vitamin or mineral nutrient per serving of
  stated size for the supplemented food, rounded off in the applicable
  manner set out in column 4 of the table to this section.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The amount of omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids,
  omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids and monounsaturated fatty acids
  must be shown in the supplemented food facts table if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any of those groups of fatty acids or
    the amount of polyunsaturated fatty acids is shown in the
    supplemented food facts table or on the label of the supplemented
    food or in any advertisement for the supplemented food that is made
    or placed by or on the direction of the manufacturer of the
    supplemented food; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any specific fatty acid is shown on
    the label of the supplemented food or in any advertisement for the
    supplemented food that is made or placed by or on the direction of
    the manufacturer of the supplemented food.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} If the label of the supplemented food, or any
  advertisement for the supplemented food that is made or placed by or
  on the direction of the manufacturer, contains a representation,
  express or implied, that includes information that is set out in
  column 1 of the table to this section, that information must also be
  shown in the supplemented food facts table.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} The supplemented food facts table must show the
  amount of any added sugar alcohol.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} The supplemented food facts table must show the
  amount of any vitamin or mineral nutrient that is declared as a
  component of an ingredient, other than flour.

- [(10)]{.lawlabel} If information set out in column 1 of the table to
  this section is included in the supplemented food facts table, it must
  be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in English and French; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if, in accordance with
    subsection B.01.012(3), the information that is required by these
    Regulations to be shown on the label may be shown in that language
    only and is shown on the label in that language.

    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> if it is 1 mg or more but
    less than 10 mg, to the nearest multiple of 2 mg;</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(c)</span> if it is 10 mg or more but
    less than 50 mg, to the nearest multiple of 5 mg; and</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(d)</span> if it is 50 mg or more, to
    the nearest multiple of 10 mg.</p></li>
    </ul></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(2)</span> The percentage is rounded
    off</p>
    <ul>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(a)</span> if the amount is declared as
    “0 mg”, to 0%; and</p></li>
    <li><p><span class="tablelabel">(b)</span> in all other cases, to the
    nearest multiple of 1%.</p></li>
    </ul></li>
    </ul></td>
    </tr>

##### [Supplemented Foods for Use in Manufacturing Other Supplemented Foods]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372315 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  supplemented food intended solely for use as an ingredient in the
  manufacture of other supplemented foods intended for sale to a
  consumer at the retail level.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited to sell the supplemented food unless
  the information referred to in subsection (3) in respect of the
  supplemented food is provided in writing and accompanies the
  supplemented food when it is delivered to the purchaser.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The information

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} must include the information that would, but for
    subsection B.29.002(6), be required by sections B.29.002 and
    B.29.003 to be included in a supplemented food facts table;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may include other information that is permitted by
    section B.29.003 to be included in that supplemented food facts
    table; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} must be expressed in accordance with sections
    B.29.002 and B.29.003, subject to the following modifications,
    namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} information in respect of supplemental
      ingredients must be expressed according to the applicable unit
      referred to in column 3 of the List of Permitted Supplemental
      Ingredients,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} per gram or 100 g of the supplemented food, if
        the net quantity of the supplemented food is declared on the
        label by weight or by count, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} per millilitre or 100 mL of the supplemented
        food, if the net quantity of the supplemented food is declared
        on the label by volume,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} information --- other than in respect of
      supplemental ingredients --- for vitamins referred to in
      subsection D.01.002(1) must be expressed in the applicable unit
      referred to in subsection D.01.003(1) and for mineral nutrients
      referred to in paragraphs D.02.001(1)(a) to (j), (l) to (n)
      and (p) must be expressed in milligrams for sodium, potassium,
      calcium, phosphorus, magnesium, iron, zinc, chloride, copper and
      manganese and in micrograms for iodide, chromium, selenium and
      molybdenum,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} per gram or 100 g of the supplemented food, if
        the net quantity of the supplemented food is declared on the
        label by weight or by count, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} per millilitre or 100 mL of the supplemented
        food, if the net quantity of the supplemented food is declared
        on the label by volume,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} information for other nutrients and the energy
      value set out in column 1 of the table to section B.29.002 or the
      table to section B.29.003 must be expressed in the units referred
      to in column 3,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} per gram or 100 g of the supplemented food, if
        the net quantity of the supplemented food is declared on the
        label by weight or by count, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} per millilitre or 100 mL of the supplemented
        food, if the net quantity of the supplemented food is declared
        on the label by volume,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} percentages of daily values and information on
      servings of stated size may be omitted, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the information must be stated with a degree of
      precision that corresponds to the accuracy of the analytical
      methodology used to produce the information.

##### [Basis of Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372336 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (5),
  the information in the supplemented food facts table must be set out
  only on the basis of the supplemented food as offered for sale.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product contains an assortment of
  supplemented foods of the same type and the typical serving consists
  of only one of those supplemented foods, the information in the
  supplemented food facts table must be set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} on the basis of each of the supplemented foods
    contained in the prepackaged product, if the information set out in
    column 1 of the table to section B.29.002 for each of those
    supplemented foods is different; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on the basis of one of the supplemented foods
    contained in the prepackaged product, if the information set out in
    column 1 of the table to section B.29.002 for each of those
    supplemented foods is the same.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a prepackaged product contains an assortment of
  supplemented foods of the same type and the typical serving consists
  of more than one of those supplemented foods, the information in the
  supplemented food facts table must be set out for each of the
  supplemented foods contained in the prepackaged product or as a
  composite value.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a supplemented food is to be prepared in
  accordance with directions provided in or on the package or is
  commonly combined with other ingredients or another food or cooked
  before being consumed, the supplemented food facts table may also set
  out information for the supplemented food as prepared, in which case

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the supplemented food facts table must set out the
    following information for the supplemented food as prepared, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} except in the case described in subparagraph
      (ii), the amount of the supplemented food expressed using the unit
      referred to in column 3 of subparagraph 1(b)(i) of the table to
      section B.29.002 as "about (naming the serving size)" or "about
      (naming the serving size) prepared" and, if applicable, in the
      manner specified in column 4 of subitems 1(1) and (2),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the supplemented food is commonly served
      combined with another food, the amount of the other food expressed
      using the unit referred to in column 3 of subparagraph 1(b)(i) of
      the table to section B.29.002,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the energy value, expressed using a description
      set out in column 2 of item 2 of the table to section B.29.002, in
      the unit set out in column 3 and in the manner set out in column
      4,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3,
      6 to 8, 10, 11 and 13 to 15 of the table to section B.29.002 and
      in column 1 of items 11 to 34 of the table to section B.29.003
      that is declared as a percentage of the daily value in the
      supplemented food facts table for the supplemented food as sold,
      expressed using a description set out in column 2 of those tables,
      as a percentage of the daily value per serving of stated size and
      in the manner specified in column 4 of those tables, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in column 1 of item
      18 of the table to section B.29.002, expressed using the
      description referred to in column 2, in the unit referred to in
      column 3 and in the manner referred to in column 4; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the supplemented food facts table may also set out
    the following information for the added ingredients or the other
    food, if it is declared in the supplemented food facts table for the
    supplemented food as sold, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3 to
      5 and 7 to 12 of the table to section B.29.002, expressed using a
      description set out in column 2, in milligrams for the information
      set out in column 1 of items 7 and 8 and in grams for the
      information set out in column 1 of items 3 to 5 and 9 to 12 and in
      the manner specified in column 4,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3
      to 10 of the table to section B.29.003, expressed using a
      description set out in column 2, in grams and in the manner
      specified in column 4, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of item 2
      of the table to section B.29.002, expressed using a description
      set out in column 2, in the unit set out in column 3 per serving
      of stated size of the supplemented food as prepared, and in the
      manner specified in column 4.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The information in the supplemented food facts table
  may also be set out on the basis of other amounts of the supplemented
  food that reflect different uses or different units of measurement of
  the supplemented food, in which case

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the supplemented food facts table must set out the
    following information for each of the other amounts of the
    supplemented food, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the amount of the supplemented food expressed in
      a household measure and a metric measure and in the manner
      specified in column 4 of subitems 1(1) and (2) of the table to
      section B.29.002,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the energy value, expressed using a description
      set out in column 2 of item 2 of the table to section B.29.002, in
      the unit set out in column 3 and in the manner set out in column
      4,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3,
      6 to 8, 10, 11 and 13 to 15 of the table to section B.29.002 and
      in column 1 of items 11 to 34 of the table to section B.29.003
      that is declared as a percentage of the daily value in the
      supplemented food facts table for the first amount of the
      supplemented food for which information is declared, expressed
      using a description set out in column 2 of those tables, as a
      percentage of the daily value per serving of stated size and in
      the manner specified in column 4 of those tables, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in column 1 of item
      18 of the table to section B.29.002, expressed using the
      description referred to in column 2, the unit referred to in
      column 3 and in the manner referred to in column 4; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the supplemented food facts table is set out in
    a version of the aggregate format specified in section B.29.015, it
    must also set out the following information for each of the other
    amounts of the supplemented food, if that information is declared in
    the supplemented food facts table for the first amount of the
    supplemented food for which information is declared, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3 to
      5 and 7 to 15 of the table to section B.29.002, expressed using a
      description set out in column 2, in milligrams for the information
      set out in column 1 of items 7, 8 and 13 to 15, and in grams for
      the information set out in column 1 of items 3 to 5 and 9 to 12
      and in the manner specified in column 4, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in column 1 of items 3
      to 34 of the table to section B.29.003, expressed using a
      description set out in column 2, in micrograms for the information
      set out in column 1 of items 11, 13, 15, 21, 22, 26, 29, 32 and
      33, in micrograms of dietary folate equivalents for the
      information set out in column 1 of item 20, in milligrams for the
      information set out in column 1 of items 12, 14, 16 to 19, 23 to
      25, 27, 28, 30, 31 and 34, and in grams for the information set
      out in column 1 of items 3 to 10 and in the manner specified in
      column 4.

##### [Presentation of Supplemented Food Facts Table]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372365 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (7),
  the supplemented food facts table must be presented in accordance with
  the format specified in the applicable figure in the Directory of SFFT
  Formats, having regard to matters such as order of presentation,
  dimensions, spacing and the use of upper and lower case letters and
  bold type.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The characters and rules in the supplemented food
  facts table must be displayed in a single colour that is a visual
  equivalent of 100% solid black type on a white background or on a
  uniform neutral background with a maximum 5% tint of colour.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The characters in the supplemented food facts table

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} must be displayed in a single standard sans serif
    font that is not decorative and in such a manner that the characters
    never touch each other or the rules; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may be displayed with larger dimensions than those
    specified in the applicable figure in the Directory of SFFT Formats
    if all the characters in the table are enlarged in a uniform manner.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The type size shown in parentheses for a version
  referred to in a table to sections B.29.009 to B.29.015 is the minimum
  type size that may be used in a supplemented food facts table to show
  nutrients and supplemental ingredients set out in the tables to
  sections B.29.002 and B.29.003 in accordance with that version.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} A rule that is specified in the applicable figure in
  the Directory of SFFT Formats as being a 1 point rule or a 2 point
  rule may be displayed with larger dimensions in the supplemented food
  facts table.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The information in the supplemented food facts table
  must be in accordance with subsections B.29.001(2) and (3) and
  sections B.29.002, B.29.003 and B.29.005.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} In a supplemented food facts table consisting of a
  table in both English and French, the order of languages may be
  reversed from the order shown in the applicable figure in the
  Directory of SFFT Formats.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372377){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372377.html"}
:::

##### [Location of Supplemented Food Facts Table]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372378 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  supplemented food facts table must be displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a table in English and a table in French on the
    same continuous surface of the available display surface;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in a table in both English and French on a
    continuous surface of the available display surface; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in a table in English on a continuous surface of
    the available display surface and a table in French on another
    continuous surface of the available display surface that is of the
    same size and prominence as the first surface.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, in accordance with subsection B.01.012(3), the
  information required by these Regulations may be shown on the label of
  a supplemented food in English only or in French only and is shown in
  that language, the supplemented food facts table may be displayed on
  the label in a table in that language only on a continuous surface of
  the available display surface.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372386){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372386.html"}
:::

##### [Orientation of Supplemented Food Facts Table]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372387 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.008
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  supplemented food facts table must be oriented in the same manner as
  other information appearing on the label of a supplemented food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a version of a supplemented food facts table
  cannot be oriented in the same manner as other information appearing
  on the label, it must be oriented in another manner if there is
  sufficient space to do so and the food contained in the package does
  not leak out and is not damaged when the package is turned over.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a
  supplemented food facts table that is set out on the top or bottom of
  a package.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372393){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372393.html"}
:::

##### [Standard and Horizontal Formats]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372394 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  supplemented food unless any of sections B.29.010 to B.29.015 applies
  to it.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the supplemented food
  facts table must be set out in a version listed in column 1 of the
  table to this section and in respect of which the condition specified
  in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the supplemented food, a supplemented food facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  supplemented food facts table must be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual standard format in accordance with
    Figure 3.5(B), 3.6(B) or 3.7(B) of the Directory of SFFT Formats;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual horizontal format in accordance with
    Figure 4.3(B), 4.4(B) or 4.5(B) of the Directory of SFFT Formats;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the linear format in accordance with Figures
    16.1(E) and (F) or 16.2(E) and (F) of the Directory of SFFT Formats;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the supplemented food facts
    table; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.29.017.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a supplemented food facts table cannot be
  displayed in accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the
  available display surface of the supplemented food, the supplemented
  food facts table must include only the information that is required by
  these Regulations to be included in that table.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the supplemented
  food facts table is set out on a tag attached to an ornamental
  container or a tag attached to a package to which a label cannot be
  physically applied or on which information cannot be legibly set out
  and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under the customary
  conditions of purchase, it must be set out in a version that is
  described in paragraph (3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column
  1 of the table to this section, without regard to any condition
  specified in column 2.

##### [Simplified Formats]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372437 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  supplemented food if it satisfies the condition set out in subsection
  B.29.002(4) and its supplemented food facts table includes only the
  information referred to in paragraphs B.29.002(4)(a) to (m).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the supplemented food
  facts table must be set out in a version that is listed in column 1 of
  the table to this section and in respect of which the condition
  specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the supplemented food, a supplemented food facts table containing only
  the information referred to in paragraphs B.29.002(4)(a) to (m) in any
  of the versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this
  section, the supplemented food facts table must be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified standard format in
    accordance with Figure 6.5(B) or 6.6(B) of the Directory of SFFT
    Formats;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified horizontal format in
    accordance with Figure 7.3(B) or 7.4(B) of the Directory of SFFT
    Formats;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the simplified linear format in accordance with
    Figures 17.1(E) and (F) or 17.2(E) and (F) of the Directory of SFFT
    Formats;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the supplemented food facts
    table; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.29.017.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the supplemented
  food facts table is set out on a tag attached to an ornamental
  container or a tag attached to a package to which a label cannot be
  physically applied or on which information cannot be legibly set out
  and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under the customary
  conditions of purchase, it must be set out in a version that is
  described in paragraph (3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column
  1 of the table to this section, without regard to any condition
  specified in column 2.

##### [Simplified Formats --- Supplemented Foods that are Single-serving Prepackaged Products]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372472 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies to a
  supplemented food that is a single-serving prepackaged product, whose
  supplemented food facts table includes only the information referred
  to in paragraphs B.29.002(5)(a) to (l).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), the supplemented food
  facts table of the supplemented food that is a single-serving
  prepackaged product must be set out in a version that is listed in
  column 1 of the table to this section and in respect of which the
  condition specified in column 2 is satisfied.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the supplemented food that is a single-serving prepackaged product, a
  supplemented food facts table containing only the information referred
  to in paragraphs B.29.002(5)(a) to (l) in any of the versions that is
  listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the supplemented food
  facts table must be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified standard format in
    accordance with Figure 6.5.1(B) or 6.6.1(B) of the Directory of SFFT
    Formats;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual simplified horizontal format in
    accordance with Figure 7.3.1(B) or 7.4.1(B) of the Directory of SFFT
    Formats;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the simplified linear format in accordance with
    Figures 17.1.1(E) and (F) or 17.2.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of
    SFFT Formats;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the supplemented food facts
    table; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.29.017.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (2) and (3), if the supplemented
  food facts table of the supplemented food that is a single-serving
  prepackaged product is set out on a tag attached to an ornamental
  container or a tag attached to a package to which a label cannot be
  physically applied or on which information cannot be legibly set out
  and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under the customary
  conditions of purchase, it must be set out in a version that is
  described in paragraph (3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column
  1 of the table to this section, without regard to any condition
  specified in column 2.

##### [Dual Format --- Supplemented Foods Requiring Preparation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372500 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.012
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  supplemented food facts table includes information referred to in
  subsection B.29.005(4), the supplemented food facts table must be set
  out in a version that is listed in column 1 of the table to this
  section and in respect of which the condition specified in column 2 is
  satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the supplemented food, a supplemented food facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  supplemented food facts table must be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual dual format in accordance with Figure
    9.5(B) or 9.6(B) of the Directory of SFFT Formats; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the supplemented food facts
    table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a supplemented food facts table cannot be
  displayed in accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the
  available display surface of the supplemented food, the supplemented
  food facts table must include only the information that is required by
  these Regulations to be included in the table, together with the
  information referred to in subsection B.29.005(4).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), if the supplemented
  food facts table is set out on a tag attached to an ornamental
  container or a tag attached to a package to which a label cannot be
  physically applied or on which information cannot be legibly set out
  and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under the customary
  conditions of purchase, it must be set out in a version that is
  described in paragraph (2)(a) or that is listed in column 1 of the
  table to this section, without regard to any condition specified in
  column 2.

##### [Aggregate Format --- Different Kinds of Supplemented Foods]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372525 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.013
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  supplemented food facts table of a prepackaged product containing an
  assortment of supplemented foods includes separate information for
  each supplemented food as provided in paragraph B.29.005(2)(a) or
  subsection B.29.005(3), the supplemented food facts table must be set
  out in a version that is listed in column 1 of the table to this
  section and in respect of which the condition specified in column 2 is
  satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the prepackaged product, a supplemented food facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  supplemented food facts table must be set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a prepackaged product described in
    paragraph B.29.005(2)(a), in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
      Figure 11.5(B) or 11.6(B) of the Directory of SFFT Formats,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the
      table to this section, even though more than 15% of the available
      display surface would be required to display the supplemented food
      facts table, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a manner described in section B.29.017; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a prepackaged product described in
    subsection B.29.005(3), in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
      Figure 11.5(B) or 11.6(B) of the Directory of SFFT Formats, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the
      table to this section, even though more than 15% of the available
      display surface would be required to display the supplemented food
      facts table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a supplemented food facts table cannot be
  displayed in accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the
  available display surface of the prepackaged product, the supplemented
  food facts table must include only the information that is required by
  these Regulations to be included for each supplemented food for which
  separate information is set out in the table.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), if the supplemented
  food facts table of the prepackaged product is set out on a tag
  attached to an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package to
  which a label cannot be physically applied or on which information
  cannot be legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or
  consumer under the customary conditions of purchase, it must be set
  out in a version that is described in subparagraph (2)(b)(i) or that
  is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, without regard to
  any condition specified in column 2.
