##### [Dual Format --- Different Amounts of Supplemented Food]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372555 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.014
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  supplemented food facts table includes separate information for
  different amounts of the supplemented food as provided in paragraph
  B.29.005(5)(a) without including the information referred to in
  paragraph B.29.005(5)(b), the supplemented food facts table must be
  set out in a version that is listed in column 1 of the table to this
  section and in respect of which the condition specified in column 2 is
  satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the supplemented food, a supplemented food facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  supplemented food facts table must be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual dual format in accordance with Figure
    13.5(B) or 13.6(B) of the Directory of SFFT Formats; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the supplemented food facts
    table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a supplemented food facts table cannot be
  displayed in accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the
  available display surface of the supplemented food, the supplemented
  food facts table must include only the information that is required by
  these Regulations to be included for each amount of the supplemented
  food for which separate information is set out in the table.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), if the supplemented
  food facts table is set out on a tag attached to an ornamental
  container or a tag attached to a package to which a label cannot be
  physically applied or on which information cannot be legibly set out
  and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under the customary
  conditions of purchase, it must be set out in a version that is
  described in paragraph (2)(a) or that is listed in column 1 of the
  table to this section, without regard to any condition specified in
  column 2.

##### [Aggregate Format --- Different Amounts of Supplemented Food]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372580 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), if the
  supplemented food facts table includes separate information for
  different amounts of the supplemented food as provided in paragraphs
  B.29.005(5)(a) and (b), the supplemented food facts table must be set
  out in a version that is listed in column 1 of the table to this
  section and in respect of which the condition specified in column 2 is
  satisfied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If it is not possible to display, in accordance with
  these Regulations on 15% or less of the available display surface of
  the supplemented food, a supplemented food facts table in any of the
  versions that is listed in column 1 of the table to this section, the
  supplemented food facts table must be set out in

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual aggregate format in accordance with
    Figure 15.5(B) or 15.6(B) of the Directory of SFFT Formats; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a version that is listed in column 1 of the table
    to this section, even though more than 15% of the available display
    surface would be required to display the supplemented food facts
    table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, in determining
  whether a version of a supplemented food facts table cannot be
  displayed in accordance with these Regulations on 15% or less of the
  available display surface of the supplemented food, the supplemented
  food facts table must include only the information that is required by
  these Regulations to be included for each amount of the supplemented
  food for which separate information is set out in the table.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2), if the supplemented
  food facts table of the supplemented food is set out on a tag attached
  to an ornamental container or a tag attached to a package to which a
  label cannot be physically applied or on which information cannot be
  legibly set out and easily viewed by the purchaser or consumer under
  the customary conditions of purchase, it must be set out in a version
  that is described in paragraph (2)(a) or that is listed in column 1 of
  the table to this section, without regard to any condition specified
  in column 2.

##### [Presentation of Additional Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372605 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.016
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If information referred to in column
  1 of the table to section B.29.003 is included in a supplemented food
  facts table that is set out in a version consisting of a table in
  English and a table in French or a table in English or French, that
  information must be displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with the order of presentation, the
    use of indents and the presentation of footnotes illustrated in
    Figures 18.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of SFFT Formats; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of matters other than those referred to
    in paragraph (a), in accordance with the format that is specified in
    the applicable figure in the Directory of SFFT Formats.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If information referred to in column 1 of the table
  to section B.29.003 is included in a supplemented food facts table
  that is set out in a version consisting of a table in both English and
  French, that information must be displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with the order of presentation, the
    use of indents and the presentation of footnotes illustrated in
    Figure 19.1(B) of the Directory of SFFT Formats; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of matters other than those referred to
    in paragraph (a), in accordance with the format that is specified in
    the applicable figure in the Directory of SFFT Formats.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (1)(a), the use of indents
  illustrated in Figures 18.1(E) and (F) of the Directory of SFFT
  Formats is not applicable if information referred to in column 1 of
  the table to section B.29.003 is set out in the linear format referred
  to in paragraph B.29.009(3)(c) or the simplified linear format
  referred to in paragraph B.29.010(3)(c).

##### [Alternative Methods of Presentation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372616 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.017
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section A.01.016 and subject
  to subsection (2), a supplemented food facts table that meets the
  conditions specified in subsection B.29.009(3), B.29.010(3) or
  B.29.011(3) or paragraph B.29.013(2)(a) may be set out on

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a tag attached to the package;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a package insert;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the inner side of a label;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a fold-out label; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an outer sleeve, overwrap or collar.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The supplemented food facts table must not be set out
  in a manner described in paragraph (1)(b) or (c) if the label of the
  supplemented food is required to show a list of cautionary statements.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the supplemented food facts table is set out in a
  manner described in paragraph (1)(b) or (c), the outer side of the
  label of the package must indicate in a type size of not less than 8
  points where the supplemented food facts table is located.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the supplemented food facts table is set out in a
  manner described in subsection (1), it must be set out

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supplemented food described in
    subsection B.29.009(3), in a version that is described in paragraph
    B.29.009(3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column 1 of the
    table to section B.29.009;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supplemented food described in
    subsection B.29.010(3), in a version that is described in paragraph
    B.29.010(3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column 1 of the
    table to section B.29.010;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supplemented food described in
    subsection B.29.011(3), in a version that is described in paragraph
    B.29.011(3)(a), (b) or (c) or that is listed in column 1 of the
    table to section B.29.011; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a prepackaged product containing an
    assortment of supplemented foods described in paragraph
    B.29.013(2)(a), in a version that is described in subparagraph
    B.29.013(2)(a)(i) or that is listed in column 1 of the table to
    section B.29.013.

##### [Small Packages]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372633 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.018]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.018
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section A.01.016 and subject
  to subsection (2), if the available display surface of a supplemented
  food is less than 100 cm^2^, the label of the supplemented food need
  not carry a supplemented food facts table if the outer side of the
  label contains an indication of how a purchaser or consumer may obtain
  the information that would otherwise be required to be set out in a
  supplemented food facts table on the label of the supplemented food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a supplemented food

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the label of the supplemented food is required
    to show a list of cautionary statements; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is the subject of any of the following
    representations on the label of the supplemented food or in any
    advertisement for the supplemented food that is made or placed by or
    on the direction of the manufacturer of the supplemented food:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any declaration of the supplemented food's energy
      value or the amount of a nutrient or supplemental ingredient
      contained in the supplemented food,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any representation that expressly or implicitly
      indicates that the supplemented food or any substance it contains
      has particular nutritional or health-related properties, including
      any statement or claim set out in column 4 of the Table of
      Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims or column 1 of
      the table following section B.01.603 or referred to in section
      B.01.311, D.01.006 or D.02.004, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any health-related statement, name, logo,
      symbol, seal of approval or mark.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (2)(b), subsection (1) applies to a
  supplemented food that meets the conditions set out in column 2 of
  item 37 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
  Claims for the subject "Free of sugars" set out in column 1 if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the supplemented food is not the subject of any
    representation referred to in paragraph (2)(b) other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement or claim set out in column 4 of item
      37 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and
      Claims for the subject "Free of sugars" set out in column 1,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the energy value of the supplemented food
      expressed in Calories per serving of stated size, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the amount of sugar alcohols expressed in grams
      per serving of stated size;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the statement or claim set out in column 4 of item
    37 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content Statements and Claims
    for the subject "Free of sugars" set out in column 1 and that
    appears on the label is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} legibly set out on the principal display panel,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in lower case letters except for the first
      letter of each word of the statement or claim, which may be an
      upper case letter,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} of at least the same size and prominence as the
      letters used in the numerical portion of the declaration of net
      quantity as required under paragraph 229(1)(a) and subsections
      229(2) and (3) of the [Safe Food for Canadians
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-108), and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} displayed in a colour contrasting with the
      background of the label;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the energy value of the supplemented food expressed
    in Calories per serving of stated size and the amount of sugar
    alcohols expressed in grams per serving of stated size are shown
    immediately after whichever of the following elements appears last
    on the label:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the list of ingredients,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a [[food allergen source, gluten source and
      added sulphites statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
      subsection B.01.010.1(1),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a declaration referred to in subsection
      B.01.010.4(1), or

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any statement referred to in subsection
      B.16.016(1); and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the label of the supplemented food is not required
    to show a list of cautionary statements.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} An indication referred to in subsection (1)

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} must be set out in a type size of not less than 8
    points;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} must include a postal address, website address or
    toll-free telephone number; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} must be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in English and French, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in one of those languages, if, in accordance
      with subsection B.01.012(3), the information that is required by
      these Regulations to be shown on the label of the supplemented
      food may be shown in that language only and is shown on the label
      in that language.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of the supplemented food must
  provide the information referred to in subsection (1) to a purchaser
  or consumer on request

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} without charge;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the following manner, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the official language in which the information
      is requested or, if specified by the purchaser or consumer, in
      both official languages, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in one of the official languages, if, in
      accordance with subsection B.01.012(3), the information that is
      required by these Regulations to be shown on the label of the
      supplemented food may be shown in that language only and is shown
      on the label in that language; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the form of a supplemented food facts table that
    is set out

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in a format, other than a horizontal format, that
      is specified in any of sections B.29.009 to B.29.015 and that
      would otherwise be carried on the label of the supplemented food
      in accordance with these Regulations, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in a version of that format that is listed in
      column 1 of item 1 of any Part of the table to the applicable
      section referred to in subparagraph (i).

**[[B.29.019]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.019 .sectionLabel}** If a
supplemented food has an available display surface of less than
100 cm^2^ and has a supplemented food facts table on its label, the
supplemented food facts table need only include

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the serving of stated size;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in column 1 of the table
  to section B.29.002 or the table to section B.29.003 in respect of the
  energy value of the supplemented food and the amount of any nutrient
  or supplemental ingredient that is the subject of a representation on
  the label of the supplemented food, or in any advertisement for the
  supplemented food that is made or placed by or on the direction of the
  manufacturer of the supplemented food, if the representation expressly
  or implicitly indicates that the supplemented food has particular
  nutritional or health-related properties, including any statement or
  claim set out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted Nutrient Content
  Statements and Claims or column 1 of the table following section
  B.01.603 or referred to in section B.01.311, D.01.006 or D.02.004;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any added sugar alcohol;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any saturated fat, sugars or sodium if
  the amount meets or exceeds the applicable threshold set out in
  columns 2, 3, 5 or 6 of the table to section B.01.350; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the amount of any supplemental ingredient for which a
  cautionary statement set out in the list of cautionary statements is
  applicable.

#### [Cautionary Statements]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1372682 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.020]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.020
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every applicable cautionary
  statement set out in column 4 of the List of Permitted Supplemental
  Ingredients in respect of the supplemental ingredients contained in a
  supplemented food must be shown

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a list on the label of the supplemented food;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} grouped together and introduced by the title, in
    bold type,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} "Caution", "Caution:" or "Caution :" in the
      English version, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} "[Attention]{.otherLang lang="fr"}",
      "[Attention]{.otherLang lang="fr"} :" or "[Attention]{.otherLang
      lang="fr"}:" in the French version;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} without any intervening printed, written or graphic
    material appearing between the title and the first cautionary
    statement;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in regular or bold type;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in lower case letters, except that upper case
    letters must be used to show the first letter of each cautionary
    statement; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} separated by a bullet point or comma.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The list of cautionary statements must be shown in a
  manner that clearly differentiates it on the label by means of one or
  both of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} graphics in the form of a solid-line border around
    the list or one or more solid lines appearing immediately above,
    below or at the sides of the list that are the same colour as that
    of the type used to show the information referred to in subsection
    B.01.008.1(1); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a background colour that creates a contrast between
    the background colour of the list and the background colour used on
    the adjacent surface of the label, other than the surface used to
    display

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a list of ingredients,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a [[food allergen source, gluten source and
      added sulphites statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
      subsection B.01.010.1(1),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a declaration referred to in subsection
      B.01.010.4(1),

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any statement referred to in subsection
      B.16.016(1),

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a nutrition facts table, or

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a supplemented food facts table.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The list of cautionary statements must be shown on
  the label without any intervening printed, written or graphic
  material,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in English and French, adjacent to each linguistic
    version of the supplemented food facts table appearing in the same
    language, if there are separate English and French versions of the
    table;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in English and French, adjacent to a bilingual
    version of the supplemented food facts table, with one linguistic
    version of the list following the other linguistic version; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in English or French, adjacent to the supplemented
    food facts table in the same language, if, in accordance with
    subsection B.01.012(3), the information required by these
    Regulations to be shown on the label may be shown in that language
    only and is shown on the label in that language.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the English and French versions of a list of
  cautionary statements appear on the label, they must be displayed on a
  continuous surface of the label's available display surface, but need
  not be on the same continuous surface of the label's available display
  surface.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the English and French versions of a list of
  cautionary statements appear on the same continuous surface of the
  label, the version that follows the other version must not begin on
  the same line as that on which the other version ends, unless the
  available display surface is less than 100 cm^2^.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372709){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372709.html"}
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 149](#1497407-1504983){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497407-1504983.html"}
:::

Version](section-B.29.020-20220721.html "Link to previous version of section B.29.020"){.PITLink}

#### [Supplemented Food Caution Identifier]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1372710 .Subheading}

##### [Presentation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372711 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.021]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.021
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The principal display panel of a
  supplemented food must carry the supplemented food caution identifier
  that is set out in Schedule K.2 if a list of cautionary statements is
  shown on the label of the supplemented food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The supplemented food caution identifier must be
  displayed in black and white and must be in accordance with the
  identifier set out in Schedule K.2.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), the supplemented food
  caution identifier must be presented in one of the following formats:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the unilingual standard format, where two separate
    versions of the identifier are shown, one in English (ES) and one in
    French (FS); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the bilingual standard format (BS), where the
    identifier is shown in both official languages.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the principal display surface is less than or
  equal to 450 cm^2^ and the width of each of the versions of the
  supplemented food caution identifier in the unilingual standard format
  or the width of the identifier in the bilingual standard format
  exceeds the width of the principal display panel, the identifier must
  be presented in the bilingual compact format (BC) in which the
  identifier is shown in both official languages.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The supplemented food caution identifier must be
  displayed in accordance with the applicable specifications set out in
  the Directory of Supplemented Food Caution Identifier Specifications.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (5), the supplemented food caution
  identifier may be displayed with larger dimensions than those set out
  in column 3 of the applicable table in the Directory of Supplemented
  Food Caution Identifier Specifications if the identifier is enlarged
  in a proportional manner vertically and horizontally.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} If, in accordance with subsection B.01.012(3), the
  information required by these Regulations may be shown on the label of
  a supplemented food in English only or in French only and is shown in
  that language, the supplemented food caution identifier may be
  displayed on the principal display panel of the supplemented food in
  that language only on a continuous surface of the available display
  surface.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} If the supplemented food caution identifier is
  presented in a bilingual format, the order in which the languages
  appear may be reversed from the order shown in the applicable
  identifier set out in Schedule K.2.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} The characters and other elements of the supplemented
  food caution identifier must not touch each other.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372725){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372725.html"}
:::

##### [Placement]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372726 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.022]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.022
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The supplemented food caution
  identifier must be displayed

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a supplemented food with a principal
    display panel whose height is less than its width, on the right half
    of the principal display panel; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any other supplemented food, on the
    upper half of the principal display panel.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The supplemented food caution identifier must be
  surrounded by a buffer that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has a width that is equal to or greater than that
    set out in column 4 of the applicable table in the Directory of
    Supplemented Food Caution Identifier Specifications, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} does not contain any text or other graphic
    material.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a supplemented food is cylindrical in shape, the
  outer edge of the buffer must be a minimum distance of 10% of the
  width of the principal display surface from the edge of the left or
  right side of that surface.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If it is impossible to comply with both paragraph
  (1)(a) and subsection (3), the supplemented food caution identifier
  may be displayed partially in the left half of the principal display
  panel but only to the extent necessary to comply with that subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372737){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372737.html"}
:::

##### [Orientation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372738 .Subheading}

**[[B.29.023]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.023 .sectionLabel}** The
supplemented food caution identifier must be oriented in the same manner
as most of the other information that appears on the principal display
panel unless the panel is displayed in the vertical plane and most of
the other information is not displayed parallel with the base of the
package, in which case the identifier must be oriented in such a manner
that the words appearing in it are parallel with the base.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372741){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372741.html"}
:::

##### [Prohibitions]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1372742 .Subheading}

**[[B.29.024]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.024 .sectionLabel}** It is
prohibited to label a prepackaged product with a supplemented food
caution identifier or sell a product that is so labelled, unless a list
of cautionary statements is shown on the label.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372745){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372745.html"}
:::

- **[[B.29.025]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.025
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited to label a
  prepackaged product with any representation, including a word, phrase,
  illustration, sign, mark, symbol or design, that is likely to be
  mistaken for a supplemented food caution identifier, or sell a
  prepackaged product that is so labelled.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), a representation
  does not include a nutrition symbol.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372750){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372750.html"}
:::

#### [Representations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1372751 .Subheading}

- **[[B.29.026]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.026
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything in these
  Regulations, it is prohibited, on the label of or in any advertisement
  for a supplemented food, to make a statement or claim to the effect
  that a supplemental ingredient that is a nutrient contained in the
  supplemented food is generally recognized as an aid in maintaining the
  functions of the body necessary to the maintenance of good health, if
  the supplemental ingredient is one for which a cautionary statement
  set out in the list of cautionary statements is applicable.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, the label of or advertisement for a
  supplemented food may carry such a statement or claim if it is
  accompanied by a statement or claim about the specific action or
  effect of the supplemental ingredient in maintaining the functions of
  the body necessary to the maintenance of good health.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the label of or any advertisement for the
  supplemented food carries a statement or claim referred to in
  subsection (1), that statement or claim and the statement or claim
  referred to in subsection (2) must,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if made on the label of or in an advertisement,
    other than a radio or television advertisement, for the supplemented
    food,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} be adjacent to one another without any
      intervening printed, written or graphic material, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} be shown in letters of the same size and
      prominence;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if made in a radio advertisement or in the audio
    portion of a television advertisement for the supplemented food,
    immediately follow one another; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if made in the visual portion of a television
    advertisement for the supplemented food,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} appear concurrently and for the same amount of
      time,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} be adjacent to one another without any
      intervening printed, written or graphic material, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} be shown in letters of the same size and
      prominence.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372765){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372765.html"}
:::

**[[B.29.027]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.027 .sectionLabel}** Despite
anything in these Regulations, if a supplemented food is required to
show a cautionary statement that is set out in the list of cautionary
statements and recommends against consumption by any individual less
than 18 years of age that is part of a group identified in the
cautionary statement, it is prohibited, on the label of or in any
advertisement for the supplemented food, to make a statement or claim to
the effect that a nutrient contained in the supplemented food is
generally recognized as an aid in maintaining the functions of the body
necessary to normal growth and development.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372768){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372768.html"}
:::

- **[[B.29.028]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.028
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything in these
  Regulations, if the label of a supplemented food is required to carry
  the statement "high caffeine content" in accordance with column 5 of
  the List of Permitted Supplemental Ingredients, it is prohibited to
  make a representation, express or implied, on the label of or in any
  advertisement for the supplemented food with respect to any vitamin or
  mineral nutrient contained in the supplemented food.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a
  declaration of a vitamin in a list of ingredients or supplemented food
  facts table, or in respect of a declaration of a mineral nutrient in a
  list of ingredients, nutrition symbol or supplemented food facts
  table.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372773){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372773.html"}
:::

- **[[B.29.029]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.029
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a list of cautionary statements
  is shown on the label of a supplemented food, the representations set
  out in subsection (2) must meet the following requirements:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the representation is displayed on the principal
    display panel,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the height of the upper case letters in the
      representation must not exceed two times the height of the upper
      case letters, excluding any accents, in the supplemented food
      caution identifier, other than in the words "Health Canada" and
      "Santé Canada", and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the height of the tallest ascender of the lower
      case letters in the representation must not exceed two times the
      height of the tallest ascender of the lower case letters in the
      supplemented food caution identifier, other than in the words
      "Health Canada" and "Santé Canada"; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the representation is displayed on any
    continuous surface, other than on the principal display panel,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the height of the upper case letters in the
      representation must not exceed two times the height of the upper
      case letters, excluding any accents, in the cautionary statements,
      and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the height of the tallest ascender of the lower
      case letters in the representation must not exceed two times the
      height of the tallest ascender of the lower case letters in the
      cautionary statements.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the
  representations are the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a declaration referred to in subsection B.01.301(1)
    or (2);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any representation that expressly or implicitly
    indicates that the supplemented food or any substance it contains
    has particular nutritional or health-related properties, including
    any statement or claim set out in column 4 of the Table of Permitted
    Nutrient Content Statements and Claims or column 1 of the table
    following section B.01.603 or referred to in section B.01.311,
    D.01.006 or D.02.004; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any health-related statement, logo, symbol, seal of
    approval or mark.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} This section does not apply to the brand name or
  product name of a supplemented food.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372788){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372788.html"}
:::

#### [Adulteration and Exemptions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1372789 .Subheading}

**[[B.29.030]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.030 .sectionLabel}** A prepackaged
product, other than a supplemented food, is adulterated if it contains a
supplemented food as an ingredient.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372792){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372792.html"}
:::

**[[B.29.031]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.031 .sectionLabel}** A prepackaged
product, other than a supplemented food, is adulterated if a substance
listed in column 1 of the List of Permitted Supplemental Ingredients has
been added to it other than in accordance with these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372795){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372795.html"}
:::

**[[B.29.032]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.29.032 .sectionLabel}** A
supplemented food does not have a poisonous or harmful substance in or
on it for the purposes of paragraph 4(1)(a) of the Act --- or is not
adulterated for the purposes of paragraph 4(1)(d) of the Act --- by
reason only that a supplemental ingredient has been added to it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2022-169, s. 21](#1371055-1372798){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1371055-1372798.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 30]{.HLabel2}[Microbiological Criteria]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1504984 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1504985 .Subheading}

**[[B.30.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.30.001 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[equivalent method]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[equivalent method]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a method of analysis
    that is equivalent to a microbiological reference method as
    determined in accordance with the document entitled Canadian
    Requirements for Determining the Equivalence of Food Microbiological
    Methods of Analysis, published by the Government of Canada on its
    website, as amended from time to time. ([méthode
    équivalente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[microbiological reference method]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[microbiological reference method]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    method of analysis set out in column 2 of the document entitled
    Table of Microbiological Reference Methods for Food, published by
    the Government of Canada on its website, as amended from time to
    time, in respect of a corresponding microorganism set out in column
    1. ([méthode de référence microbiologique]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[Table of Microbiological Criteria]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Table of Microbiological Criteria]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
    document entitled Table of Microbiological Criteria for Food,
    published by the Government of Canada on its website, as amended
    from time to time. ([Tableau des critères
    microbiologiques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 150](#1497409-1504997){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497409-1504997.html"}
:::

#### [Adulteration]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1504998 .Subheading}

**[[B.30.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.30.002 .sectionLabel}** A food set
out in column 1 of the Table of Microbiological Criteria is adulterated
if a corresponding microorganism set out in column 2 is present in or on
the food and at least one of the following conditions is met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the number of sample units of the food with a level
  of the microorganism greater than that set out in column 5 is greater
  than the number set out in column 4; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the level of the microorganism in any of the sample
  units of the food is greater than the level, if any, set out in column
  6.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 150](#1497409-1505003){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497409-1505003.html"}
:::

#### [Exemption]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1505004 .Subheading}

**[[B.30.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.30.003 .sectionLabel}** A food set
out in column 1 of the Table of Microbiological Criteria is, in respect
of the presence of a corresponding microorganism set out in column 2,
exempt from the application of paragraph 4(1)(a) of the Act, if neither
condition described in paragraphs B.30.002(a) or (b) is met in relation
to the microorganism.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 150](#1497409-1505007){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497409-1505007.html"}
:::

#### [Assessment]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1505008 .Subheading}

**[[B.30.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-B.30.004 .sectionLabel}** For the
purpose of sections B.30.002 and B.30.003,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the number of sample units taken for a food set out
  in column 1 of the Table of Microbiological Criteria for the purpose
  of determining the level of a microorganism set out in column 2 must
  be the number of sample units set out in column 3 in relation to that
  microorganism; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the level of a microorganism present in or on a food
  is to be determined in accordance with an applicable microbiological
  reference method or an equivalent method.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-244, s. 150](#1497409-1505013){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1497409-1505013.html"}
:::

## [PART C]{.HLabel1}[Drugs]{.HTitleText1} {#h-574668 .Part}

### [DIVISION 1]{.HLabel2} {#h-574669 .Subheading}

#### [General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-574670 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Part

  [[acetaminophen product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[acetaminophen product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as in Division 9; ([produit d'acétaminophène]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[adult standard dosage unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[adult standard dosage unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has, with
      reference to a drug, the same meaning as in Division 9; ([dose
      normale pour adultes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a noxious and
      unintended response to a drug, which occurs at doses normally used
      or tested for the diagnosis, treatment or prevention of a disease
      or the modification of an organic function; ([réaction indésirable
      à une drogue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[antibiotic]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[antibiotic]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any drug or combination
      of drugs such as those named in C.01.410 to C.01.592 which is
      prepared from certain micro-organisms, or which formerly was
      prepared from micro-organisms but is now made synthetically and
      which possesses inhibitory action on the growth of other
      micro-organisms; ([antibiotique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[authorization holder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[authorization holder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2017-259, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[brand name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[brand name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with reference to a
      drug, the name, whether or not including the name of any
      manufacturer, corporation, partnership or individual, in English
      or French,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is assigned to the drug by its
        manufacturer,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under which the drug is sold or advertised, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that is used to distinguish the drug; ([marque
        nominative]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[case report]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[case report]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a detailed record of all
      relevant data associated with the use of a drug in a
      subject; ([fiche d'observation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[children's standard dosage unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[children's standard dosage unit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has, with
      reference to a drug, the same meaning as in Division 9; ([dose
      normale pour enfants]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[child resistant package]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[child resistant package]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a package
      that meets the requirements of subsection (2); ([emballage
      protège-enfants]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[common name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[common name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with reference to a
      drug, the name in English or French by which the drug is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} commonly known, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} designated in scientific or technical journals,
        other than the publications referred to in Schedule B to the
        Act; ([nom usuel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[COVID-19]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[COVID-19]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the coronavirus disease
      2019; ([COVID-19]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[COVID-19 drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[COVID-19 drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug, other than a
      veterinary health product, that is manufactured, sold or
      represented for use in relation to COVID-19; ([drogue contre la
      COVID-19]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[discontinue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[discontinue]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of the sale
      of a drug by the manufacturer to whom a document was issued under
      subsection C.01.014.2(1) that sets out the drug identification
      number assigned for the drug, to permanently cease the sale of the
      drug; ([cesser]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[expiration date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[expiration date]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug in dosage form, the
        earlier of the following dates, expressed at minimum as a year
        and month:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the date up to and including which the drug
          maintains its labelled potency, purity and physical
          characteristics, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the date after which the manufacturer
          recommends that the drug not be used; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an active ingredient, whichever
        of the following dates is applicable, expressed at minimum as a
        year and month:

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the retest date, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the date after which the manufacturer
          recommends that the active ingredient not be used; ([date
          limite d'utilisation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[flavour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[flavour]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a non-medicinal ingredient
      or combination of non-medicinal ingredients added to a drug solely
      to produce or mask a particular taste. It does not include an
      ingredient or combination of ingredients that impart only a sweet
      taste to the drug; ([saveur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fragrance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fragrance]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a non-medicinal ingredient
      or combination of non-medicinal ingredients added to a drug to
      produce or mask a particular odour; ([parfum]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[immediate container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[immediate container]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the receptacle
      that is in direct contact with a drug; ([récipient
      immédiat]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[internal use]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[internal use]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means ingestion by mouth or
      application for systemic effect to any part of the body in which
      the drug comes into contact with mucous membrane; ([usage
      interne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ISAD Interim Order]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ISAD Interim Order]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Interim Order
      Respecting the Importation, Sale and Advertising of Drugs for Use
      in Relation to COVID-19 made by the Minister on September 16, 2020
      and published in Part I of the [Canada
      Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/) on October 3, 2020; ([arrêté
      d'urgence IVPD]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[List A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[List A]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document, entitled List
      of Certain Antimicrobial Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, that
      is published by the Government of Canada on its website, as
      amended from time to time; ([Liste A]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[List B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[List B]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document, entitled List
      of Certain Veterinary Drugs Which May Be Imported But Not Sold,
      that is published by the Government of Canada on its website, as
      amended from time to time; ([Liste B]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[List C]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[List C]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document, entitled List
      of Veterinary Health Products, that is published by the Government
      of Canada on its website, as amended from time to time; ([Liste
      C]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[List D]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[List D]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document entitled List of
      Certain Non-prescription Drugs for Distribution as Samples that is
      published by the Government of Canada on its website, as amended
      from time to time; ([Liste D]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[non-medicinal ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-medicinal ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a substance
      --- other than the pharmacologically active drug --- that is added
      during the manufacturing process and that is present in the
      finished drug product; ([ingrédient non
      médicinal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[official drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[official drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any drug

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for which a standard is provided in these
        Regulations, or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for which no standard is provided in these
        Regulations but for which a standard is provided in any of the
        publications mentioned in Schedule B to the Act; ([drogue
        officielle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[parenteral use]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[parenteral use]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means administration of a
      drug by means of a hypodermic syringe, needle or other instrument
      through or into the skin or mucous membrane; ([usage
      parentéral]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[per cent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[per cent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means per cent by weight unless
      otherwise stated; ([pour cent]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pharmaceutical ink]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pharmaceutical ink]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a non-medicinal
      ingredient or combination of non-medicinal ingredients used to
      imprint the drug with marks or symbols; ([encre
      pharmaceutique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pharmacist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pharmacist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is registered or otherwise entitled under the
        laws of a province to practise pharmacy, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is practising pharmacy in that
        province; ([pharmacien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pharmacy technician]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pharmacy technician]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is registered or otherwise entitled under the
        laws of a province to practise as a pharmacy technician; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is practising as a pharmacy technician in that
        province; ([technicien en pharmacie]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[practitioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[practitioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is entitled under the laws of a province to
        treat patients with a prescription drug, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is practising their profession in that
        province; ([praticien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[prescription]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[prescription]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an order given by a
      practitioner directing that a stated amount of any drug or mixture
      of drugs specified therein be dispensed for the person named in
      the order; ([ordonnance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[proper name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[proper name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with reference to a
      drug, the name in English or French

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} assigned to the drug in section C.01.002,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that appears in bold-face type for the drug in
        these Regulations and, where the drug is dispensed in a form
        other than that described in this Part, the name of the
        dispensing form,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} specified in the Canadian licence in the case
        of drugs included in Schedule C or Schedule D to the Act, or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} assigned in any of the publications mentioned
        in Schedule B to the Act in the case of drugs not included in
        paragraph (a), (b) or (c); ([nom propre]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[salicylate product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[salicylate product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
      in Division 9; ([produit de salicylate]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[serious adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[serious adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      noxious and unintended response to a drug that occurs at any dose
      and that requires in-patient hospitalization or prolongation of
      existing hospitalization, causes congenital malformation, results
      in persistent or significant disability or incapacity, is
      life-threatening or results in death; ([réaction indésirable grave
      à une drogue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[serious unexpected adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[serious unexpected adverse drug
      reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a serious adverse drug
      reaction that is not identified in nature, severity or frequency
      in the risk information set out on the label of the
      drug; ([réaction indésirable grave et imprévue à une
      drogue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[teaspoon]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[teaspoon]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, for the purpose of
      calculation of dosage, a volume of 5 cubic
      centimetres; ([cuillerée à thé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[test group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[test group]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a group that meets the
      requirements of subsection (3); ([groupe d'essai]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[veterinary health product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[veterinary health product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of the
      following drugs that is in dosage form and that is not
      manufactured, sold or represented for use in the diagnosis,
      treatment, mitigation or prevention of a disease, disorder or
      abnormal physical state, or its symptoms:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a substance set out in Column I of Part 1 of
        List C that is consistent with the descriptive information set
        out in Columns II to V, or any combination of any substances in
        which all the medicinal ingredients are substances set out in
        Column I of Part 1 of that list if that combination is, in
        respect of each of those substances, consistent with the
        descriptive information set out in Columns II and III and the
        descriptive information set out in Columns IV and V that is,
        within each of those columns, common to those substances;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a homeopathic medicine set out in Column I of
        Part 2 of List C that is consistent with the descriptive
        information set out in Columns II to V, or any combination of
        homeopathic medicines set out in Column I of Part 2 of that list
        if that combination is, in respect of each of those homeopathic
        medicines, consistent with the descriptive information set out
        in Columns II and III and the descriptive information set out in
        Columns IV and V that is, within each of those columns, common
        to those homeopathic medicines; and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a traditional medicine set out in Column I of
        Part 3 of List C that is consistent with the descriptive
        information set out in Columns II to V, or any combination of
        traditional medicines set out in Column I of Part 3 of that list
        if that combination is, in respect of each of those traditional
        medicines, consistent with the descriptive information set out
        in Columns II and III and the descriptive information set out in
        Columns IV and V that is, within each of those columns, common
        to those traditional medicines; ([produit de santé
        animale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[withdrawal period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[withdrawal period]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the length of time
      between the last administration of a drug to an animal and the
      time when tissues or products collected from the treated animal
      for consumption as food contain a level of residue of the drug
      that would not likely cause risk to human health. ([délai
      d'attente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the Act, [[serious adverse drug
  reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} has the same meaning as in subsection
  (1).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A child resistant package is a package that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} when tested in accordance with an acceptable
    method,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a test group comprising children,
      cannot be opened

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} by at least 85 per cent of those children prior
        to a demonstration to them of the proper means of opening the
        package, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} by at least 80 per cent of those children after
        the demonstration, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a test group comprising adults

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} can be opened by at least 90 per cent of those
        adults, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} where the package is designed so that, once
        opened and reclosed, it continues to meet the requirements of
        subparagraph (i), can be so reclosed by at least 90 per cent of
        those adults; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} complies with the requirements of one of the
    following standards, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} Canadian Standards Association Standard
      CAN/CSA-Z76.1-M90, entitled Recloseable Child-Resistant Packages,
      published January 1990, as amended from time to time,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} European Standard EN 28317:1992, entitled
      Child-resistant packaging --- Requirements and testing procedures
      for reclosable packages, as adopted by the European Committee for
      Standardization on October 30, 1992, recognized by the British
      Standards Institution, and effective February 15, 1993 and by the
      Association française de normalisation, and effective December 20,
      1992, and which reiterates fully the international standard ISO
      8317:1989, as amended from time to time, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} Code of Federal Regulations (United States),
      Title 16, Section 1700.15, entitled Poison prevention packaging
      standards, as amended from time to time.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, [[test
  group]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} means

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in relation to children, a group of at least 200
    children who

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} are healthy and have no obvious physical or
      mental disability,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} are between 42 and 51 months of age, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} represent evenly, within plus or minus 10 per
      cent, each monthly age between 42 and 51 months calculated to the
      nearest month; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in relation to adults, a group of at least 100
    adults who

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} are healthy and have no obvious physical or
      mental disability,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} are between 18 and 45 years of age, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} represent evenly, within plus or minus 10 per
      cent, each yearly age between 18 and 45 years calculated to the
      nearest year.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, an amendment from
  time to time to a standard referred to in paragraph (2)(b) becomes
  effective 18 months after the date designated by the competent
  authority as the effective date for the amendment.

**[[C.01.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.003 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a drug that is not labelled as required by these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-544, s. 1
:::

- **[[C.01.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The inner and outer labels of a drug
  shall show

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} on the principal display panel

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the proper name, if any, of the drug which, if
      there is a brand name for the drug, shall immediately precede or
      follow the brand name in type not less than one-half the size of
      that of the brand name,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if there is no proper name, the common name of
      the drug, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-238, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-238, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} in both official languages, the notation
      "sterile" "[stérile]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" if the drug is
      required to be sterile by these Regulations;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on the upper left quarter of the principal display
    panel

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the symbol "Pr" in the case of a prescription
      drug, but the symbol "Pr" shall not appear on the label of any
      other drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the symbol "![Symbol consisting of a diamond
      shape outline in which an uppercase letter C is
      centred.](/images/CRC870img/CRC870_ef004.jpg)" in a clear manner
      and a conspicuous colour and size, in the case of a controlled
      drug, other than a controlled drug contained in an agricultural
      implant and set out in Part III of the schedule to Part G,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the symbol "N" in a colour contrasting with the
      rest of the label or in type not less than half the size of any
      letters used thereon, in the case of a narcotic as defined in the
      Narcotic Control Regulations, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a targeted substance as defined
      in section 1 of the [Benzodiazepines and Other Targeted Substances
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2000-217), the following symbol
      in a colour contrasting with the rest of the label and in type not
      less than half the size of any other letter used on the main
      panel, namely,

      <figure>
      <div class="imageGroupleft">
      <img src="/images/CRC870img/CRC870_ef002.jpg"
      alt="Symbol consisting of a square outline divided in half from top left corner to bottom right corner. The top right half has an uppercase letter C inside and lower left half has an uppercase letter T inside." />
      </div>
      </figure>

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} on any panel

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the manufacturer of the
      drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the lot number of the drug,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} adequate directions for use of the drug, except
      in the case of a drug to which section C.01.004.02 applies,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a quantitative list of the medicinal ingredients
      of the drug by their proper names or, if they have no proper
      names, by their common names, except in the case of a drug to
      which section C.01.004.02 applies,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the drug, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for extraordinary use
      in respect of which a notice of compliance has been issued under
      section C.08.004.01, the following statement, displayed in capital
      letters and in a legible manner:

      "HEALTH CANADA HAS AUTHORIZED THE SALE OF THIS EXTRAORDINARY USE
      NEW DRUG FOR \[naming purpose\] BASED ON LIMITED CLINICAL TESTING
      IN HUMANS.

      [SANTÉ CANADA A AUTORISÉ LA VENTE DE CETTE DROGUE NOUVELLE POUR
      USAGE EXCEPTIONNEL AUX FINS DE \[indication de la fin\] EN SE
      FONDANT SUR DES ESSAIS CLINIQUES RESTREINTS CHEZ L'ÊTRE
      HUMAIN.]{.otherLang lang="fr"}".

- [(1.1) to (1.5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2014-158, s.
  3\]]{.Repealed}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the requirements of subsection (1),
  the outer label of a drug shall display the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the net amount of the drug in the container in
    terms of weight, measure or number;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug intended for parenteral use,
    a quantitative list of any preservatives present therein by their
    proper names or, if they have no proper names, by their common
    names; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug for human use that contains
    mercury or a salt or derivative thereof as a preservative, a
    quantitative list of all mercurial preservatives present therein by
    their proper names or, if they have no proper names, by their common
    names.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the container of a drug is too small to
  accommodate an inner label that conforms to the requirements of these
  Regulations, the inner label requirements of these Regulations do not
  apply to the drug in that container if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} there is an outer label that complies with the
    labelling requirements of these Regulations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the inner label shows

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the proper name of the drug, the common name of
      the drug if there is no proper name or, in the case of a drug with
      more than one medicinal ingredient, the brand name of the drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the potency of the drug except where, in the
      case of a drug with more than one medicinal ingredient, the name
      used pursuant to subparagraph (i) for that drug is unique for a
      particular potency of the drug,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the net contents of the drug if it is not in a
      discrete dosage form,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the route of administration of the drug if other
      than oral,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the lot number of the drug,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the name of the manufacturer of the drug,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the drug, and

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} the identification of special characteristics
      of the dosage form if they are not evident from the name of the
      drug under subparagraphs (i) or (ii).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/92-654, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) to (3) do not apply to a drug that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sold to a drug manufacturer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sold by a pharmacist under a prescription or by a
    practitioner, if its label shows suitable directions for use and
    meets the requirements set out in section C.01.005; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} listed in Schedule D to the Act.

- **[[C.01.004.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.004.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every label of a drug for human use
  in dosage form shall display the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a telephone number, email address, website address,
    postal address or any other information that enables communication
    with a contact person in Canada; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement to the effect that any injury to a
    person's health that is suspected of being associated with the use
    of the drug may be reported to the contact person.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the labels of a drug that is listed in Schedule C
    or D to the Act and that is in dosage form; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the inner and outer labels of a drug to which
    section C.01.004.02 applies.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2014-158, s. 4
:::

- **[[C.01.004.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.004.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the requirements of
  section C.01.004, the outer label of a drug for human use in dosage
  form shall display, either one bilingual table, placed on any panel,
  that contains only the following information in both English and
  French or one table in English and one table in French, each of which
  is placed on any panel, that contains only the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} adequate directions for use of the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a quantitative list of the drug's medicinal
    ingredients by their proper names or, if they have no proper names,
    by their common names;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the drug's non-medicinal ingredients listed in
    alphabetical order or in descending order of predominance by their
    proportion in the drug, preceded by words that clearly distinguish
    them from the medicinal ingredients; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in subsection
    C.01.004.01(1).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a package is too small to accommodate an outer
  label that displays one bilingual table that lists all of the drug's
  non-medicinal ingredients or two unilingual tables, each of which
  lists all of the drug's non-medicinal ingredients, the list of
  non-medicinal ingredients shall be displayed in both English and
  French on a tag, tape or card that is attached to the package.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If pharmaceutical ink, a fragrance or a flavour has
  been added to the drug, the following expressions may be included in
  the list of non-medicinal ingredients to indicate that those
  ingredients have been added to the drug, instead of listing them
  individually:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case where a bilingual table referred to in
    subsection (1) is displayed, the expressions
    "flavour/[saveur]{.otherLang lang="fr"}",
    "fragrance/[parfum]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" and "pharmaceutical
    ink/[encre pharmaceutique]{.otherLang lang="fr"}"; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case where two unilingual tables referred to
    in subsection (1) are displayed, the expressions

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} "[encre pharmaceutique]{.otherLang lang="fr"}",
      "[parfum]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" and "[saveur]{.otherLang
      lang="fr"}" in the table in French, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} "flavour", "fragrance" and "pharmaceutical ink"
      in the table in English.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the composition of the drug varies from one lot to
  another with respect to its non-medicinal ingredients,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case where a bilingual table referred to in
    subsection (1) is displayed, the table shall include a reference to
    all non-medicinal ingredient alternatives that may be present in the
    drug, preceded by the symbol "+/--" or "±" or the expression
    "or/[ou]{.otherLang lang="fr"}" or "may contain/[peut
    contenir]{.otherLang lang="fr"}"; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case where two unilingual tables referred to
    in subsection (1) are displayed,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the table in French shall list all non-medicinal
      ingredient alternatives that may be present in the drug, preceded
      by the symbol "+/--" or "±" or the expression "[ou]{.otherLang
      lang="fr"}" or "[peut contenir]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the table in English shall list all
      non-medicinal ingredient alternatives that may be present in the
      drug, preceded by the symbol "+/--" or "±" or the expression "or"
      or "may contain".

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of paragraphs (3)(a) and (4)(a), the
  French terms in the expressions may appear first.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) to (5) do not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} prescription drugs;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} drugs that are permitted to be sold without a
    prescription but that are to be administered only under the
    supervision of a practitioner; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} drugs that are represented as being solely for use
    as a disinfectant on hard non-porous surfaces.

**[[C.01.004.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.004.03 .sectionLabel}** In
addition to the requirements of section C.01.004, the inner label of a
drug to which section C.01.004.02 applies shall display on any panel

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} adequate directions for use of the drug;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a quantitative list of the drug's medicinal
  ingredients by their proper names or, if they have no proper names, by
  their common names; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in subsection
  C.01.004.01(1).

- **[[C.01.004.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.004.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall import a drug in
  dosage form into Canada for the purpose of sale unless they have in
  Canada a person who is responsible for the sale of the drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person who imports a drug in dosage form into
  Canada shall sell any lot or batch of the drug unless the name of the
  person who imports it, and the address of the principal place of
  business in Canada of the person responsible for its sale, appears on
  the inner and outer labels of the drug.

- **[[C.01.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The principal display panel of both
  the inner label and outer label of a drug in dosage form shall show
  the drug identification number assigned for that drug, preceded by the
  expression "Drug Identification Number" or "[Drogue : identification
  numérique]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", or both, or the abbreviation "DIN".

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a drug in dosage form that is compounded by a
    pharmacist under a prescription or by a practitioner; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a drug in dosage form that is sold under a
    prescription if the following information appears on the drug's
    label:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the drug's proper name, common name or brand
      name,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug's potency, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the name of the drug's manufacturer.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} In this section and in sections C.01.005.1 and
  C.01.014, [[drug in dosage form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug in
  a form in which it is ready for use by the consumer without requiring
  any further manufacturing.

- **[[C.01.005.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.005.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No pharmacist or practitioner shall
  sell a Class A opioid --- including one that is compounded by a
  pharmacist under a prescription or by a practitioner --- unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the drug's package has applied to it a warning
    sticker that meets the specifications set out in the source
    document; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the drug is accompanied by a patient information
    handout that meets the specifications set out in the source
    document.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of the sale
  of a Class A opioid by a pharmacist or practitioner if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the opioid will be, or is, administered under the
    supervision of a practitioner; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the sale is to a pharmacist or practitioner.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in this section.

  [[Class A opioid]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Class A opioid]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug in dosage form
      set out in Part A of the List of Opioids, published by the
      Government of Canada on its website, as amended from time to
      time. ([opioïde de catégorie A]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[source document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[source document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document
      entitled Information for Patients Concerning Opioids, published by
      the Government of Canada on its website, as amended from time to
      time. ([document source]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

**[[C.01.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.006 .sectionLabel}** Where a
package of a drug has only one label, that label shall contain all the
information required by these Regulations to be shown on both the inner
and the outer labels.

**[[C.01.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.007 .sectionLabel}** No reference,
direct or indirect, to the Act or to these Regulations shall be made
upon any label of or in any advertisement for a drug unless such
reference is a specific requirement of the Act or these Regulations.

**[[C.01.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.008 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/80-544, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

**[[C.01.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.009 .sectionLabel}** If any Act of
Parliament or any of its regulations prescribes a standard or grade for
a drug and that standard or grade is given a name or designation in the
Act or regulation, no person shall, on a label of or in any
advertisement for that drug, use that name or designation unless the
drug conforms with the standard or grade.

**[[C.01.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.010 .sectionLabel}** If it is
necessary to provide adequate directions for the safe use of a
parenteral drug or prescription drug that is used in the treatment or
prevention of any disease, disorder or abnormal physical state mentioned
in Schedule A.1 to the Act, the disease, disorder or abnormal physical
state may be mentioned on the drug's labels, including any package
insert and any document that is provided on request and that sets out
supplementary information on the use of the drug, and, in that respect,
the drug is exempt from subsections 3(1) and (2) of the Act.

- **[[C.01.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A drug referred to in subsection
  10(2) of the Act shall be exempt from the standard for any drug
  contained in any publication mentioned in Schedule B to the Act to the
  extent that such drug differs from that standard with respect to
  colour, flavour, shape and size, if such difference does not interfere
  with any method of assay prescribed in any such publication.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/93-243, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a manufacturer's standard is used for a drug,
  the manufacturer shall make available to the Minister, on request,
  details of that standard and of a method of analysis for the drug
  acceptable to the Minister.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No person shall use a manufacturer's standard for a
  drug that provides

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a lesser degree of purity than the highest degree
    of purity, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a greater variation in potency than the least
    variation in potency,

  provided for that drug in any publication mentioned in Schedule B to
  the Act.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (4) does not apply in respect of new
  drugs, other than those listed in Schedule C to the Act.

**[[C.01.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.012 .sectionLabel}** A
manufacturer who makes representations on a label of a drug in oral
dosage form, or in any advertisement, with respect to the site, rate or
extent of release to the body of a medicinal ingredient of the drug, or
the availability to the body of a medicinal ingredient of the drug,
shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} before making the representations, conduct such
  investigations, using an acceptable method, as may be necessary to
  demonstrate that the site, rate or extent of release to the body of
  the medicinal ingredient of the drug and the availability to the body
  of the medicinal ingredient of the drug, correspond to the
  representations; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} on request submit the record of such investigations
  to the Minister.

- **[[C.01.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.013
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the manufacturer of a drug is
  requested in writing by the Minister to submit on or before a
  specified day evidence with respect to a drug, the manufacturer shall
  make no further sales of that drug after that day unless he has
  submitted the evidence requested.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister determines that the evidence
  submitted by a manufacturer under subsection (1) is not sufficient, he
  or she shall so notify the manufacturer in writing.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to subsection (2), a manufacturer is
  notified that the evidence with respect to a drug is not sufficient,
  he shall make no further sales of that drug unless he submits further
  evidence and is notified in writing by the Minister that that further
  evidence is sufficient.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A reference in this section to evidence with respect
  to a drug means evidence to establish the safety of the drug under the
  conditions of use recommended and the effectiveness of the drug for
  the purposes recommended.
