#### [Limits of Variability]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575632 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01.061]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.061
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the net amount of a drug in a
  package is not expressed on the label in terms of number of dosage
  units, any 10 packages of the drug selected as provided by official
  method DO-31, Determination of Net Contents, dated December 7, 1988,
  shall contain an amount of the drug such that, when determined by that
  official method, the average of the net amounts of the drug in the
  10 packages is not less than the net amount of the drug shown on the
  label.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the net amount of a drug in a package is
  expressed on the label in terms of the number of dosage units, any
  10 packages of the drug selected as provided by official method DO-31,
  Determination of Net Contents, dated December 7, 1988, shall contain a
  number of units such that, when determined by that official method,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the average number of dosage units in the
    10 packages is not less than the number of dosage units shown on the
    label;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} no package contains less than the number of dosage
    units shown on the label except as provided in the table; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where the drug is a controlled drug as defined in
    section G.01.001 or a narcotic as defined in the [Narcotic Control
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._1041), no package contains
    more than the number of dosage units shown on the label except as
    provided in the table to this section.

- **[[C.01.062]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.062
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (5),
  no manufacturer shall sell a drug in dosage form where the amount of
  any medicinal ingredient therein, determined using an acceptable
  method, is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} less than 90.0 per cent of the amount of the
    medicinal ingredient shown on the label; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} more than 110.0 per cent of the amount of the
    medicinal ingredient shown on the label.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (5), where a drug in dosage
  form contains a medicinal ingredient that is a volatile substance of
  botanical origin or its synthetic equivalent, the amount of that
  ingredient, determined using an acceptable method, shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} not less than 85.0 per cent of the amount of the
    medicinal ingredient shown on the label; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} not more than 120.0 per cent of the amount of the
    medicinal ingredient shown on the label.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (5), where a drug in capsule
  form contains a medicinal ingredient that is a vitamin in a fish-liver
  oil, no variation from the amount of the medicinal ingredient as shown
  on the label, determined using an acceptable method, is permitted
  other than that which is in accordance with the variation for that
  fish-liver oil as stated in any publication whose name is referred to
  in Schedule B to the Act.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (5), where a drug in dosage
  form contains a medicinal ingredient that is a vitamin, no variation
  from the amount of the medicinal ingredient shown on the label,
  determined using an acceptable method, is permitted other than the
  variation set out in column III or IV of an item of the table to this
  section opposite the vitamin set out in column I of that item for the
  amount of vitamin set out in column II of that item.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) to (4) do not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a drug for which a notice of compliance has been
    issued under section C.08.004 or C.08.004.01;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/98-423, s. 8\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a drug for which a standard is contained in any
    publication whose name is referred to in Schedule B to the Act;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a drug described in Schedule C or D to the Act or
    Division 6 of Part C of these Regulations; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a drug for which a drug identification number has
    been assigned under subsection C.01.014.2(1) and in respect of which

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the conditions of pharmaceutical production and
      quality control are suitable for controlling the identity,
      quality, purity, stability, safety, strength and potency of the
      drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all labels to be used in connection with the
      drug, including any package insert and any document that is
      provided on request and that sets out supplementary information on
      the use of the drug, make proper claims in respect of the drug,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the drug can, without undue foreseeable risk to
      humans, be used for the purposes and under the conditions of use
      recommended by the manufacturer, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the drug is effective for the purposes and under
      the conditions of use recommended by the manufacturer.

**[[C.01.063]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.063 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/96-399, s. 2\]]{.Repealed}

**[[C.01.064]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.064 .sectionLabel}** Where a drug
is prepared for ophthalmic or parenteral use and contains a preservative
ingredient, that ingredient

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} shall be present only in an amount necessary to
  obtain the intended action and that does not pose undue risk to humans
  or animals; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} shall not interfere with the therapeutic properties
  of the drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/90-586, s. 2
:::

**[[C.01.065]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.065 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a drug that is prepared for ophthalmic or parenteral use
unless a representative sample of each lot of the drug in its immediate
container

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is tested by an acceptable method for identity, and
  the drug is found to be true to its proper name, or to its common name
  if there is no proper name;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} is tested by an acceptable method for sterility,
  except

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} for living vaccines, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where the manufacturer has submitted evidence,
    satisfactory to the Minister to prove that processing controls
    ensure the sterility of the drug in its immediate container,

  and the drug is found to be sterile; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} is subjected to such further tests satisfactory to
  the Minister to ensure that the drug is safe to use according to
  directions.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/86-552, s. 1
- SOR/90-586, s. 3
- SOR/93-202, s. 12
- SOR/96-399, s. 3
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01.065-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.01.065"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.01.066]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.066 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a drug in aqueous solution that is prepared for parenteral
use unless it has been prepared with non-pyrogenic water produced by
distillation or reverse osmosis.

- **[[C.01.067]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.067
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall sell a drug that is prepared for parenteral use unless a
  representative sample of each lot of the drug in its immediate
  container

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is tested by an acceptable method for the presence
    of pyrogens; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} when so tested, is found to be non-pyrogenic.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a drug
  that cannot be tested for the presence of pyrogens or that is
  inherently pyrogenic.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-335, s. 1
- SOR/96-399, s. 4
:::

**[[C.01.068]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.068 .sectionLabel}** Detailed
records of the tests required by sections C.01.065 and C.01.067 shall be
retained by the manufacturer for a period of at least one year after the
expiration date on the label of the drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-715, s. 5
- SOR/92-654, s. 3
:::

**[[C.01.069]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.069 .sectionLabel}** The packaging
of a drug that is prepared for parenteral use shall meet the following
requirements:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the immediate container shall be of such material and
  construction that

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} no deleterious substance is yielded to the drug,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} it is non-reactive with the drug,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} visual or electronic inspection of the drug is
    possible,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} protection against environmental factors that
    cause deterioration or contamination of the drug is provided or,
    where that protection cannot be provided by the immediate container,
    it is provided by the secondary packaging, and

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a sufficient quantity of the drug is contained to
    allow withdrawal of the labelled amount of the drug; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the immediate closures and any material coming into
  contact with the drug in its immediate container shall meet the
  requirements of subparagraphs (a)(i) and (ii).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/96-399, s. 5
:::

**[[C.01.070]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.070 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a drug that is a hypodermic tablet that does not completely
dissolve in and form a clear solution with water.

#### [Mercuric Chloride Tablets]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575711 .Subheading}

**[[C.01.071]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.071 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell mercuric chloride tablets for household use that are packaged
in lots of 200 or less, unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} such tablets are

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} of an irregular or angular shape,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} coloured blue, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} packed in an immediate container that is readily
    distinguishable by touch; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the principal display panel of both the inner and the
  outer labels carries in prominent type and in a colour contrasting to
  that of such labels

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the design of a skull and cross-bones, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the word "Poison".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-181, s. 2
:::

#### [Aminopyrine and Dipyrone]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575730 .Subheading}

**[[C.01.131]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.131 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell Aminopyrine or Dipyrone (a derivative of Aminopyrine) for
oral or parenteral use, unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the inner label carries the statement:

  > ::: QuotedText
  > "WARNING: Fatal agranulocytosis may be associated with the use of
  > Aminopyrine and Dipyrone. It is essential that adequate blood
  > studies be made. (See enclosed warnings and precautions)"; and
  > :::

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the outer label or the package insert carries the
  following statements:

  > ::: QuotedText
  > "WARNING: Serious and even fatal agranulocytosis is known to occur
  > after the administration of Aminopyrine or Dipyrone. Fatal
  > agranulocytosis has occurred after short term, intermittent and
  > prolonged therapy with the drugs. Therefore, the use of these drugs
  > should be as brief as possible. Bearing in mind the possibility that
  > such reactions may occur, Aminopyrine or Dipyrone should be used
  > only when other less potentially dangerous agents are ineffective.
  >
  > PRECAUTIONS: It is essential that frequent white blood cell counts
  > and differential counts be made during treatment with these drugs.
  > However, it is emphasized that agranulocytosis may occur suddenly
  > without prior warning. The drug should be discontinued at the first
  > evidence of any alteration of the blood count or sign of
  > agranulocytosis, and the patient should be instructed to discontinue
  > use of the drug at the first indication of sore throat or sign of
  > other infection in the mouth or throat (pain, swelling, tenderness,
  > ulceration)."
  > :::

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-69, s. 34(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01.131-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.01.131"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.01.132]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.132 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall disseminate to a practitioner promotional literature about
Aminopyrine or Dipyrone unless the statements set out in section
C.01.131 are included in such literature.

**[[C.01.133]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.133 .sectionLabel}** The
provisions of sections C.01.131 and C.01.132 do not apply to
preparations containing Aminopyrine or Dipyrone that are

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} dispensed by a pharmacist pursuant to a prescription;
  or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} sold for veterinary use only.

#### [Coated Potassium Salts]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575740 .Subheading}

**[[C.01.134]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.134 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell coated tablets containing potassium salts, with or without
thiazide diuretics, unless the inner label thereof or the package insert
carries the following statement:

> ::: QuotedText
> "WARNING: A probable association exists between the use of coated
> tablets containing potassium salts, with or without thiazide
> diuretics, and the incidence of serious small bowel ulceration. Such
> preparations should be used only when adequate dietary supplementation
> is not practical, and should be discontinued if abdominal pain,
> distension, nausea, vomiting or gastro-intestinal bleeding occur."
> :::

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-69, s. 34(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01.134-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.01.134"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.01.135]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.135 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall disseminate to a practitioner promotional literature about coated
tablets containing potassium salts, with or without thiazide diuretics,
unless the statement set out in section C.01.134 is included in such
literature.

**[[C.01.136]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.136 .sectionLabel}** The
provisions of sections C.01.134 and C.01.135 do not apply to coated
tablets containing potassium salts with or without thiazide diuretics
that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} are sold for veterinary use only;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} are dispensed by a pharmacist pursuant to a
  prescription; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} contain 100 milligrams or less of elemental potassium
  per tablet.

#### [Antibiotics]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575749 .Subheading}

**[[C.01.401]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.401 .sectionLabel}** Except as
provided in these Regulations, an antibiotic for other than parenteral
use shall, in addition to meeting the requirements of section C.01.004,
carry on both the inner label and outer label the potency of the drug,
expressed in terms of International Units where established or, if no
International Unit has been established, in terms of units, milligrams,
micrograms or fractions of a gram,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} per gram in the case of solids or viscous liquids;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} per millilitre in the case of other liquids; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} per individual dosage or dispensing form in the case
  of antibiotic preparations put up in individual dosage or dispensing
  form.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-544, s. 7
- SOR/92-654, s. 4
:::

#### [Chloramphenicol]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575759 .Subheading}

**[[C.01.430 to C.01.432]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.430_to_C.01.432
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/80-544, s. 8\]]{.Repealed}

**[[C.01.433]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.433 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell chloramphenicol and its salts and derivatives, for oral or
parenteral use, unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the inner label carries a warning statement to the
  effect that

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} bone marrow depression has been associated with the
    use of chloramphenicol, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the enclosed warnings and precautions should be
    read carefully; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the outer label or the package insert carries the
  following:

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a warning statement to the effect that
    chloramphenicol should not be used in the treatment or prophylaxis
    of minor infections or where it is not indicated, as in cold,
    influenza, or infections of the upper respiratory tract; that there
    are two types of bone marrow depression associated with the use of
    chloramphenicol; that some degree of depression of the bone marrow
    is commonly seen during therapy, is dose-related and is potentially
    reversible; that blood studies may detect early changes and; that
    the other type of bone marrow depression, a sudden, delayed and
    usually fatal bone marrow hypoplasia that may occur without warning,
    is very rare, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a statement of precautions to be taken to the
    effect that it is essential that appropriate blood studies be made
    during treatment with chloramphenicol and that while blood studies
    may detect early peripheral blood changes, such studies cannot be
    relied on to detect the rare and generally irreversible bone marrow
    depression prior to development of aplastic anemia.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-69, s. 35(F)
:::

::: PITLink

Version](section-C.01.433-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.01.433"){.PITLink}

that are sold by a pharmacist under a prescription.

#### [Veterinary Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575790 .Subheading}

**[[C.01.600]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.600 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell for veterinary use a drug listed in the Table of Limits of
Drug Dosage for Adults, other than a drug in a form not suitable for
human use, unless both the inner and outer labels carry the statement
"For Veterinary Use Only" or "Veterinary Use Only".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-543, s. 5
:::

**[[C.01.601]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.601 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/93-407, s. 6\]]{.Repealed}

**[[C.01.602]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.602 .sectionLabel}** The
provisions of sections C.01.401 and C.01.402 do not apply to an
antibiotic in amounts less than 50 parts per million contained in an
animal food.

**[[C.01.603]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.603 .sectionLabel}** The
provisions of paragraphs C.01.401 (b) and (c) and section C.01.402 do
not apply to an antibiotic in amounts greater than 50 parts per million
contained in an animal food.

**[[C.01.604]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.604 .sectionLabel}** Both the
inner and outer labels of a veterinary drug represented as containing a
vitamin shall carry

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the amount of each vitamin present in
  the drug, expressed in terms of the proper name only of the vitamin in

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} International Units per gram or per millilitre for
    vitamin A, provitamin A, vitamin D, and vitamin E,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} milligrams per gram in the case of solids or
    viscous liquids, or per millilitre in the case of other liquids, for
    thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, niacinamide, pyridoxine, d-pantothenic
    acid, d-panthenol, folic acid, ascorbic acid, and vitamin K,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} micrograms per gram in the case of solids or
    viscous liquids, or per millilitre in the case of other liquids, for
    biotin, and vitamin B~12~,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} Oral Units for vitamin B~12~ with intrinsic factor
    concentrate, or

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} for vitamin products put up in individual dosage or
    dispensing form, the specified units per individual dosage or
    dispensing form;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} except for drugs in a form not suitable for human
  use, the statement "For Veterinary Use Only" or "Veterinary Use Only".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-543, s. 6
:::

**[[C.01.605]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.605 .sectionLabel}** An antibiotic
for parenteral use that is recommended for veterinary use only shall
carry on both the inner and outer labels

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the potency of the drug expressed in terms of
  International Units where established, or, if no International Unit
  has been established, in terms of units, milligrams or fractions of a
  gram, per gram in the case of solids or viscous liquids, per
  millilitre in the case of other liquids, or per individual dosage or
  dispensing form for antibiotic preparations put up in individual
  dosage or dispensing form; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/92-654, s. 5\]]{.Repealed}

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the statement "For Veterinary Use Only" or
  "Veterinary Use Only".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-543, s. 7
- SOR/92-654, s. 5
:::

**[[C.01.606]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.606 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell an antibiotic preparation for the treatment of animals, other
than an antibiotic preparation that is a new drug sold pursuant to
section C.08.013, unless,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the preparation is not to be used for lactating
  animals providing milk to be consumed as food, the inner and outer
  labels of the preparation carry a statement to that effect; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the preparation may be used for lactating
  animals providing milk to be consumed as food,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} there has been submitted, on request, to the
    Minister, acceptable evidence to show the period of time, not
    exceeding 96 hours, that must elapse after the last treatment with
    the preparation in order that the milk from treated lactating
    animals will contain no residue of antibiotics that would cause
    injury to human health, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the principal display panel of the outer label of
    the preparation, the inner label and the packaging insert, if any,
    describing the antibiotic preparation carry the warning **"WARNING:
    MILK TAKEN FROM TREATED ANIMALS DURING TREATMENT AND WITHIN \...
    HOURS AFTER THE LATEST TREATMENT MUST NOT BE USED AS FOOD"**, where
    the number of hours to be inserted is determined according to
    evidence submitted pursuant to subparagraph (i).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/88-378, s. 1
- SOR/92-664, s. 2
- SOR/93-467, s. 1
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01.606-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.01.606"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.01.606.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.606.1 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a product intended for the prevention or treatment of foot
rot of cattle if that product contains Ethylenediamine Dihydroiodide
(EDDI).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/90-327, s. 1
:::

**[[C.01.607]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.607
.sectionLabel}** Notwithstanding subparagraph C.01.004(1)(c)(ii), the
declaration of a lot number is not required on the label of an animal
feeding-stuff containing a drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/80-543, s. 8
:::

**[[C.01.608]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.608 .sectionLabel}** The
provisions of section C.01.604 do not apply to medicated feeds
registered under the [Feeds Act](/eng/acts/F-9).

**[[C.01.609]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.609 .sectionLabel}** Despite
paragraph C.01.401(a), the potency of an antibiotic in amounts greater
than 50 parts per million contained in a medicated feed registered under
the [Feeds Act](/eng/acts/F-9) may be declared in grams per tonne.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-69, s. 20
- [SOR/2021-46, s. 6(F)](#1288905-1290077){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1288905-1290077.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01.609-20180404.html "Link to previous version of section C.01.609"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.01.610]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.610 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell any substance having oestrogenic activity for administration
to poultry that may be consumed as food.

**[[C.01.610.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.610.1 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a drug for administration to animals that produce food or
that are intended for consumption as food if that drug contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} chloramphenicol or its salts or derivatives;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a 5-nitrofuran compound;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} clenbuterol or its salts or derivatives;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a 5-nitroimidazole compound; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} diethylstilbestrol or other stilbene compounds.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-539, s. 1
- SOR/85-685, s. 2
- SOR/91-546, s. 1
- SOR/94-568, s. 2
- SOR/97-510, s. 2
- SOR/2003-292, s. 3
:::

**[[C.01.610.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.610.2 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell an antibiotic preparation containing chloramphenicol, its
salts or derivatives, for administration to animals that do not produce
food and that are not intended for consumption as food unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} both the inner label and outer label of the
  preparation carry the words "WARNING: FEDERAL LAW PROHIBITS THE
  ADMINISTRATION OF THIS PREPARATION TO ANIMALS THAT PRODUCE FOOD OR
  ANIMALS THAT ARE INTENDED FOR CONSUMPTION AS FOOD / [MISE EN GARDE :
  EN VERTU DES LOIS FÉDÉRALES, IL EST INTERDIT D'ADMINISTRER CETTE
  PRÉPARATION AUX ANIMAUX QUI PRODUISENT DES ALIMENTS OU AUX ANIMAUX
  DESTINÉS À ÊTRE CONSOMMÉS COMME ALIMENTS]{.otherLang lang="fr"}";

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the preparation is for parenteral use, the
  preparation contains, in the form of chloramphenicol sodium succinate,
  not more than one gram of chloramphenicol per vial;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} where the preparation is for ophthalmic use, the
  preparation contains not more than one per cent chloramphenicol; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} where the preparation is for oral use, the
  preparation

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is in tablet or capsule form and contains not more
    than one gram of chloramphenicol per tablet or capsule, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is in the form of a chloramphenicol palmitate
    suspension and contains not more than three grams of chloramphenicol
    per container.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/91-546, s. 1
:::

- **[[C.01.611]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.611
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, in writing, from
  time to time require the manufacturer of a drug recommended for
  administration to animals that may be consumed as food

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to file with the Minister in respect of that drug a
    submission describing in detail tests carried out to verify that the
    administration of the drug to an animal does not result in a
    substance named in column II of the List referred to in the
    [Marketing Authorization for Maximum Residue Limits for Veterinary
    Drugs in Foods](/eng/regulations/SOR-2013-87) being present in a
    food set out in column III of the List, except in an amount within
    the maximum residue limit set out in column IV of the List in
    respect of the food and the substance; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to print on the principal display panel of the
    outer label, the inner label and the packaging insert, if any, that
    describes the drug, a warning that food derived from animals to
    which the drug has been administered must not be sold for human
    consumption unless there has elapsed since the administration of the
    drug a period of time specified by the Minister, based on a review
    of the available data with respect to drug residues.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No manufacturer shall sell a drug in respect of which
  the Minister has required a warning to be printed pursuant to
  paragraph (1)(b) unless the manufacturer has complied with that
  request.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/93-467, s. 2
- SOR/2016-74, s. 10
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01.611-20160504.html "Link to previous version of section C.01.611"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.01.612]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.612
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every manufacturer or importer who
  sells a veterinary drug in dosage form that contains an active
  pharmaceutical ingredient that is set out in List A, or every person
  who compounds such a drug, shall, in a form established by the
  Minister, submit to the Minister an annual report identifying for each
  drug, the total quantity sold or compounded and an estimate of the
  quantity sold or compounded for each intended animal species.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The annual report described in subsection (1) is for
  a period of one calendar year and shall be submitted on or before
  March 31 of the year following the calendar year covered by the
  report, beginning with the first full calendar year after the day on
  which this section comes into force.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-76, s. 6
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01.612-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.01.612"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.01.613]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.613
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall import a drug into
  Canada for the purpose of administering it to an animal that produces
  food or an animal that is intended for consumption as food if the sale
  of the drug in Canada would constitute a violation of the Act or these
  Regulations.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a drug that is
  described in List B.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-76, s. 6
:::

- **[[C.01.614]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.614
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Sections 43 to 58 of the [Natural
  Health Products Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2003-196) apply in
  relation to a veterinary health product, as if that product were a
  [[natural health product]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in
  subsection 1(1) of those Regulations.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A veterinary health product shall display, on the
  principal display panel of the inner and outer label, the statement:
  "Veterinary Health Product / [Produit de santé animale]{.otherLang
  lang="fr"}" or "[Produit de santé animale]{.otherLang lang="fr"} /
  Veterinary Health Product".

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Section C.01.600 and paragraph C.01.604(b) do not
  apply in respect of a veterinary health product.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-76, s. 6
:::

- **[[C.01.615]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.615
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every manufacturer or importer of a
  veterinary health product shall notify the Minister of the sale of
  that product in Canada at least 30 days before the day on which that
  sale is commenced.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notification shall be in a form established by
  the Minister and contain the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name, mailing address, telephone number and
    email address of the manufacturer or importer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the brand name under which the veterinary health
    product is sold;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the pharmaceutical form in which the veterinary
    health product is sold;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the strength per dosage unit;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the route of administration;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a quantitative list of the medicinal ingredients
    and a qualitative list of the non-medicinal ingredients;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the species of animal for which the veterinary
    health product is recommended; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the use or purpose for which the veterinary health
    product is recommended.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A manufacturer or importer who has provided the
  Minister with a notification under subsection (1) shall provide the
  Minister with any changes to the information required under subsection
  (2), in a form established by the Minister, at least 30 days before
  the day on which the veterinary health product to which the changes
  relate is sold.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-76, s. 6
:::

**[[C.01.616]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.616 .sectionLabel}** If the
Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that a veterinary health
product may no longer be safe, the Minister may request that the
manufacturer or importer of the veterinary health product provide the
Minister, within 15 days after the day on which the request is received,
with information and documents demonstrating that the veterinary health
product is safe.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-76, s. 6
:::

- **[[C.01.617]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.617
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may direct the
  manufacturer or importer to stop the sale of a veterinary health
  product if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer or importer does not, within the
    required period, provide the Minister with the information and
    documents requested under section C.01.616;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information and documents provided by the
    manufacturer or importer in accordance with section C.01.616 do not
    demonstrate that the veterinary health product is safe; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the sale of the veterinary health product would be a violation of
    the Act or these Regulations.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall lift a direction to stop the sale
  of a veterinary health product if the manufacturer or importer
  provides the Minister with information and documents demonstrating
  that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a direction to stop a sale under
    either paragraph (1)(a) or (b), the veterinary health product is
    safe;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a direction to stop a sale under
    paragraph 1(c), the sale of the veterinary health product would no
    longer be a violation of the Act or these Regulations; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the situation giving rise to the direction to stop
    the sale of the veterinary health product did not exist.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2017-76, s. 6
:::

**[[C.01.625]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01.625 .sectionLabel}** Contraceptive
drugs that are manufactured, sold or represented for use in the
prevention of conception and that are not prescription drugs may be
advertised to the general public.

- SOR/2013-122, s. 13
:::

### [DIVISION 1A]{.HLabel2}[Establishment Licences]{.HTitleText2} {#h-575903 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575904 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The definitions in this subsection
  apply in this Division and in Divisions 2 to 4.

  [[active ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[active ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that, when
      used as a raw material in the fabrication of a drug in dosage
      form, provides its intended effect. ([ingrédient
      actif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[active pharmaceutical ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[active pharmaceutical ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      active ingredient that is used in the fabrication of a
      pharmaceutical. ([ingrédient actif
      pharmaceutique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[antimicrobial agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[antimicrobial agent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that is
      capable of destroying pathogenic micro-organisms and that is
      labelled as being for use in the disinfection of environmental
      surfaces or medical devices, as defined in the [Medical Devices
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-98-282), that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} are not invasive devices as defined in those
        Regulations; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} are intended to come into contact with intact
        skin only. ([agent antimicrobien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[batch certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[batch certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a certificate
      issued by the fabricator of a lot or batch of a drug that is
      either imported within the framework of a mutual recognition
      agreement or referred to on the List of Non-prescription Drugs Not
      Subject to Certain Testing Requirements, and in which the
      fabricator

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} identifies the master production document for
        the drug and certifies that the lot or batch has been
        fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested in accordance with the
        procedures described in that document;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provides a detailed description of the drug,
        including

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement of all properties and qualities
          of the drug, including the identity, potency and purity of the
          drug, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a statement of tolerances for the properties
          and qualities of the drug;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} identifies the analytical methods used in
        testing the lot or batch and provides details of the analytical
        results obtained;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} sets out the addresses of the buildings at
        which the lot or batch was fabricated, packaged/labelled and
        tested; and

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} certifies that the lot or batch was fabricated,
        packaged/labelled and tested

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug that is imported within
          the framework of a mutual recognition agreement, in accordance
          with the good manufacturing practices of the regulatory
          authority that has recognized those buildings as meeting its
          good manufacturing practices standards, or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug that is not imported
          within the framework of a mutual recognition agreement and
          that is referred to on the List of Non-prescription Drugs Not
          Subject to Certain Testing Requirements, in accordance with
          the requirements of Division 2. ([certificat de
          lot]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[bulk process intermediate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[bulk process intermediate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an active
      ingredient that is used in the fabrication of either a drug of
      biological origin that is listed in Schedule C to the Act or a
      drug that is listed in Schedule D to the Act. ([produit
      intermédiaire en vrac]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[class monograph]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[class monograph]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document prepared
      by the Department of Health that

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} lists the types and strengths of medicinal
        ingredients that may be contained in drugs of a specified class;
        and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sets out labelling and other requirements that
        apply to those drugs. ([monographie de classe]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[dilute drug premix]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[dilute drug premix]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug for
      veterinary use that results from mixing a drug premix with a
      [[feed]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section 2 of the
      [Feeds Act](/eng/acts/F-9), to such a level that at least 10 kg of
      the resulting mixture is required to medicate one tonne of
      [[complete feed]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in subsection
      1(1) of the [Feeds Regulations,
      2024](/eng/regulations/SOR-2024-132), with the lowest approved
      dosage level of the drug. ([prémélange médicamenteux
      dilué]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[dosage form class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[dosage form class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a parenteral,
      tablet, capsule, solution, suspension, aerosol, powder,
      suppository, medical gas or drug premix, or any other dosage form
      class designated by the Minister. ([classe de forme
      posologique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[drug premix]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[drug premix]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug for veterinary
      use to which a drug identification number has been assigned, where
      the directions on its label specify that it is to be mixed with
      feed as defined in section 2 of the [Feeds
      Act](/eng/acts/F-9). ([prémélange médicamenteux]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[fabricate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fabricate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means to prepare and preserve a
      drug for the purposes of sale. ([manufacturer]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means to import into Canada a drug
      for the purpose of sale. ([importer]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[List of Non-prescription Drugs Not Subject to Certain Testing Requirements]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[List of Non-prescription Drugs Not Subject to Certain Testing
      Requirements]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the document entitled
      List of Non-prescription Drugs for Which the Testing Requirements
      Set Out in Subsections C.02.019(1) and (2) of the Food and Drug
      Regulations Do Not Apply that is published by the Government of
      Canada on its website, as amended from time to time. ([Liste de
      drogues vendues sans ordonnance et non soumises à certaines
      analyses]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[MRA country]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[MRA country]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a country that is a
      participant in a mutual recognition agreement with Canada. ([pays
      participant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mutual recognition agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mutual recognition agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      international agreement that provides for the mutual recognition
      of compliance certification for good manufacturing practices for
      drugs. ([accord de reconnaisance mutuelle]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[package/label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[package/label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means to put a drug in its
      immediate container or to affix the inner or outer label to the
      drug. ([emballer-étiqueter]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pharmaceutical]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pharmaceutical]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug other than a
      drug listed in Schedule C or D to the Act. ([produit
      pharmaceutique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[recognized building]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[recognized building]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of
      the fabrication, packaging/labelling or testing of a drug, a
      building that a regulatory authority that is designated under
      subsection C.01A.019(1) in respect of that activity for that drug
      has recognized as meeting its good manufacturing practices
      standards in respect of that activity for that drug. ([bâtiment
      reconnu]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[recognized country or region]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[recognized country or region]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      country or region that is set out in the document entitled List of
      Foreign Countries or Regions and Their Regulatory Authorities for
      the Application of Subsection C.02.019(5) of the Food and Drug
      Regulations, published by the Government of Canada on its website,
      as amended from time to time. ([pays ou régions
      reconnus]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a government
      agency or other entity in an MRA country that has a legal right to
      control the use or sale of drugs within that country and that may
      take enforcement action to ensure that drugs marketed within its
      jurisdiction comply with legal requirements. ([autorité
      réglementaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[site]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[site]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2002-368, s.
      1\]]{.Repealed}

  [[wholesale]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[wholesale]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/2013-74, s.
      2\]]{.Repealed}

  [[wholesaler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[wholesaler]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is not a
      distributor described in section C.01A.003 and who sells any of
      the following drugs other than at retail sale:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a drug in dosage form that is listed in
        Schedule C or D to the Act, a drug that is a prescription drug
        or a controlled drug as defined in section G.01.001;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an active ingredient;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a narcotic as defined in the [Narcotic Control
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._1041); or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a drug containing
        [[cannabis]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in subsection 2(1)
        of the [Cannabis
        Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5). ([grossiste]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this Division and in Division 2,
  [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} does not include any of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a dilute drug premix;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a [[medicated feed]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
    defined in subsection 1(1) of the [Feeds Regulations,
    2024](/eng/regulations/SOR-2024-132);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an active ingredient that is for veterinary use and
    that is not an active pharmaceutical ingredient;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an active pharmaceutical ingredient for veterinary
    use that is not required to be sold pursuant to a prescription and
    that is also a [[natural health product]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
    defined in subsection 1(1) of the [Natural Health Products
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2003-196);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a drug that is used only for the purposes of an
    experimental study in accordance with a certificate issued under
    section C.08.015.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister designates additional dosage form
  classes, the Minister shall make a list of those classes available on
  request.

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575951 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This Division does not apply to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} wholesaling a drug premix;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (3), importing or
    compounding, pursuant to a prescription, a drug that is not
    commercially available in Canada by one of the following persons:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a pharmacist,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a practitioner, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a person who compounds a drug under the
      supervision of a practitioner;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} any activity with respect to a positron-emitting
    radiopharmaceutical that is used only for the purposes of a basic
    clinical research study described in section C.03.304;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any activity with respect to a drug that is used
    only for the purposes of clinical testing in accordance with
    subsection C.05.006(1) or section C.08.005;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} fabricating, packaging/labelling, testing as
    required under Division 2, distributing as a distributer referred to
    in section C.01A.003, wholesaling or importing any of the following
    drugs for which prescriptions are not required and that are for
    human use in dosage form and not represented as a treatment,
    preventative or cure for any of the diseases, disorders or abnormal
    physical states set out in Schedule A.1 to the Act, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} homeopathic drugs,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} drugs that meet the requirements of a class
      monograph entitled "Vitamin Supplements", "Mineral Supplements",
      "Dietary Vitamin Supplements" or "Dietary Mineral Supplements", as
      the case may be, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} drugs that

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} contain a plant, mineral or animal substance in
        respect of which therapeutic activity or disease prevention
        activity is claimed, including traditional herbal medicines,
        traditional Chinese medicines, ayurvedic (East Indian) medicines
        and traditional aboriginal (North American) medicines, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the medical use of which is based solely on
        historical and ethnological evidence from references relating to
        a medical system other than one based on conventional scientific
        standards; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} fabricating, packaging/labelling, testing,
    distributing, and importing of antimicrobial agents.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} This Division and Division 2 do not apply to a
  veterinary health product or an active pharmaceutical ingredient that
  is used in the fabrication of a veterinary health product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} This Division and Divisions 2 to 4 do not apply to
  the affixing of a label to a previously labelled container.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} This Division applies to the importing, by a
  pharmacist, a veterinary practitioner or a person who compounds a drug
  under the supervision of a veterinary practitioner, of an active
  pharmaceutical ingredient for veterinary use that is for the purpose
  of compounding, pursuant to a prescription, a drug in dosage form that
  is not commercially available in Canada, if that ingredient is set out
  in List A.

**[[C.01A.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.003 .sectionLabel}** This
Division and Divisions 2 to 4 apply to the following distributors:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a distributor of an active ingredient; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a distributor of a drug for which the distributor
  holds the drug identification number.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5

- SOR/2017-259, s. 12

**[[C.01A.003.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.003.1 .sectionLabel}** For the
purposes of this Division and the provisions of Divisions 2 to 4 that
are prescribed in paragraphs A.01.048(b) to (d),

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a reference to a distributor referred to in section
  C.01A.003 or a distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(a)
  includes a reference to a distributor of an active ingredient that is
  intended for use outside Canada; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a reference to a distributor referred to in section
  C.01A.003 or a distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(b)
  includes a reference to a distributor of a drug in dosage form that is
  intended for consumption or use outside Canada.

#### [Prohibition]{.HTitleText3} {#h-575978 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall, except in accordance with an establishment licence,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} fabricate, package/label or import a drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} perform the tests, including examinations, required
    under Division 2;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} distribute as a distributor referred to in section
    C.01A.003 a drug other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an active pharmaceutical ingredient, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an active ingredient that is used in the
      fabrication of a drug that is of non-biological origin and that is
      listed in Schedule C to the Act; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} wholesale a drug other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an active pharmaceutical ingredient, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an active ingredient that is used in the
      fabrication of a drug that is of non-biological origin and that is
      listed in Schedule C to the Act.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person does not require an establishment licence to
  perform tests under Division 2 if the person holds an establishment
  licence as a fabricator, a packager/labeller, a distributor referred
  to in paragraph C.01A.003(b) or an importer.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person shall carry on an activity referred to in
  subsection (1) unless the person holds

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a [[narcotic]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
    as defined in the [Narcotic Control
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._1041), a licence for that
    narcotic under those Regulations;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a [[controlled
    drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section G.01.001, a
    licence for that drug under Part G; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a drug containing
    [[cannabis]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in subsection 2(1) of
    the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5), a licence for that drug to
    conduct that activity under the [Cannabis
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2018-144).

- **[[C.01A.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who wishes to apply for an
  establishment licence shall submit an application to the Minister, in
  a form established by the Minister, that contains the following
  information and documents:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant's name, address and telephone number,
    and their facsimile number and electronic mail address, if any;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and telephone number, and the facsimile
    number and electronic mail address, if any, of a person to contact
    in case of an emergency;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} each activity set out in Table I to section
    C.01A.008 for which the licence is requested;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} each category of drugs set out in Table II to
    section C.01A.008 for which the licence is requested;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} each dosage form class in respect of which the
    applicant proposes to carry out a licensed activity, and whether it
    will be in a sterile dosage form;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} whether the applicant proposes to carry out a
    licensed activity in respect of an active ingredient;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the address of each building in Canada in which the
    applicant proposes to fabricate, package/label, test as required
    under Division 2 or store drugs, specifying for each building the
    activities and the categories of drugs and, for each category, the
    dosage form classes, if any, and whether any drug will be in a
    sterile form;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the address of each building in Canada at which
    records will be maintained;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} whether any building referred to in paragraphs (g)
    and (h) is a dwelling-house;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number, if any, or a name
    that clearly identifies the drug,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} for each [[narcotic]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as
      defined in the [Narcotic Control
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._1041), each [[controlled
      drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in section G.01.001 or
      each drug containing [[cannabis]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined
      in subsection 2(1) of the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) for
      which the licence is requested, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} for each other drug within a category of drugs
      for which the licence is requested, unless the licence is to
      perform tests required under Division 2, distribute as set out in
      paragraph C.01A.003(a), or wholesale;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} if any of the buildings referred to in
    paragraph (g) have been inspected under the Act or these
    Regulations, the date of the last inspection;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} evidence that the applicant's buildings, equipment
    and proposed practices and procedures meet the applicable
    requirements of Divisions 2 to 4;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an importer of a drug that is
    fabricated, packaged/labelled or tested in an MRA country at a
    recognized building,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each fabricator,
      packager/labeller and tester of the drug and the address of each
      building in which the drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled or
      tested, specifying for each building the activities and the
      categories of drugs and, for each category, the dosage form
      classes, if any, and whether any drug will be in a sterile form,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in respect of each activity done in an MRA
      country at a recognized building, the name of the regulatory
      authority that is designated under subsection C.01A.019(1) in
      respect of that activity for that drug and that has recognized
      that building as meeting its good manufacturing practices
      standards in respect of that activity for that drug, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in respect of any other activities,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} a certificate from a Canadian inspector
        indicating that the fabricator's, packager/labeller's or
        tester's buildings, equipment, practices and procedures meet the
        applicable requirements of Divisions 2 to 4, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} other evidence establishing that the
        fabricator's, packager/labeller's or tester's buildings,
        equipment, practices and procedures meet the applicable
        requirements of Divisions 2 to 4;

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any other importer, the name and
    address of each fabricator, packager/labeller and tester of the
    drugs proposed to be imported and the address of each building in
    which the drugs will be fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested,
    specifying for each building the activities and the categories of
    drugs and, for each category, the dosage form classes, if any, and
    whether any drug will be in a sterile form; and

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an importer referred to in paragraph
    (n),

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a certificate from a Canadian inspector
      indicating that the fabricator's, packager/labeller's and tester's
      buildings, equipment, practices and procedures meet the applicable
      requirements of Divisions 2 to 4, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} other evidence establishing that the
      fabricator's, packager/labeller's and tester's buildings,
      equipment, practices and procedures meet the applicable
      requirements of Divisions 2 to 4.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An application for an establishment licence that
  relates to one or more activities set out in Table I to section
  C.01A.008 that are to be carried out in respect of a category of drugs
  that is set out in Table II to that section and that includes a drug
  that is fabricated, sold or represented for use in relation to a
  condition described in the [[List of Conditions that Threaten Public
  Health]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section C.08.001.1, may
  include a statement to that effect.

- **[[C.01A.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who wishes to amend an
  establishment licence shall submit an application to the Minister, in
  a form established by the Minister, that contains the information and
  documents referred to in section C.01A.005 that relate to the
  amendment.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} An application to amend an establishment licence
  that relates to one or more activities set out in Table I to section
  C.01A.008 that are to be carried out in respect of a category of drugs
  that is set out in Table II to that section and that includes a drug
  that is fabricated, sold or represented for use in relation to a
  condition described in the [[List of Conditions that Threaten Public
  Health]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section C.08.001.1, may
  include a statement to that effect.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An establishment licence must be amended where the
  licensee proposes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to add an activity or category of drugs, as set out
    in the tables to section C.01A.008;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a category of drugs and activity
    indicated in the licence, to authorize sterile dosage forms of the
    category;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} to add any building in Canada at which drugs are
    authorized to be fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested as required
    under Division 2 or stored, or to add, for an existing building, an
    authorization to fabricate, package/label, test or store a category
    of drugs, or sterile dosage forms of the category; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in addition to the matters set out in
    paragraphs (a) to (c), in the case of an importer,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to add a fabricator, packager/labeller or tester
      of a drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to amend the name or address of a fabricator,
      packager/labeller or tester indicated in the licence, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if the address of the buildings at which drugs
      are authorized to be fabricated, packaged/labelled or tested is
      indicated in the licence, to add additional buildings or, for an
      existing building, to add an authorization to fabricate,
      package/label or test a category of drugs, or sterile dosage forms
      of the category.

- **[[C.01A.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, on receipt of an
  application for an establishment licence, an amendment to an
  establishment licence or the review of an establishment licence,
  require the applicant to submit further details pertaining to the
  information contained in the application that are necessary to enable
  the Minister to make a decision.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} When considering an application, the Minister may
  require that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an inspection be made during normal business hours
    of any building referred to in paragraph C.01A.005(1)(g) or (h); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the applicant, if a fabricator, a
    packager/labeller, a person who performs tests required under
    Division 2, a distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(b) or
    an importer, supply samples of any material to be used in the
    fabrication, packaging/labelling or testing of a drug.

#### [Issuance]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576041 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.008
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (1.1) and
  section C.01A.010, the Minister shall, on receipt of the information
  and material referred to in sections C.01A.005 to C.01A.007, issue or
  amend an establishment licence.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall, in ascertaining whether they
  have received the information and material referred to in sections
  C.01A.005 to C.01A.007 in relation to an application referred to in
  subsection C.01A.005(2) or C.01A.006(1.1) that contains the statement
  referred to in the applicable subsection, also take into consideration
  the public health need related to the condition described in the
  [[List of Conditions that Threaten Public
  Health]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section C.08.001.1.

- [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} If an application for an establishment licence or
  to amend such a licence contains a statement referred to in subsection
  C.01A.005(2) or C.01A.006(1.1) that relates to a condition that is
  subsequently removed from the [[List of Conditions that Threaten
  Public Health]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in section
  C.08.001.1, the Minister may nonetheless issue or amend the licence on
  the basis of the application.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The establishment licence shall indicate

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} each activity set out in Table I to this section
    that is authorized and the category of drugs set out in Table II to
    this section for which each activity is authorized, specifying for
    each activity and category whether sterile dosage forms are
    authorized;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the address of each building in Canada at which a
    category of drugs set out in Table II to this section is authorized
    to be fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested as required under
    Division 2 or stored, specifying for each building which of those
    activities and for which category of drugs, and whether sterile
    dosage forms of the category are authorized; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in addition to the matters referred to in
    paragraphs (a) and (b), in the case of an importer,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of each fabricator,
      packager/labeller and tester from whom the importer is authorized
      to obtain the drug for import, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the address of each building at which the drug
      is authorized to be fabricated, packaged/labelled or tested,
      specifying for each building the activities and the category of
      drugs set out in Table II to this section that are authorized, and
      whether sterile dosage forms are authorized.

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2002-368, s. 5\]]{.Repealed}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may indicate in an establishment licence
  a period for which records shall be retained under Division 2 that,
  based on the safety profile of the drug or materials, is sufficient to
  ensure the health of the consumer.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} When issuing an establishment licence, the Minister
  may impose terms and conditions on the establishment licence
  respecting

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the tests to be performed in respect of a drug, and
    the equipment to be used, to ensure that the drug is not unsafe for
    use; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any other matters necessary to prevent risk to the
    health of consumers, including conditions under which drugs are
    fabricated, packaged/labelled or tested.

#### [Annual Licence Review]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576069 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of an establishment
  licence that is not suspended shall submit an application for the
  review of their licence to the Minister before April 1 of each year
  and include with it the information and documents referrred to in
  section C.01A.005.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall conduct an annual review of the
  licence on the basis of the information and documents submitted by the
  holder and any other relevant information in the Minister's
  possession.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5
- SOR/97-298, s. 1
- SOR/2011-81, s. 5
:::

:::

#### [Refusal to Issue]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576075 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may refuse to issue or
  amend an establishment licence in respect of any or all matters
  indicated in subsection C.01A.008(2) if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant has made a false or misleading
    statement in relation to the application for the licence; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the applicant has had an establishment licence
    suspended in respect of the matter.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall refuse to issue or amend an
  establishment licence in respect of any or all matters indicated in
  subsection C.01A.008(2) if the Minister has reasonable grounds to
  believe that issuing or amending an establishment licence in respect
  of the matter would constitute a risk to the health of the consumer.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister refuses to issue or amend an
  establishment licence, the Minister shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} notify the applicant in writing of the reasons for
    the refusal; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} give the applicant an opportunity to be heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5
:::

#### [Terms and Conditions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576086 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person who holds an
  establishment licence shall comply with

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the requirements of the establishment licence; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the applicable requirements of Divisions 2 to 4.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2000-120, s. 4\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5
- SOR/2000-120, s. 4

:::

- **[[C.01A.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.012
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may amend the terms and
  conditions of an establishment licence that are imposed under
  subsection C.01A.008(4) if the Minister believes on reasonable grounds
  that an amendment is necessary to prevent risk to the health of the
  consumer.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall give at least 15 days notice in
  writing to the holder of the establishment licence of the proposed
  amendment, the reasons for it and its effective date.

::: HistoricalNote

- **[[C.01A.012.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.012.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection C.01A.008(4), the
  Minister may, at any time, including when issuing an establishment
  licence, impose terms and conditions on an establishment licence that
  is issued or amended under section C.01A.008 on the basis of an
  application referred to in subsection C.01A.005(2) or C.01A.006(1.1)
  that contains the statement referred to in the applicable subsection.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, terms and conditions that may

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the power in subsection (1)

  licence is cancelled, even if the holder of the licence does not carry
  out activities in respect of the drug that formed the basis for the
  statement contained in the application that led to the issuance or

#### [Notification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576099 .Subheading}

**[[C.01A.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.013 .sectionLabel}** Every
person who holds an establishment licence shall notify the Minister in
writing within 15 days after

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} there is any change to the information referred to in
  any of paragraphs C.01A.005(1)(a), (b) and (e) to (i); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} an event occurs that results in their being in
  contravention of any of the applicable requirements set out in
  Divisions 2 to 4, if the event may affect the quality, safety or
  efficacy of a drug that they fabricate, package/label, test in
  accordance with the requirements set out in Division 2 or store,
  including during transportation.

::: HistoricalNote

- **[[C.01A.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.014
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No licensee shall carry on a
  licensed activity in respect of any category of drugs if a change
  referred to in subsection (2) has occurred in respect of that
  category, unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} they have filed with the Minister a notice that
    contains sufficient information to enable the Minister to assess the
    safety of the drug, taking into account the change; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has issued to them a letter indicating
    that the information will be reviewed and has not, within 90 days
    after issuing the letter, sent them a notice indicating that the
    change is not acceptable.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notification is required in respect of the following
  changes where they may affect whether a drug can be fabricated,
  packaged/labelled, tested or stored in accordance with the applicable
  requirements of Divisions 2 to 4:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} changes to the plans and specifications of a
    building where a drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested or
    stored;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} changes to the equipment that is used in the
    fabrication, packaging/labelling or testing of a drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} changes to the practices or procedures; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an importer, other than an importer
    of a drug that is fabricated, packaged/labelled or tested in an MRA
    country at a recognized building, any change referred to in
    paragraphs (a) to (c) that relates to the fabricator,
    packager/labeller or tester of the drug being imported.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5
- SOR/2000-120, s. 5
- SOR/2002-368, s. 6
:::

- **[[C.01A.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An importer of a drug that is
  fabricated, packaged/labelled or tested in an MRA country at a
  recognized building shall immediately notify the Minister if the
  fabricator, packager/labeller or tester indicated in the importer's
  establishment licence no longer holds a valid permit, licence or other
  authorization issued by the regulatory authority that recognized that
  building.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall, on receiving a notification under
  subsection (1), amend the importer's establishment licence by removing
  the name and address of that fabricator, packager/labeller or tester.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5
- SOR/2000-120, s. 6
- SOR/2002-368, s. 7

#### [Suspension]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576121 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.016
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may suspend an
  establishment licence in respect of any or all matters indicated in
  subsection C.01A.008(2) if he or she has reasonable grounds to believe
  that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensee has contravened any provision of the
    Act or these Regulations; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensee has made a false or misleading
    statement in the application for the establishment licence.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before suspending an establishment licence, the
  Minister shall consider

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensee's history of compliance with the Act
    and these Regulations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the risk that allowing the licence to continue in
    force would constitute for the health of the consumer.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall not suspend an establishment
  licence until

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has sent the licensee a written notice
    that sets out the reason for the proposed suspension, any corrective
    action required to be taken and the time within which it must be
    taken;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if corrective action is required, the time set out
    in the notice has passed without the action having been taken; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the licensee has been given an opportunity to be
    heard in respect of the suspension.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5
- SOR/2018-84, s. 4
- [SOR/2021-46, s. 7](#1288907-1290078){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1288907-1290078.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01A.016-20180423.html "Link to previous version of section C.01A.016"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.01A.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.017
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may suspend an
  establishment licence in respect of any or all matters indicated in
  subsection C.01A.008(2) without giving the licensee an opportunity to
  be heard if it is necessary to do so to prevent a risk to the health
  of consumers, by giving the licensee a notice that states the reason
  for the suspension.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensee may request of the Minister, in writing,
  that the suspension be reconsidered.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall, within 45 days after the date of
  receiving the request, provide the licensee with the opportunity to be
  heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5
- SOR/2018-84, s. 5
:::

Version](section-C.01A.017-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.01A.017"){.PITLink}

**[[C.01A.017.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.017.1 .sectionLabel}** The
Minister may suspend an establishment licence in respect of any or all
matters indicated in subsection C.01A.008(2) if, after the Minister has,
under section 21.31 of the Act, ordered the licensee to conduct an
assessment in order to provide evidence establishing that the licensee's
buildings, equipment or practices and procedures, as the case may be,
continue to meet the requirements referred to in paragraph
C.01A.005(1)(l), subparagraph C.01A.005(1)(m)(ii) or (iii) or paragraph
C.01A.005(1)(o),

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensee fails to comply with the order; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensee complies with the order but the Minister
  determines that the results of the assessment are not sufficient to
  establish that those requirements continue to be met.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-84, s. 6
- [SOR/2021-45, s. 11](#1289421-1316850){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1289421-1316850.html"}
:::

Version](section-C.01A.017.1-20180423.html "Link to previous version of section C.01A.017.1"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.01A.018]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.018 .sectionLabel}** The
Minister shall reinstate an establishment licence in respect of any or
all matters indicated in subsection C.01A.008(2) that are the subject of
the suspension if, within 12 months after the effective date of the
suspension, the licensee provides the Minister with sufficient evidence
demonstrating that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the situation on which the suspension was based has
  been corrected; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the situation on which the suspension was based did
  not exist.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 5
- SOR/2018-84, s. 6

#### [Cancellation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576151 .Subheading}

**[[C.01A.018.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.018.1 .sectionLabel}** The
Minister shall cancel an establishment licence if the licensee has
failed to submit an application for the review of the licence in
accordance with subsection C.01A.009(1).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2011-81, s. 6
- SOR/2018-84, s. 7
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.01A.018.1-20110401.html "Link to previous version of section C.01A.018.1"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.01A.018.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.018.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister has suspended an
  establishment licence in respect of all matters indicated in
  subsection C.01A.008(2) and the suspension is still in effect 12
  months after the effective date of the suspension, the Minister shall
  cancel the licence.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister has suspended an establishment
  licence in respect of one or more of the matters indicated in
  subsection C.01A.008(2) and the suspension is still in effect 12
  months after the effective date of the suspension, the Minister shall
  cancel the licence only in respect of the matters that are the subject
  of the suspension.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2018-84, s. 7
:::

#### [Designation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576160 .Subheading}

- **[[C.01A.019]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.01A.019
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Division
  and Divisions 2 to 4, a regulatory authority that is set out in
  column 1 of the List of Regulatory Authorities for the Purposes of
  Section C.01A.019 of the Food and Drug Regulations, published by the
  Government of Canada on its website, as amended from time to time, is
  designated in respect of the activities set out in column 3 for the
  drugs or category of drugs set out in column 2.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Whole blood and its components are excluded from the
  drugs and categories of drugs that are set out in column 2 of the
  List.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The lot release of drugs listed in Schedule D to the
  Act is excluded from the activity of testing set out in column 3 of
  the List.

**[[C.02.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.002 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

[[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/97-12,
    s. 6\]]{.Repealed}

[[importer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[importer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/97-12,
    s. 6\]]{.Repealed}

[[medical gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[medical gas]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any gas or mixture of
    gases manufactured, sold or represented for use as a drug; ([gaz
    médical]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[packaging material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[packaging material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a
    label; ([matériel d'emballage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[produce]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[produce]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/97-12, s.
    6\]]{.Repealed}

[[quality control department]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[quality control department]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2010-95, s. 1\]]{.Repealed}

[[specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a detailed description

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of all properties and qualities of

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the methods used for
      testing and examining the drug, raw material or packaging
      material, and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of tolerances for the properties and
      qualities of the drug, raw material or packaging
      material. ([spécifications]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

**[[C.02.002.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.002.1 .sectionLabel}** This
Division does not apply to fabricating, packaging/labelling, testing,
storing and importing of antimicrobial agents.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2004-282, s. 3
:::

**[[C.02.002.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.002.2 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a reference to specifications is --- in respect of a
  drug intended for consumption or use outside Canada, the raw material
  used in such a drug or the packaging material for such a drug --- a
  reference to the specifications with which the drug, raw material or
  packaging material is required to comply in the country in which the
  drug is intended to be consumed or used; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the definition [[expiration
  date]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection C.01.001(1) does not apply
  in respect of a drug intended for consumption or use outside Canada.
