#### [Sale]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576192 .Subheading}

**[[C.02.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.003 .sectionLabel}** No
distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(b) and no importer shall
sell a drug unless it has been fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested and
stored, including during transportation, in accordance with the
requirements set out in this Division.

::: HistoricalNote

**[[C.02.003.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.003.1 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a drug that they have fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested
or stored unless they have fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested or
stored the drug, including during transportation, in accordance with the
requirements set out in this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2013-74, s. 7

- **[[C.02.003.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.003.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall import an active
  ingredient into Canada for the purpose of sale unless they have in
  Canada a person who is responsible for its sale.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person who imports an active ingredient into
  Canada shall sell any lot or batch of it unless the following appear
  on its label:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and civic address of the person who
    imports it; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the principal place of
    business in Canada of the person who is responsible for its sale.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2013-74, s. 7
:::

#### [Use in Fabrication]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576206 .Subheading}

**[[C.02.003.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.003.3 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall use an active ingredient in the fabrication of a drug unless the
ingredient has been fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested and stored,
including during transportation, in accordance with the requirements set
out in this Division.

#### [Premises]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576210 .Subheading}

**[[C.02.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.004 .sectionLabel}** The premises
in which a lot or batch of a drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled or
stored shall be designed, constructed and maintained in a manner that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} permits the operations therein to be performed under
  clean, sanitary and orderly conditions;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} permits the effective cleaning of all surfaces
  therein; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} prevents the contamination of the drug and the
  addition of extraneous material to the drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, s. 8
- SOR/2010-95, s. 3
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.02.004-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.004"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Equipment]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576217 .Subheading}

**[[C.02.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.005 .sectionLabel}** The equipment
with which a lot or batch of a drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled or
tested shall be designed, constructed, maintained, operated and arranged
in a manner that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} permits the effective cleaning of its surfaces;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} prevents the contamination of the drug and the
  addition of extraneous material to the drug; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} permits it to function in accordance with its
  intended use.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, s. 9
:::

#### [Personnel]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576224 .Subheading}

**[[C.02.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.006 .sectionLabel}** Every lot or
batch of a drug shall be fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested and
stored, including during transportation, under the supervision of
personnel who, having regard to the duties and responsibilities
involved, have had any technical, academic or other training that the
Minister considers satisfactory in the interests of the health of the
consumer or purchaser.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/85-754, s. 2
- SOR/97-12, s. 52
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 16](#1496756-1503665){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496756-1503665.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.02.006-20180404.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.006"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Sanitation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576228 .Subheading}

- **[[C.02.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person who fabricates or
  packages/labels a drug shall have a written sanitation program that
  shall be implemented under the supervision of qualified personnel.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The sanitation program referred to in subsection (1)
  shall include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} cleaning procedures for the premises where the drug
    is fabricated or packaged/labelled and for the equipment used in the
    fabrication or packaging/labelling; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} instructions on the sanitary fabrication and
    packaging/labelling of drugs and the handling of materials used in
    the fabrication and packaging/labelling of drugs.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, ss. 10, 53
:::

- **[[C.02.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.008
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person who fabricates or
  packages/labels a drug shall have, in writing, minimum requirements
  for the health and the hygienic behaviour and clothing of personnel to
  ensure the clean and sanitary fabrication and packaging/labelling of
  the drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall have access to any area where a drug
  is exposed during its fabrication or packaging/labelling if the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is affected with or is a carrier of a disease in a
    communicable form; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has an open lesion on any exposed surface of the
    body.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, s. 11
:::

#### [Raw Material Testing]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576243 .Subheading}

- **[[C.02.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Each lot or batch of raw material
  shall be tested against the specifications for that raw material prior
  to its use in the fabrication of a drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No lot or batch of raw material shall be used in the
  fabrication of a drug unless that lot or batch of raw material
  complies with the specifications for that raw material.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), water may, prior to
  the completion of its tests under that subsection, be used in the
  fabrication of a drug.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If any property of a raw material is subject to
  change during storage of the material, including during
  transportation, no lot or batch of that raw material shall be used in
  the fabrication of a drug after the lot or batch has been stored,
  including during transportation, unless the raw material is retested
  after an appropriate interval and meets the specifications for that
  material.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Where the specifications referred to in
  subsections (1), (2) and (4) are not prescribed, they shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be in writing;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be acceptable to the Minister who shall take into
    account the specifications contained in any publication mentioned in
    Schedule B to the Act; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be approved by the person in charge of the quality
    control department.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, s. 59
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 17](#1496758-1503667){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496758-1503667.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.02.009-20180404.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.009"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.02.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The testing referred to in section
  C.02.009 shall be performed on a sample taken

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} after receipt of each lot or batch of raw material
    on the premises of the fabricator; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (2), before receipt of each
    lot or batch of raw material on the premises of the fabricator, if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the fabricator

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} has evidence satisfactory to the Minister to
        demonstrate that raw materials sold to him by the vendor of that
        lot or batch of raw material are consistently manufactured in
        accordance with and consistently comply with the specifications
        for those raw materials, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} undertakes periodic complete confirmatory
        testing with a frequency satisfactory to the Minister, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the raw material has not been transported or
      stored under conditions that may affect its compliance with the
      specifications for that raw material.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} After a lot or batch of raw material is received on
  the premises of the fabricator, the lot or batch of raw material shall
  be tested for identity.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, ss. 12, 60
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

[Previous
Version](section-C.02.010-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.010"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Manufacturing Control]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576266 .Subheading}

- **[[C.02.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator, packager/labeller,
  distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(b) and importer of a
  drug shall have written procedures prepared by qualified personnel in
  respect of the drug to ensure that the drug meets the specifications
  for that drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every person required to have written procedures
  referred to in subsection (1) shall ensure that each lot or batch of
  the drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested in compliance
  with those procedures.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, s. 13
:::

- **[[C.02.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.012
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator, packager/labeller,
  distributor referred to in section C.01A.003, importer and wholesaler
  of a drug shall maintain

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a system of control that permits complete and rapid
    recall of any lot or batch of the drug that is on the market; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a program of self-inspection.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator and packager/labeller and, subject
  to subsections (3) and (4), every distributor referred to in paragraph
  C.01A.003(b) and importer of a drug shall maintain a system to ensure
  that any lot or batch of the drug fabricated and packaged/labelled on
  premises other than their own is fabricated and packaged/labelled in
  accordance with the requirements of this Division.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to a distributor if the
  drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested in Canada by a person
  who holds an establishment licence that authorizes those activities in
  respect of that drug.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not apply to a distributor or
  importer if the drug is fabricated or packaged/labelled in an MRA
  country at a recognized building and both of the following
  requirements are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the address of the building is set out in their
    establishment licence; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} they retain a copy of the batch certificate for
    each lot or batch of the drug that they receive.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, s. 13
- SOR/2000-120, s. 9
- SOR/2002-368, s. 9
- SOR/2013-74, s. 8
- [SOR/2024-136, s. 3(F)](#1458077-1500053){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1458077-1500053.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-C.02.012-20131108.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.012"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Quality Control]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576283 .Subheading}

**[[C.02.012.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.012.1 .sectionLabel}** Every lot
or batch of a drug shall be fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested and
stored, including during transportation, in a manner that assures the
quality of the drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 18](#1496760-1503671){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496760-1503671.html"}
:::

- **[[C.02.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.013
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator, packager/labeller,
  wholesaler, distributor referred to in section C.01A.003 and importer
  of a drug shall have on their premises in Canada a quality control
  department that is supervised by personnel described in section
  C.02.006.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Except in the case of a wholesaler or a distributor
  referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(a), the quality control department
  shall be a distinct organizational unit that functions and reports to
  management independently of any other functional unit, including the
  manufacturing, processing, packaging or sales unit.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/89-174, s. 8(F)
- SOR/97-12, s. 55
- SOR/2000-120, s. 10
- SOR/2010-95, s. 4
- SOR/2013-74, s. 9
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.02.013-20100429.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.013"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.02.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.014
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except in the case of a wholesaler
  or a distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(a), no lot or
  batch of a drug shall be made available for further use in fabrication
  or for sale unless the person in charge of the quality control
  department approves the sale or the further use.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A drug that is returned to its fabricator,
  packager/labeller, wholesaler, distributor referred to in section
  C.01A.003 or importer shall not be made available for further use in
  fabrication or for further sale unless the person in charge of the
  quality control department approves the further sale or further use.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No lot or batch of a raw material or
  packaging/labelling material shall be used in the fabrication or
  packaging/labelling of a drug unless the person in charge of the
  quality control department approves the use.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} No lot or batch of a drug shall be reprocessed unless
  the person in charge of the quality control department approves the
  reprocessing.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/89-174, s. 8(F)
- SOR/97-12, ss. 14, 55
- SOR/2010-95, s. 5
- SOR/2013-74, s. 9
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.02.014-20100429.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.014"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.02.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} All fabrication,
  packaging/labelling, testing, storage and transportation methods and
  procedures that may affect the quality of a drug shall be examined and
  approved by the person in charge of the quality control department
  before their implementation.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The person in charge of the quality control
  department shall cause to be investigated any complaint or information
  that is received respecting the quality of a drug or its deficiencies
  or hazards and cause any necessary corrective action to be taken, in
  the case where the complaint or information relates to an activity
  over which the department exercises quality control.

- [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} In the case where the complaint or information that
  is received does not relate to an activity over which the quality
  control department exercises quality control, the person in charge of
  the department shall forward the complaint or information to the
  person in charge of the quality control department that exercises
  quality control over that activity.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The person in charge of the quality control
  department shall cause all tests or examinations required pursuant to
  this Division to be performed by a competent laboratory.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, s. 15
- SOR/2010-95, s. 6
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.02.015-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.015"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Packaging Material Testing]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576303 .Subheading}

- **[[C.02.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.016
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Each lot or batch of packaging
  material shall, prior to its use in the packaging of a drug, be
  examined or tested against the specifications for that packaging
  material.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No lot or batch of packaging material shall be used
  in the packaging of a drug unless the lot or batch of packaging
  material complies with the specifications for that packaging material.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The specifications referred to in subsections (1)
  and (2) shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be in writing;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be acceptable to the Minister who shall take into
    account the specifications contained in any publication mentioned in
    Schedule B to the Act; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be approved by the person in charge of the quality
    control department.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/89-174, s. 8(F)
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.02.016-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.016"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.02.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.017
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The examination or testing referred
  to in section C.02.016 shall be performed on a sample taken

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} after receipt of each lot or batch of packaging
    material on the premises of the person who packages a drug; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (2), before receipt of each
    lot or batch of packaging material on the premises of the person who
    packages a drug, if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that person

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} has evidence satisfactory to the Minister to
        demonstrate that packaging materials sold to him by the vendor
        of that lot or batch of packaging material are consistently
        manufactured in accordance with and consistently comply with the
        specifications for those packaging materials, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} undertakes periodic complete confirmatory
        examination or testing with a frequency satisfactory to the
        Minister,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the packaging material has not been transported
      or stored under conditions that may affect its compliance with the
      specifications for that packaging material.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} After a lot or batch of packaging material is
  received on the premises of the person who packages a drug,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the lot or batch of the packaging material shall be
    examined or tested for identity; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the labels shall be examined or tested in order to
    ensure that they comply with the specifications for those labels.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/89-174, ss. 2(F), 8(F)
- SOR/97-12, s. 56(F)
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

#### [Finished Product Testing]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576326 .Subheading}

- **[[C.02.018]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.018
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Each lot or batch of a drug shall,
  before it is made available for further use in fabrication or for
  sale, be tested against the specifications for that drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No lot or batch of a drug shall be made available for
  further use in fabrication or for sale unless it complies with the
  specifications for that drug.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The specifications referred to in subsections (1)
  and (2) shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be in writing;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be approved by the person in charge of the quality
    control department; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} comply with the Act and these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/2013-74, s. 10
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.02.018-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.02.018"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.02.019]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.019
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A packager/labeller of a drug, a
  distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(b) and an importer of a
  drug other than an active ingredient shall perform the finished
  product testing on a sample of the drug that is taken either

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} after receipt of each lot or batch of the drug on
    their premises in Canada; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} before receipt of each lot or batch of the drug on
    their premises in Canada if the following conditions are met:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the packager/labeller, distributor or importer

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} has evidence satisfactory to the Minister to
        demonstrate that drugs sold to them by the vendor of that lot or
        batch are consistently manufactured in accordance with and
        consistently comply with the specifications for those drugs, and

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} undertakes periodic complete confirmatory
        testing, with a frequency satisfactory to the Minister, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug has not been transported or stored
      under conditions that may affect its compliance with the
      specifications for that drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the packager/labeller, distributor or importer
  receives a lot or batch of a drug on their premises in Canada the
  useful life of which is more than 30 days, the lot or batch shall be
  tested for identity and the packager/labeller shall confirm the
  identity after the lot or batch is packaged/labelled.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a distributor
  if the drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested in Canada by a
  person who holds an establishment licence that authorizes that
  activity.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a distributor
  or importer if the drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested in
  an MRA country at a recognized building and they retain a copy of the
  batch certificate for each lot or batch of the drug that they receive.

- [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a
  distributor or importer of a COVID-19 drug if the lot of the drug is
  the subject of a request made under subsection C.04.007(2).

- [(4.2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a
  packager/labeller, distributor or importer if the following conditions
  are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the drug is a radiopharmaceutical or a
    [[radionuclide generator]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in
    section C.03.001, and has a useful life of no more than 30 days; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the packager/labeller, distributor or importer
    maintains evidence satisfactory to the Minister to demonstrate that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the drug has been tested against the
      specifications for that drug, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug has not been transported or stored
      under conditions that may affect its compliance with those
      specifications.

- [(4.3)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a
  packager/labeller, distributor or importer if the following conditions
  are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the drug is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} for human use,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in dosage form,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} listed in Schedule D to the Act,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} not a vaccine, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} composed of genetically modified autologous human
      nucleated cells or is delivered to cells using an adeno-associated
      virus vector; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the packager/labeller, distributor or importer
    maintains evidence satisfactory to the Minister to demonstrate that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the drug has been tested against the
      specifications for that drug, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug has not been transported or stored
      under conditions that may affect its compliance with those
      specifications.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a distributor
  or importer of a drug that is not a prescription drug and that is part
  of a class of drugs that is set out in column 1 of the List of
  Non-prescription Drugs Not Subject to Certain Testing Requirements if
  all of the following conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the drug contains, as its only active ingredients,
    one or more of those set out in column 2, each of which corresponds
    to that class, in the corresponding quantity set out in column 3,
    and the drug is consistent with the descriptive information set out
    in columns 4 to 6;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the drug is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} fabricated in Canada or in a recognized country
      or region,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} packaged/labelled in Canada or in a recognized
      country or region, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tested in a recognized country or region;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the distributor or the importer retains a copy of
    the batch certificate for each lot or batch of the drug that is
    distributed or imported, as the case may be.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} A drug that is referred to in subsection (4.2), (4.3)
  or (5) and that is imported may be shipped directly to a person other
  than the importer if the following conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} before importing the drug, the importer receives a
    document that demonstrates that the drug complies with the
    specifications for that drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the importer and the distributor have measures in
    place to ensure that all the requirements of these Regulations in
    respect of the importation of the drug are met.

#### [Records]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576351 .Subheading}

- **[[C.02.020]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.020
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator, packager/labeller,
  distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(b) and importer shall
  maintain all of the following records on their premises in Canada for
  each drug that they fabricate, package/label, distribute or import:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} except in the case of an importer of an active
    pharmaceutical ingredient or an active ingredient that is used in
    the fabrication of a drug that is of non-biological origin and that
    is listed in Schedule C to the Act, master production documents for
    the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} evidence that each lot or batch of the drug has
    been fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested and stored, including
    during transportation, in accordance with the procedures described
    in the master production documents;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} evidence that the conditions under which the drug
    was fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested and stored, including
    during transportation, meet the requirements set out in this
    Division;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} evidence that establishes the period during which
    the drug in the container in which it is sold or made available for
    further use in fabrication will meet the specifications for that
    drug; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} evidence that the finished product testing referred
    to in section C.02.018 was carried out and the results of that
    testing.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every distributor referred to in paragraph
  C.01A.003(b) and importer shall make available to the Minister, on
  request, the results of testing performed on raw materials and
  packaging/labelling materials for each lot or batch of a drug that it
  distributes or imports.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator shall maintain on their premises
  written specifications for all raw materials and adequate evidence of
  the testing of those raw materials referred to in section C.02.009 and
  of the test results.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Every person who packages a drug shall maintain on
  their premises written specifications for all packaging materials and
  adequate evidence of the examination or testing of those materials
  referred to in section C.02.016 and of any test results.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator, packager/labeller and tester shall
  maintain on their premises in Canada detailed plans and specifications
  of each building in Canada where they fabricate, package/label or test
  drugs and a description of the design and construction of those
  buildings.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator, packager/labeller and tester shall
  maintain on their premises in Canada personnel records in respect of
  each person who is employed to supervise the fabrication,
  packaging/labelling and testing of drugs, including the person's
  title, responsibilities, qualifications, experience and training.

- **[[C.02.021]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.021
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} All records and evidence of the
  fabrication, packaging/labelling, finished product testing referred to
  in section C.02.018 and storage, including storage during
  transportation, of a drug in dosage form that are required to be
  maintained under this Division shall be retained for one year after
  the expiration date of the drug unless the relevant establishment
  licence specifies some other period.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), all records and evidence
  of the fabrication, packaging/labelling, finished product testing
  referred to in section C.02.018 and storage, including during
  transportation, of an active ingredient that are required to be
  maintained under this Division shall be retained in respect of each
  lot or batch of the active ingredient for the following period unless
  the relevant establishment licence specifies some other period:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an active ingredient that has a
    retest date, three years after the lot or batch has been completely
    distributed; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, one year after the expiration
    date of the lot or batch.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), all records and evidence
  of the raw material testing referred to in section C.02.009 and of the
  testing of packaging/labelling materials that are required to be
  maintained under this Division shall be retained for five years after
  the raw materials and packaging/labelling materials were last used in
  the fabrication or packaging/labelling of a drug unless the relevant
  establishment licence specifies some other period.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a fabricator is required to maintain records and
  evidence in respect of the same active ingredient under
  subsections (2) and (3), they shall maintain them for the longest
  period that is applicable.

- **[[C.02.022]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.022
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every wholesaler, distributor
  referred to in section C.01A.003 and importer of a drug in dosage form
  shall retain records of sale of each lot or batch of the drug, which
  enable them to recall the lot or batch from the market, for one year
  after the expiration date of that lot or batch unless their
  establishment licence specifies some other period.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every distributor of an active ingredient referred to

  active ingredient shall retain records of sale of each lot or batch of
  the active ingredient, which enable them to recall the lot or batch

    retest date, three years after the lot or batch has been completely
    distributed; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, one year after the expiration
    date of the lot or batch.

- **[[C.02.023]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.023
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of a complaint or any
  information respecting the quality of a drug or its deficiencies or
  hazards, every fabricator, packager/labeller, wholesaler, distributor
  referred to in section C.01A.003 and importer of the drug shall make a
  record of the complaint or information that contains the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the results of any investigation carried out under
    subsection C.02.015(2) and, if applicable, the corrective action
    taken; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and business address of the person in
    charge of the quality control department to whom the complaint or
    information was forwarded under subsection C.02.015(2.1) and the
    date on which it was forwarded.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Records referred to in subsection (1) shall be
  retained for the following period unless the person holds an
  establishment licence that specifies some other period:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug in dosage form, one year
    after the expiration date of the lot or batch of the drug; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an active ingredient,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the active ingredient has a retest date, three
      years after the lot or batch has been completely distributed, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, one year after the expiration
      date of the lot or batch of the active ingredient.

- **[[C.02.024]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.024
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator, packager/labeller,
  distributor referred to in section C.01A.003, importer and wholesaler
  shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} maintain records of the results of the
    self-inspection program required by section C.02.012 and of any
    action taken in connection with that program; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} retain those records for a period of at least three

  shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} maintain records on the operation of the sanitation

**[[C.02.024.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.024.1 .sectionLabel}** Every
distributor of an active ingredient referred to in paragraph
C.01A.003(a) and every fabricator, packager/labeller, wholesaler and
importer of an active ingredient shall add all of the following
information to the documentation that accompanies the active ingredient,
immediately after any like information that has been added by another
person:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} their establishment licence number, or if there is
  none, their name, address, telephone number, fax number and email
  address;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} an indication whether they have fabricated,
  packaged/labelled, wholesaled, distributed or imported the active
  ingredient and the date on which that activity was carried out;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the lot number.

#### [Samples]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576409 .Subheading}

- **[[C.02.025]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.025
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every distributor referred to in
  paragraph C.01A.003(b) and importer of a drug in dosage form shall
  retain in Canada a sample of each lot or batch of the
  packaged/labelled drug for one year after the expiration date of the
  drug unless their establishment licence specifies otherwise.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), the fabricator of a drug
  in dosage form shall retain a sample of each lot or batch of raw
  materials used in the fabrication for two years after the materials
  were last used in the fabrication unless their establishment licence
  specifies some other period.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), the fabricator of an
  active ingredient shall retain a sample of each lot or batch of it for
  the following period unless their establishment licence specifies some
  other period:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an active ingredient that has a
    retest date, three years after the lot or batch has been completely
    distributed; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, one year after the expiration
    date of the lot or batch.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a fabricator is required to maintain samples in
  respect of the same active ingredient under subsections (2) and (3),
  they shall maintain them for the longest period that is applicable.

**[[C.02.026]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.026 .sectionLabel}** The samples
referred to in section C.02.025 shall be in an amount that is sufficient
to determine whether the drug or raw material complies with the
specifications for that drug or raw material.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
:::

#### [Stability]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576422 .Subheading}

- **[[C.02.027]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.027
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every distributor referred to in
  paragraph C.01A.003(b) and importer of a drug in dosage form shall
  establish the period during which each drug in the package in which it
  is sold will comply with the specifications for that drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator and importer of an active ingredient
  shall establish the period during which each drug in the package in
  which it is sold will comply with the specifications for that drug.

::: HistoricalNote

- SOR/97-12, s. 58

- **[[C.02.028]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.028
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every distributor referred to in
  paragraph C.01A.003(b) and importer of a drug in dosage form shall
  monitor, by means of a continuing program, the stability of the drug
  in the package in which it is sold.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every fabricator and importer of an active ingredient
  shall monitor, by means of a continuing program, the stability of the
  drug in the package in which it is sold.

#### [Sterile Products]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576433 .Subheading}

**[[C.02.029]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.029 .sectionLabel}** In addition
to the other requirements of this Division, a drug that is intended to
be sterile shall be fabricated and packaged/labelled

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in separate and enclosed areas;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} under the supervision of personnel trained in
  microbiology; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} by a method scientifically proven to ensure
  sterility.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-524, s. 3
- SOR/97-12, s. 21
:::

#### [Medical Gases]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576440 .Subheading}

**[[C.02.030]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.02.030 .sectionLabel}** The
provisions of sections C.02.025, C.02.027 and C.02.028 do not apply to
medical gases.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-754, s. 3
:::

### [DIVISION 3]{.HLabel2} {#h-576444 .Subheading}

#### [Schedule C Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576445 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.001 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

[[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that is listed in Schedule
    C to the Act that is in dosage form or a drug that is an active
    ingredient of biological origin that can be used in the preparation
    of a drug listed in that Schedule; ([drogue]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[licence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[licence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[Canadian
    licence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/97-12,
    s. 22\]]{.Repealed}

[[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, SOR/97-12, s.
    22\]]{.Repealed}

[[master lot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[master lot]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a quantity of a drug from
    which a lot is prepared for sale by subsequent dilution or
    mixture; ([maître-lot]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[radionuclide generator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[radionuclide generator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a radioactive
    parent and daughter

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contained in an ion-exchange column, or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} dissolved in a suitable solvent in a
      liquid-liquid extraction system

    where the radioactive daughter is separated from its parent by

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} elution from the ion exchange column, or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a solvent extraction procedure. ([générateur de
      radionucléide]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 22
- SOR/2013-74, s. 15
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.03.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.03.001"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.03.001.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.001.1 .sectionLabel}** No
distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(b) or importer shall sell
a drug unless it has been fabricated, packaged/labelled, tested and
stored in accordance with this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 23
:::

**[[C.03.002 to C.03.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.002_to_C.03.005
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/97-12, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

**[[C.03.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.012 .sectionLabel}** On written
request from the Minister, every fabricator, packager/labeller, tester,
distributor referred to in paragraph C.01A.003(b) and importer of a drug
shall submit protocols of tests together with samples of any lot or
master lot of the drug before it is sold, and no person shall sell a lot
of which the protocol or sample fails to meet the requirements of these
Regulations.

**[[C.03.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.013 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall fabricate or import a drug that is derived from animal tissue
unless the tissue is obtained from a healthy animal free from infectious
disease.

::: HistoricalNote

#### [Radiopharmaceuticals]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576486 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.201]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.201 .sectionLabel}** In these
Regulations, [[radiopharmaceutical]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug
that exhibits spontaneous disintegration of unstable nuclei with the
emission of nuclear particles or photons.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 29
:::

- **[[C.03.202]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.202
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every package containing a
  radiopharmaceutical, other than a radionuclide generator, shall carry,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} on both the inner and the outer labels,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the proper name of the drug, which proper name,
      where there is a brand name, shall immediately precede or follow
      the brand name,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name of the distributor referred to in
      paragraph C.01A.003(b),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the lot number, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number assigned for the
      radiopharmaceutical, preceded by the expression "Drug
      Identification Number" or "[Drogue : identification
      numérique]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", or both, or the abbreviation
      "DIN"; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} on the outer label

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the address of the distributor referred to in
      paragraph C.01A.003(b),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the standard that the drug professes to meet, if
      that standard is referred to in any publication mentioned in
      Schedule B to the Act,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the pharmaceutical form or the
      route of administration of the drug,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the recommended use and the
      recommended radioactivity to be administered for that use, or a
      reference to an accompanying package insert that shows such
      information,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2017-259, s. 16\]]{.Repealed}

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the radiation warning symbol set out in Schedule
      3 to the [Radiation Protection
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2000-203) and the words
      "[RAYONNEMENT]{.otherLang lang="fr"} --- DANGER --- RADIATION",

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} the names and a statement of the amounts of any
      preservatives or stabilizing agents contained in the drug,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} the names and a statement of the amounts of
      all other non-radioactive contents of the drug,

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the total radioactivity content
      of the drug including overfill,

    - [(x)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the total volume of the drug
      including overfill, except where its contents are entirely in
      gaseous, capsule or lyophilized form,

    - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the concentration of radioactive
      material in the drug expressed as

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} units of radioactivity per capsule or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} units of radioactivity per unit volume,

      except where the contents of the drug are entirely in gaseous or
      lyophilized form,

    - [(xii)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the specific activity of the
      drug expressed as units of radioactivity per unit weight of
      carrier present or the statement "carrier-free" or "[sans
      entraîneur]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", whichever is applicable,

    - [(xiii)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the reference time in respect
      of the radioactivity values mentioned in subparagraphs (ix), (xi)
      and (xii), the name of the month being written or designated by
      letter abbreviation,

    - [(xiv)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the recommended useful life or
      the date after which the drug is not recommended for use, the name
      of the month being written or designated by letter abbreviation,
      and

    - [(xv)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the special storage requirements
      with reference to temperature and light.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subparagraph (1)(a)(iv) does not apply to a
  radiopharmaceutical that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} compounded by a pharmacist under a prescription or
    by a practitioner; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sold under a prescription, if the
    radiopharmaceutical's label indicates

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its proper name, common name or brand name,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} its potency, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the name of its manufacturer.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subparagraph (1)(b)(viii) of this section does not
  apply where the information referred to in that subparagraph is shown
  on a package insert that accompanies the drug.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Section C.01.005 does not apply to a
  radiopharmaceutical.

- **[[C.03.204]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.204
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a drug that
  contains technetium-99m at any time during its useful life if it also
  contains a radionuclidic impurity set out in the monograph for Sodium
  Pertechnetate Tc-99m Injection referred to in the publication set out
  in item 8 of Schedule B to the Act, in an amount greater than that
  shown in the monograph.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a radionuclide generator from
  which can be removed a drug that contains technetium-99m, at any time
  during the useful life of the drug, if the drug also contains a
  radionuclidic impurity set out in the monograph for Sodium
  Pertechnetate Tc-99m Injection referred to in the publication set out
  in item 8 of Schedule B to the Act, in an amount greater than that
  shown in the monograph.

#### [Drugs, Other than Radionuclides, Sold or Represented for Use in the Preparation of Radiopharmaceuticals]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576550 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2017-259, s. 18(F)

\]
:::

**[[C.03.205]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.205 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this section and in sections C.03.206 to C.03.209.

[[component]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[component]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a unit of a drug, other than a radionuclide,
      separately packaged in a kit; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an empty vial or other accessory item in a
      kit. ([constituant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[kit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[kit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a package that is intended to be
    used in the preparation of radiopharmaceuticals and that

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} contains one or more separately packaged units of
      a drug, other than a radionuclide; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may contain empty vials or other accessory
      items. ([trousse]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/79-236, s. 4
- SOR/2017-259, s. 19
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.03.205-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.03.205"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.03.206]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.206 .sectionLabel}** Sections
C.01.005 and C.04.009 do not apply to a component or kit.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/79-236, s. 4
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 22](#1496776-1533628){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496776-1533628.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.03.206-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.03.206"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.03.207]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.207
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every component shall be labelled to
  show

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} adequate identification of the component and an
    adequate description of its function;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where applicable, a quantitative list of its
    ingredients or a reference to the label of the kit that shows such
    information;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name of the distributor referred to in
    paragraph C.01A.003(b);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the lot number;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a statement of any special storage requirements
    with respect to temperature and light;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the date after which the component is not
    recommended for use, the name of the month being written in full or
    designated by letter abbreviation; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} adequate directions for use or a reference to the
    accompanying package insert that shows such directions.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The component of a kit that is intended to contain
  the prepared radiopharmaceutical shall be labelled to display the drug
  identification number assigned for the kit, preceded by the expression
  "Drug Identification Number" or "[Drogue : identification
  numérique]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", or both, or the abbreviation "DIN".

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/79-236, s. 4
- SOR/97-12, s. 58
- SOR/2017-259, s. 20
- SOR/2018-69, s. 23(F)
:::

**[[C.03.208]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.208 .sectionLabel}** Every kit
shall be labelled to show

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its proper name;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} its brand name, if any;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a list of its contents;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the distributor referred to
  in paragraph C.01A.003(b);

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number assigned for the kit,
  preceded by the expression "Drug Identification Number" or "[Drogue :
  identification numérique]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", or both, or the
  abbreviation "DIN";

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the lot number;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a statement of any special storage requirements with
  respect to temperature and light;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} the date after which the kit is not recommended for
  use, the name of the month being written in full or designated by
  letter abbreviation;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} where the label of a component makes reference to the
  label of the kit that shows information as to the ingredients of the
  component, a quantitative list of the ingredients of that component;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the sterility and apyrogenicity of the
  components;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} adequate directions for preparing the
  radiopharmaceutical or a reference to the accompanying package insert
  that shows such directions;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the duration of the useful life of the
  prepared radiopharmaceutical;

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the storage requirements for the
  prepared radiopharmaceutical;

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the recommended use for the prepared
  radiopharmaceutical and the recommended radioactivity to be
  administered for that use, or a reference to the accompanying package
  insert that shows such information; and

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the route of administration of the
  prepared radiopharmaceutical.

**[[C.03.209]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.209 .sectionLabel}** A package
insert shall be included in every kit and shall show

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the proper name and the brand name, if any, of the
  kit and a description of its use;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a list of the contents of the kit;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the distributor referred to
  in paragraph C.01A.003(b) of the kit;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} identification of the radionuclides that can be used
  to prepare the radiopharmaceutical;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} directions for preparing the radiopharmaceutical and
  a statement of the storage requirements for the prepared
  radiopharmaceutical;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the duration of the useful life of the
  prepared radiopharmaceutical;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} a description of the biological actions of the
  prepared radiopharmaceutical;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} indications and contraindications in respect of the
  prepared radiopharmaceutical;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} warnings and precautions in respect of the components
  and the prepared radiopharmaceutical;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} the adverse reactions, if any, associated with the
  prepared radiopharmaceutical;

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} where applicable, the pharmacology and toxicology of
  the prepared radiopharmaceutical or a statement that such information
  is available on request;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} the radiation dosimetry in respect of the prepared
  radiopharmaceutical;

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the recommended use for the prepared
  radiopharmaceutical and the recommended radioactivity to be
  administered for that use;

- [(n)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the route of administration of the
  prepared radiopharmaceutical; and

- [(o)]{.lawlabel} a recommendation that the radiochemical purity and
  radioactivity content of the prepared radiopharmaceutical be checked
  prior to administration.
