#### [Positron-emitting Radiopharmaceuticals]{.HTitleText3} {#h-576614 .Subheading}

##### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576615 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.301]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.301 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this section and in sections C.03.302 to C.03.319.

[[adverse reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[adverse reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an undesirable and
    unintended response in a study subject or other person to a study
    drug that is caused by the administration of any dose of the study
    drug. ([réaction indésirable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[good clinical practices]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[good clinical practices]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means generally
    accepted clinical practices that are designed to protect the rights,
    safety and well-being of study subjects and other persons. ([bonnes
    pratiques cliniques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a study drug, to
    import it into Canada for sale for the purpose of a
    study. ([importer]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[other person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[other person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an individual who comes
    into physical contact with a study subject. ([autre
    personne]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[protocol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[protocol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document that describes the
    objectives, design, methodology, statistical considerations and
    organization of a study. ([protocole]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[qualified investigator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[qualified investigator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the physician
    and member in good standing of a professional medical association in
    Canada to whom a sponsor gives the responsibility for the proper
    conduct of the study at a given study site, who is entitled to
    practise their profession under the laws of the province where the
    study site is located. ([chercheur qualifié]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[research ethics board]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[research ethics board]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body described
    in section C.03.306. ([comité d'éthique de la
    recherche]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[serious adverse reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[serious adverse reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an adverse
    reaction that results in any of the following consequences for the
    study subject or other person:

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their in-patient hospitalization or its
      prolongation;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a congenital malformation;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} persistent or significant disability or
      incapacity;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a life-threatening condition; or

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} death. ([réaction indésirable
      grave]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[serious unexpected adverse reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[serious unexpected adverse reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    serious adverse reaction that is not identified in nature, severity
    or frequency in the risk information set out on the label of the
    study drug. ([réaction indésirable grave et
    imprévue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[sponsor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[sponsor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is responsible
    for the conduct of a study. ([promoteur]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[study]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[study]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a basic clinical research study
    that involves human subjects and that is described in sections
    C.03.304 and C.03.305. ([étude]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[study drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[study drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a positron-emitting
    radiopharmaceutical that is used in a study. ([drogue destinée à
    l'étude]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[study site]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[study site]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the location where all or
    part of a study is conducted. ([lieu d'étude]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Application]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576637 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.302]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.302
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Sections C.03.303 to C.03.319 apply
  to the sale and importation of study drugs.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Sections C.03.001 to C.03.209 and Divisions 5 and 8
  do not apply to study drugs.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Sections C.03.303 to C.03.319 do not apply to a study
  drug manufactured from a bulk process intermediate that is of
  biological origin.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Prohibition]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576644 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.303]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.303 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell or import a study drug unless all of the following
requirements are met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the study drug is for use only in a study;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the study drug has been previously tested in human
  subjects and its safety in humans has been demonstrated;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the study drug is to be imported, the manufacturer
  of the drug has a representative in Canada who is responsible for its
  sale;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor is authorized under section C.03.309 to
  sell or import the study drug; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor complies with sections C.03.310 to
  C.03.316.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Purpose of Study]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576653 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.304]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.304
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The purpose of a study is to obtain
  data on any of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the pharmacokinetics or metabolism of the study
    drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} normal human biochemistry or physiology; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} changes caused to human biochemistry or physiology
    by aging, disease or medical interventions.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A study is not primarily intended to do any of the
  following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} discover, identify or verify the pharmacodynamic
    effects of the study drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} identify adverse reactions;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} fulfil an immediate therapeutic or diagnostic
    purpose; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} ascertain the safety or efficacy of the study drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576666 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.305]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.305
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A study shall meet all of the
  following requirements:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} before the study drug is used in the study, there
    is sufficient data from testing it in animals and humans to
    demonstrate its safety in humans;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the amount of active ingredients or combination of
    active ingredients in the study drug has been shown not to cause any
    clinically detectable pharmacodynamic effect in humans;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the total radiation dose incurred annually by a
    study subject, including from multiple administrations of the study
    drug, from significant contaminants or from impurities and from the
    use of other procedures for the purposes of the study, will be not
    more than 50 mSv;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any concomitant drug used in the study has been
    assigned a drug identification number under subsection C.01.014.2(1)
    or, in the case of a concomitant drug that is a new drug, has been
    issued a notice of compliance under section C.08.004;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} study subjects shall be at least 18 years old and
    have legal capacity at the time of the study;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} female study subjects shall

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} be confirmed at the outset of the study, on the
      basis of a pregnancy test, as not being pregnant or state in
      writing that they are not pregnant, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} be advised that if they are lactating, they are
      to suspend lactation for 24 hours after the administration of the
      study drug; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the study shall not involve more than 30 study
    subjects.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (1)(g), a study may involve more
  than 30 study subjects if the sponsor provides the Minister with a
  scientific rationale for the increase and the Minister approves it.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Research Ethics Board]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576681 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.306]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.306 .sectionLabel}** A research
ethics board has all of the following characteristics:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its principal mandate is to approve the initiation of
  and to periodically review biomedical research that involves human
  subjects in order to protect their rights, safety and well-being;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} it has at least five members, a majority of whom are
  Canadian citizens or permanent residents under the [Immigration and
  Refugee Protection Act](/eng/acts/I-2.5), is composed of both men and
  women and includes at least the following:

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} two members whose primary experience and expertise
    are in a scientific discipline, who have broad experience in the
    methods and areas of research to be approved and one of whom is from
    a medical discipline,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} one member knowledgeable in ethics,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} one member knowledgeable in Canadian laws
    relevant to the research to be approved,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} one member whose primary experience and expertise
    are in a non-scientific discipline, and

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} one member who is from the community or is a
    representative of an organization interested in the areas of
    research to be approved and who is not affiliated with the sponsor
    or with the study site; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} it has no affiliations with the sponsor that could
  compromise its ability to fulfil its principal mandate, or that could
  be perceived to do so.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Application for Authorization]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576693 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.307]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.307
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall submit to the
  Minister an application for authorization to sell or import a study
  drug that contains the information set out in subsection (2) as well
  as sufficient information to demonstrate that all of the following
  criteria are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the use of the study drug will not endanger the
    health of any study subject or other person;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the study is not contrary to the best interests of
    the study subjects; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the objectives of the study can reasonably be
    achieved.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application shall contain all of the following
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the title of the study and the protocol code or
    identification;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the purposes and a concise description of the
    study;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the number of study subjects;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the brand name, if any, of the study drug;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the chemical or generic name of the active
    ingredients in the study drug;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a qualitative list of the non-active ingredients of
    the study drug;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the maximum mass of the study drug to be
    administered to each study subject;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the radioactive dose range of the study drug,
    expressed in MBq or mCi;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the effective dose or effective dose equivalent of
    the study drug, expressed in mSv/MBq or rem/mCi;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor's name and civic address, its postal
    address if different, and its telephone number, fax number and email
    address;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer's name and civic address, its
    postal address if different, and its telephone number, fax number
    and email address;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an application for importation, the
    name and civic address, the postal address if different, and the
    telephone number, fax number and email address of the manufacturer's
    representative in Canada who is responsible for the sale of the
    study drug;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} the name and civic address of each study site;

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} for each study site, the name, civic address,
    telephone number, fax number and email address of the qualified
    investigator;

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} the proposed starting date for the study at each
    study site, if known;

  - [(p)]{.lawlabel} for each study site, the name, civic address,
    telephone number, fax number and email address of the research
    ethics board;

  - [(q)]{.lawlabel} a statement, dated and signed by the research
    ethics board for each study site, that certifies that it has
    reviewed and approved the study, the protocol and the statement of
    the risks and anticipated benefits arising to the health of study
    subjects as a result of participating in the study that is set out
    in the informed consent form;

  - [(r)]{.lawlabel} a list of any previous applications for an
    authorization to sell or import a drug for a study related to the
    current study; and

  - [(s)]{.lawlabel} a statement, dated and signed by the sponsor's
    senior medical or scientific officer in Canada and senior executive
    officer, that certifies both of the following:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the study will be conducted in accordance with
      these Regulations, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all of the information contained or referred to
      in the application is complete and accurate and is not false or
      misleading.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Additional Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576723 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.308]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.308 .sectionLabel}** If the
information submitted under section C.03.307 is insufficient to enable
the Minister to determine whether the sale or importation of the study
drug should be authorized, the Minister may, by notice in writing,
request the sponsor to provide any additional information that is
necessary to make the determination and that is relevant to the study
drug, the study or the protocol, by the date specified in the notice.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Authorization]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576727 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.309]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.309 .sectionLabel}** After
examining the application and any additional information, the Minister
shall authorize the sponsor to sell or import the study drug if she or
he determines that the application complies with the requirements of
section C.03.307, and shall send a notice of that decision to the
sponsor that specifies the study sites in respect of which the sale or
importation are authorized.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Notice]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576731 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.310]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.310 .sectionLabel}** The sponsor
shall notify the Minister in writing of the day on which the sale or
importation of the study drug is intended to start in respect of each
study site, not later than 15 days before that day.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Good Clinical Practices]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576735 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.311]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.311 .sectionLabel}** A sponsor
shall ensure that each study is conducted in accordance with good
clinical practices and that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the study is scientifically sound and clearly
  described in its protocol;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the study is conducted, and the study drug is used,
  in accordance with the protocol and with these Regulations;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} systems and procedures are implemented that assure
  the quality of every aspect of the study;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} at each study site, there is only one qualified
  investigator;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} at each study site, medical care and medical
  decisions, in respect of the study, are under the supervision of the
  qualified investigator;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} each individual who is involved in the conduct of the
  study is qualified by their education, training and experience to
  perform their respective tasks;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} before a study subject participates in the study, a
  copy of their signed consent form is included in the records for the
  study;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} the requirements respecting information and records
  set out in section C.03.315 are met; and

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} the study drug is manufactured, handled and stored in
  accordance with Division 2, other than sections C.02.019, C.02.025 and
  C.02.026.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Labelling]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576748 .Subheading}

**[[C.03.312]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.312 .sectionLabel}** Despite any
other provision of these Regulations respecting labelling, the sponsor
shall ensure that the study drug

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} bears an inner label that sets out both of the
  following:

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the unique batch number for the study drug, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the radiation warning symbol set out in Schedule 3
    to the [Radiation Protection
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2000-203) and the words
    "[RAYONNEMENT]{.otherLang lang="fr"} --- DANGER --- RADIATION"; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} is accompanied by a package insert that sets out all
  of the following information:

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement that indicates that the study drug is
    to be used only under the supervision of a qualified investigator,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the chemical or generic name of the active
    ingredients in the study drug,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the name and civic address of the manufacturer,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the name and civic address of the sponsor,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the code or other identification of the protocol,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the warnings and precautions in respect of the use
    of the study drug, and

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} a list of the possible adverse reactions that are
    associated with the use of the study drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
- SOR/2018-69, s. 24(F)
- [SOR/2021-46, s. 9(F)](#1288911-1290082){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1288911-1290082.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.03.312-20180404.html "Link to previous version of section C.03.312"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Submission of Information]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576763 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.313]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.313
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} On the Minister's written request, a
  sponsor shall submit, within the period specified in the request,
  information to establish the safety of the study drug if the Minister
  has reason to believe any of the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the use of the study drug may endanger the health
    of a study subject or other person;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the study may be contrary to the best interests of
    the study subjects;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a qualified investigator is not respecting their
    undertaking made under paragraph C.03.315(3)(f); or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} information submitted in respect of the study drug
    or study is false or misleading.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, by notice in writing, require the
  sponsor to provide the Minister with any information or records
  referred to in subsection C.03.315(3) to assess the safety of the
  study drug or the health of the study subjects or other persons, by
  the date specified in the notice.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Adverse Reaction Reporting]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576773 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.314]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.314
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} During the course of a study, the
  sponsor shall notify the Minister of any serious adverse reaction or
  serious unexpected adverse reaction that occurs inside or outside
  Canada, within the following period:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the adverse reaction is fatal or
    life-threatening, within seven days after becoming aware of it; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the adverse reaction is not fatal or
    life-threatening, within 15 days after becoming aware of it.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall, within eight days after having
  notified the Minister under subsection (1), file with the Minister a
  complete report in respect of the adverse reaction, including an
  assessment of the importance and implication of the findings.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Sections C.01.016 to C.01.020 do not apply to study
  drugs.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Records]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576782 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.315]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.315
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall record, handle and
  store all information in respect of a study in a way that allows it to
  be reported completely and accurately and to be interpreted and
  verified.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall maintain complete and accurate
  records to establish that the study is conducted in accordance with
  these Regulations.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall maintain all of the following
  records in respect of the use of the study drug in each study:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} records respecting all adverse reactions that occur
    inside or outside Canada, including the indications for use and the
    dosage form of the study drug at the time of the adverse reaction;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} written procedures for subject monitoring and for
    the documentation and reporting of adverse reactions;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} articles from scientific journals or other
    publications that were used in support of the safety profile of the
    study drug in respect of humans;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} records in respect of each study subject, including
    respecting their enrolment, a copy of their signed consent form and
    sufficient information to enable them to be identified and contacted
    in the event that the sale of the study drug may endanger their
    health or that of another person;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} records respecting the shipment, receipt, sale,
    return and destruction or other disposition of the study drug;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} for each study site, an undertaking, dated and
    signed by the qualified investigator before the start of the study,
    that they will

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} conduct the study in accordance with good
      clinical practices, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} on discontinuance of the study by the sponsor,
      for any reason related to health or safety, immediately inform
      both the study subjects and the research ethics board of the
      discontinuance, provide them with the reasons for the
      discontinuance and advise them in writing of any potential risks
      to the health of study subjects or other persons;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} for each study site, a copy of the informed consent
    form; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} for each study site, a copy of the certifying
    statement described in paragraph C.03.307(2)(q), of the protocol for
    the study and of the statement of the risks and anticipated benefits
    arising to the health of study subjects as a result of participating
    in the study that is set out in the informed consent form.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall maintain all records for five years
  after the day on which the study ends.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Discontinuance of a Study]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576800 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.316]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.316
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a sponsor discontinues a study in
  its entirety or at a study site, the sponsor shall notify all
  qualified investigators of the discontinuance as soon as possible in
  writing, and include in the notice the reasons for the discontinuance
  and whether the study presented any risks to the health of study
  subjects or other persons.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the discontinuance is for reasons that would
  affect the health or safety of study subjects or other persons, the
  sponsor shall notify the Minister in writing within 15 days after the
  discontinuance, and include in the notice the reasons for the
  discontinuance and whether it will have an impact on any proposed or
  ongoing studies in respect of the study drug in Canada by the sponsor.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Suspension]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576806 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.317]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.317
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall suspend an
  authorization to sell or import a study drug, in its entirety or in
  respect of a study site, in any of the following circumstances:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} information provided by the sponsor under section
    C.03.307, C.03.308 or C.03.313 proves to be inaccurate or
    incomplete;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor fails to provide the Minister with
    sufficient information to establish the safety of the study drug
    pursuant to a written request under section C.03.313, by the date
    specified in the request;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor fails to notify the Minister of an
    adverse reaction or file a report in respect of an adverse reaction
    in accordance with section C.03.314; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor contravenes a provision of these
    Regulations or any provision of the Act in relation to the study
    drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In determining whether to suspend an authorization in
  its entirety or in respect of a study site, the Minister shall
  consider whether the reason for the suspension affects the study in
  its entirety or affects only a certain study site.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before suspending an authorization, the Minister
  shall send the sponsor a notice that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} specifies whether the suspension is of the study
    authorization in its entirety or in respect of a study site and sets
    out the reasons for the proposed suspension and the effective date;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, specifies the corrective action that
    the sponsor must take and the period within which it must be taken;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} gives the sponsor a reasonable opportunity to be
    heard in writing concerning the proposed suspension.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (3), the Minister shall
  immediately suspend an authorization if she or he has reason to
  believe that it is necessary to do so to prevent injury to the health
  of a study subject or any other person.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} When the Minister suspends an authorization under
  subsection (4), the Minister must send the sponsor a notice that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sets out the reasons for the suspension;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, specifies the corrective action that
    the sponsor must take and the period within which it must be taken;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} gives the sponsor a reasonable opportunity to be
    heard in writing concerning the suspension.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Reinstatement]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576825 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.318]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.318
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  Minister shall reinstate the authorization if the sponsor provides the
  Minister with sufficient evidence to establish that the study does not
  present a risk of injury to the health of study subjects or other
  persons, within the following periods:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a suspension under subsection
    C.03.317(1), 30 days after the day on which the suspension is
    effective; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a suspension under subsection
    C.03.317(4), the period specified in the notice sent under
    subsection C.03.317(5).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister does not reinstate any part of an
  authorization that was suspended, the Minister shall amend the
  authorization to remove that part.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

##### [Cancellation]{.HTitleText4} {#h-576833 .Subheading}

- **[[C.03.319]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.03.319
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall cancel an
  authorization, in its entirety or in respect of a study site, in
  either of the following circumstances:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the study is discontinued in its entirety or at
    that study site by the sponsor under section C.03.316; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor fails to provide the Minister with the
    evidence required by subsection C.03.318(1) within the specified
    period.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} When the Minister cancels all or part of an
  authorization, she or he shall send the sponsor a notice that sets out
  the reasons for the cancellation and the effective date.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2012-129, s. 5
:::

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[Schedule D Drugs]{.HTitleText2} {#h-576841 .Subheading}

#### [Definitions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533855 .Subheading}

**[[C.04.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.001 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Division.

[[biological source material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[biological source material]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} biological material sourced or derived from
      humans;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} animals, including insects, or any biological
      material sourced or derived from them;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} plants or any biological material sourced or
      derived from them; or

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} micro-organisms, including bacteria, viruses,
      fungi and bacteriophages, or any biological material sourced or
      derived from them. ([matériel d'origine
      biologique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that is listed in Schedule
    D to the Act that is in dosage form or an active ingredient that can
    be used in the preparation of a drug listed in that
    Schedule. ([drogue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[holder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[holder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a drug identification
    number assigned for a drug, means the manufacturer to whom a
    document setting out the number was issued under subsection
    C.01.014.2(1). ([titulaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 31
- SOR/2013-74, s. 16
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533856){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533856.html"}
:::

#### [Prohibitions on Sale]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533866 .Subheading}

**[[C.04.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.002 .sectionLabel}** It is
prohibited for a distributor or importer of a drug to sell the drug
unless it has been fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested in
accordance with this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/97-12, s. 33
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533868){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533868.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.04.002-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.04.002"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.04.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.003 .sectionLabel}** It is
prohibited for a person to sell a drug that they have fabricated,
packaged/labelled or tested unless they have fabricated,
packaged/labelled or tested it, as the case may be, in accordance with
this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533872){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533872.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.04.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.04.003"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Biological Source Material]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533869 .Subheading}

- **[[C.04.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for a person to use
  biological source material in the fabrication of a drug unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the biological source material is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} prepared and stored in a manner that ensures its
      suitability for use in the fabrication of the drug, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} collected, in the case of material of human or
      animal origin, under medical or veterinary supervision, as the
      case may be;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person collects the information that is
    necessary to allow the tracing of the biological source material;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any human from whom, or animal from which, the
    biological source material is collected --- or any animal that is
    such material --- is free from any disease that would make the
    material unsuitable for use in the fabrication of the drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who uses biological source material in the
  fabrication of a drug must ensure that the material meets any
  specifications for the material that have been provided to the
  Minister in connection with the drug.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person who uses biological source material in the
  fabrication of a drug must retain any documents containing the
  information referred to in paragraph (1)(b) for a period that they
  determine after taking into account the following factors, but the
  period must end no earlier than five years after the day on which the
  biological source material was last used in the fabrication of the
  drug:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the nature of the biological source material;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the risks associated with the biological source
    material;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the manner in which the biological source material
    is used in the fabrication of the drug; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the fabricated drug is in dosage form, the
    intended use of the drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533887){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533887.html"}
:::

#### [Prevention of Contamination]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533888 .Subheading}

- **[[C.04.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every person who fabricates a drug
  and every person who packages a drug in an immediate container must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} segregate all work involving infectious agents that
    require special handling, including spore-bearing pathogenic
    micro-organisms; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} minimize the possibility of contamination of
    biological source material and drugs at the premises where the
    person fabricates or packages the drug, including by taking measures
    to protect against infection any individual who has access to the
    area where the person fabricates or packages the drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for a person to conduct laboratory
  procedures of a diagnostic nature in their premises unless the conduct
  of those procedures is segregated from the fabrication,
  packaging/labelling and testing of drugs.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533895){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533895.html"}
:::

#### [Reference Preparations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533896 .Subheading}

**[[C.04.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.006 .sectionLabel}** Reference
preparations that are used to test the purity or potency of a drug must
allow for the control of the quality of the drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533899){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533899.html"}
:::

#### [Lot Release]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533900 .Subheading}

- **[[C.04.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[suitable for
  sale]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a lot of a drug, means that
  the lot has been fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested in
  accordance with these Regulations and in a manner that is consistent
  with information provided to the Minister regarding the quality and
  safety of the drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, for the purpose of assessing
  whether a lot of a drug in dosage form is suitable for sale, request
  that the following persons provide the Minister with any information,
  samples of the drug or its active ingredients, or material to be used
  to test the samples:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a fabricator of the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a packager/labeller of the drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an importer of the drug; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the holder of the drug identification number.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for a person who is requested to
  provide information, samples or material under subsection (2), and any
  other person whom the Minister notifies of the request, to sell drugs
  from the lot to which the request relates unless the Minister notifies
  the person that the lot is suitable for sale.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533910){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533910.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.04.007-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.04.007"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Periodic Quality Reporting]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533911 .Subheading}

**[[C.04.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.008 .sectionLabel}** The holder of
the drug identification number for a drug in dosage form must, at the
request of the Minister, provide the Minister, on an annual basis or at
any longer interval specified by the Minister, with information
regarding the quality of the drug and its active ingredients, including
information regarding the consistency of the fabrication and packaging
processes for the drug and the ingredients.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533914){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533914.html"}
:::

#### [Labelling]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533917 .Subheading}

- **[[C.04.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The principal display panel of both
  the inner and outer labels of a drug in dosage form must show

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the drug's brand name, if any;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the drug's proper name, if any, which, if there is
    a brand name, must immediately precede or follow the brand name in
    type not less than one-half the size of that of the brand name;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if there is no proper name, the drug's common name,
    which, if there is a brand name, must immediately precede or follow
    the brand name in type not less than one-half the size of that of
    the brand name;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the net quantity of the drug in the immediate
    container for the purpose of the inner label and the net quantity of
    the drug in the outer package for the purpose of the outer label;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} if the drug is sterile, an indication to that
    effect;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} if any of the drug's medicinal ingredients are
    sourced or derived from human biological source material, an
    indication to that effect; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} if any of the drug's medicinal ingredients are
    sourced or derived from animal biological source material, the
    animal species from which each of those ingredients is sourced or
    derived.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The inner and outer labels of a drug in dosage form
  must show on any panel

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the holder of the drug identification
    number assigned for the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the potency of the drug, if applicable;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the recommended dose of the drug;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the lot number of the drug;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the drug;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} adequate directions for use of the drug; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} any other information that is necessary to prevent
    injury to human health.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (2)(f) does not apply if adequate
  directions for use of the drug must be displayed on the label in
  accordance with section C.01.004.02 or C.01.004.03.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (2)(g), if another provision of
  these Regulations requires that information referred to in that
  paragraph be shown on a particular panel of a label, the information
  must be shown on that panel.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The outer label of a drug in dosage form must show on
  any panel

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the address of the holder of the drug
    identification number assigned for the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a quantitative list of any preservatives contained
    in the drug, by their proper names, or if a preservative has no
    proper name, by its common name;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the approved storage conditions for the drug;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any other information that is necessary for the
    proper storage and handling of the drug, accompanied, as the case
    may be, by any designated space for the addition of supplementary
    information in this regard by the person who stores or handles the
    drug; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for extraordinary use in
    respect of which a notice of compliance has been issued under
    section C.08.004.01, the following statement, displayed in capital
    letters and in a legible manner:

    "HEALTH CANADA HAS AUTHORIZED THE SALE OF THIS EXTRAORDINARY USE NEW
    DRUG FOR \[naming purpose\] BASED ON LIMITED CLINICAL TESTING IN
    HUMANS.

    [SANTÉ CANADA A AUTORISÉ LA VENTE DE CETTE DROGUE NOUVELLE POUR
    USAGE EXCEPTIONNEL AUX FINS DE \[indication de la fin\] EN SE
    FONDANT SUR DES ESSAIS CLINIQUES RESTREINTS CHEZ L'ÊTRE
    HUMAIN.]{.otherLang lang="fr"}"

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The inner label requirements of these Regulations do
  not apply in respect of a drug in dosage form whose immediate
  container is too small to accommodate an inner label that meets those
  requirements if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the inner label shows

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the drug's brand name, if any,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug's proper name, if any,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the drug's common name, if there is no proper
      name,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number assigned for that
      drug, preceded by the expression "Drug Identification Number" or
      "Drogue : identification numérique", or both, or the abbreviation
      "DIN",

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the name of the holder of the drug identification
      number assigned for the drug,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the net quantity of the drug in the container,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} the drug's potency, if applicable, unless the
      drug contains more than one medicinal ingredient and the drug's
      brand name is unique for a particular potency of the drug,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} the drug's lot number,

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} the drug's expiration date,

    - [(x)]{.lawlabel} the drug's route of administration, and

    - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} any other information that is necessary to
      prevent injury to human health; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the outer label meets the applicable requirements
    of these Regulations.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} The expiration date referred to in paragraph (2)(e)
  and subparagraph (6)(a)(ix) may be omitted from the label of a drug
  that is to be stockpiled by the following entities for use in
  emergency situations if the date is communicated by an alternative
  means to the individuals who administer the drug:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Government of Canada or the government of a
    province for the use of a department or agency of that government;
    or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a municipal government or an institution of a
    municipal government.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533963){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533963.html"}
:::

#### [Labelling --- Prescription Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1533964 .Subheading}

- **[[C.04.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.04.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a drug in dosage form
  that is a prescription drug, the symbol "Pr" must be shown on

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the upper left quarter of the principal display
    panel of both the inner and the outer labels; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the drug is packaged in a single-dose container,
    on the upper left quarter of the principal display panel of the
    outer label.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a drug that is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sold to a person who holds an establishment licence
    under Division 1A; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sold by a pharmacist under a prescription or by a
    practitioner, if its label shows suitable directions for use and
    meets the requirements set out in section C.01.005.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 23](#1496778-1533973){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496778-1533973.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Drugs for Clinical Trials Involving Human Subjects]{.HTitleText2} {#h-577812 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577813 .Subheading}

**[[C.05.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.001 .sectionLabel}** The
definitions in this section apply in this Division.

[[adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any noxious and
    unintended response to a drug that is caused by the administration
    of any dose of the drug. ([réaction indésirable à une
    drogue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[adverse event]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[adverse event]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any adverse occurrence
    in the health of a clinical trial subject who is administered a
    drug, that may or may not be caused by the administration of the
    drug, and includes an adverse drug reaction. ([incident
    thérapeutique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[clinical trial]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[clinical trial]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an investigation in
    respect of a drug for use in humans that involves human subjects and
    that is intended to discover or verify the clinical, pharmacological
    or pharmacodynamic effects of the drug, identify any adverse events
    in respect of the drug, study the absorption, distribution,
    metabolism and excretion of the drug, or ascertain the safety or
    efficacy of the drug. ([essai clinique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug for human use that is to
    be tested in a clinical trial. ([drogue]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[good clinical practices]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[good clinical practices]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means generally
    accepted clinical practices that are designed to ensure the
    protection of the rights, safety and well-being of clinical trial
    subjects and other persons, and the good clinical practices referred
    to in section C.05.010. ([bonnes pratiques
    cliniques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[import]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means to import a drug into Canada
    for the purpose of sale in a clinical
    trial. ([importer]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[investigator's brochure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[investigator's brochure]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of
    a drug, a document containing the preclinical and clinical data on
    the drug that are described in paragraph C.05.005(e). ([brochure du
    chercheur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[protocol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[protocol]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a document that describes the
    objectives, design, methodology, statistical considerations and
    organization of a clinical trial. ([protocole]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[qualified investigator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[qualified investigator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the person
    responsible to the sponsor for the conduct of the clinical trial at
    a clinical trial site, who is entitled to provide health care under
    the laws of the province where that clinical trial site is located,
    and who is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a clinical trial respecting a drug
      to be used for dental purposes only, a physician or dentist and a
      member in good standing of a professional medical or dental
      association; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, a physician and a member in
      good standing of a professional medical association. ([chercheur
      qualifié]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[research ethics board]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[research ethics board]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body that is
    not affiliated with the sponsor, and

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the principal mandate of which is to approve the
      initiation of, and conduct periodic reviews of, biomedical
      research involving human subjects in order to ensure the
      protection of their rights, safety and well-being; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that has at least five members, that has a
      majority of members who are Canadian citizens or permanent
      residents under the [Immigration and Refugee Protection
      Act](/eng/acts/I-2.5), that is composed of both men and women and
      that includes at least

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} two members whose primary experience and
        expertise are in a scientific discipline, who have broad
        experience in the methods and areas of research to be approved
        and one of whom is from a medical discipline or, if the clinical
        trial is in respect of a drug to be used for dental purposes
        only, is from a medical or dental discipline,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} one member knowledgeable in ethics,

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} one member knowledgeable in Canadian laws
        relevant to the biomedical research to be approved,

      - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} one member whose primary experience and
        expertise are in a non-scientific discipline, and

      - [(v)]{.lawlabel} one member who is from the community or is a
        representative of an organization interested in the areas of
        research to be approved and who is not affiliated with the
        sponsor or the site where the clinical trial is to be conducted.
        ([comité d'éthique de la recherche]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[serious adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[serious adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
    adverse drug reaction that requires in-patient hospitalization or
    prolongation of existing hospitalization, that causes congenital
    malformation, that results in persistent or significant disability
    or incapacity, that is life threatening or that results in
    death. ([réaction indésirable grave à une drogue]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[serious unexpected adverse drug reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[serious unexpected adverse drug
    reaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a serious adverse drug reaction
    that is not identified in nature, severity or frequency in the risk
    information set out in the investigator's brochure or on the label
    of the drug. ([réaction indésirable grave et imprévue à une
    drogue]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[sponsor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[sponsor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an individual, corporate body,
    institution or organization that conducts a clinical
    trial. ([promoteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- 2001, c. 27, s. 273
- SOR/2012-16, s. 1(F)
- SOR/2013-56, s. 1(F)
:::

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577839 .Subheading}

- **[[C.05.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), this
  Division applies to the sale or importation of drugs to be used for
  the purposes of clinical trials involving human subjects.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Except for paragraph C.05.003(a), subsections
  C.05.006(2) and (3), paragraphs C.05.010(a) to (i), section C.05.011,
  subsections C.05.012(1) and (2), paragraphs C.05.012(3)(a) to (d)
  and (f) to (h), subsection C.05.012(4) and sections C.05.013, C.05.016
  and C.05.017, this Division does not apply to the sale or importation
  of a drug for the purposes of a clinical trial authorized under
  subsection C.05.006(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
:::

#### [Prohibition]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577845 .Subheading}

**[[C.05.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.003 .sectionLabel}** Despite
sections C.01.014, C.08.002, C.08.002.02 and C.08.003, no person shall
sell or import a drug for the purposes of a clinical trial unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the person is authorized under this Division;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person complies with this Division and sections
  C.01.015, C.01.036, C.01.037 to C.01.040, C.01.040.2, C.01.064 to
  C.01.067, C.01.070, C.01.131, C.01.133 to C.01.136, and C.01.435; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the drug is to be imported, the person has a
  representative in Canada who is responsible for the sale of the drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2011-88, s. 7
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.05.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.003"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577852 .Subheading}

**[[C.05.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.004 .sectionLabel}** Despite these
Regulations, a sponsor may submit an application under this Division to
sell or import a drug for the purposes of a clinical trial that contains
a substance the sale of which is prohibited by these Regulations, if the
sponsor establishes, on the basis of scientific information, that the
inclusion of the substance in the drug may result in a therapeutic
benefit for a human being.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
:::

#### [Application for Authorization]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577856 .Subheading}

**[[C.05.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.005 .sectionLabel}** An
application by a sponsor for authorization to sell or import a drug for
the purposes of a clinical trial under this Division shall be submitted
to the Minister, signed and dated by the sponsor's senior medical or
scientific officer in Canada and senior executive officer and shall
contain the following information and documents:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the protocol for the clinical trial;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the statement, as it will be set out in
  each informed consent form, that states the risks and anticipated
  benefits arising to the health of clinical trial subjects as a result
  of their participation in the clinical trial;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a clinical trial attestation, signed and dated by the
  sponsor's senior medical or scientific officer in Canada and senior
  executive officer, containing

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the title of the protocol and the clinical trial
    number,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the brand name, the chemical name or the code for
    the drug,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the therapeutic and pharmacological
    classifications of the drug,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the medicinal ingredients of the drug,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the non-medicinal ingredients of the drug,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the dosage form of the drug,

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} the name, address and telephone number and, if
    applicable, the facsimile number and electronic mail address of the
    sponsor,

  - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} if the drug is to be imported, the name, address
    and telephone number and, if applicable, the facsimile number and
    electronic mail address of the sponsor's representative in Canada
    who is responsible for the sale of the drug,

  - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} for each clinical trial site, the name, address
    and telephone number and, if applicable, the facsimile number and
    electronic mail address of the qualified investigator, if known at
    the time of submitting the application,

  - [(x)]{.lawlabel} for each clinical trial site, the name, address and
    telephone number and, if applicable, the facsimile number and
    electronic mail address of the research ethics board that approved
    the protocol referred to in paragraph (a) and approved an informed
    consent form containing the statement referred to in paragraph (b),
    if known at the time of submitting the application, and

  - [(xi)]{.lawlabel} a statement

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} that the clinical trial will be conducted in
      accordance with good clinical practices and these Regulations, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} that all information contained in, or referenced
      by, the application is complete and accurate and is not false or
      misleading;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name, address and telephone number and, if
  applicable, the facsimile number and electronic mail address of any
  research ethics board that has previously refused to approve the
  protocol referred to in paragraph (a), its reasons for doing so and
  the date on which the refusal was given, if known at the time of
  submitting the application;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} an investigator's brochure that contains the
  following information, namely,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the physical, chemical and pharmaceutical
    properties of the drug,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the pharmacological aspects of the drug, including
    its metabolites in all animal species tested,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the pharmacokinetics of the drug and the drug
    metabolism, including the biological transformation of the drug in
    all animal species tested,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any toxicological effects in any animal species
    tested under a single dose study, a repeated dose study or a special
    study in respect of the drug,

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} any results of carcinogenicity studies in any
    animal species tested in respect of the drug,

  - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} any results of clinical pharmacokinetic studies of
    the drug,

  - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} any information regarding drug safety,
    pharmacodynamics, efficacy and dose responses of the drug that were
    obtained from previous clinical trials in humans, and

  - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} if the drug is a radiopharmaceutical as defined
    in section C.03.201, information regarding directions for preparing
    the radiopharmaceutical, the radiation dosimetry in respect of the
    prepared radiopharmaceutical and a statement of the storage
    requirements for the prepared radiopharmaceutical;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} if the drug contains a human-sourced excipient,
  including any used in the placebo,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} information that indicates the human-sourced
    excipient has been assigned a drug identification number under
    subsection C.01.014.2(1) or, in the case of a new drug, issued a
    notice of compliance under subsection C.08.004(1), as the case may
    be, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, sufficient information to
    support the identity, purity, potency, stability and safety of the
    human-sourced excipient;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} if the drug has not been assigned a drug
  identification number under subsection C.01.014.2(1) or, in the case
  of a new drug, a notice of compliance has not been issued under
  section C.08.004 or C.08.004.01, the chemistry and manufacturing
  information in respect of the drug, including its site of manufacture;
  and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} the proposed date for the commencement of the
  clinical trial at each clinical trial site, if known at the time of
  submitting the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2011-88, s. 8
- SOR/2012-16, s. 2(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.05.005-20110325.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.005"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Authorization]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577891 .Subheading}

- **[[C.05.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), a sponsor
  may sell or import a drug, other than a drug described in subsection
  (2), for the purposes of a clinical trial if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor has submitted to the Minister an
    application in accordance with section C.05.005;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister does not, within 30 days after the
    date of receipt of the application, send to the sponsor a notice in
    respect of the drug indicating that the sponsor may not sell or
    import the drug for any of the following reasons:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that the information and documents in respect of
      the application

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} were not provided in accordance with these
        Regulations, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} are insufficient to enable the Minister to
        assess the safety and risks of the drug or the clinical trial,
        or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that based on an assessment of the application,
      an assessment of any information submitted under section C.05.009
      or a review of any other information, the Minister has reasonable
      grounds to believe that

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the use of the drug for the purposes of the
        clinical trial endangers the health of a clinical trial subject
        or other person,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the clinical trial is contrary to the best
        interests of a clinical trial subject, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} the objectives of the clinical trial will not
        be achieved;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} for each clinical trial site, the sponsor has
    obtained the approval of the research ethics board in respect of the
    protocol referred to in paragraph C.05.005(a) and in respect of an
    informed consent form that contains the statement referred to in
    paragraph C.05.005(b); and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} before the sale or importation of the drug at a
    clinical trial site, the sponsor submits to the Minister the
    information referred to in subparagraphs C.05.005(c)(ix) and (x) and
    paragraphs C.05.005(d) and (h), if it was not submitted in respect
    of that clinical trial site at the time of submitting the
    application.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), a sponsor may sell or
  import a drug for the purposes of a clinical trial in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a new drug that has been issued a notice of
    compliance under subsection C.08.004(1), if the clinical trial is in
    respect of a purpose or condition of use for which the notice of
    compliance was issued; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a drug, other than a new drug, that has been
    assigned a drug identification number under subsection
    C.01.014.2(1), if the clinical trial is in respect of a use or
    purpose for which the drug identification number was assigned.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A sponsor may not sell or import a drug for the
  purposes of a clinical trial

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} during the period of any suspension made under
    section C.05.016 or C.05.017; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} after a cancellation made under section C.05.016 or
    C.05.017.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 3(F)
:::

#### [Notification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577913 .Subheading}

**[[C.05.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.007 .sectionLabel}** If the sale
or importation of a drug is authorized under this Division, the sponsor
may make one or more of the following changes if the sponsor notifies
the Minister in writing within 15 days after the date of the change:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a change to the chemistry and manufacturing
  information that does not affect the quality or safety of the drug,
  other than a change for which an amendment is required by section
  C.05.008; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a change to the protocol that does not alter the risk
  to the health of a clinical trial subject, other than a change for
  which an amendment is required by section C.05.008.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 4(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.05.007-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.007"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Amendment]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577919 .Subheading}

- **[[C.05.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.008
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4) and (5),
  when the sale or importation of a drug is authorized under this
  Division and the sponsor proposes to make an amendment referred to in
  subsection (2), the sponsor may sell or import the drug for the
  purposes of the clinical trial in accordance with the amended
  authorization, if the following conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor has submitted to the Minister an
    application for amendment in accordance with subsection (3);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister does not, within 30 days after the
    date of receipt of the application for amendment, send to the
    sponsor a notice in respect of the drug indicating that the sponsor
    may not sell or import the drug in accordance with the amendment for
    any of the following reasons, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} that the information and documents in respect of
      the application for amendment

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} were not provided in accordance with these
        Regulations, or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} are insufficient to enable the Minister to
        assess the safety and risks of the drug or the clinical trial,
        or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} that based on an assessment of the application
      for amendment, an assessment of any information submitted under
      section C.05.009 or a review of any other information, the
      Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the use of the drug for the purposes of the
        clinical trial endangers the health of a clinical trial subject
        or other person,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the clinical trial is contrary to the best
        interests of a clinical trial subject, or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} the objectives of the clinical trial will not
        be achieved;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} before the sale or importation of the drug, the
    sponsor submits to the Minister

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} for each clinical trial site, the name, address
      and telephone number and, if applicable, the facsimile number and
      electronic mail address of the research ethics board that approved
      any amended protocol submitted under paragraph (3)(a) or approved
      any amended statement submitted under paragraph (3)(c), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name, address and telephone number and, if
      applicable, the facsimile number and electronic mail address of
      any research ethics board that has previously refused to approve
      any amendment to the protocol, its reasons for doing so and the
      date on which the refusal was given;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} before the sale or importation of the drug, the
    sponsor maintains records concerning

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in paragraph
      C.05.005(h), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in subparagraph
      C.05.005(c)(ix), if any of that information has changed since it
      was submitted;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} before the sale or importation of the drug in
    accordance with the amended authorization, the sponsor ceases to
    sell or import the drug in accordance with the existing
    authorization; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor conducts the clinical trial in
    accordance with the amended authorization.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), amendments are

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} amendments to the protocol that affect the
    selection, monitoring or dismissal of a clinical trial subject;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} amendments to the protocol that affect the
    evaluation of the clinical efficacy of the drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} amendments to the protocol that alter the risk to
    the health of a clinical trial subject;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} amendments to the protocol that affect the safety
    evaluation of the drug;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} amendments to the protocol that extend the duration
    of the clinical trial; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} amendments to the chemistry and manufacturing
    information that may affect the safety or quality of the drug.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The application for amendment referred to in
  subsection (1) shall contain a reference to the application submitted
  under section C.05.005 and shall contain the following documents and
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the application is in respect of an amendment
    referred to in any of paragraphs (2)(a) to (e), a copy of the
    amended protocol that indicates the amendment, a copy of the
    protocol submitted under paragraph C.05.005(a), and the rationale
    for the amendment;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the application is in respect of an amendment
    referred to in paragraph (2)(e), a copy of the amended
    investigator's brochure or an addendum to the investigator's
    brochure that indicates the new information, including supporting
    toxicological studies and clinical trial safety data;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the application is in respect of an amendment
    referred to in any of paragraphs (2)(a) to (f) and, as a result of
    that amendment, it is necessary to amend the statement referred to
    in paragraph C.05.005(b), a copy of the amended statement that
    indicates the amendment; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if the application is in respect of an amendment
    referred to in paragraph (2)(f), a copy of the amended chemistry and
    manufacturing information that indicates the amendment, and the
    rationale for that amendment.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the sponsor is required to immediately make one or
  more of the amendments referred to in subsection (2) because the
  clinical trial or the use of the drug for the purposes of the clinical
  trial endangers the health of a clinical trial subject or other
  person, the sponsor may immediately make the amendment and shall
  provide the Minister with the information referred to in
  subsection (3) within 15 days after the date of the amendment.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} A sponsor may not sell or import a drug for the
  purposes of a clinical trial

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} during the period of any suspension made under
    section C.05.016 or C.05.017; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} after a cancellation made under section C.05.016 or
    C.05.017.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 5
:::

#### [Additional Information and Samples]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577957 .Subheading}

**[[C.05.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.009 .sectionLabel}** If the
information and documents submitted in respect of an application under
section C.05.005 or an application for amendment under section C.05.008
are insufficient to enable the Minister to determine whether any of the
reasons referred to in paragraph C.05.006(1)(b) or C.05.008(1)(b) exist,
the Minister may require the sponsor to submit, within two days after
receipt of the request, samples of the drug or additional information
relevant to the drug or the clinical trial that are necessary to make
the determination.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 6(F)
:::

[Previous
Version](section-C.05.009-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.009"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Sponsor's Obligations]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577961 .Subheading}

#### [Good Clinical Practices]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577962 .Subheading}

**[[C.05.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.010 .sectionLabel}** Every sponsor
shall ensure that a clinical trial is conducted in accordance with good
clinical practices and, without limiting the generality of the
foregoing, shall ensure that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the clinical trial is scientifically sound and
  clearly described in a protocol;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the clinical trial is conducted, and the drug is
  used, in accordance with the protocol and this Division;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} systems and procedures that assure the quality of
  every aspect of the clinical trial are implemented;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} for each clinical trial site, the approval of a
  research ethics board is obtained before the clinical trial begins at
  the site;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} at each clinical trial site, there is no more than
  one qualified investigator;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} at each clinical trial site, medical care and medical
  decisions, in respect of the clinical trial, are under the supervision
  of the qualified investigator;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} each individual involved in the conduct of the
  clinical trial is qualified by education, training and experience to
  perform his or her respective tasks;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} written informed consent, given in accordance with
  the applicable laws governing consent, is obtained from every person
  before that person participates in the clinical trial but only after
  that person has been informed of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the risks and anticipated benefits to his or her
    health arising from participation in the clinical trial, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all other aspects of the clinical trial that are
    necessary for that person to make the decision to participate in the
    clinical trial;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} the requirements respecting information and records
  set out in section C.05.012 are met; and

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} the drug is manufactured, handled and stored in
  accordance with the applicable good manufacturing practices referred
  to in Divisions 2 to 4 except sections C.02.019, C.02.025 and
  C.02.026.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 7(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.05.010-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.010"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Labelling]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577978 .Subheading}

**[[C.05.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.011 .sectionLabel}** Despite any
other provision of these Regulations respecting labelling, the sponsor
shall ensure that the drug bears a label that sets out the following
information in both official languages:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement indicating that the drug is an
  investigational drug to be used only by a qualified investigator;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, number or identifying mark of the drug;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the expiration date of the drug;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the recommended storage conditions for the drug;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the lot number of the drug;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the sponsor;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the protocol code or identification; and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} if the drug is a radiopharmaceutical as defined in
  section C.03.201, the information required by subparagraph
  C.03.202(1)(b)(vi).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 8(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.05.011-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.011"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Records]{.HTitleText3} {#h-577990 .Subheading}

- **[[C.05.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.012
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall record, handle and
  store all information in respect of a clinical trial in a way that
  allows its complete and accurate reporting as well as its
  interpretation and verification.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall maintain complete and accurate
  records to establish that the clinical trial is conducted in
  accordance with good clinical practices and these Regulations.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall maintain complete and accurate
  records in respect of the use of a drug in a clinical trial, including

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a copy of all versions of the investigator's
    brochure for the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} records respecting each change made to the
    investigator's brochure, including the rationale for each change and
    documentation that supports each change;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} records respecting all adverse events in respect of
    the drug that have occurred inside or outside Canada, including
    information that specifies the indication for use and the dosage
    form of the drug at the time of the adverse event;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} records respecting the enrolment of clinical trial
    subjects, including information sufficient to enable all clinical
    trial subjects to be identified and contacted in the event that the
    sale of the drug may endanger the health of the clinical trial
    subjects or other persons;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} records respecting the shipment, receipt,
    disposition, return and destruction of the drug;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} for each clinical trial site, an undertaking from
    the qualified investigator that is signed and dated by the qualified
    investigator prior to the commencement of his or her
    responsibilities in respect of the clinical trial, that states that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the qualified investigator will conduct the
      clinical trial in accordance with good clinical practices, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the qualified investigator will immediately, on
      discontinuance of the clinical trial by the sponsor, in its
      entirety or at a clinical trial site, inform both the clinical
      trial subjects and the research ethics board of the
      discontinuance, provide them with the reasons for the
      discontinuance and advise them in writing of any potential risks
      to the health of clinical trial subjects or other persons;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} for each clinical trial site, a copy of the
    protocol, informed consent form and any amendment to the protocol or
    informed consent form that have been approved by the research ethics
    board for that clinical trial site; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} for each clinical trial site, an attestation,
    signed and dated by the research ethics board for that clinical
    trial site, stating that it has reviewed and approved the protocol
    and informed consent form and that the board carries out its
    functions in a manner consistent with good clinical practices.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall maintain all records referred to in
  this Division for a period of 15 years.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- [SOR/2022-18, s. 55](#1339209-1339500){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1339209-1339500.html"}
:::
