#### [Submission of Information and Samples]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578008 .Subheading}

- **[[C.05.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.013
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall require a sponsor
  to submit, within two days after receipt of the request, information
  concerning the drug or the clinical trial, or samples of the drug, if
  the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the use of the drug for the purposes of the
    clinical trial endangers the health of a clinical trial subject or
    other person;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the clinical trial is contrary to the best
    interests of a clinical trial subject;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the objectives of the clinical trial will not be
    achieved;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a qualified investigator is not respecting the
    undertaking referred to in paragraph C.05.012(3)(f); or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} information submitted in respect of the drug or the
    clinical trial is false or misleading.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may require the sponsor to submit,
  within seven days after receipt of the request, any information or
  records kept under section C.05.012, or samples of the drug, in order
  to assess the safety of the drug or the health of clinical trial
  subjects or other persons.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 9(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.05.013-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.013"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Serious Unexpected Adverse Drug Reaction Reporting]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578019 .Subheading}

- **[[C.05.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.014
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} During the course of a clinical
  trial, the sponsor shall inform the Minister of any serious unexpected
  adverse drug reaction in respect of the drug that has occurred inside
  or outside Canada as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if it is neither fatal nor life threatening, within
    15 days after becoming aware of the information; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if it is fatal or life threatening, within seven
    days after becoming aware of the information.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The sponsor shall, within eight days after having
  informed the Minister under paragraph (1)(b), submit to the Minister a
  complete report in respect of that information that includes an
  assessment of the importance and implication of any findings made.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Sections C.01.016 to C.01.020 do not apply to drugs
  used for the purposes of a clinical trial.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2017-18, s. 16
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.05.014-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.014"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Discontinuance of a Clinical Trial]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578028 .Subheading}

- **[[C.05.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a clinical trial is discontinued
  by the sponsor in its entirety or at a clinical trial site, the
  sponsor shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} inform the Minister no later than 15 days after the
    date of the discontinuance;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide the Minister with the reason for the
    discontinuance and its impact on the proposed or ongoing clinical
    trials in respect of the drug conducted in Canada by the sponsor;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} as soon as possible, inform all qualified
    investigators of the discontinuance and of the reasons for the
    discontinuance, and advise them in writing of any potential risks to
    the health of clinical trial subjects or other persons; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in respect of each discontinued clinical trial
    site, stop the sale or importation of the drug as of the date of the
    discontinuance and take all reasonable measures to ensure the
    recovery of all unused quantities of the drug that have been sold.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the sponsor has discontinued the clinical trial in
  its entirety or at a clinical trial site, the sponsor may resume
  selling or importing the drug for the purposes of a clinical trial in
  its entirety or at a clinical trial site if, in respect of each
  clinical trial site where the sale or importation is to be resumed,
  the sponsor submits to the Minister the information referred to in
  subparagraphs C.05.005(c)(ix) and (x) and paragraphs C.05.005(d) and
  (h).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
:::

#### [Suspension and Cancellation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578038 .Subheading}

- **[[C.05.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.016
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  Minister shall suspend the authorization to sell or import a drug for
  the purposes of a clinical trial, in its entirety or at a clinical
  trial site, if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor has contravened these Regulations or
    any provisions of the Act relating to the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any information submitted in respect of the drug or
    clinical trial is false or misleading;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor has failed to comply with good clinical
    practices; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor has failed to provide

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} information or samples of the drug as required
      under section C.05.009 or C.05.013, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} information or a report under section C.05.014.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section C.05.017, the Minister shall not
  suspend an authorization referred to in subsection (1) unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has sent to the sponsor a written
    notice of the intention to suspend the authorization that indicates
    whether the authorization is to be suspended in its entirety or at a
    clinical trial site and the reason for the intended suspension;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the sponsor has not, within 30 days after receipt
    of the notice referred to in paragraph (a), provided the Minister
    with information or documents that demonstrate that the
    authorization should not be suspended on the grounds that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the situation giving rise to the intended
      suspension did not exist, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the situation giving rise to the intended
      suspension has been corrected; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has provided the sponsor with the
    opportunity to be heard in paragraph (b).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall suspend the authorization by
  sending to the sponsor a written notice of suspension of the
  authorization that indicates the effective date of the suspension,
  whether the authorization is suspended in its entirety or at a
  clinical trial site and the reason for the suspension.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister has suspended an authorization under
  subsection (1), the Minister shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} reinstate the authorization in its entirety or at a
    clinical trial site, as the case may be, if within 30 days after the
    effective date of the suspension the sponsor provides the Minister
    with information or documents that demonstrate that the situation
    giving rise to the suspension has been corrected; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} cancel the authorization in its entirety or at a
    clinical trial site, as the case may be, if within 30 days after the
    effective date of the suspension the sponsor has not provided the
    Minister with the information or documents referred to in paragraph
    (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 10
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.05.016-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.05.016"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.05.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.05.017
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall suspend an
  authorization to sell or import a drug for the purposes of a clinical
  trial, in its entirety or at a clinical trial site, before giving the
  sponsor an opportunity to be heard if the Minister has reasonable
  grounds to believe that it is necessary to do so to prevent injury to
  the health of a clinical trial subject or other person.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall suspend the authorization by
  sending to the sponsor a written notice of suspension of the
  authorization that indicates the effective date of the suspension,
  whether the authorization is suspended in its entirety or at a
  clinical trial site and the reason for the suspension.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister has suspended an authorization under
  subsection (1), the Minister shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} reinstate the authorization in its entirety or at a
    clinical trial site, as the case may be, if within 60 days after the
    effective date of the suspension the sponsor provides the Minister
    with information or documents that demonstrate that the situation
    giving rise to the suspension did not exist or that it has been
    corrected; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} cancel the authorization in its entirety or at a
    clinical trial site, as the case may be, if within 60 days after the
    effective date of the suspension the sponsor has not provided the
    Minister with the information or documents referred to in paragraph
    (a).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2001-203, s. 4
- SOR/2012-16, s. 11
:::

#### [General]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578086 .Subheading}

**[[C.06.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.001 .sectionLabel}** In this
Division,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} solubility and specific gravity shall be determined
  at 25°C;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} tests for identity, quantitative tests for arsenic,
  lead, copper, zinc, fluorine, and sulphur dioxide, and limit tests
  shall be made by the official methods; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} determination of physical and chemical constants
  shall be carried out by acceptable methods.

#### [Conjugated Estrogens]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578091 .Subheading}

**[[C.06.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.002 .sectionLabel}** **\[S\].
Conjugated estrogens** shall be the drug conjugated estrogens described
in The Pharmacopeia of the United States of America, XVIII (1970),
except that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dilute assay preparation A, assay preparations A
  and B and equilin reagent described therein shall be prepared by
  official method DO-29, Conjugated Estrogens, October 15, 1981; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the identification test described therein shall be
  performed by official method DO-29, Conjugated Estrogens, October 15,
  1981.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-429, s. 5
:::

#### [Conjugated Estrogens for Injection]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578097 .Subheading}

**[[C.06.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.003 .sectionLabel}** **\[S\].
Conjugated estrogens for injection** shall be the drug conjugated
estrogens for injection described in The Pharmacopeia of the United
States of America, XVIII (1970), except that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dilute assay preparation A, assay preparations A
  and B and equilin reagent described therein shall be prepared by
  official method DO-29, Conjugated Estrogens, October 15, 1981; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the identification test described therein shall be
  performed by official method DO-29, Conjugated Estrogens, October 15,
  1981.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-429, s. 6
:::

#### [Conjugated Estrogens Tablets]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578103 .Subheading}

**[[C.06.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.004 .sectionLabel}** **\[S\].
Conjugated estrogens tablets** shall be the drug conjugated estrogens
tablets described in The Pharmacopeia of the United States of America,
XVIII (1970), except that

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dilute assay preparation A, assay preparations A
  and B and equilin reagent described therein shall be prepared by
  official method DO-29, Conjugated Estrogens, October 15, 1981; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the identification test described therein shall be
  performed by official method DO-29, Conjugated Estrogens, October 15,
  1981.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-429, s. 7
:::

.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/80-544, s. 12\]]{.Repealed}

**[[C.06.120]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.120 .sectionLabel}** **\[S\].
Digitoxin** shall be the drug digitoxin described in the Pharmacopeia of
the United States of America.

#### [Digoxin]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578114 .Subheading}

#### [Digoxin Elixir]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578116 .Subheading}

**[[C.06.131]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.131 .sectionLabel}** **\[S\].

#### [Digoxin Injection]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578118 .Subheading}

#### [Gelatin]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578130 .Subheading}

**[[C.06.170]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.170 .sectionLabel}** Gelatin shall

or the British Pharmacopeia.

**[[C.06.180 to C.06.183]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.180_to_C.06.183
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/80-544, s. 12\]]{.Repealed}

**[[C.06.230 to C.06.233]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.230_to_C.06.233
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/80-544, s. 12\]]{.Repealed}

**[[C.06.240 to C.06.242]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.240_to_C.06.242
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/80-544, s. 12\]]{.Repealed}

#### [Thyroid]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578135 .Subheading}

**[[C.06.250]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.250 .sectionLabel}** **Thyroid**
shall be the cleaned, dried, powdered thyroid glands of domestic animals
used for food, and shall contain not less than 0.17 per cent, and not
more than 0.23 per cent iodine and no added iodine in either inorganic
or organic form, and

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its characters are

  *Description*, ---

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} *General*, --- thyroid occurs as a cream-coloured,
    amorphous powder; the odour and taste are faint and meat-like, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} *Microscopical*, --- when suitably mounted and
    examined under the microscope, thyroid shows the following: numerous
    smooth to striated hyaline fragments of colloids, of angular to
    irregular shape, that are colourless to pale yellow in water mounts,
    brown in *Mallory's stain* and pink in *solution of eosin*, some of
    these fragments containing granules, minute vacuoles, crystalloidal
    bodies and cells; numerous irregular fragments of follicular
    epithelium staining brown with *Mallory's stain*, the individual
    cells more or less polygonal to rounded-angular or irregularly
    cuboidal, often with prominent nuclei staining dark blue, their
    cytoplasm purplish with *Delafield's solution of haematoxylin*;
    slender glistening segments of capillaries of closely undulate
    outline; numerous slender segments of neuraxons; numerous aggregates
    of particles of intercellular substance and slender, mostly straight
    connective tissue fibres staining blue to greenish blue with a
    mixture of *Mallory's stain* and *solution of phosphotungstic acid*,
    the bundles of fibres often appearing reddish in *Mallory's stain*;
    few glistening fragments of blood vessels with serrated or crenated
    ends as viewed in water mounts; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the tests for its purity are

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} *Inorganic iodine*, --- add to one gram of thyroid
    10 millilitres of a saturated solution of *zinc sulphate* in
    *water*, shake, allow to stand five minutes, and filter through a
    fritted glass filter; add to five millilitres of the filtrate
    0.5 millilitre of *mucilage of starch* and four drops each of a 10
    per cent w/v solution of *sodium nitrite* in *water and dilute
    sulphuric acid*, shaking after each addition: no blue colour is
    produced, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} *Moisture*, --- thyroid loses not more than six
    per cent moisture.

**[[C.06.251]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.06.251 .sectionLabel}** Thyroid shall
be

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} assayed by official method DO-26, Thyroid,
  October 15, 1981; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} stored in a cool place and in a tightly-closed
  container.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/82-429, s. 8
:::

### [DIVISION 7]{.HLabel2}[Sale of Drugs for the Purposes of Implementing the General Council Decision]{.HTitleText2} {#h-578152 .Subheading}

#### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578153 .Subheading}

**[[C.07.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.001 .sectionLabel}** The
definitions in this section apply in this Division.

[[Commissioner of Patents]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Commissioner of Patents]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
    Commissioner of Patents appointed under subsection 4(1) of the
    Patent Act. ([commissaire aux brevets]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[General Council Decision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[General Council Decision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the meaning
    assigned by subsection 30(6) of the Act. ([décision du Conseil
    général]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578159 .Subheading}

**[[C.07.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.002 .sectionLabel}** This Division
applies to the sale of drugs for the purposes of implementing the
General Council Decision.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

#### [Application for Authorization]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578163 .Subheading}

**[[C.07.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.003 .sectionLabel}** An
application by a manufacturer for authorization to sell a drug under
this Division shall be submitted to the Minister and shall contain the
following information and documents:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement that the manufacturer intends to file an
  application with the Commissioner of Patents under section 21.04 of
  the [Patent Act](/eng/acts/P-4);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a new drug, the submission number and
  date of filing of the new drug submission or abbreviated new drug
  submission filed under section C.08.002 or C.08.002.1, respectively,
  and of any supplement filed under section C.08.003 in respect of the
  drug;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a drug that is not a new drug,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the application number and date of filing of the
    application that has been filed under section C.01.014.1 in respect
    of the drug, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number, if one has been
    assigned in respect of the drug pursuant to section C.01.014.2;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} for a drug in a solid dosage form, the manner in
  which the drug is marked in accordance with paragraph C.07.008(a) and
  evidence that such manner does not alter the safety and efficacy of
  the drug;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} for a drug in a dosage form that is not solid, the
  manner in which the immediate container is marked in accordance with
  paragraph C.07.008(a); and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} a sample of the label for the drug that includes the
  information required by paragraph C.07.008(c).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

#### [Authorization]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578175 .Subheading}

**[[C.07.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.004 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall notify the manufacturer and the Commissioner of Patents for the
purposes of paragraph 21.04(3)(b) of the [Patent Act](/eng/acts/P-4)
that the manufacturer's drug meets the requirements of the Act and these
Regulations if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer has submitted to the Minister an
  application in accordance with section C.07.003 and a copy of the
  application filed by the manufacturer with the Commissioner of Patents
  under section 21.04 of the [Patent Act](/eng/acts/P-4);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a new drug, an examination of the new
  drug submission or abbreviated new drug submission or supplement to
  either submission by the Minister demonstrates that the submission or
  supplement complies with section C.08.002, C.08.002.1 or C.08.003, as
  the case may be, and section C.08.005.1;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a drug that is not a new drug, a drug
  identification number has been assigned pursuant to section
  C.01.014.2; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Minister is satisfied that the manufacturer and
  the drug comply with the Act and these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

**[[C.07.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.005 .sectionLabel}** Despite
sections C.01.014, C.08.002 and C.08.003, a manufacturer may sell a drug
under this Division if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has notified the Commissioner of Patents
  for the purposes of paragraph 21.04(3)(b) of the [Patent
  Act](/eng/acts/P-4) that the drug meets the requirements of the Act
  and these Regulations; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer has received authorization under
  section 21.04 of the [Patent Act](/eng/acts/P-4).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

**[[C.07.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.006 .sectionLabel}** Sections
C.01.005 and C.01.014.1 to C.01.014.4 do not apply to new drugs sold
under this Division.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

#### [Notice to Commissioner of Patents]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578191 .Subheading}

**[[C.07.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.007 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall notify the manufacturer and the Commissioner of Patents for the
purposes of paragraph 21.13(b) of the [Patent Act](/eng/acts/P-4) in the
event that the Minister is of the opinion that the manufacturer's drug
authorized to be sold under this Division has ceased to meet the
requirements of the Act and these Regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

#### [Marking and Labelling]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578195 .Subheading}

**[[C.07.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.008 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a drug under this Division unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the drug itself permanently bears the mark "XCL", in
  the case of a drug in a solid dosage form, or the immediate container
  permanently bears the mark "XCL", in the case of a drug in a dosage
  form that is not solid;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the colour of the drug itself is significantly
  different from the colour of the version of the drug sold in Canada,
  in the case of a drug in a solid dosage form; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the label of the drug permanently bears the mark
  "XCL", followed by the export tracking number assigned by the Minister
  under section C.07.009 and the words "FOR EXPORT UNDER THE GENERAL
  COUNCIL DECISION. NOT FOR SALE IN CANADA." or "[POUR EXPORTATION AUX
  TERMES DE LA DÉCISION DU CONSEIL GÉNÉRAL. VENTE INTERDITE AU
  CANADA]{.otherLang lang="fr"}."

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

**[[C.07.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.009 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
shall assign an export tracking number to each drug in respect of which
the Minister has notified the Commissioner of Patents under section
C.07.004.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

#### [Records]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578205 .Subheading}

**[[C.07.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.010 .sectionLabel}** The
manufacturer shall, with respect to a drug authorized to be sold under
this Division,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} establish and maintain records, in a manner that
  enables an audit to be made, respecting the information referred to in
  subsection C.08.007(1), and retain those records for at least seven
  years from the day on which they were established; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide to the Minister the summaries referred to in
  section C.08.008.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
- SOR/2014-125, s. 1
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.07.010-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.07.010"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Notice to Minister]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578211 .Subheading}

**[[C.07.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.07.011 .sectionLabel}** The
manufacturer shall notify the Minister in writing not less than 15 days
before commencing the manufacture of the first lot of a drug authorized
to be sold under this Division and not less than 15 days before the
exportation of each subsequent lot of the drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2005-141, s. 1
:::

### [DIVISION 8]{.HLabel2} {#h-578215 .Subheading}

#### [New Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578216 .Subheading}

**[[C.08.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.001 .sectionLabel}** For the
purposes of the Act and this Division, [[new drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
means a drug, other than a veterinary health product,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} that contains or consists of a substance, whether as
  an active or inactive ingredient, carrier, coating, excipient,
  menstruum or other component, that has not been sold as a drug in
  Canada for sufficient time and in sufficient quantity to establish in
  Canada the safety and effectiveness of that substance for use as a
  drug;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is a combination of two or more drugs, with or
  without other ingredients, and that has not been sold in that
  combination or in the proportion in which those drugs are combined in
  that drug, for sufficient time and in sufficient quantity to establish
  in Canada the safety and effectiveness of that combination and
  proportion for use as a drug; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} with respect to which the manufacturer prescribes,
  recommends, proposes or claims a use as a drug, or a condition of use
  as a drug, including dosage, route of administration or duration of
  action, and that has not been sold for that use or condition of use in
  Canada for sufficient time and in sufficient quantity to establish in
  Canada the safety and effectiveness of that use or condition of use of
  that drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/95-172, s. 2
- SOR/2017-76, s. 10
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.08.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.08.001"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[C.08.001.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.001.1 .sectionLabel}** For the
purposes of this Division,

[[Canadian reference product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Canadian reference product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a drug in respect of which a notice of compliance
      is issued under section C.08.004 or C.08.004.01 and which is
      marketed in Canada by the innovator of the drug,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a drug, acceptable to the Minister, that can be
      used for the purpose of demonstrating bioequivalence on the basis
      of pharmaceutical and, where applicable, bioavailability
      characteristics, where a drug in respect of which a notice of
      compliance has been issued under section C.08.004 or C.08.004.01
      cannot be used for that purpose because it is no longer marketed
      in Canada, or

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a drug, acceptable to the Minister, that can be
      used for the purpose of demonstrating bioequivalence on the basis
      of pharmaceutical and, where applicable, bioavailability
      characteristics, in comparison to a drug referred to in paragraph
      (a); ([produit de référence canadien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[designated COVID-19 drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[designated COVID-19 drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
    SOR/2024-238, s. 24\]]{.Repealed}

[[List of Conditions that Threaten Public Health]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[List of Conditions that Threaten Public
    Health]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the List of Conditions that
    Threaten Public Health in Canada, published on the Government of
    Canada's website, as amended from time to time; ([Liste d'affections
    qui menacent la santé publique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[pharmaceutical equivalent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[pharmaceutical equivalent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a new drug
    that, in comparison with another drug, contains identical amounts of
    the identical medicinal ingredients, in comparable dosage forms, but
    that does not necessarily contain the same non-medicinal
    ingredients; ([équivalent pharmaceutique]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[public health emergency drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[public health emergency drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a new
    drug for which the purpose and conditions of use recommended by the
    manufacturer relate to a condition that is described in the List of
    Conditions that Threaten Public Health; ([drogue pour urgence de
    santé publique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a detailed description
    of a new drug and of its ingredients and includes

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement of all properties and qualities of
      the ingredients that are relevant to the manufacture and use of
      the new drug, including the identity, potency and purity of the
      ingredients,

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the methods used for
      testing and examining the ingredients, and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the tolerances associated with the
      properties and qualities of the
      ingredients. ([spécifications]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- **[[C.08.001.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.001.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may add a condition to
  the List of Conditions that Threaten Public Health only if the
  Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the condition presents, or is the result of, a
    significant risk to public health in Canada; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} immediate action is required to deal with the risk.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} However, the Minister may add COVID-19 to the List of
  Conditions that Threaten Public Health, even if the criteria set out
  in subsection (1) are not met with respect to COVID-19 at the time of
  the addition, as long as the Minister has reasonable grounds to
  believe that the addition is necessary to protect public health or
  safety.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 25](#1496784-1503689){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496784-1503689.html"}
:::

**[[C.08.001.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.001.3 .sectionLabel}** If a
condition that is on the List of Conditions that Threaten Public Health
is removed from the list, a public health emergency drug that relates to
that condition continues to be considered a public health emergency drug
for the purposes of this Division if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of the public health emergency drug, a new
  drug submission has been filed under section C.08.002 or a supplement
  to a new drug submission has been filed under section C.08.003;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the condition is removed from the List after the
  submission or supplement is filed; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has not issued, in respect of the
  submission or supplement, a notice of compliance under section
  C.08.004 or a notice under paragraph C.08.004(3)(b).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2024-238, s. 25](#1496784-1503695){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1496784-1503695.html"}
:::

- **[[C.08.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell or advertise a
  new drug unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer of the new drug has filed with the
    Minister a new drug submission, an extraordinary use new drug
    submission, an abbreviated new drug submission or an abbreviated
    extraordinary use new drug submission relating to the new drug that
    is satisfactory to the Minister;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has issued, under section C.08.004 or
    C.08.004.01, a notice of compliance to the manufacturer of the new
    drug in respect of the submission; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the notice of compliance in respect of the
    submission has not been suspended under section C.08.006.

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2014-158, s. 10\]]{.Repealed}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A new drug submission shall contain sufficient
  information and material to enable the Minister to assess the safety
  and effectiveness of the new drug, including the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a description of the new drug and a statement of
    its proper name or its common name if there is no proper name;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the brand name of the new drug or
    the identifying name or code proposed for the new drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a list of the ingredients of the new drug, stated
    quantitatively, and the specifications for each of those
    ingredients;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a description of the plant and equipment to be used
    in the manufacture, preparation and packaging of the new drug;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} details of the method of manufacture and the
    controls to be used in the manufacture, preparation and packaging of
    the new drug;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} details of the tests to be applied to control the
    potency, purity, stability and safety of the new drug;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} detailed reports of the tests made to establish the
    safety of the new drug for the purpose and under the conditions of
    use recommended;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} substantial evidence of the clinical effectiveness
    of the new drug for the purpose and under the conditions of use
    recommended;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a statement of the names and qualifications of all
    the investigators to whom the new drug has been sold;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for veterinary use, a
    draft of every label to be used in connection with the new drug,
    including any package insert and any document that is provided on
    request and that sets out supplementary information on the use of
    the new drug;

  - [(j.1)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for human use, mock-ups
    of every label to be used in connection with the new drug ---
    including any package insert and any document that is provided on
    request and that sets out supplementary information on the use of
    the new drug --- and mock-ups of the new drug's packages;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} a statement of all the representations to be made
    for the promotion of the new drug respecting

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the recommended route of administration of the
      new drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the proposed dosage of the new drug,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the claims to be made for the new drug, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the contra-indications and side effects of the
      new drug;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} a description of the dosage form in which it is
    proposed that the new drug be sold;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} evidence that all test batches of the new drug used
    in any studies conducted in connection with the submission were
    manufactured and controlled in a manner that is representative of
    market production;

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug intended for
    administration to food-producing animals, the withdrawal period of
    the new drug; and

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for human use other than
    a public health emergency drug, an assessment as to whether there is
    a likelihood that the new drug will be mistaken for another drug for
    which a drug identification number has been assigned due to a
    resemblance between the brand name that is proposed to be used in
    respect of the new drug and the brand name, common name or proper
    name of the other drug.

- [(2.01)]{.lawlabel} If clinical trial data that is included in a new
  drug submission under paragraph (2)(g) or (h) or (2.1)(b) is broken
  down by population subgroup in an application made to the European
  Medicines Agency or the United States Food and Drug Administration to
  authorize the sale of the new drug, the data must be broken down in
  the same manner in the new drug submission.

- [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} A manufacturer may file, for a public health
  emergency drug, a new drug submission that does not meet the
  requirements set out in paragraphs (2)(g) and (h) if the submission
  contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement that the submission contains evidence
    to establish that the requirement set out in paragraph (b) is met;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sufficient evidence to support the conclusion that
    the benefits associated with the public health emergency drug
    outweigh the risks associated with it for the purpose and under the
    conditions of use recommended, with consideration given to the
    uncertainties relating to those benefits and risks as well as the
    public health need related to the applicable condition described in
    the List of Conditions that Threaten Public Health.

- [(2.2)]{.lawlabel} A manufacturer may file, for a public health
  emergency drug for human use, a new drug submission that does not meet
  the requirements set out in paragraph (2)(j.1) if the submission
  contains a draft of every label to be used in connection with the
  drug, including any package insert and any document provided on
  request that sets out supplementary information on the use of the
  drug.

- [(2.3)]{.lawlabel} If, at the time a new drug submission is filed for
  a public health emergency drug, the manufacturer is unable to provide
  the Minister with information or material that is referred to in any
  of paragraphs (2)(e) to (k), (m) and (n) and (2.1)(b) and subsection
  (2.2) --- and, as applicable, the corresponding material referred to
  in paragraphs C.08.005.1(1)(b) to (d) --- or any of that information
  or material is incomplete, the manufacturer must provide the Minister,
  at that time, with a plan that specifies how and when they will
  provide the Minister with the missing information or material.

- [(2.4)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (2.1) to (2.3) apply only if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the new drug submission contains a statement that
    the submission is for a public health emergency drug; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the purpose and conditions of use specified in the
    submission relate only to a condition described in the List of
    Conditions that Threaten Public Health and the submission contains a
    statement to that effect.

- [(2.5)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (2.1) to (2.3) do not apply if a notice
  of compliance is being sought on the basis of a direct or indirect
  comparison between the new drug and another drug.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of a new drug shall, at the request
  of the Minister, provide the Minister, where for the purposes of a new
  drug submission the Minister considers it necessary to assess the
  safety and effectiveness of the new drug, with the following
  information and material:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the names and addresses of the manufacturers of
    each of the ingredients of the new drug and the names and addresses
    of the manufacturers of the new drug in the dosage form in which it
    is proposed that the new drug be sold;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} samples of the ingredients of the new drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} samples of the new drug in the dosage form in which
    it is proposed that the new drug be sold; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any additional information or material respecting
    the safety and effectiveness of the new drug.

- **[[C.08.002.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.002.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A manufacturer of a new drug may
  file an extraordinary use new drug submission for the new drug if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the new drug is intended for

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} emergency use in situations where persons have
      been exposed to a chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear
      substance and action is required to treat, mitigate or prevent a
      life-threatening or other serious disease, disorder or abnormal
      physical state, or its symptoms, that results, or is likely to
      result, from that exposure, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} preventative use in persons who are at risk of
      exposure to a chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear
      substance that is potentially lethal or permanently disabling; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the requirements set out in paragraphs
    C.08.002(2)(g) and (h) cannot be met because

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} exposing human volunteers to the substance
      referred to in paragraph (a) would be potentially lethal or
      permanently disabling, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the circumstances in which exposure to the
      substance occurs are sporadic and infrequent.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (3) and (5), an extraordinary
  use new drug submission shall contain

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an attestation, signed and dated by the senior
    executive officer in Canada of the manufacturer filing the
    submission and by the manufacturer's senior medical or scientific
    officer, certifying that the conditions referred to in paragraphs
    (1)(a) and (b) are met, together with sufficient supporting
    information to enable the Minister to determine that those
    conditions are met; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sufficient information and material to enable the
    Minister to assess the safety and effectiveness of the new drug,
    including the following:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information and material described in
      paragraphs C.08.002(2)(a) to (f), (i) to (m) and (o),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} information respecting the pathophysiological
      mechanism for the toxicity of the chemical, biological,
      radiological or nuclear substance and describing the new drug's
      ability to treat, mitigate or prevent that mechanism,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} detailed reports of in vitro studies respecting
      the toxicity and activity of the new drug in relation to the
      recommended purpose,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} detailed reports of studies, in an animal
      species that is expected to react with a response that is
      predictive for humans, establishing the safety of the new drug,
      and providing substantial evidence of its effect, when used for
      the purpose and under the conditions of use recommended,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} information confirming that the end point of
      animal studies is clearly related to the desired benefit in
      humans,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} information demonstrating that there is a
      sufficient understanding of the pharmacokinetics and
      pharmacodynamics of the new drug in animals and in humans to
      enable inferences to be drawn in respect of humans so as to allow
      for the selection of an effective dose in humans,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} information respecting the safety of the new
      drug in humans, including detailed reports of clinical trials, if
      any, establishing the safety of the new drug,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} information, if any, respecting the
      effectiveness of the new drug in humans for the purpose or under
      the conditions of use recommended,

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} a plan for monitoring and establishing the
      safety and effectiveness of the new drug under the conditions of
      use recommended that includes procedures for gathering and
      analyzing data, and

    - [(x)]{.lawlabel} any available assessment reports regarding the
      new drug prepared by regulatory authorities in countries other
      than Canada.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Reports referred to in subparagraph (2)(b)(iii) or
  information referred to in subparagraph (2)(b)(vi) may be omitted if
  the extraordinary use new drug submission includes a detailed
  scientific explanation as to why the reports are or the information is
  not available.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Any information or material that is necessary to
  enable the Minister to assess the safety and effectiveness of the new
  drug shall, at the request of the Minister, be added to the
  extraordinary use new drug submission, including

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the names and addresses of the manufacturers of
    each of the ingredients of the new drug and the names and addresses
    of the manufacturers of the new drug in the dosage form in which it
    is proposed to be sold;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} samples of the ingredients of the new drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} samples of the new drug in the dosage form in which
    it is proposed to be sold; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any information omitted by virtue of subsection
    (3).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} If an extraordinary use new drug submission is in
  respect of a new purpose for a new drug for which a notice of
  compliance has been issued under section C.08.004, the information and
  material referred to in subparagraph (2)(b)(i) may be omitted unless
  any of it is different from that which was originally submitted.

- SOR/2014-158, s. 11

**[[C.08.002.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.002.02 .sectionLabel}** Despite
sections C.08.002 and C.08.003, no manufacturer or importer shall sell a
new drug for extraordinary use in respect of which a notice of
compliance has been issued under section C.08.004.01 except to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Government of Canada or the government of a
  province for the use of a department or agency of that government, on
  receipt of a written order signed by the minister responsible for the
  department or by the person in charge of the agency, or by their duly
  authorized representative; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a municipal government, or an institution of such a
  government, on receipt of a written order signed by a senior official
  of the government or institution or by his or her duly authorized
  representative.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2011-88, s. 11
:::

- **[[C.08.002.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.002.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A manufacturer of a new drug may
  file an abbreviated new drug submission or an abbreviated
  extraordinary use new drug submission for the new drug where, in
  comparison with a Canadian reference product,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the new drug is the pharmaceutical equivalent of
    the Canadian reference product;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the new drug is bioequivalent with the Canadian
    reference product, based on the pharmaceutical and, where the
    Minister considers it necessary, bioavailability characteristics;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the route of administration of the new drug is the
    same as that of the Canadian reference product; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the conditions of use for the new drug fall within
    the conditions of use for the Canadian reference product.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An abbreviated new drug submission or an abbreviated
  extraordinary use new drug submission shall contain sufficient
  information and material to enable the Minister to assess the safety
  and effectiveness of the new drug, including the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information and material described in

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs C.08.002(2)(a) to (f), (j) to (l) and
      (o), in the case of an abbreviated new drug submission, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} paragraphs C.08.002(2)(a) to (f), (j) to (l) and
      (o), and subparagraphs C.08.002.01(2)(b)(ix) and (x), in the case
      of an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug submission;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} information identifying the Canadian reference
    product used in any comparative studies conducted in connection with
    the submission;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} evidence from the comparative studies conducted in
    connection with the submission that the new drug is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the pharmaceutical equivalent of the Canadian
      reference product, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where the Minister considers it necessary on the
      basis of the pharmaceutical and, where applicable, bioavailability
      characteristics of the new drug, bioequivalent with the Canadian
      reference product as demonstrated using bioavailability studies,
      pharmacodynamic studies or clinical studies;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} evidence that all test batches of the new drug used
    in any studies conducted in connection with the submission were
    manufactured and controlled in a manner that is representative of
    market production; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} for a drug intended for administration to
    food-producing animals, sufficient information to confirm that the
    withdrawal period is identical to that of the Canadian reference
    product.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of a new drug shall, at the request
  of the Minister, provide the Minister, where for the purposes of an
  abbreviated new drug submission or an abbreviated extraordinary use
  new drug submission the Minister considers it necessary to assess the
  safety and effectiveness of the new drug, with the following
  information and material:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the names and addresses of the manufacturers of
    each of the ingredients of the new drug and the names and addresses
    of the manufacturers of the new drug in the dosage form in which it
    is proposed that the new drug be sold;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} samples of the ingredients of the new drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} samples of the new drug in the dosage form in which
    it is proposed that the new drug be sold; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any additional information or material respecting
    the safety and effectiveness of the new drug.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, in the case of an
  abbreviated new drug submission, a new drug for extraordinary use in
  respect of which a notice of compliance has been issued under section
  C.08.004.01 is not a Canadian reference product.

- **[[C.08.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section C.08.002, no person
  shall sell a new drug in respect of which a notice of compliance has
  been issued to the manufacturer of that new drug and has not been
  suspended under section C.08.006, if any of the matters specified in
  subsection (2) are significantly different from the information or
  material contained in the new drug submission, extraordinary use new
  drug submission, abbreviated new drug submission or abbreviated
  extraordinary use new drug submission, unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer of the new drug has filed with the
    Minister a supplement to that submission;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has issued a notice of compliance to
    the manufacturer of the new drug in respect of the supplement; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the notice of compliance in respect of the
    supplement has not been suspended under section C.08.006.

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2014-158, s. 13\]]{.Repealed}

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The matters specified for the purposes of subsection
  (1), in relation to the new drug, are the following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the description of the new drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the new drug or the identifying
    name or code proposed for the new drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the specifications of the ingredients of the new
    drug;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the plant and equipment used in manufacturing,
    preparation and packaging the new drug;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the method of manufacture and the controls used in
    manufacturing, preparation and packaging the new drug;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the tests applied to control the potency, purity,
    stability and safety of the new drug;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the labels used in connection with the new drug;

  - [(g.1)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for human use, its
    packages;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the representations made with regard to the new
    drug respecting

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the recommended route of administration of the
      new drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the dosage of the new drug,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the claims made for the new drug,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the contra-indications and side effects of the
      new drug, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the withdrawal period of the new drug; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the dosage form in which it is proposed that the
    new drug be sold.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A supplement to a submission referred to in
  subsection (1), with respect to the matters that are significantly
  different from those contained in the submission, shall contain
  sufficient information and material to enable the Minister to assess
  the safety and effectiveness of the new drug in relation to those
  matters.

- [(3.01)]{.lawlabel} If clinical trial data that is included in a
  supplement to a new drug submission is broken down by population
  subgroup in an application made to the European Medicines Agency or
  the United States Food and Drug Administration to authorize the sale
  of the new drug, the data must be broken down in the same manner in
  the supplement.

- [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} A supplement to a submission referred to in
  subsection (1) shall contain, as the case may be,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if, due to a matter specified in subsection (2) ---
    other than the brand name of a new drug for human use --- that the
    supplement concerns, it is necessary to modify a new drug's labels:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for veterinary use, a
      draft of every label to be used in connection with the new drug,
      including any package insert and any document that is provided on
      request and that sets out supplementary information on the use of
      the new drug, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for human use,
      mock-ups of every label to be used in connection with the new drug
      --- including any package insert and any document that is provided
      on request and that sets out supplementary information on the use
      of the new drug --- and mock-ups of the new drug's packages; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the supplement concerns the brand name of a new
    drug for human use:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an assessment as to whether there is a likelihood
      that the new drug will be mistaken for another drug for which a
      drug identification number has been assigned due to a resemblance
      between the brand name that is proposed to be used in respect of
      the new drug and the brand name, common name or proper name of the
      other drug, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} mock-ups of every label to be used in connection
      with the new drug --- including any package insert and any
      document that is provided on request and that sets out
      supplementary information on the use of the new drug --- and
      mock-ups of the new drug's packages.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a supplement to an extraordinary use new drug
  submission or an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug submission
  concerns a matter specified in subparagraph (2)(h)(iii), the
  supplement shall contain the attestation and supporting information
  referred to in paragraph C.08.002.01(2)(a).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer may file, for a public health
  emergency drug, a supplement to the new drug submission referred to in
  subsection (1) that does not contain all of the information and
  material that is required under subsection (3) if the supplement
  contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement that the supplement contains evidence
    to establish that the requirement set out in paragraph (b) is met;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the matters that are significantly
    different from those contained in the submission, sufficient
    evidence to support the conclusion that the benefits associated with
    the public health emergency drug outweigh the risks associated with
    it for the purpose and under the conditions of use recommended, with
    consideration given to the uncertainties relating to those benefits
    and risks as well as the public health need related to the
    applicable condition described in the List of Conditions that
    Threaten Public Health.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer may file, for a public health
  emergency drug for human use, a supplement to the new drug submission
  referred to in subsection (1) that does not meet the requirements set
  out in subparagraph (3.1)(a)(ii) or (b)(ii) if the supplement contains
  a draft of every label to be used in connection with the drug,
  including any package insert and any document provided on request that
  sets out supplementary information on the use of the drug.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} If, at the time the manufacturer files, for a public
  health emergency drug, a supplement to the new drug submission
  referred to in subsection (1), the manufacturer is unable to provide
  the Minister with information or material that relates to any of the
  matters referred to in paragraphs (2)(d) to (h) and (5)(b) and
  subsection (6) --- and, as applicable, the corresponding material
  referred to in paragraphs C.08.005.1(1)(b) to (d) --- or if any of
  that information or material is incomplete, the manufacturer shall
  provide the Minister, at that time, with a plan that specifies how and
  when they will provide the Minister with the missing information or
  material.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (5) to (7) apply only if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the supplement contains a statement that the
    supplement is for a public health emergency drug; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the purpose and conditions of use specified in the
    supplement relate only to a condition described in the List of
    Conditions that Threaten Public Health and the supplement contains a
    statement to that effect.

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (5) to (7) do not apply if a notice of
  compliance in respect of the supplement is being sought on the basis
  of a direct or indirect comparison between the new drug and another
  drug.

- **[[C.08.003.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.003.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section.

  [[submission]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[submission]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a new drug submission that is filed under
        section C.08.002;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an extraordinary use new drug submission that
        is filed under section C.08.002.01;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an abbreviated new drug submission that is
        filed under section C.08.002.1; or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug
        submission that is filed under section
        C.08.002.1. ([présentation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[supplement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a supplement to a
      submission that is filed under section
      C.08.003. ([supplément]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite sections C.08.002, C.08.002.01, C.08.002.1
  and C.08.003 and subject to subsection (3), the manufacturer of a new
  drug is not permitted to file a submission or supplement for the new
  drug on the basis of a direct or indirect comparison to any new drug
  in respect of which an authorization was issued under the ISAD Interim
  Order.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (2) does not prevent the manufacturer of a
  new drug from filing a submission or supplement for the new drug on
  the basis of a direct or indirect comparison to another new drug in
  respect of which an authorization was issued under the ISAD Interim
  Order if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a notice of compliance is issued under section
    C.08.004 or C.08.004.01 in respect of a submission or supplement for
    that other new drug; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the comparison is in respect of the matters that
    were approved by the notice of compliance.

**[[C.08.003.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.003.1 .sectionLabel}** In
examining a new drug submission, an extraordinary use new drug
submission, an abbreviated new drug submission, an abbreviated
extraordinary use new drug submission or a supplement to any of those
submissions, the Minister may, for the purpose of assessing the safety
and effectiveness of the new drug for which the submission or supplement
was filed, examine

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} information or material provided by any person under
  the Act;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} information or material obtained from sites at which
  the new drug or any [[active ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as
  defined in subsection C.01A.001(1), of the new drug is or is proposed
  to be [[fabricated]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} or
  [[packaged/labelled]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} within the meaning of
  those terms in that subsection, or tested; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} information or material obtained directly or
  indirectly from a [[foreign regulatory
  authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in subsection
  C.10.001(1).

- **[[C.08.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section C.08.004.1, the
  Minister shall, after completing an examination of a new drug
  submission or abbreviated new drug submission or a supplement to
  either submission,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if that submission or supplement complies with
    section C.08.002, C.08.002.1 or C.08.003, as the case may be, and
    section C.08.005.1, issue a notice of compliance; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if that submission or supplement does not comply
    with section C.08.002, C.08.002.1 or C.08.003, as the case may be,
    or section C.08.005.1, issue a notice to the manufacturer to that
    effect.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a new drug submission or an abbreviated new drug
  submission or a supplement to either submission does not comply with
  section C.08.002, C.08.002.1 or C.08.003, as the case may be, or
  section C.08.005.1, the manufacturer who filed the submission or
  supplement may amend the submission or supplement by filing additional
  information or material within 90 days after the day on which the
  Minister issues a notice to the manufacturer under paragraph
  C.08.004(1)(b) or within any longer period specified by the Minister.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section C.08.004.1, the Minister shall,
  after completing an examination of any additional information or
  material filed in respect of a new drug submission or an abbreviated
  new drug submission or a supplement to either submission,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if that submission or supplement complies with
    section C.08.002, C.08.002.1 or C.08.003, as the case may be, and
    section C.08.005.1, issue a notice of compliance; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if that submission or supplement does not comply
    with section C.08.002, C.08.002.1 or C.08.003, as the case may be,
    or section C.08.005.1, issue a notice to the manufacturer to that
    effect.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} A notice of compliance issued in respect of a new
  drug on the basis of information and material contained in a
  submission filed pursuant to section C.08.002.1 shall state the name
  of the Canadian reference product referred to in the submission and
  shall constitute a declaration of equivalence for that new drug.

- **[[C.08.004.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.004.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section.

  [[abbreviated new drug submission]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[abbreviated new drug submission]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes
      an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug
      submission. ([présentation abrégée de drogue
      nouvelle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[innovative drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[innovative drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that contains
      a medicinal ingredient not previously approved in a drug by the
      Minister and that is not a variation of a previously approved
      medicinal ingredient such as a salt, ester, enantiomer, solvate or
      polymorph. ([drogue innovante]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[new drug submission]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[new drug submission]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes an
      extraordinary use new drug submission. ([présentation de drogue
      nouvelle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[pediatric populations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[pediatric populations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the following
      groups: premature babies born before the 37th week of gestation;
      full-term babies from 0 to 27 days of age; and all children from
      28 days to 2 years of age, 2 years plus 1 day to 11 years of age
      and 11 years plus 1 day to 18 years of age. ([population
      pédiatrique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of the definition [[innovative
  drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection (1), a medicinal ingredient
  is not considered to be approved in a drug by reason of the Minister
  having issued or amended an authorization under the ISAD Interim Order
  in respect of a COVID-19 drug that contains the medicinal ingredient.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The purpose of this section is to implement Articles
  20.48 and 20.49 of the Agreement between Canada, the United States of
  America and the United Mexican States, as defined in the definition
  [[Agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 2 of the
  [Canada--United States--Mexico Agreement Implementation
  Act](/eng/acts/C-10.65), and paragraph 3 of Article 39 of the
  Agreement on Trade-related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights set
  out in Annex 1C to the Agreement Establishing the World Trade
  Organization, as defined in the definition
  [[Agreement]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection 2(1) of the [World
  Trade Organization Agreement Implementation Act](/eng/acts/W-11.8).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a manufacturer seeks a notice of compliance for a
  new drug on the basis of a direct or indirect comparison between the
  new drug and an innovative drug,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer may not file a new drug
    submission, a supplement to a new drug submission, an abbreviated
    new drug submission or a supplement to an abbreviated new drug
    submission in respect of the new drug before the end of a period of
    six years after the day on which the first notice of compliance was
    issued to the innovator in respect of the innovative drug; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister shall not approve that submission or
    supplement and shall not issue a notice of compliance in respect of
    the new drug before the end of a period of eight years after the day
    on which the first notice of compliance was issued to the innovator
    in respect of the innovative drug.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The period specified in paragraph (3)(b) is
  lengthened to eight years and six months if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the innovator provides the Minister with the
    description and results of clinical trials relating to the use of
    the innovative drug in relevant pediatric populations in its first
    new drug submission for the innovative drug or in any supplement to
    that submission that is filed within five years after the issuance
    of the first notice of compliance for that innovative drug; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} before the end of a period of six years after the
    day on which the first notice of compliance was issued to the
    innovator in respect of the innovative drug, the Minister determines
    that the clinical trials were designed and conducted for the purpose
    of increasing knowledge of the use of the innovative drug in those
    pediatric populations and this knowledge would there-by provide a
    health benefit to members of those populations.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (3) does not apply if the innovative drug
  is not being marketed in Canada.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (3)(a) does not apply to a manufacturer if
  the innovator consents to the filing of a new drug submission, a
  supplement to a new drug submission, an abbreviated new drug
  submission or a supplement to an abbreviated new drug submission by
  the manufacturer before the end of the period of six years specified
  in that paragraph.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (3)(a) does not apply to a manufacturer if
  the manufacturer files an application for authorization to sell its
  new drug under section C.07.003.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (3)(b) does not apply to a manufacturer if
  the innovator consents to the issuance of a notice of compliance to
  the manufacturer before the end of the period of eight years specified
  in that paragraph or of eight years and six months specified in
  subsection (4).

- [(9)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall maintain a register of innovative
  drugs that includes information relating to the matters specified in
  subsections (3) and (4).

- **[[C.08.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (1.1) and
  notwithstanding sections C.08.002 and C.08.003, a manufacturer of a
  new drug may sell it to a qualified investigator to be used solely for
  the purpose of clinical testing to obtain evidence with respect to the
  safety, dosage and effectiveness of that new drug, when the following
  conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} before the sale, the manufacturer has filed with
    the Minister, in compliance with section C.08.005.1, a preclinical
    submission containing information and material respecting

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the new drug or the identifying
      name or code proposed for the new drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the chemical structure or other specific
      identification of the composition of the new drug,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the source of the new drug,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a detailed protocol of the clinical testing,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the results of investigations made to support the
      clinical use of the new drug,

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the contra-indications and precautions known in
      respect of the new drug and the suggested treatment of overdosage
      of the new drug,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} all ingredients of the new drug, stated
      quantitatively,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} the methods, equipment, plant and controls
      used in the manufacture, processing and packaging of the new drug,

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} the tests applied to control the potency, purity
      and safety of the new drug, and

    - [(x)]{.lawlabel} the names and qualifications of all investigators
      to whom the drug is to be sold and the names of all institutions
      in which the clinical testing is to be carried out;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has not, within 60 days after the date
    of receipt of the preclinical submission, sent by registered mail to
    the manufacturer a notice in respect of that new drug indicating
    that the preclinical submission is not satisfactory;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} all inner labels and outer labels used in
    conjunction with the sale of the new drug to qualified investigators
    carry the statements

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} "Investigational Drug" or "[Drogue de
      recherche]{.otherLang lang="fr"}", and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} "To Be Used By Qualified Investigators Only" or
      "[Réservée uniquement à l'usage de chercheurs
      compétents]{.otherLang lang="fr"}";

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} before the sale, the manufacturer ascertains that
    every qualified investigator to whom the new drug is to be sold

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} has the facilities for the clinical testing to be
      conducted by the investigator, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} has received the information and material
      referred to in subparagraphs (a)(i) to (vi); and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} every qualified investigator to whom the new drug
    is to be sold has agreed in writing with the manufacturer that the
    investigator will

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} not use the new drug or permit it to be used
      other than for clinical testing,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} not permit the new drug to be used by any person
      other than the investigator except under the investigator's
      direction,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} report immediately to that manufacturer and, if
      so required by the Minister, report to the Minister all serious
      adverse reactions encountered during the clinical testing, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} account to the manufacturer for all quantities
      of the new drug received, where so requested by the manufacturer.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} This section applies only in respect of a new drug
  for veterinary use.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), no manufacturer shall
  sell a new drug to a qualified investigator unless that manufacturer
  has, in respect of all previous sales of that new drug to any
  qualified investigator,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} kept accurate records of the distribution of that
    new drug and of the results of the clinical testing and has made
    those records available to the Minister for inspection on the
    request of the Minister; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} immediately reported to the Minister all
    information he has obtained with respect to serious adverse
    reactions.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may notify the manufacturer of a new
  drug that sales of that new drug to qualified investigators are
  prohibited if, in the opinion of the Minister, it is in the interest
  of public health to do so.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1), no manufacturer shall
  sell a new drug to a qualified investigator if the Minister has
  notified the manufacturer of that drug that such sales are prohibited.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(c) does not apply to a
  radiopharmaceutical as defined in section C.03.201 or to a component
  or kit as defined in section C.03.205.

- **[[C.08.005.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.005.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every manufacturer who files a new
  drug submission, an extraordinary use new drug submission, an
  abbreviated new drug submission, an abbreviated extraordinary use new
  drug submission, a supplement to any of those submissions or a
  submission for the clinical testing of a new drug for veterinary use
  shall, in addition to any information and material that is required
  under section C.08.002, C.08.002.01, C.08.002.1, C.08.003 or C.08.005,
  include in the submission or supplement

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2018-84, s. 10\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a sectional report in respect of each human, animal
    and [in vitro]{.otherLang lang="la"} study included in the
    submission or supplement;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a comprehensive summary of each human, animal and
    [in vitro]{.otherLang lang="la"} study referred to or included in
    the submission or supplement; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a submission certificate in respect of all
    information and material contained in the submission or supplement
    and any additional information or material filed to amend the
    submission or supplement.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A sectional report referred to in paragraph (1)(b)
  shall include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a summary of each study included in the submission
    or supplement;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a summary of any additional information or material
    filed to amend the submission or supplement; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where raw data is available to the manufacturer in
    respect of a study,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a summary of the data,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a cross-referencing of the data to the relevant
      portions of the sectional report,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a description of the conditions under which the
      experiments from which the data were obtained were conducted,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the details of the data treatment process, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the results and conclusions of the study.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The comprehensive summary referred to in paragraph
  (1)(c) shall include a summary of the methods used, results obtained
  and conclusions arrived at in respect of all studies referred to or
  included in the submission or supplement and shall be cross-referenced
  to the relevant portions of the sectional reports.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The submission certificate referred to in paragraph
  (1)(d) shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} certify that all information and material included
    in the submission or supplement and any additional information or
    material filed to amend the submission or supplement are accurate
    and complete, and that the sectional reports and the comprehensive
    summary correctly represent the information and material referred to
    or included in the submission or supplement; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the senior executive officer in Canada of the
      manufacturer filing the submission or supplement, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the senior medical or scientific officer of the
      manufacturer.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2018-84, s. 10\]]{.Repealed}

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Every manufacturer who has filed a new drug
  submission, an extraordinary use new drug submission, an abbreviated
  new drug submission, an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug
  submission, a supplement to any of those submissions or a submission
  for the clinical testing of a new drug for veterinary use and who has
  any relating clinical case reports or raw data that were not included
  in the submission or supplement shall keep those reports or data and
  shall, within 30 days after receiving a written request from the
  Minister, submit them to the Minister.
