- **[[C.08.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (2),
  evidence or new information obtained by the Minister includes any
  information or material filed by any person under Division 5 or
  section C.08.002, C.08.002.01, C.08.002.1, C.08.003, C.08.005 or
  C.08.005.1.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, by notice to a manufacturer,
  suspend, for a definite or indefinite period, a notice of compliance
  issued to that manufacturer in respect of a new drug submission, an
  extraordinary use new drug submission, an abbreviated new drug
  submission, an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug submission or a
  supplement to any of those submissions if the Minister considers

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that the drug is not safe for the use represented
    in the submission or supplement, as shown by evidence obtained from

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} clinical or other experience not reported in the
      submission or supplement or not available to the Minister at the
      time the notice of compliance was issued, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} tests by new methods or tests by methods not
      reasonably applicable at the time the notice of compliance was
      issued;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that, upon the basis of new information obtained
    after the issuance of the notice of compliance, there is lack of
    substantial evidence that the drug will have the effect it is
    represented to have under the conditions of use prescribed,
    recommended or proposed by the manufacturer;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that the submission or supplement contained an
    untrue statement of material fact;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} that the manufacturer has failed to establish a
    system for maintaining required records or has repeatedly or
    deliberately failed to maintain such records;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} that, on the basis of new information obtained
    after the issuance of the notice of compliance, the methods,
    equipment, plant and controls used in the manufacturing, processing
    and packaging of the drug are inadequate to assure and preserve the
    identity, strength, quality or purity of the new drug;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} that, on the basis of new information obtained
    after the issuance of the notice of compliance, the labelling of the
    drug is false or misleading or incomplete in any particular and that
    this defect was not corrected by the manufacturer upon receipt of a
    written notice from the Minister specifying the respect in which the
    labelling is false or misleading or incomplete; or

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} that, in the case of a new drug for extraordinary
    use, the manufacturer has not adhered to the plan referred to in
    subparagraph C.08.002.01(2)(b)(ix).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, by notice to a manufacturer,
  suspend for a definite or indefinite period a notice of compliance
  issued to that manufacturer in respect of a new drug submission, an
  extraordinary use new drug submission, an abbreviated new drug
  submission, an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug submission or a
  supplement to any of those submissions if, after the Minister has,
  under section 21.31 of the Act, ordered the holder of a therapeutic
  product authorization referred to in subparagraph C.01.052(1)(a)(iii)
  to conduct an assessment of the new drug in order to provide evidence
  establishing that the benefits associated with the drug outweigh the
  risks of injury to health,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the holder fails to comply with the order; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the holder complies with the order but the Minister
    determines that the results of the assessment are not sufficient to
    establish that the benefits associated with the drug outweigh the
    risks of injury to health.

- **[[C.08.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a manufacturer has received a
  notice of compliance issued in respect of a new drug submission, an
  extraordinary use new drug submission, an abbreviated new drug
  submission, an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug submission or a
  supplement to any of those submissions, the manufacturer shall
  establish and maintain records, in a manner that enables an audit to
  be made, respecting

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} animal or clinical experience, studies,
    investigations and tests conducted by the manufacturer or reported
    to him by any person concerning that new drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} reports from the scientific literature or the
    bibliography therefrom that are available to him concerning that new
    drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} experience, investigations, studies and tests
    involving the chemical or physical properties or any other
    properties of that new drug;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} any substitution of another substance for that new
    drug or any mixing of another substance with that new drug;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any error in the labelling of that new drug or in
    the use of the labels designed for that new drug;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} any bacteriological or any significant chemical or
    physical or other change or deterioration in any lot of that new
    drug;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} any failure of one or more distributed lots of the
    new drug to meet the specifications established for that new drug in
    the submission or supplement; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} any unusual failure in efficacy of that new drug.

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/95-521, s. 3\]]{.Repealed}

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer shall retain the records
  respecting the information referred to in subsection (1) for at least
  seven years from the day on which they were established.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A manufacturer or importer who sells a new drug for
  extraordinary use in accordance with section C.08.002.02 shall retain
  the written order for at least 15 years from the day on which the
  order was filled.

**[[C.08.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.008 .sectionLabel}** No

**[[C.08.008.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.008.1 .sectionLabel}** Where a
manufacturer has received a notice of compliance issued in respect of an
extraordinary use new drug submission, an abbreviated extraordinary use
new drug submission or a supplement to either of those submissions, the
manufacturer

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} shall adhere to the plan referred to in subparagraph
  C.08.002.01(2)(b)(ix); and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} shall, before the first day of October in each year
  and whenever requested to do so by the Minister for the purposes of
  assessing the safety and effectiveness of the drug to which the notice
  of compliance relates, provide a report on the use of the drug,
  including a critical analysis of any available updated information
  respecting the drug's safety and effectiveness.

- **[[C.08.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister has decided

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to notify the manufacturer of a new drug for
    veterinary use that the sale of that drug to qualified investigators
    is prohibited, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to suspend a notice of compliance issued under
    section C.08.004 or C.08.004.01,

  the manufacturer, if dissatisfied with that decision, may require the
  Minister to provide him with the reasons for the decision.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where the manufacturer has received the reasons for a
  decision of the Minister pursuant to subsection (1), he may require
  the Minister to refer that decision to a New Drug Committee and
  thereupon shall provide the Minister with a statement of the reasons
  for his dissatisfaction and any information and material upon which he
  relies in support of those reasons.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister has been required to refer a
  decision to a New Drug Committee pursuant to subsection (2), he shall
  appoint a member of the New Drug Committee, the dissatisfied
  manufacturer shall appoint a member of the New Drug Committee and the
  two members so appointed shall appoint a third member of the New Drug
  Committee who shall be chairman, or, if they are unable to do so
  within a reasonable time, the Minister shall appoint a third member of
  the New Drug Committee who shall be chairman.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Any person who is in the full-time employment of the
  Department or in the full-time employment of the dissatisfied
  manufacturer shall not be appointed a member of a New Drug Committee.

- [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} A member of a New Drug Committee shall, on
  appointment, sign an undertaking not to disclose or use any
  information, material, data, evidence or representations considered
  pursuant to subsection (6).

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Minister shall pay the reasonable fees and costs
  incurred by the member of the New Drug Committee appointed by the
  Minister, and the dissatisfied manufacturer shall pay the reasonable
  fees and costs incurred by the member appointed by the dissatisfied
  manufacturer, and the Minister and the dissatisfied manufacturer shall
  each pay half of the reasonable fees and costs incurred by the
  chairman.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} The New Drug Committee formed pursuant to
  subsection (3) shall consider the reasons for the decision of the
  Minister, the reasons for the dissatisfaction of the dissatisfied
  manufacturer and any information or material in support of the reasons
  of the Minister or the dissatisfied manufacturer and may consider
  other evidence, material, information or representations.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} The New Drug Committee formed pursuant to
  subsection (3) shall report its findings and recommendations to the
  Minister.

- [(7.1)]{.lawlabel} No member of a New Drug Committee shall disclose or
  use any information, material, data, evidence or representations
  considered pursuant to subsection (6).

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} Where the Minister has received the findings and
  recommendations of a New Drug Committee, he may reconsider the
  decision to which those findings and recommendations relate.

**[[C.08.009.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.009.01 .sectionLabel}** The
following definitions apply in sections C.08.009.03 to C.08.009.05.

[[Chief Public Health Officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Chief Public Health Officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Chief
    Public Health Officer appointed under subsection 6(1) of the [Public
    Health Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/P-29.5). ([administrateur en
    chef de la santé publique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[dosage form class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[dosage form class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
    subsection C.01A.001(1). ([classe de forme
    posologique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[fabricate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[fabricate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
    subsection C.01A.001(1). ([manufacturer]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[foreign regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[foreign regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
    government agency or other entity outside Canada that has a legal
    right to control the manufacturing, use or sale of drugs within its
    jurisdiction and that may take enforcement action to ensure that
    drugs marketed within its jurisdiction comply with the applicable
    legal requirements. ([autorité réglementaire
    étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[package/label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[package/label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
    subsection C.01A.001(1). ([emballer-étiqueter]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

- **[[C.08.009.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.009.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The holder of an establishment
  licence may import a public health emergency drug if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Public Health Officer provides the
    Minister with

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name and contact information of the holder,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name and contact information of the public
      health emergency drug's manufacturer,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the name of the public health emergency drug
      and a description of it,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} information indicating that the public health
      emergency drug is the subject of a new drug submission, a
      supplement to a new drug submission or an application made to a
      foreign regulatory authority to authorize its sale,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} information specifying the quantity of the public
      health emergency drug to be imported, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the civic address of the place where the public
      health emergency drug will be stored after it is imported;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the holder provides the Minister with

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name and contact information of each
      fabricator, packager/labeller and tester of the public health
      emergency drug and the civic address of each building at which the
      drug will be fabricated, packaged/labelled or tested, specifying
      for each building

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the activities referred to in Table I to
        section C.01A.008 that apply to the public health emergency
        drug,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the categories referred to in Table II to that
        section that apply to the public health emergency drug, and

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} for each of those categories, the dosage form
        classes, if any, and, in the case of a public health emergency
        drug that will be sterile, an indication to that effect, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a certificate from an inspector indicating that
      the buildings, equipment, practices and procedures of each
      fabricator, packager/labeller and tester meet the applicable
      requirements set out in Divisions 2 to 4 or, alternatively, other
      evidence establishing that those requirements are met; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the public health emergency drug belongs to a
    category of drugs that are authorized to be imported under the
    establishment licence.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to the holder of an
  establishment licence in respect of a building referred to in
  subparagraph (1)(b)(i) if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the building is listed in the licence; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in clauses (1)(b)(i)(A)
    to (C) that the holder submitted in respect of the building in their
    application for the licence under section C.01A.005 or in an
    application to amend the licence under section C.01A.006, has not
    changed.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the conditions set out in subsection (1) are met,
  the Minister shall send a letter to the Chief Public Health Officer to
  that effect.

#### [Disclosure of Information in Respect of Clinical Trials]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1116590 .Subheading}

- **[[C.08.009.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.009.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In sections C.08.009.2 and
  C.08.009.3, [[information in respect of a clinical
  trial]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means information in respect of a
  [[clinical trial]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, within the meaning of
  section C.05.001, that is contained in a new drug submission, an
  extraordinary use new drug submission, an abbreviated new drug
  submission or an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug submission for
  a new drug for human use filed under section C.08.002, C.08.002.01 or
  C.08.002.1 or in a supplement to any of those submissions filed under
  section C.08.003.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, the definition [[information
  in respect of a clinical trial ]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} includes
  information that is contained in a submission or supplement referred
  to in that definition and that is in respect of clinical testing
  involving human subjects in regards to which an application was filed
  under this Division before September 1, 2001.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-62, s. 3](#1116222-1116595){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1116222-1116595.html"}
:::

- **[[C.08.009.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.009.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Information in respect of a clinical
  trial that is confidential business information ceases to be
  confidential business information when one of the following
  circumstances occurs with respect to the submission or supplement:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Minister issues a notice of compliance under
    section C.08.004 or C.08.004.01;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case where the Minister issues a notice to
    the manufacturer under paragraph C.08.004(1)(b) or C.08.004.01(1)(b)
    and the manufacturer does not amend the submission or supplement
    under subsection C.08.004(2) or C.08.004.01(2), the applicable
    period referred to in the relevant subsection expires;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister issues a notice to the manufacturer
    under paragraph C.08.004(3)(b) or C.08.004.01(3)(b).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to information in
  respect of a clinical trial that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} was not used by the manufacturer in the submission
    or supplement to support the proposed conditions of use for the new
    drug or the purpose for which the new drug is recommended; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} describes tests, methods or assays that are used
    exclusively by the manufacturer.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-62, s. 3](#1116222-1116605){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1116222-1116605.html"}
:::

**[[C.08.009.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.009.3 .sectionLabel}** The
Minister may disclose, without notifying the person to whose business or
affairs the information relates or obtaining their consent, any
information in respect of a clinical trial that has ceased to be
confidential business information.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-62, s. 3](#1116222-1116608){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1116222-1116608.html"}
:::

#### [Sale of New Drug for Emergency Treatment]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578524 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2020-212, s. 1(F)

\]
:::

- **[[C.08.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may issue a letter of
  authorization to a manufacturer of a new drug authorizing the sale of
  a specified quantity of the new drug for human or veterinary use to a
  practitioner, for use in the emergency treatment of an animal or a
  person under the care of that practitioner, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the practitioner provides the following information
    to the Minister:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name of the new drug and details concerning
      the medical emergency for which the new drug is required,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of the new drug that is required,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (2), the information in
      the possession of the practitioner in respect of the use, safety
      and efficacy of the new drug,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the name and the civic address of the person to
      whom the new drug is to be shipped, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} any other information the Minister may request to
      enable the Minister to determine whether to issue the letter of
      authorization;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the practitioner agrees to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} provide a report to the manufacturer of the new
      drug and to the Minister describing the results obtained following
      the use of the new drug to address the medical emergency,
      including information respecting any adverse drug reactions
      observed by the practitioner, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} account to the Minister, on request, for all
      quantities of the new drug received;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for human use, the person
    referred to in subparagraph (a)(iv) is a practitioner or a
    pharmacist; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a new drug for veterinary use, the
    person referred to in subparagraph (a)(iv) is a practitioner, a
    pharmacist or a person who may sell a medicated feed pursuant to
    section C.08.012.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subparagraph (1)(a)(iii) does not apply if the
  following conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sale of the new drug has been authorized under
    subsection (1) to address the same medical emergency on at least one
    previous occasion;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the European Medicines Agency or the United States
    Food and Drug Administration has authorized the sale of the new drug
    without terms or conditions, for the same use in its jurisdiction;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has not cancelled the assignment of a
    drug identification number for the new drug under paragraph
    C.01.014.6(2)(b) or (c) or subsection C.01.014.6(3).

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2021-271, s. 4\]]{.Repealed}

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The letter of authorization must contain the
  following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the practitioner to whom the new drug
    may be sold;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and the civic address of the person to
    whom the new drug may be shipped;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name of the new drug and the medical emergency
    in respect of which it may be sold; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of the new drug that may be sold to
    the practitioner to address the medical emergency.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, the practitioner is
  not required to know the identity of the animal or the person under
  the care of that practitioner at the time the letter of authorization
  is issued.

::: HistoricalNote

- **[[C.08.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section C.08.002, the
  manufacturer may sell a new drug in accordance with a letter of
  authorization issued under subsection C.08.010(1).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In the case of the sale under subsection (1) of a new
  drug for veterinary use that contains an active pharmaceutical
  ingredient set out in List A and that was not imported under section
  C.08.011.2, an annual report identifying the total quantity of the new
  drug that was sold, including an estimate of the quantity sold in
  respect of each animal species for which the drug is intended, must be
  submitted to the Minister by the manufacturer, if the new drug was
  present in Canada at the time of sale, otherwise by the practitioner.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The sale of a new drug made in accordance with
  subsection (1) is exempt from the provisions of the Act and these
  Regulations other than this section.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} The annual report described in subsection (2) is for
  a period of one calendar year and must be submitted on or before March
  31 of the year following the calendar year covered by the report,
  beginning with the first full calendar year during which the drug is
  first sold.

- **[[C.08.011.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.011.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may issue a letter of
  authorization to the manufacturer of a new drug authorizing the holder
  of an establishment licence to import a specified quantity of the new
  drug for human or veterinary use, if the following conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer provides the following information
    to the Minister:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name of the new drug and details concerning
      the medical emergency for which the new drug will be imported,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of the new drug to be imported,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the name of the holder of an establishment
      licence who will import the new drug,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the civic address of the facility where the new
      drug is to be stored in Canada, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} any other information the Minister may request to
      enable the Minister to determine whether to issue the letter of
      authorization;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the establishment licence authorizes the
    importation of a new drug in the same category as the one to be
    imported; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the quantity that is to be imported does not exceed
    the amount that the Minister determines is likely to be required to
    address the medical emergency.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2021-271, s. 5\]]{.Repealed}

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The letter of authorization must contain the
  following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the new drug and the medical emergency
    in respect of which the letter is issued;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the quantity of the new drug that may be imported
    to address the medical emergency;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name of the holder of an establishment licence
    who is authorized to import the new drug; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the civic address of the facility where the new
    drug is to be stored in Canada.

#### [Sale of Medicated Feeds]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578545 .Subheading}

- **[[C.08.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.012
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding anything in this
  Division, a person may sell, pursuant to a written prescription of a
  veterinary practitioner, a medicated feed if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} as regards the drug or drugs used as the medicating
    ingredient of the medicated feed,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has assigned a drug identification
      number pursuant to section C.01.014.2, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the sale is permitted by section C.08.005,
      C.08.011 or C.08.013;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the medicated feed is for the treatment of animals
    under the direct care of the veterinary practitioner who signed the
    prescription;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the medicated feed is for therapeutic purposes
    only; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the written prescription contains the following
    information:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the person named on the
      prescription as the person for whom the medicated feed is to be
      mixed,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the species, production type and age or weight
      of the animals to be treated with the medicated feed,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the type and amount of medicated feed to be
      mixed,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the proper name, or the common name if there is
      no proper name, of the drug or each of the drugs, as the case may
      be, to be used as medicating ingredients in the preparation of the
      medicated feed, and the dosage levels of those medicating
      ingredients,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} any special mixing instructions, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} labelling instructions including

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} feeding instructions,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} a warning statement respecting the withdrawal
        period to be observed following the use of the medicated feed,
        and

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} where applicable, cautions with respect to
        animal health or to the handling or storage of the medicated
        feed.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, [[medicated
  feed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in the [Feeds
  Regulations, 2024](/eng/regulations/SOR-2024-132).

#### [Experimental Studies]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578566 .Subheading}

##### [Conditions of Sale]{.HTitleText4} {#h-578567 .Subheading}

- **[[C.08.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.013
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding anything in this
  Division, a person may sell a new drug proposed for use in animals to
  an experimental studies investigator in a quantity specified by the
  Minister for the purpose of conducting an experimental study in
  animals if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the experimental studies investigator has been
    issued an experimental studies certificate pursuant to subsection
    C.08.015(1) and the certificate has not been suspended or cancelled
    pursuant to section C.08.018; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the drug is labelled in accordance with subsection
    C.08.016(1).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section and sections
  C.08.014 to C.08.018,

  [[experimental studies certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[experimental studies certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      certificate issued pursuant to subsection
      C.08.015(1); ([certificat d'études
      expérimentales]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[experimental studies investigator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[experimental studies investigator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      person named as the investigator in an experimental studies
      certificate; ([expert en études expérimentales]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[experimental study]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[experimental study]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a limited test of
      a new drug in animals carried out by an experimental studies
      investigator. ([étude expérimentale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-333, s. 1
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.08.013-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.08.013"){.PITLink}
:::

##### [Experimental Studies Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-578578 .Subheading}

- **[[C.08.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.014
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of obtaining an
  experimental studies certificate, an applicant shall submit to the
  Minister, in writing, the following information and material:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the new drug or the identifying
    name or code proposed for the new drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the objectives and an outline of the proposed
    experimental study of the new drug;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the species, number and production type of animals
    in respect of which the new drug is to be administered;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the manufacturer of the new
    drug;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the address of the premises in which the
    experimental study is to be conducted;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a description of the facilities to be used to
    conduct the experimental study;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name, address and qualifications of the
    proposed experimental studies investigator;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the chemical structure, if known, and the relevant
    compositional characteristics of the new drug;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the proposed quantity of the new drug to be used
    for the experimental study;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the results of any toxicological or pharmacological
    studies that may have been conducted with the new drug;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} the written agreement referred to in subsection
    (2); and

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} such other information and material as the Minister
    may require.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a food-producing animal is involved in an
  experimental study, the applicant referred to in subsection (1) shall,
  for the purposes of obtaining an experimental studies certificate,
  obtain from the owner of the animals, or from a person authorized by
  the owner, a written agreement not to sell the animal or any products
  from it without prior authorization from the experimental studies
  investigator.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may request the manufacturer of a new
  drug to submit to him samples of the new drug or of any ingredient of
  the drug and, in satisfactory form and manner, any other information
  that the Minister requests and where such samples or information are
  not submitted, the Minister may refuse to issue an experimental
  studies certificate.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-333, s. 1
- SOR/93-202, s. 28
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.08.014-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.08.014"){.PITLink}
:::

- **[[C.08.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where, on receipt of the information
  and material submitted pursuant to section C.08.014, the Minister has
  determined that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant is qualified as an experimental
    studies investigator for the purposes of the proposed experimental
    study,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the facilities for the conduct of the experimental
    study are adequate for the purposes of the proposed experimental
    study, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the proposed experimental study can be conducted
    without undue foreseeable risk to humans or animals,

  the Minister shall issue an experimental studies certificate for the
  purposes of the proposed experimental study and shall specify therein
  the quantity of the new drug that may be sold to the experimental
  studies investigator.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If, on receipt of the information and material
  submitted under section C.08.014, the Minister determines that the
  requirements of paragraphs (1)(a), (b) and (c) have not been met, the
  Minister shall refuse to issue an experimental studies certificate.

##### [Labelling]{.HTitleText4} {#h-578606 .Subheading}

- **[[C.08.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.016
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The label of a new drug that is sold
  pursuant to section C.08.013 shall show

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the new drug or the identifying
    name or code proposed for the new drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a warning statement to the effect that the drug is
    for use only in an experimental study in animals;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the lot number of the drug;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the manufacturer of the
    drug; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name of the person to whom the drug has been
    supplied.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Sections C.01.004, C.01.005 and C.01.014 do not apply
  to a drug that is sold pursuant to section C.08.013 and labelled in
  accordance with subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-333, s. 1
- SOR/88-378, s. 2
- SOR/93-202, s. 29
:::

##### [Conditions of Experimental Study]{.HTitleText4} {#h-578617 .Subheading}

**[[C.08.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.017 .sectionLabel}** An
experimental studies investigator shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} use the new drug only in accordance with the outline
  of the experimental study;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} report immediately to the Minister all serious
  adverse drug reactions associated with the use of the new drug;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} report promptly to the Minister, on request, the
  results of the experimental study;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} return to the manufacturer, on request, all
  quantities of the new drug not used in the experimental study;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} maintain all records of the experimental study for a
  period of at least two years after the conclusion of the study and, on
  request, make such records available to the Minister;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} report promptly to the Minister any known disposition
  of animals involved in the study or of any products from the animals
  that is contrary to the terms of the agreement referred to in
  subsection C.08.014(2); and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} account to the Minister, on request, for all
  quantities of the new drug received by him.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-333, s. 1
- SOR/2001-203, s. 10
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
:::

##### [Suspension or Cancellation of Experimental Studies Certificate]{.HTitleText4} {#h-578628 .Subheading}

- **[[C.08.018]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.08.018
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister determines that it
  is necessary in order to safeguard animal health or public health or
  to promote public safety, he or she may suspend for a definite or
  indefinite period or cancel an experimental studies certificate.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Without limiting the generality of subsection (1),
  the Minister may suspend or cancel an experimental studies certificate
  if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information and material submitted pursuant to
    section C.08.014 contains an untrue statement or contains any
    omission concerning the properties of the drug that were known or
    ought reasonably to have been known to the manufacturer or the
    experimental studies investigator;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the labelling of the new drug is, at any time,
    false, misleading, deceptive or incomplete;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the qualifications of the experimental studies
    investigator prove to be inadequate;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} there is evidence that the experimental studies
    investigator has not complied with the conditions referred to in
    section C.08.017; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an action of the manufacturer in respect of the new
    drug has resulted in his conviction for a violation of section
    C.08.002.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-333, s. 1
- SOR/2018-69, ss. 26, 27
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-C.08.018-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section C.08.018"){.PITLink}
:::

### [DIVISION 9]{.HLabel2} {#h-578639 .Subheading}

#### [Non-prescription Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578640 .Subheading}

**[[C.09.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.001 .sectionLabel}** This Division
does not apply to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a drug that is required by these Regulations or the
  [Narcotic Control Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._1041) to be
  sold only on prescription; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a drug for use exclusively in animals.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
:::

#### [Analgesics]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578646 .Subheading}

##### [General]{.HTitleText4} {#h-578647 .Subheading}

**[[C.09.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.010 .sectionLabel}** No
manufacturer or importer shall, after June 30, 1986, sell a drug for
analgesia that contains a combination of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a salt or derivative of salicylic acid with another
  salt or derivative of salicylic acid or with salicylamide; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} acetaminophen with a salt or derivative of salicylic
  acid or with salicylamide.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
:::

**[[C.09.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.011 .sectionLabel}** Each label of
a drug that is intended for internal use and contains acetaminophen,
salicylic acid or a salt or derivative thereof shall, after June 30,
1986, carry a caution

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} to consult a physician if the underlying condition
  requires continued use for more than five days; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that it is hazardous to exceed the maximum
  recommended dose unless advised by a physician.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
- SOR/86-589, s. 1
:::

**[[C.09.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.012 .sectionLabel}** Each label of
a drug that is intended for internal use and contains salicylic acid or
a salt or derivative thereof shall after June 30, 1986, carry a warning
statement to consult a physician before taking the drug during the last
three months of pregnancy or when nursing.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
:::

#### [Acetaminophen]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578661 .Subheading}

- **[[C.09.020]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.020
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The adult standard dosage unit of
  acetaminophen shall be 325 mg.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The children's standard dosage units of acetaminophen
  shall be 80 mg or 160 mg.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
- SOR/90-587, s. 4
:::

- **[[C.09.021]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.021
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Division, [[acetaminophen
  product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acetaminophen as a single medicinal ingredient; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acetaminophen in combination with caffeine.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No manufacturer or importer shall sell an
  acetaminophen product unless it meets the requirements of this
  Division.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/90-587, s. 5\]]{.Repealed}

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
- SOR/90-587, s. 5
:::

- **[[C.09.022]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.022
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (4),
  an acetaminophen product sold in the form of a tablet, capsule or
  other solid dosage form intended for oral administration shall contain
  one adult standard dosage unit of acetaminophen per individual dosage
  form.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} An acetaminophen product in the form of a tablet,
  capsule or other solid dosage form intended for oral administration
  may contain 500 mg of acetaminophen per individual dosage form if it
  has a label that states that it is not a standard dosage unit product.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} An acetaminophen product sold in the form of a
  tablet, capsule or other solid dosage form that is intended for oral
  administration may contain 325 mg of acetaminophen for immediate
  release and another 325 mg for subsequent release, if it has a label
  that states that it is not a standard dosage unit product.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} An acetaminophen product sold in the form of a
  tablet, capsule or other solid dosage form that is intended for oral
  administration and that is specially recommended for children shall
  contain one children's standard dosage unit of acetaminophen per
  individual dosage form.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} An acetaminophen product in the form of a liquid that
  is intended to be taken as drops and that is specially recommended for
  children shall contain one children's standard dosage unit of
  acetaminophen per millilitre of the product.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} A package of an acetaminophen product described in
  subsection (5) shall be accompanied by a measuring device capable of
  accurately delivering 0.5 mL of the product.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} An acetaminophen product in the form of a liquid that
  is not intended to be taken as drops and that is specially recommended
  for children shall contain one children's standard dosage unit per
  teaspoon of the product.

- [(8)]{.lawlabel} An acetaminophen product in the form of a liquid
  shall contain one adult standard dosage unit of acetaminophen per
  teaspoon of the product.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
- SOR/85-966, s. 4
- SOR/86-954, s. 1
- SOR/99-441, s. 1
:::

#### [Salicylates]{.HTitleText3} {#h-578686 .Subheading}

- **[[C.09.030]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.030
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The adult standard dosage unit of a
  salicylate shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of acetylsalicylic acid, sodium
    salicylate and magnesium salicylate, 325 mg; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of choline salicylate, 435 mg.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The children's standard dosage unit of a salicylate
  shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of acetylsalicylic acid, sodium
    salicylate and magnesium salicylate, 80 mg; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of choline salicylate, 110 mg.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
:::

- **[[C.09.031]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.031
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Division, [[salicylate
  product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a salt or derivative of salicylic acid as a single
    medicinal ingredient;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a salt or derivative of salicylic acid in
    combination with caffeine;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a salt or derivative of salicylic acid in
    combination with one or more buffering agents or antacids; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a salt or derivative of salicylic acid in
    combination with caffeine and one or more buffering agents or
    antacids.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No manufacturer or importer shall sell a salicylate
  product after June 30, 1986 unless it meets the requirements of this
  Division.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} No manufacturer or importer shall, until June 30,
  1986, sell a salicylate product in a dosage unit other than one
  mentioned in this Division, unless the salicylate product was legally
  available for sale in Canada on February 1, 1984.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
- SOR/85-966, s. 5(E)
:::

- **[[C.09.032]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.032
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3)
  and section C.09.035, a salicylate product in the form of a tablet,
  capsule or other solid dosage form intended for oral administration
  shall contain one adult standard dosage unit of a salicylate per
  individual dosage form.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A salicylate product in the form of a tablet, capsule
  or other solid dosage form intended for oral administration may
  contain

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} 500 mg of acetylsalicylic acid, sodium salicylate
    or magnesium salicylate, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} 670 mg of choline salicylate

  per individual dosage form if it has a label that states that it is
  not a standard dosage unit product.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A salicylate product in the form of a tablet, capsule
  or other solid dosage form intended for oral administration may
  contain

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} two adult standard dosage units of a salicylate per
    individual dosage form if the label of the salicylate product states
    that each individual dosage form contains two adult standard dosage
    units; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} three adult standard dosage units of a salicylate
    per individual dosage form if the label of the salicylate product
    states that each individual dosage form contains three adult
    standard dosage units.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
- SOR/85-966, s. 6
:::

- **[[C.09.033]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.033
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), a
  salicylate product in the form of a liquid shall contain one adult
  standard dosage unit of a salicylate per teaspoon.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} A salicylate product in the form of a liquid may
  contain

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} two adult standard dosage units of a salicylate per
    teaspoon if the label of the salicylate product states that each
    teaspoon of the product contains two adult standard dosage units;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} three adult standard dosage units of a salicylate
    per teaspoon if the label of the salicylate product states that each
    teaspoon of the product contains three adult standard dosage units.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
:::

**[[C.09.034]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.034 .sectionLabel}** A salicylate
product that is claimed to be buffered shall provide at least 1.9
milliequivalents of acid neutralizing capacity per adult standard dosage
unit of a salicylate.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
:::

**[[C.09.035]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.09.035 .sectionLabel}** A salicylate
product in the form of a tablet, capsule or other solid dosage form
intended for oral administration and that is specially recommended for
children shall contain one children's standard dosage unit of a
salicylate per individual dosage form.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-145, s. 4
:::

### [DIVISION 10]{.HLabel2}[Access to Drugs in Exceptional Circumstances]{.HTitleText2} {#h-578730 .Subheading}

- **[[C.10.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section and in section C.10.002.

  [[foreign regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[foreign regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      government agency or other entity outside Canada that has a legal
      right to control the manufacturing, use or sale of drugs within
      its jurisdiction. ([autorité réglementaire
      étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Public Health Officer appointed under
        subsection 6(1) of the [Public Health Agency of Canada
        Act](/eng/acts/P-29.5);

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Medical Officer of Health, or
        equivalent, of a province;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Surgeon General of the Canadian Armed
        Forces; or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Medical Officer of Public Health for
        the Department of Indigenous Services. ([responsable de la santé
        publique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite sections A.01.040 and C.01.004.1, any person
  who holds an establishment licence that authorizes the importation of
  a drug may import a drug for which a notice of compliance has not been
  issued under section C.08.004 or C.08.004.01, or for which a drug
  identification number has not been assigned under subsection
  C.01.014.2(1), if the following conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a public health official has, within the past year,
    notified the Minister in writing of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an urgent public health need for the immediate
      use of the drug within their jurisdiction, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the intended use or purpose of the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the drug is authorized by a foreign regulatory
    authority in the United States, Switzerland or the European Union to
    be sold for the same use or purpose as that described under
    subparagraph (a)(ii);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the drug is in the same category as the category
    for which the licence was issued;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the drug is imported directly from the country in
    which it is authorized to be sold by the foreign regulatory
    authority; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the drug is one for which the following information
    is set out in the List of Drugs for an Urgent Public Health Need
    that is published by the Government of Canada on its website, as
    amended from time to time:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} brand name,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} medicinal ingredients,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} dosage form,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} strength,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} route of administration, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} identifying code or number, if any, assigned in
      the country in which the drug was authorized for sale.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Sections C.01A.006 and C.01A.007 do not apply in
  respect of the importation of a drug under subsection (2).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, a licensee may, despite
  subsection C.01A.004(1), import a drug under subsection (2) without
  having their licence amended under section C.01A.006.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Divisions 2 to 4, other than the following
  provisions, do not apply to the importation of a drug under subsection
  (2):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sections C.02.003.1 and C.02.004 as they apply to
    the storage of the drug by the licensee;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.006;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} subsection C.02.012(1);

  - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.012.1 as it applies to the storage
    of the drug by the licensee;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} sections C.02.013 and C.02.014;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.015 as it applies to the storage and
    transportation of the drug by the licensee;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} subsection C.02.021(1) as it applies to the storage
    of the drug by the licensee;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} subsection C.02.022(1);

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.023;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} subsections C.02.024(1) and C.02.025(1); and

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} section C.03.013.

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2024-238, s. 39\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[C.10.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A sale of a drug that is imported
  under subsection C.10.001(2) is exempt from the provisions of these
  Regulations only if the drug is sold to a person within the
  jurisdiction of a public health official who has notified the Minister
  as described in paragraph C.10.001(2)(a), for use in respect of the
  same urgent public health need for which it was imported.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any person who wholesales such a drug must hold an
  establishment licence to wholesale a drug in the same category and
  despite subsection (1), the following provisions apply in respect of
  the wholesale:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sections C.02.003.1 and C.02.004 as they apply to
    the storage of the drug by the licensee;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.006 as it applies to the storage of
    the drug by the licensee;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} subsection C.02.012(1);

  - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.012.1 as it applies to the storage
    of the drug by the licensee;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.013;

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.014;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.015 as it applies to the storage and
    transportation of the drug by the licensee;

  - [(e.1)]{.lawlabel} subsection C.02.021(1) as it applies to storage;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} subsection C.02.022(1);

  - [(f.1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2023-247, s. 7\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} section C.02.023; and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} subsection C.02.024(1).

**[[C.10.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.003 .sectionLabel}** Every
licensee who imports a drug under subsection C.10.001(2) must notify the
Minister within 15 days after the day on which it is imported by
providing the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name, title and contact information of the person
  who imported the drug;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the drug;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the medicinal ingredients, strength, dosage form and
  route of administration of the drug and any identifying code or number
  assigned to it in the country in which it was authorized for sale;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of the country from which the drug was
  imported; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the total quantity of the drug imported.

- **[[C.10.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this section and in sections C.10.005 to C.10.011.

  [[designated drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[designated drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that is set
      out in the List of Drugs for Exceptional Importation and
      Sale. ([drogue désignée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of the following drugs for
      human use:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} drugs included in Schedule I, II, III, IV or V
        to the [Controlled Drugs and Substances Act](/eng/acts/C-38.8);

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} prescription drugs;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} drugs that are listed in Schedule C or D to the
        Act; and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} drugs that are permitted to be sold without a
        prescription but that are to be administered only under the
        supervision of a practitioner. ([drogue]{.DefinedTermLink
        lang="fr"})

  [[foreign regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[foreign regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same
      meaning as in subsection C.10.001(1). ([autorité réglementaire
      étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[List of Drugs for Exceptional Importation and Sale]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[List of Drugs for Exceptional Importation and
      Sale]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the List of Drugs for Exceptional
      Importation and Sale that is published by the Government of Canada
      on its website, as amended from time to time. ([Liste des drogues
      destinées aux importations et aux ventes
      exceptionnelles]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In sections C.10.006 and C.10.009, [[batch
  certificate]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef},
  [[fabricate]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, [[MRA
  country]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef},
  [[package/label]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} and [[recognized
  building]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} have the same meanings as in
  subsection C.01A.001(1).
