- **[[C.10.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may add a drug to the
  List of Drugs for Exceptional Importation and Sale only if the
  Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} there is a shortage or risk of shortage of another
    drug for which a notice of compliance has been issued under section
    C.08.004 or C.08.004.01 or for which a drug identification number
    has been assigned under subsection C.01.014.2(1); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the drug to be added to that list can be
    substituted for the drug referred to in paragraph (a).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In subsection (1), [[shortage]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}
  has the same meaning as in section C.01.014.8.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-199, s. 5](#1314952-1339769){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1314952-1339769.html"}
:::

- **[[C.10.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who holds an establishment
  licence that authorizes the importation of a drug may import a
  designated drug if the following conditions are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensee provides the Minister, electronically
    in a format specified by or acceptable to the Minister and not later
    than the third business day before the day on which the designated
    drug is imported, with a notification that contains the following
    information:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the licensee's name and contact information,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name and contact information of each
      fabricator, packager/labeller and tester of the designated drug
      and the address of each building in which it is fabricated,
      packaged/labelled or tested,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in respect of the designated drug,

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} its brand name,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} its medicinal ingredients,

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} its dosage form,

      - [(D)]{.lawlabel} its strength,

      - [(E)]{.lawlabel} its route of administration,

      - [(F)]{.lawlabel} its identifying code or number, if any,
        assigned in the country in which it is authorized for sale, and

      - [(G)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of its conditions of
        use,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the intended port of entry into Canada,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the estimated date of arrival of the shipment of
      the designated drug, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} the total quantity of the designated drug that
      is intended to be imported on the date referred to in subparagraph
      (v);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the designated drug is authorized to be sold by a
    foreign regulatory authority within its jurisdiction;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the designated drug is in the same category as the
    category for which the establishment licence was issued;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the following information is set out in the List of
    Drugs for Exceptional Importation and Sale in respect of the
    designated drug:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the licensee's name,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in clauses
      (a)(iii)(A) to (F),

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the name of the foreign regulatory authority
      referred to in paragraph (b), and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the date after which it may no longer be
      imported;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the lot number of the designated drug is set out in
    the list referred to in paragraph (d), if applicable;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the total quantity of the designated drug that the
    licensee imports does not exceed the maximum limit specified in the
    list referred to in paragraph (d) in respect of the drug, if
    applicable;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the designated drug is imported on or before the
    date referred to in subparagraph (d)(iv); and

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the licensee has prepared a plan that specifies the
    measures to be taken in order for the licensee to comply with
    section C.10.011.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In subsection (1), [[business
  day]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a day other than

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Saturday; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a Sunday or other holiday.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-199, s. 5](#1314952-1339801){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1314952-1339801.html"}
:::

**[[C.10.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.007 .sectionLabel}** Sections
A.01.040, A.01.044 and C.01.004.1 do not apply in respect of the
importation, under section C.10.006, of a designated drug by a person
who holds an establishment licence.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-199, s. 5](#1314952-1339804){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1314952-1339804.html"}
:::

- **[[C.10.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.008
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to sections C.10.009 and
  C.10.010, a sale of a designated drug that is imported under section
  C.10.006 is exempt from the following provisions:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sections A.01.015, A.01.017 and A.01.051; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the provisions of Part C other than

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} sections C.01.016, C.01.017, C.01.019 to
      C.01.020.1, C.01.040.3 to C.01.049.1 and C.01.051,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the provisions of Divisions 1A and 2, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} this section and sections C.10.009 to C.10.011.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, for the purposes of section
  C.01.016, the manufacturer of a designated drug is required to comply
  only with the requirements set out in sections C.01.017 and C.01.019
  in respect of the drug.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (1) and (2) cease to apply in respect of
  the sale of a designated drug on its expiration date.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-199, s. 5](#1314952-1339815){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1314952-1339815.html"}
:::

- **[[C.10.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Section C.02.019 does not apply to a
  person who holds an establishment licence in respect of a designated
  drug that they import under section C.10.006.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The licensee shall perform the finished product
  testing on a sample of the designated drug that is taken either

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} after receipt of each lot or batch of the
    designated drug on their premises in Canada; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} before receipt of each lot or batch of the
    designated drug on their premises in Canada if the following
    conditions are met:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the licensee has evidence satisfactory to the
      Minister to demonstrate that lots or batches of the designated
      drug sold to them by the vendor of the lot or batch are
      consistently manufactured in accordance with and consistently
      comply with the specifications for that drug, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the designated drug has not been transported or
      stored under conditions that may affect its compliance with the
      specifications for that drug.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} In subsection (2), a reference to specifications is a
  reference to the specifications with which the designated drug is
  required to comply within the jurisdiction of the foreign regulatory
  authority referred to in paragraph C.10.006(1)(b).

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the licensee receives on their premises in Canada
  a lot or batch of a designated drug whose useful life is more than 30
  days, they shall visually inspect the lot or batch to confirm the
  identity of the product.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (2) and (4) do not apply to the licensee
  if the designated drug is fabricated, packaged/labelled and tested in
  an MRA country at a recognized building and the following conditions
  are met:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the address of the building is set out in their
    establishment licence; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} they retain a copy of the batch certificate for
    each lot or batch of the designated drug that they receive for at
    least one year after the expiration date of the lot or batch.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} In this section,
  [[specifications]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} has the same meaning as in
  section C.02.002.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-199, s. 5](#1314952-1339830){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1314952-1339830.html"}
:::

- **[[C.10.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who holds an establishment
  license and who imports a designated drug under section C.10.006 is
  required to comply with paragraphs C.02.020(1)(a), (b) and (d) in
  respect of the drug but is not required to maintain the records
  referred to in those paragraphs on their premises in Canada.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may request that the licensee provide to
  the Minister any of the records referred to in paragraphs
  C.02.020(1)(a), (b) or (d) in respect of the designated drug.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensee shall provide the requested records
  electronically in a format specified by or acceptable to the Minister
  within the time limit specified by the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-199, s. 5](#1314952-1339836){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1314952-1339836.html"}
:::

- **[[C.10.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.10.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who holds an establishment
  licence shall not sell a designated drug that they imported under
  section C.10.006 unless they ensure that the information referred to
  in clause C.10.006(1)(a)(iii)(G) is available in English and French
  and in a manner that permits the safe use of the drug.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The licensee shall ensure that the information is
  available in accordance with subsection (1) until at least the end of
  the day on the latest expiration date of the designated drug that they
  imported.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-199, s. 5](#1314952-1339841){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1314952-1339841.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 11]{.HLabel2}[Public or Canadian Armed Forces Health Emergencies --- Drugs for Immediate Use or Stockpiling]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1391102 .Subheading}

- **[[C.11.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in
  this Division.

  [[foreign regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[foreign regulatory authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same
      meaning as in subsection C.10.001(1). ([autorité réglementaire
      étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[initial public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[initial public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      public health official named in an authorization issued under
      subsection C.11.003(1). ([responsable de la santé publique
      initial]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Public Health Officer appointed under
        subsection 6(1) of the [Public Health Agency of Canada
        Act](/eng/acts/P-29.5);

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Medical Officer of Health, or
        equivalent, of a province;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Medical Officer of Health, or equivalent,
        of a municipality;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Surgeon General of the Canadian Armed
        Forces; or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the Chief Medical Officer of Public Health for
        the Department of Indigenous Services. ([responsable de la santé
        publique]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[subsequent public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[subsequent public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means
      any public health official, other than the initial public health
      official, who obtains the quantity of a drug, or a portion of the
      quantity, that is specified in an authorization issued under
      subsection C.11.003(1). ([responsable de la santé publique
      subséquent]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} This Division applies to a drug for human use in
  dosage form for which a drug identification number has not been
  assigned under subsection C.01.014.2(1) or for which a notice of
  compliance has not been issued under section C.08.004 or C.08.004.01,
  including drugs that have ceased to be considered to be natural health
  products by virtue of subsection 103.15(2) of the [Natural Health
  Products Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2003-196).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391216){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391216.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In order to address an actual,
  imminent or potential emergency, event or incident affecting public
  health or the health of members of the Canadian Armed Forces, a public
  health official may, on application to the Minister, obtain an
  authorization that permits a drug manufacturer to sell a specified
  quantity of a drug to the public health official, for immediate use or
  stockpiling or both.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} set out the name of the public health official and
    include information setting out how they may be contacted at any
    time;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} set out the name of the manufacturer and include
    information setting out how they may be contacted at any time;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} describe the emergency, event or incident;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} state whether the drug is for immediate use or
    stockpiling or both;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} describe the use of the drug that is intended to
    address the emergency, event or incident;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} set out the civic address of the place to which the
    drug is to be shipped by the manufacturer;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} set out the following information about the drug:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its brand name, if any, and either its proper
      name, common name and chemical name or its identifying name, code,
      number or mark,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} its medicinal ingredients,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its strength,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} its dosage form,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the recommended dosage for the use described
      under paragraph (e),

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} its recommended route of administration,

    - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} the indications that have been approved by any
      foreign regulatory authority, if applicable,

    - [(viii)]{.lawlabel} its contraindications,

    - [(ix)]{.lawlabel} a summary of its safety profile, and

    - [(x)]{.lawlabel} the recommended storage conditions for the drug;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} specify the quantity of the drug required to
    address the emergency, event or incident;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} include a statement by the public health official,
    accompanied by supporting information or documents, attesting that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} there is an actual, imminent or potential
      emergency, event or incident affecting public health or the health
      of the members of the Canadian Armed Forces that is likely to
      result, in humans, in a serious or life-threatening disease,
      disorder or abnormal physical state,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} immediate action is or would likely be required
      to diagnose, treat, mitigate or prevent the disease, disorder or
      abnormal physical state or its symptoms,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} conventional therapies, if any, have failed,
      are unsuitable or are unavailable in Canada at the time the
      application is made, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the known and potential benefits associated with
      the use of the drug described under paragraph (e) outweigh the
      known and potential risks associated with that use;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} include any information or document available to
    the public health official concerning the safety, efficacy and
    quality of the drug in respect of the use described under paragraph
    (e), including information published in a medical or scientific
    journal; and

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} set out the following information, if known by the
    public health official:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the names of the foreign regulatory authorities
      that have authorized the sale of the drug in their jurisdictions
      for the same use as that described under paragraph (e),

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the names of the foreign regulatory authorities
      that have received an application for authorization to sell the
      drug in their jurisdictions for the use described under
      paragraph (e) but that have not yet made a decision in respect of
      that application at the time the public health official makes the
      application under subsection (1), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the names of the foreign regulatory authorities
      that have refused to authorize the sale of the drug in their
      jurisdictions for any use, as well as the reason for the refusal.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The public health official must provide the Minister
  with any additional information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary for the purpose of reviewing the application,
  by the date specified by the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391250){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391250.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, after review of
  the application, issue an authorization to a manufacturer authorizing
  the sale of a specified quantity of the drug to the public health
  official for the use described in the application.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In reviewing the application, the Minister must
  consider whether there is an alternative mechanism that would address
  the emergency, event or incident.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The authorization must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} set out the date of issue;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} set out the name and contact information of the
    public health official;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} set out the name and contact information of the
    manufacturer;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} describe the emergency, event or incident;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} state whether the drug is for immediate use or
    stockpiling or both;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} describe the use for which the sale of the drug is
    authorized in order to address the emergency, event or incident;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} set out the civic address of the place to which the
    drug is to be shipped by the manufacturer;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} set out the following information about the drug:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its brand name, if any, and either its proper
      name, common name and chemical name or its identifying name, code,
      number or mark,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} its medicinal ingredients,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its strength,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} its dosage form,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} its recommended dosage and route of
      administration, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} its recommended storage conditions; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} specify the quantity of the drug that may be sold.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391271){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391271.html"}
:::

**[[C.11.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.004 .sectionLabel}** The initial
public health official must notify the Minister, in writing, of any
change to the information provided under paragraph C.11.002(2)(g),
subparagraph C.11.002(2)(i)(iv), paragraph C.11.002(2)(j) or subsection
C.11.002(3), within 30 days after the day on which they become aware of
the change.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391274){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391274.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection C.11.008(2),
  these Regulations, other than sections A.01.010, A.01.014 and
  A.01.045, subsections C.01.001(1) and (1.1) and this Division, do not
  apply to a drug that is sold in accordance with an authorization.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a drug described in Schedule C or D of
  the Act, a drug that is sold in accordance with an authorization is
  exempt from the application of section 12 of the Act.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391279){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391279.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The initial public health official
  must ensure that the drug bears a label or is accompanied by a
  document that clearly sets out the following information in English
  and French:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and civic address of the drug's
    manufacturer;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a statement that the Minister has authorized the
    sale of the drug to address the emergency, event or incident
    described in the authorization;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a statement that the drug is to be used only for
    the use described in the authorization;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the drug's brand name, if any, and either its
    proper name, common name and chemical name or its identifying name,
    code, number or mark;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the drug's medicinal ingredients;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the drug's strength;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the drug's dosage form;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the drug's recommended dosage and route of
    administration;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the drug's lot number, if known;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} all warnings and precautions in respect of the use
    of the drug, if any;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} the drug's expiration date, or, if there is no
    expiration date, the stability testing date or the date on which the
    drug should be retested, as specified by the manufacturer;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} the drug's recommended storage conditions; and

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} the net contents of the drug's container, in terms
    of the weight, volume, size or number of units of the drug in the
    container.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any subsequent public health official must ensure
  that the drug bears the label or is accompanied by the document.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the initial public health official becomes aware
  of a change to any of the information referred to in paragraph (1)(a),
  (h), (j), (k) or (l), they must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} ensure that the information on the drug's label or
    in the accompanying document is updated; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} notify of the change, in writing and without delay,
    any person to whom they have sold any quantity of the drug.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} If the person notified under paragraph (3)(b) is a
  subsequent public health official, they must notify of the change, in
  writing and without delay, any person to whom they have sold any
  quantity of the drug.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Any person who is notified under paragraph (3)(b) or
  subsection (4) must ensure that the updated information accompanies,
  in writing, any quantity of the drug that remains in their possession.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391302){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391302.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the information
  required under subsection C.11.006(1), the initial public health
  official or any subsequent public health official, as the case may be,
  must make the following information available to the following
  persons, in writing, in English and French:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to the persons to whom the drug is administered and
    the persons who administer the drug, the known and potential
    benefits and risks associated with the use for which the sale of the
    drug is authorized, the recommended duration of use, if any, of the
    drug and instructions on how to report serious adverse drug
    reactions; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to the persons who administer the drug, the
    information referred to in paragraphs C.11.002(2)(a), (b) and (e)
    and subparagraphs C.11.002(2)(g)(v), (vii) and (viii), if that
    information is not set out on the drug's label or accompanying
    document.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the initial public health official becomes aware
  of a change to any of the information referred to in subsection (1),
  they must, in writing and without delay, notify the relevant persons
  of the change.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391309){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391309.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.008
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If the initial public health
  official is a person referred to in paragraph (d) of the definition
  [[public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection
  C.11.001(1), they must submit a written report to the Minister in
  respect of any serious adverse drug reaction to the drug, and include
  in the report the information referred to in paragraphs
  C.01.020.1(2)(b) to (l), no later than the 30th day after the day on
  which they become aware of the reaction.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the initial public health official is a person
  referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) or (e) of the definition
  [[public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection
  C.11.001(1), the written report is not required and section C.01.020.1
  applies in respect of the provision of information relating to serious
  adverse drug reactions.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391314){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391314.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The initial public health official
  must monitor the response to the drug in the emergency, event or
  incident --- including monitoring information they receive relating to
  serious adverse drug reactions --- and must take reasonable steps to
  obtain information on that response.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The initial public health official must, on request
  of the Minister, submit a written report to the Minister on the
  monitoring of the response to the drug in the emergency, event or
  incident during the time period specified by the Minister, as well as
  on any corrective measures taken as a result of the monitoring.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391319){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391319.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The initial public health official
  must maintain all information about the sale and use of the drug in a
  way that allows them to submit the information, notices and reports
  referred to in sections C.11.004 and C.11.008 and subsection
  C.11.009(2).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} The initial public health official and any subsequent
  public health official must maintain all information about the sale
  and use of the drug in a way that allows them to communicate with
  persons to whom the drug has been administered if the health of those
  persons may be endangered by its use.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391324){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391324.html"}
:::

**[[C.11.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.011 .sectionLabel}** The initial
public health official or any subsequent public health official, as the
case may be, must retain the information, notices and reports referred
to in sections C.11.004 and C.11.008, subsection C.11.009(2) and section
C.11.010, as applicable, for 15 years after the end of the period to
which the information, notices and reports relate.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391327){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391327.html"}
:::

**[[C.11.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.012 .sectionLabel}** The initial
public health official must account to the Minister for any unused
quantity of stockpiled drug remaining in their possession at the end of
the preceding calendar year by the January 30 that follows the first
full calendar year during which the drug is stockpiled and then by
January 30 of each subsequent year.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391330){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391330.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.013
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may cancel an
  authorization if the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the drug presents a serious or imminent risk of injury to human
  health.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister cancels an authorization, the initial
  public health official must, without delay, notify of the cancellation
  any person to whom they have directly distributed any quantity of the
  drug.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} These Regulations apply to any unused quantity of the
  drug as of the day on which the cancellation takes effect.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391336){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391336.html"}
:::

- **[[C.11.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-C.11.014
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may issue an
  authorization that permits an initial public health official who is a
  person referred to in paragraph (a), (d) or (e) of the definition
  [[public health official]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection
  C.11.001(1) to sell a specified quantity of a stockpiled drug to a
  practitioner for use in the emergency treatment of a person under the
  care of that practitioner, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer of the drug has been issued a
    letter of authorization under subsection C.08.010(1) that authorizes
    the sale of a specified quantity of the drug to that practitioner
    for the emergency treatment of that person; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the use of the drug specified in the letter of
    authorization is the same as the use described in the authorization
    issued to the manufacturer under subsection C.11.003(1).

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} This Division, other than this section, does not
  apply to a drug sold in accordance with an authorization issued under
  subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2023-18, s. 4](#1390699-1391343){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1390699-1391343.html"}
:::

## [PART D]{.HLabel1}[Vitamins, Minerals and Amino Acids]{.HTitleText1} {#h-578798 .Part}

- **[[D.01.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Part,

  [[advertise]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[advertise]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means to advertise to the
      general public; ([faire de la publicité]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[brand name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[brand name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with reference to a
      drug, the name, whether or not including the name of any
      manufacturer, corporation, partnership or individual, in English
      or French,

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is assigned to the drug by its
        manufacturer,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under which the drug is sold or advertised, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that is used to distinguish the drug; ([marque
        nominative]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[common name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[common name]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, with reference to a
      salt or derivative of a vitamin, the name in English or French by
      which the salt or derivative is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} commonly known, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} designated in scientific or technical
        journals; ([nom usuel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Food Compositional Standards Document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Food Compositional Standards Document]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has
      the same meaning as in subsection B.01.001(1); ([Document sur les
      normes de composition des aliments]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[human milk fortifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[human milk fortifier]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as in section B.25.001; ([fortifiant pour lait
      humain]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[human milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[human milk substitute]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as in section B.25.001; ([succédané de lait
      humain]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any food that is
      contained in a package in the manner in which it is ordinarily
      sold to, or used or purchased by, a person; ([produit
      préemballé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[reasonable daily intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[reasonable daily intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a
      food named in an item in Column I of Schedule K, means the amount
      of that food set out in Column II of that item; ([ration
      quotidienne normale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[recommended daily intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[recommended daily intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      SOR/2016-305, s. 61\]]{.Repealed}

  [[supplemental ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplemental ingredient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same
      meaning as in section B.01.001; ([ingrédient
      supplémentaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[supplemented food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplemented food]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
      in section B.01.001; ([aliment supplémenté]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[supplemented food facts table]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[supplemented food facts table]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same
      meaning as in subsection B.01.001(1); ([tableau des renseignements
      sur les aliments supplémentés]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Table of Daily Values]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Table of Daily Values]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as in subsection B.01.001(1); ([Tableau des valeurs
      quotidiennes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Table of Reference Amounts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Table of Reference Amounts]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same
      meaning as in subsection B.01.001(1); ([Tableau des quantités de
      référence]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[testimonial]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[testimonial]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, with respect to a food or
      drug that is represented as containing a vitamin, mineral nutrient
      or mineral, means any dramatized or undramatized pictorial,
      written or oral representation as to the result that is, has been
      or may be produced by the addition to a person's diet of that
      vitamin, mineral nutrient or mineral, as the case may
      be; ([témoignage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[weighted recommended nutrient intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[weighted recommended nutrient
      intake]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a vitamin or
      mineral nutrient, the amount of the vitamin or mineral nutrient
      set out in Table II to Division 1 and Table II to Division
      2. ([apport nutritionnel recommandé pondéré]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Part, a serving of stated
  size of a food shall be

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} based on the food as offered for sale;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in either of the following cases, the net quantity
    of the food in the package:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the quantity of food in the package can
      reasonably be consumed by one person at a single eating occasion,
      or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if the package contains less than 200% of the
      reference amount for the food; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in all other cases, the amount indicated for the
    food according to the criteria set out in column 3A of the Table of
    Reference Amounts.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} A serving of stated size of a food shall be expressed
  as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a single-serving prepackaged product
    to which paragraph (2)(b) applies, per package and using the
    following units:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in grams, if the net quantity of the food is
      shown on the label by weight or by count, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in millilitres, if the net quantity of the food
      is shown on the label by volume; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a multiple-serving prepackaged
    product to which paragraph (2)(c) applies, according to the
    following units set out in column 3B of the Table of Reference
    Amounts and according to the manner set out in that column:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the household measure that applies to the
      product, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the metric measure that applies to the product.

- **[[D.01.001.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.001.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The daily value of a vitamin or
  mineral nutrient set out in column 1 of Part 2 of the Table of Daily
  Values is, in respect of a food, the quantity

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} set out in column 2, if the food is intended solely
    for infants six months of age or older but less than one year of
    age;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} set out in column 3, if the food is intended for
    infants six months of age or older but less than one year of age or
    for children one year of age or older but less than four years of
    age, and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} set out in column 4, in any other case.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply if the food is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a human milk fortifier; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a human milk substitute intended solely for infants
    less than six months of age.

**[[D.01.001.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.001.2 .sectionLabel}** If both a
[[nutrition symbol]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in subsection
B.01.001(1), and a statement or claim referred to in any of sections
D.01.004 to D.01.007 and D.02.002 to D.02.005 appear on the principal
display panel of a prepackaged product,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the height of the upper case letters in the statement
  or claim must not exceed two times the height of the upper case
  letters, excluding any accents, in the nutrition symbol, other than in
  the words "Health Canada" and "Santé Canada"; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the height of the tallest ascender of the lower case
  letters in the statement or claim must not exceed two times the height
  of the tallest ascender of the lower case letters in the nutrition
  symbol, other than in the words "Health Canada" and "Santé Canada".

### [DIVISION 1]{.HLabel2}[Vitamins in Foods]{.HTitleText2} {#h-578839 .Subheading}

- **[[D.01.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Division,
  [[vitamin]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of the following vitamins:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} vitamin A;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} vitamin D;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} vitamin E;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} vitamin K;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} vitamin C;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} thiamin, thiamine or vitamin B~1~;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} riboflavin or vitamin B~2~;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} niacin;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} vitamin B~6~;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} folacin or folate;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} vitamin B~12~;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} pantothenic acid or pantothenate;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} biotin; and

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} choline. (*vitamine*)

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Division, no expression,
  other than an expression set out in subsection (1), shall be used to
  declare the vitamin content of a food.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} This Division applies only in respect of foods
  represented as containing a vitamin for use in human nutrition.

- **[[D.01.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of these
  Regulations, the vitamin content of a food --- other than a formulated
  liquid diet, human milk fortifier, human milk substitute or food
  represented as containing a human milk substitute --- shall be
  determined

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin A, in terms of the content
    of retinol and its derivatives and beta-carotene, calculated on the
    basis of micrograms of retinol activity equivalents (RAE) and
    expressed in micrograms on the basis of the following relationships:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} 1 RAE = 1 microgram of retinol, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 1 RAE = 12 micrograms of beta-carotene;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin D, in terms of the content
    of cholecalciferol and ergocalciferol, expressed in micrograms;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin E, in terms of the content
    of d-alpha-tocopherol and dl-alpha-tocopherol and their derivatives,
    expressed in milligrams on the basis of the following relationships:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} one milligram d-alpha-tocopherol = one milligram
      vitamin E, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} one milligram dl-alpha-tocopherol = 0.74
      milligram vitamin E;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin K, in terms of the content
    of phylloquinone and menaquinones, expressed in micrograms;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin C, in terms of the content
    of L-ascorbic acid and L-dehydroascorbic acid and their derivatives,
    calculated in milligram equivalents of L-ascorbic acid and expressed
    in milligrams;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of thiamin, thiamine or vitamin B~1~,
    and its derivatives, in terms of the content of thiamin, expressed
    in milligrams;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} in the case of riboflavin or vitamin B~2~ and its
    derivatives, in terms of the content of riboflavin, expressed in
    milligrams;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} in the case of niacin, in terms of the content of
    niacin and its derivatives, calculated in milligrams of nicotinic
    acid, plus the content of tryptophan, calculated in milligrams and
    divided by 60, with the total niacin equivalents (NE) expressed in
    milligrams;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin B~6~, in terms of the
    content of pyridoxine, pyridoxal and pyridoxamine and their
    derivatives, calculated in milligram equivalents of pyridoxine and
    expressed in milligrams;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} in the case of folate, in terms of the content of
    folic acid (pteroylmonoglutamic acid) and related compounds
    exhibiting the biological activity of folic acid, calculated on the
    basis of micrograms of dietary folate equivalents (DFE) and
    expressed in micrograms on the basis of the following relationships:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} 1 DFE = 1 μg food folate, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 1 DFE = 0.6 μg folic acid from food with added
      folic acid;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin B~12~, in terms of the
    content of cyanocobalamin and related compounds exhibiting the
    biological activity of cyanocobalamin, calculated in microgram
    equivalents of cyanocobalamin and expressed in micrograms;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} in the case of pantothenic acid or pantothenate, in
    terms of the content of d-pantothenic acid, expressed in milligrams;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} in the case of biotin, in terms of the content of
    biotin, expressed in micrograms; and

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} in the case of choline, in terms of the content of
    choline, expressed in milligrams.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of paragraph (1)(h), the content of
  tryptophan may be calculated

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where the protein originates from a food that
    contains protein from more than one source or from a source other
    than milk, meat, poultry, fish or eggs, as constituting 1.1 per cent
    of the protein;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where the protein originates from milk, meat,
    poultry or fish, as constituting 1.3 per cent of the protein; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} where the protein originates from eggs, as
    constituting 1.5 per cent of the protein.

- **[[D.01.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited, on the label of or
  in any advertisement for a food --- other than a formulated liquid
  diet, human milk fortifier, human milk substitute or food represented
  as containing a human milk substitute --- to make a statement or claim
  concerning the vitamin content of the food unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the vitamin is set out in column 1 of Part 2 of the
    Table of Daily Values;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the percentage of the daily value of the vitamin,
    per serving of stated size, is 5% or more; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the vitamin content is declared on the label or in
    the advertisement as a percentage of the daily value, per serving of
    stated size.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The condition set out in paragraph (1)(c) need not
  be met if the statement or claim described in subsection (1) is made
  on a label of or in any advertisement for a fresh vegetable or fruit
  or any combination of fresh vegetables or fruits without any added
  ingredients, an orange with added food colour or a fresh vegetable or
  fruit coated with mineral oil, paraffin wax, petrolatum or any other
  protective coating.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a statement or claim described in subsection (1)
  is made in an advertisement for a food that is not a prepackaged
  product or in an advertisement for a prepackaged product that is not
  made or placed by or on the direction of the manufacturer of the
  product, the percentage of the daily value, per serving of stated
  size, shall,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an advertisement, other than a radio
    or television advertisement, be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
      written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
      statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
      statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
      once, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shown in letters of at least the same size and
      prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
      claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
      if the statement or claim is made more than once;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a radio advertisement or the audio
    portion of a television advertisement, immediately precede or follow
    the statement or claim; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a television advertisement, be
    communicated

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the audio mode, if the statement or claim is
      made only in the audio portion of the advertisement or in both the
      audio and visual portions, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the audio or visual mode, if the statement or
      claim is made only in the visual portion of the advertisement.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The percentage of the daily value, per serving of
  stated size, that is communicated in the visual mode of a television
  advertisement in accordance with subparagraph (2)(c)(ii) shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} appear concurrently with and for at least the same
    amount of time as the statement or claim;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
    written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
    statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
    statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
    once; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be shown in letters of at least the same size and
    prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
    claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
    if the statement or claim is made more than once.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply in respect of a
  declaration of the vitamin content in a nutrition facts table or
  supplemented food facts table.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(c) does not apply to a declaration of
  the biotin content as required by subparagraph B.24.202(a)(vi).

**[[D.01.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.006 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall, on the label of or in any advertisement for a food, make any
claim concerning the action or effects of a vitamin contained in the
food, except to the effect that the vitamin

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is a factor in the maintenance of good health; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} is generally recognized as an aid in maintaining the
  functions of the body necessary to the maintenance of good health and
  normal growth and development.

- **[[D.01.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a component of an ingredient of a
  prepackaged product set out in the table to subsection B.01.009(1) is
  a vitamin, no person shall, on the label of or in any advertisement
  for the prepackaged product, make a statement or claim concerning the
  vitamin as a component of that ingredient unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} despite subsection B.01.008.2(6), the vitamin is
    declared by its common name, and that common name is shown in
    parentheses immediately after the ingredient in respect of which it
    is a component, except that if a source of a food allergen or gluten
    is required by paragraph B.01.010.1(8)(a) to be shown immediately
    after that ingredient, the common name of the vitamin is instead
    shown immediately after that source; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all components of the ingredient are declared.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to flour used as an
  ingredient in the manufacture of a prepackaged product referred to in
  subsection (1).

**[[D.01.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.009 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section D.01.010, no person shall sell a food to which any of the
following vitamins have been added unless a reasonable daily intake of
that food by a person would result in the daily intake by such person of
that vitamin in an amount not less than,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin A, 1,600 International Units;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of thiamine, 0.6 milligram;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of riboflavin, 1.0 milligram;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of niacin or niacinamide, six milligrams;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of ascorbic acid, 20 milligrams; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin D, 300 International Units.

**[[D.01.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.010 .sectionLabel}** Where a food
to which any of the following vitamins have been added is represented as
being solely for use in the feeding of children under two years of age,
no person shall sell such food unless a reasonable daily intake of that
food by a child under two years of age would result in the daily intake
by the child of that vitamin in an amount not less than,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin A, 1,000 International Units;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of thiamine, 0.4 milligram;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of riboflavin, 0.6 milligram;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of niacin or niacinamide, four
  milligrams;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of pyridoxine, 0.6 milligram;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of ascorbic acid, 20 milligrams;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin D, 300 International Units;
  and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin E, five International Units.

**[[D.01.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.01.011 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a food to which any of the following vitamins have been added
if a reasonable daily intake of that food by a person would result in
the daily intake by such person of that vitamin in an amount more than,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin A, 2,500 International Units;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of thiamine, two milligrams;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of riboflavin, three milligrams;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of niacin or niacinamide, 20 milligrams;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of pyridoxine, 1.5 milligrams;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of ascorbic acid, 60 milligrams;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin D, 400 International Units;
  and

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} in the case of vitamin E, 15 International Units.

### [DIVISION 2]{.HLabel2}[Mineral Nutrients in Foods]{.HTitleText2} {#h-578963 .Subheading}

- **[[D.02.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Division, [[mineral
  nutrient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of the following chemical
  elements, whether alone or in a compound with one or more other
  chemical elements:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sodium;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} potassium;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} calcium;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} phosphorus;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} magnesium;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} iron;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} zinc;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} iodide;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} chloride;

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} copper;

  - [(k)]{.lawlabel} fluoride;

  - [(l)]{.lawlabel} manganese;

  - [(m)]{.lawlabel} chromium;

  - [(n)]{.lawlabel} selenium;

  - [(o)]{.lawlabel} cobalt;

  - [(p)]{.lawlabel} molybdenum;

  - [(q)]{.lawlabel} tin;

  - [(r)]{.lawlabel} vanadium;

  - [(s)]{.lawlabel} silicon; and

  - [(t)]{.lawlabel} nickel. (*minéral nutritif*)

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} This Division applies only in respect of foods that
  are represented as containing a mineral nutrient for use in human
  nutrition.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/88-559, s. 34
- SOR/90-830, s. 9(F)
:::

- **[[D.02.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited, on the label of or
  in any advertisement for a food --- other than salt for table or
  general household use containing added iodide, prepackaged water and
  ice, a formulated liquid diet, human milk fortifier, human milk
  substitute or food represented as containing a human milk substitute
  --- to make a statement or claim concerning the mineral nutrient
  content of the food unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the mineral nutrient is set out in column 1 of Part
    2 of the Table of Daily Values;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the percentage of the daily value of the mineral
    nutrient, per serving of stated size, is 5% or more; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the mineral nutrient content is declared on the
    label or in the advertisement as a percentage of the daily value,
    per serving of stated size.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The condition set out in paragraph (1)(c) need not
  be met if the statement or claim described in subsection (1) is made
  on a label of or in any advertisement for a fresh vegetable or fruit
  or any combination of fresh vegetables or fruits without any added
  ingredients, an orange with added food colour or a fresh vegetable or
  fruit coated with mineral oil, paraffin wax, petrolatum or any other
  protective coating.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a statement or claim described in subsection (1)
  is made in an advertisement for a food that is not a prepackaged
  product or in an advertisement for a prepackaged product that is not
  made or placed by or on the direction of the manufacturer of the
  product, the percentage of the daily value, per serving of stated
  size, shall,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an advertisement, other than a radio
    or television advertisement, be

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
      written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
      statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
      statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
      once, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} shown in letters of at least the same size and
      prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
      claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
      if the statement or claim is made more than once;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a radio advertisement or the audio
    portion of a television advertisement, immediately precede or follow
    the statement or claim; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a television advertisement, be
    communicated

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the audio mode, if the statement or claim is
      made only in the audio portion of the advertisement or in both the
      audio and visual portions, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the audio or visual mode, if the statement or
      claim is made only in the visual portion of the advertisement.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} The percentage of the daily value, per serving of
  stated size, that is communicated in the visual mode of a television
  advertisement in accordance with subparagraph (2)(c)(ii) shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} appear concurrently with and for at least the same
    amount of time as the statement or claim;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} be adjacent to, without any intervening printed,
    written or graphic material, the statement or claim, if the
    statement or claim is made only once, or the most prominent
    statement or claim, if the statement or claim is made more than
    once; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be shown in letters of at least the same size and
    prominence as those of the statement or claim, if the statement or
    claim is made only once, or the most prominent statement or claim,
    if the statement or claim is made more than once.

- [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a statement or claim
  made in respect of the sodium or potassium content.

- [(5)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (1)(a) and (c) do not apply in respect of
  a declaration of the total fluoride ion content as required by
  sections B.12.002 and B.12.008.

- [(6)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply in respect of a
  declaration of the mineral nutrient content in a nutrition facts table
  or supplemented food facts table.

- [(7)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(c) does not apply in respect of a
  declaration of the chromium, copper, manganese, molybdenum and
  selenium content as required by subparagraph B.24.202(a)(v).

**[[D.02.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.004 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall, on the label of or in any advertisement for a food, make any
claim concerning the action or effects of a mineral nutrient contained
in the food, except to the effect that the mineral nutrient

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} is a factor in the maintenance of good health; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} is generally recognized as an aid in maintaining the
  functions of the body necessary to the maintenance of good health and
  normal growth and development.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-300, s. 61(E)
- SOR/88-559, s. 34
:::

- **[[D.02.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a component of an ingredient of a
  prepackaged product set out in the table to subsection B.01.009(1) is
  a mineral nutrient, no person shall, on the label of or in any
  advertisement for the prepackaged product, make a statement or claim
  concerning the mineral nutrient as a component of that ingredient
  unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} despite subsection B.01.008.2(6), the mineral
    nutrient is declared by its common name, and that common name is
    shown in parentheses immediately after the ingredient in respect of
    which it is a component, except that if a source of a food allergen
    or gluten is required by paragraph B.01.010.1(8)(a) to be shown
    immediately after that ingredient, the common name of the mineral
    nutrient is instead shown immediately after that source; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all components of the ingredient are declared.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to flour used as an
  ingredient in the manufacture of a prepackaged product referred to in
  subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/88-559, s. 34
- SOR/2003-11, s. 35
- SOR/2011-28, s. 8
- SOR/2016-305, s. 69
:::

Version](section-D.02.005-20120804.html "Link to previous version of section D.02.005"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[D.02.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.006 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2003-11, s. 35\]]{.Repealed}

**[[D.02.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.007 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/88-559, s. 34\]]{.Repealed}

**[[D.02.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.008 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall, in advertising a food that is represented as containing a mineral
nutrient or on a label of such food,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} give any assurance or guarantee of any kind with
  respect to the result that may be, has been or will be obtained by the
  addition of the mineral nutrient to a person's diet; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} refer to, reproduce or quote any testimonial.

<!-- -->

- **[[D.02.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a food to which
  any of the following mineral nutrients have been added unless a
  reasonable daily intake of that food by a person would result in the
  daily intake by such person of that mineral nutrient in an amount not
  less than,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of calcium, 300 milligrams;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of phosphorus, 300 milligrams;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of iron, four milligrams; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of iodine, 0.10 milligram.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a human milk
  fortifier or a supplemented food.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2021-57, s. 23](#1290631-1291717){.wb-lbx

- **[[D.02.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell elemental iron
  powder for use in foods as a source of iron as a mineral nutrient
  unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} subject to paragraph (b), the powder meets the
    specifications for

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} Iron, Carbonyl,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} Iron, Electrolytic, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} Iron, Reduced,

    as set out in the Food Chemicals Codex, Third Edition, 1981,
    published by the National Academy of Sciences of the United States
    of America; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of Iron, Reduced, 100 per cent by
    weight of the particles pass through a 100 mesh sieve and at least
    95 per cent by weight of the particles pass through a 325 mesh
    sieve.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No person shall sell a food to which elemental iron
  powder has been added as a source of iron as a mineral nutrient unless
  the powder meets the requirements referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) and
  (b).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-303, s. 1
:::

**[[D.02.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.02.011 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a food to which sodium iron pyrophosphate has been added as a
source of iron as a mineral nutrient unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the bioavailability of the iron in the food is not
  less than that set out in column 3 for that item of the [[Table of
  Chemical, Physical and Nutritional Characteristics of
  Food]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as defined in subsection B.01.001(1), as
  determined by the corresponding method set out in column 4; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} that person retains documentary evidence showing that
  the bioavailability of the iron in the food has been determined by the
  method referred to in paragraph (a) and, on request by the Minister,
  submits such evidence to the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/84-303, s. 1
- SOR/2018-69, s. 27
- SOR/2024-244, s. 153
:::

### [DIVISION 3]{.HLabel2}[Addition of Vitamins, Mineral Nutrients or Amino Acids to Foods]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579063 .Subheading}

- **[[D.03.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.03.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Division, the expressions
  [[vitamin]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} and [[mineral
  nutrient]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} have the same meaning as in Divisions 1
  and 2.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} This Division applies only in respect of foods that
  are represented as containing a vitamin, mineral nutrient or amino
  acid for use in human nutrition.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/88-559, s. 35
:::

- **[[D.03.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.03.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section D.03.003, no
  person shall sell a food, other than a supplemented food, to which a
  vitamin, mineral nutrient or amino acid has been added unless the food
  is listed in Column I of the Table to this section and the vitamin,
  mineral nutrient or amino acid, as the case may be, is listed opposite
  that food in Column II.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} No milk or milk product or derivative listed in
  Column I of the Table to this section applies to the lacteal secretion
  obtained from the mammary gland of any animal other than a cow, genus
  [Bos]{.otherLang lang="la"}, or a product or derivative of such
  secretion unless that animal is identified therein.

**[[D.03.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.03.003 .sectionLabel}** Section
D.03.002 does not apply to a food, other than a supplemented food, if
all of the following conditions are met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the food is

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a gluten-free food referred to in paragraph
    B.24.003(1)(g), or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} represented for a special dietary use referred to
    in paragraph B.24.003(1)(h) or (i);

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} no standard is set out in the Food Compositional
  Standards Document for the food; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the food is not advertised.

::: HistoricalNote

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[[\[Repealed, SOR/2003-196, s. 105\]]{.Repealed}]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579088 .Subheading}

### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Minerals in Drugs]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579089 .Subheading}

**[[D.05.001 to D.05.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.05.001_to_D.05.007
.sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, SOR/2003-196, s. 106\]]{.Repealed}

- **[[D.05.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.05.008
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), no person
  shall sell a drug containing fluorine if the largest recommended daily
  dosage of that drug as shown on the label thereof would, if consumed
  by a person, result in a daily intake by that person of more than one
  milligram of fluoride ion.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a drug sold by
  prescription.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-196, s. 2
:::

**[[D.05.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.05.009 .sectionLabel}** Where a drug
contains fluorine, both the inner and outer labels of the drug shall
carry a cautionary statement that, if the drug is used in an area where
the drinking water has a natural fluorine content in excess of 0.7 parts
of fluoride ion per million parts of water or is artificially
fluoridated, mottling of the tooth enamel of a user of the drug may
result.

**[[D.05.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-D.05.010 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed,
SOR/2003-196, s. 107\]]{.Repealed}

## [PART E]{.HLabel1}[Cyclamate Sweeteners]{.HTitleText1} {#h-579098 .Part}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2016-74, s. 11

\]
:::

- **[[E.01.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-E.01.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this Part, [[cyclamate
  sweetener]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of the following substances
  sold as a sweetener:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} cyclohexyl sulfamic acid or any of its salts; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any substance containing cyclohexyl sulfamic acid
    or any of its salts.

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} Part B does not apply to any cyclamate sweetener.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-422, s. 4
- SOR/2016-74, s. 12
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-E.01.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section E.01.001"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Sale]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579108 .Subheading}

**[[E.01.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-E.01.002 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall sell a cyclamate sweetener that is not labelled as required by
this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-422, s. 4
- SOR/2016-74, s. 13
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-E.01.002-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section E.01.002"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Advertising]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579112 .Subheading}

**[[E.01.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-E.01.003 .sectionLabel}** No person
shall, in advertising a cyclamate sweetener to the general public, make
any representation other than with respect to the name, price and
quantity of the sweetener.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-422, s. 4
- SOR/2016-74, s. 14
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-E.01.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section E.01.003"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Labelling]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579116 .Subheading}

**[[E.01.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-E.01.004 .sectionLabel}** Every
cyclamate sweetener shall be labelled to state that it should be used
only on the advice of a physician.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-422, s. 4
- SOR/2016-74, s. 15
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-E.01.004-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section E.01.004"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[E.01.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-E.01.005 .sectionLabel}** Every
cyclamate sweetener shall be labelled to show

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} its energy value expressed, in calories, per
  teaspoon, drop, tablet or other measure used in the directions for use
  and per 100 grams or 100 millilitres; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a list of all its ingredients and, in the case of
  cyclohexyl sulfamic acid or any of its salts or a carbohydrate, its
  quantity.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-422, s. 4
- SOR/2016-74, s. 16
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-E.01.005-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section E.01.005"){.PITLink}
:::

## [PART G]{.HLabel1}[Controlled Drugs]{.HTitleText1} {#h-579125 .Part}

### [DIVISION 1]{.HLabel2}[General]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579126 .Subheading}

#### [Definitions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-579127 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[G.01.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.001 .sectionLabel}** The following
definitions apply in this Part.

[[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Act]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the [Controlled Drugs and
    Substances Act](/eng/acts/C-38.8). ([Loi]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[advertisement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[advertisement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes any representation by
    any means whatever for the purpose of promoting, directly or
    indirectly, the sale or other disposal of a controlled
    drug. ([publicité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[competent authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[competent authority]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a public authority
    of a foreign country that is authorized under the laws of the
    country to approve the importation or exportation of controlled
    drugs into or from the country. ([autorité
    compétente]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[compound]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[compound]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a
    preparation. ([composé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[controlled drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[controlled drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a controlled substance set out in the schedule to
      this Part; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a midwife, nurse practitioner or
      podiatrist, a controlled substance set out in the schedule to this
      Part that the midwife, nurse practitioner or podiatrist may
      prescribe, possess or conduct an activity with, in accordance with
      sections 3 and 4 of the [New Classes of Practitioners
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2012-230). ([drogue
      contrôlée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[designated criminal offence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[designated criminal offence]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an offence involving the financing of terrorism
      against any of sections 83.02 to 83.04 of the [Criminal
      Code](/eng/acts/C-46);

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an offence involving fraud against any of
      sections 380 to 382 of the [Criminal Code](/eng/acts/C-46);

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the offence of laundering proceeds of crime
      against section 462.31 of the [Criminal Code](/eng/acts/C-46);

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an offence involving a criminal organization
      against any of sections 467.11 to 467.13 of the [Criminal
      Code](/eng/acts/C-46); or

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a conspiracy or an attempt to commit, being an
      accessory after the fact in relation to, or any counselling in
      relation to, an offence referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to
      (d). ([infraction désignée en matière criminelle]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

[[destroy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[destroy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a controlled drug,
    means to alter or denature it to such an extent that its consumption
    is rendered impossible or
    improbable. ([destruction]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[hospital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[hospital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a facility that is

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} licensed, approved or designated by a province in
      accordance with the laws of the province to provide care or
      treatment to persons or animals suffering from any form of disease
      or illness; or

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} owned or operated by the Government of Canada or
      the government of a province and that provides health
      services. ([hôpital]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[international obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[international obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an obligation
    in respect of a controlled drug set out in a convention, treaty or
    other multilateral or bilateral instrument that Canada has ratified
    or to which Canada adheres. ([obligation
    internationale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[label]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in section 2
    of the [Food and Drugs
    Act](/eng/acts/F-27). ([étiquette]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[licensed dealer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[licensed dealer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the holder of a
    licence issued under section G.02.007. ([distributeur
    autorisé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[midwife]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[midwife]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in section 1
    of the [New Classes of Practitioners
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2012-230). ([sage-femme]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[nurse practitioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[nurse practitioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
    in section 1 of the [New Classes of Practitioners
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2012-230). ([infirmier
    praticien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[package]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[package]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes anything in which a
    controlled drug is wholly or partly contained, placed or
    packed. ([emballage]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[pharmacist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[pharmacist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who is entitled
    under the laws of a province to practise pharmacy and who is
    practising pharmacy in that province. ([pharmacien]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[podiatrist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[podiatrist]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in
    section 1 of the [New Classes of Practitioners
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2012-230). ([podiatre]{.DefinedTermLink
    lang="fr"})

[[preparation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[preparation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a drug that contains a
    controlled drug and an active medicinal ingredient in a recognized
    therapeutic dose, other than a controlled
    drug. ([préparation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[prescription]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[prescription]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an authorization given by
    a practitioner that a stated amount of a controlled drug be
    dispensed for the person named in it or the animal identified in
    it ([ordonnance]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[qualified person in charge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[qualified person in charge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
    individual designated under subsection G.02.004(1). ([responsable
    qualifié]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[Security Directive]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[Security Directive]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Directive on
    Physical Security Requirements for Controlled Substances and Drugs
    Containing Cannabis, as amended from time to time and published by
    the Government of Canada on its website. ([Directive en matière de
    sécurité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[senior person in charge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[senior person in charge]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the individual
    designated under section G.02.003. ([responsable
    principal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[test kit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[test kit]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a kit

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that contains a controlled drug and a reagent
      system or buffering agent;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is used during the course of a chemical or
      analytical procedure to test for the presence or quantity of a
      controlled drug for a medical, laboratory, industrial,
      educational, law administration or enforcement, or research
      purpose; and

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the contents of which are not intended or likely
      to be consumed by, or administered to, a person or an
      animal. ([nécessaire d'essai]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1208691 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agricultural implants

- **[[G.01.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Act and this Part do not apply
  in respect of a controlled drug that is contained in an agricultural
  implant and set out in Part III of the schedule to this Part, but
  nothing in this section exempts such a drug from the requirements of
  Part C.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definition of [[agricultural
  implant]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[agricultural
  implant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a product that is presented in a
  form suitable to allow sustained release of an active ingredient over
  a certain period of time and that is intended for insertion under the
  skin of a food-producing animal for the purpose of increasing weight
  gain and improving feed efficiency.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Member of police force

**[[G.01.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.003 .sectionLabel}** A member of a
police force or a person acting under their direction and control who,
in respect of the conduct of the member or person, is exempt from the
application of subsection 4(2) or section 5, 6 or 7 of the Act by virtue
of the [Controlled Drugs and Substances Act (Police Enforcement)
Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-97-234) is, in respect of that
conduct, exempt from the application of this Part.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of Parts C and D

**[[G.01.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.004 .sectionLabel}** Except as
otherwise provided in this Part, it is prohibited to sell or provide a
controlled drug or a preparation that does not comply with all
provisions of Parts C and D that are applicable to it.
