#### [Possession]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1208705 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorized persons

- **[[G.01.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.005
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person is authorized to possess a
  controlled drug set out in any of items 1 to 3, 8 to 10, 12 to 14, 16
  and 17 of Part I of the schedule to this Part if the person has
  obtained the controlled drug in accordance with these Regulations, in
  the course of activities conducted in connection with the
  administration or enforcement of an Act or regulation, or from a
  person who is exempt under section 56 of the Act from the application
  of subsection 5(1) of the Act with respect to that controlled drug,
  and the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} requires the controlled drug for their business or
    profession and is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a licensed dealer,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a pharmacist, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} a practitioner who is registered and entitled
      to practise in the province in which they possess that drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is a practitioner who is registered and entitled to
    practise in a province other than the province in which they have
    that possession for emergency medical purposes only;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is a hospital employee or a practitioner in a
    hospital;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has obtained the controlled drug for their own use

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} from a practitioner, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in accordance with a prescription that was not
      issued or obtained in contravention of these Regulations;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} is a practitioner of medicine who received the
    controlled drug under subsection G.06.003(1) or (2) and their
    possession is for the purpose of providing or delivering it to a
    person referred to in subsection G.06.003(3);

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} is an agent or mandatary of a practitioner of
    medicine who received the controlled drug under subsection
    G.06.003(1) and their possession is for the purpose of providing or
    delivering it to a person referred to in subsection G.06.003(2);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} is employed as an inspector, a member of the Royal
    Canadian Mounted Police, a police constable, a peace officer or a
    member of the technical or scientific staff of the Government of
    Canada, the government of a province or a university in Canada and
    their possession is in connection with that employment;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} is not a practitioner of medicine referred to in
    paragraph (e) or an agent or mandatary referred to in paragraph (f),
    is exempted under section 56 of the Act with respect to possession
    of that controlled drug and their possession is for a purpose set
    out in the exemption; or

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} is the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agent or mandatary

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person is authorized to possess a controlled drug
  referred to in subsection (1) if the person is acting as the agent or
  mandatary of any person who is authorized to possess it in accordance
  with any of paragraphs (1)(a) to (e), (h) and (i).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agent or mandatary --- person referred
  to in paragraph (1)(g)

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person is authorized to possess a controlled drug
  referred to in subsection (1) if they

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} are acting as the agent or mandatary of a person
    who they have reasonable grounds to believe is a person referred to
    in paragraph (1)(g); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} possess the controlled drug for the purpose of
    assisting that person in the administration or enforcement of an Act
    or a regulation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208730){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208730.html"}
:::

#### [Test Kits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1208731 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorized activities

**[[G.01.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.006 .sectionLabel}** A person may
sell, possess or otherwise deal in a test kit if the following
conditions are met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a registration number has been issued for the test
  kit under section G.01.008 and has not been cancelled under section
  G.01.009;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the test kit bears, on its external surface,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name of the manufacturer,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the trade name or trademark, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the registration number; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the test kit will be used for a medical, laboratory,
  industrial, educational, law administration or enforcement, or
  research purpose.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208741){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208741.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.01.006-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.01.006"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for registration number

- **[[G.01.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer of a test kit may
  obtain a registration number for it by submitting to the Minister an
  application containing

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the design and
    construction of the test kit;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the controlled drug and
    other substances, if any, contained in the test kit, including the
    qualitative and quantitative composition of each component; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a description of the proposed use of the test kit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the person authorized by the
    applicant for that purpose; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that all of
    the information submitted in support of the application is correct
    and complete to the best of their knowledge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information or document

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The applicant must, not later than the date specified
  in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide the Minister
  with any information or document that the Minister determines is
  necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208755){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208755.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.01.007-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.01.007"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issuance of registration number

**[[G.01.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.008 .sectionLabel}** On completion
of the review of the application for a registration number, the Minister
must issue a registration number for the test kit, preceded by the
letters "TK", if the Minister determines that the test kit will only be
used for a medical, laboratory, industrial, educational, law
administration or enforcement, or research purpose and that it contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a controlled drug and an adulterating or denaturing
  agent that are combined in such a manner and in such a quantity,
  proportion or concentration that the preparation or mixture has no
  significant drug abuse potential; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} such small quantities or concentrations of any
  controlled drug as to have no significant drug abuse potential.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208761){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208761.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.01.008-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.01.008"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Cancellation of registration number

**[[G.01.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.01.009 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
must cancel the registration number for a test kit if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the test kit is removed from the market by the
  manufacturer;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the test kit is used or is likely to be used for any purpose other
  than a medical, laboratory, industrial, educational, law
  administration or enforcement, or research purpose; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the cancellation is necessary to protect public health or safety,
  including to prevent a controlled drug from being diverted to an
  illicit market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208768){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208768.html"}
:::

### [DIVISION 2]{.HLabel2}[Licensed Dealers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579239 .Subheading}

#### [Authorized Activities]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1208772 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}General

- **[[G.02.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer may produce,
  assemble, sell, provide, transport, send, deliver, import or export a
  controlled drug if they comply with this Part and the terms and
  conditions of their dealer's licence and any permit issued under this
  Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Qualified person in charge present

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer may conduct an activity in relation
  to a controlled drug at their site only if the qualified person in
  charge or an alternate qualified person in charge is present at the
  site.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permit --- import and export

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must obtain a permit to import or
  export a controlled drug.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Possession for export

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer may possess a controlled drug for
  the purpose of exporting it if they have obtained it in accordance
  with this Part.

#### [Dealer's Licences]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1208785 .Subheading}

##### [Preliminary Requirements]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1208786 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Eligible persons

**[[G.02.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.002 .sectionLabel}** The following
persons may apply for a dealer's licence:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an individual who ordinarily resides in Canada;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a corporation that has its head office in Canada or
  operates a branch office in Canada; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the holder of a position that includes responsibility
  for controlled drugs on behalf of the Government of Canada, the
  government of a province, a police force, a hospital or a university
  in Canada.

- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208793){.wb-lbx

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Senior person in charge

**[[G.02.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.003 .sectionLabel}** An applicant
for a dealer's licence must designate only one individual as the senior
person in charge, who has overall responsibility for management of the
activities with respect to controlled drugs that are specified in the
licence application. The applicant may designate themself if the
applicant is an individual.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Qualified person in charge

- **[[G.02.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.004
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} An applicant for a dealer's licence
  must designate only one individual as the qualified person in charge,
  who is responsible for supervising the activities with respect to
  controlled drugs that are specified in the licence application and for
  ensuring that those activities comply with this Part. The applicant
  may designate themself if the applicant is an individual.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Alternate qualified person in charge

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An applicant for a dealer's licence may designate an
  individual as an alternate qualified person in charge, who is
  authorized to replace the qualified person in charge when that person
  is absent. The applicant may designate themself if the applicant is an
  individual.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Qualifications

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Only an individual who meets the following
  requirements may be designated as a qualified person in charge or an
  alternate qualified person in charge:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} they work at the site specified in the dealer's
    licence;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} they

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} are a person entitled or, if applicable,
      registered and entitled by a provincial professional licensing
      authority or a professional association in Canada and entitled to
      practise a profession that is relevant to their duties, such as
      pharmacist, practitioner, pharmacy technician or laboratory
      technician,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} hold a diploma, certificate or credential
      awarded by a post-secondary educational institution in Canada in a
      field or occupation that is relevant to their duties, such as
      pharmacy, medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine, pharmacology,
      chemistry, biology, pharmacy technician, laboratory technician,
      pharmaceutical regulatory affairs or supply chain management or
      security, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} hold a diploma, certificate or credential that
      is awarded by a foreign educational institution in a field or
      occupation referred to in subparagraph (ii) and hold

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} an [[equivalency
        assessment]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in subsection
        73(1) of the [Immigration and Refugee Protection
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/SOR-2002-227), or

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} an equivalency assessment issued by an
        organization or institution that is responsible for issuing
        equivalency assessments and is recognized by a province;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} they have sufficient knowledge of and experience
    with the use and handling of the controlled drugs specified in the
    dealer's licence to properly carry out their duties; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} they have sufficient knowledge of the provisions of
    the Act and this Part that are applicable to the activities
    specified in the dealer's licence to properly carry out their
    duties.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An applicant for a dealer's licence may designate an
  individual who does not meet any of the requirements of paragraph
  (3)(b) as a qualified person in charge or an alternate qualified
  person in charge if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} no other individual working at the site meets those
    requirements;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} those requirements are not necessary for the
    activities specified in the licence; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the individual has sufficient knowledge ---
    acquired from a combination of education, training or work
    experience --- to properly carry out their duties.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ineligibility

**[[G.02.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.005 .sectionLabel}** An individual
is not eligible to be a senior person in charge, a qualified person in
charge or an alternate qualified person in charge if, during the 10
years before the day on which the dealer's licence application is
submitted,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a designated substance offence or a
  designated criminal offence or a [[designated
  offence]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in subsection 2(1) of the
  [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5), the individual

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} was convicted as an adult, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} was a [[young person]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} who
    received an [[adult sentence]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as those terms
    are defined in subsection 2(1) of the [Youth Criminal Justice
    Act](/eng/acts/Y-1.5); or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of an offence committed outside Canada
  that, if committed in Canada, would have constituted a designated
  substance offence or a designated criminal offence or a [[designated
  offence]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} as defined in subsection 2(1) of the
  [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5),

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the individual was convicted as an adult, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if they committed the offence when they were at
    least 14 years old but less than 18 years old, the person received a
    sentence that was longer than the maximum [[youth
    sentence]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef}, as that term is defined in
    subsection 2(1) of the [Youth Criminal Justice
    Act](/eng/acts/Y-1.5), that could have been imposed under that Act
    for such an offence.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208839){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208839.html"}
:::

##### [Issuance of Licence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1208840 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[G.02.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who intends to conduct an
  activity referred to in section G.02.001 must obtain a dealer's
  licence for each site at which they intend to conduct activities by
  submitting an application to the Minister that contains the following
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the licence is requested by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an individual, the individual's name,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a corporation, its corporate name and any other
      name registered with a province, under which it intends to conduct
      the activities specified in its dealer's licence or by which it
      intends to identify itself, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the holder of a position described in paragraph
      G.02.002(c), the applicant's name and the title of the position;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address, telephone number and, if
    applicable, the email address of the proposed site and, if different
    from the municipal address, its mailing address;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name, date of birth, telephone number and email
    address of the proposed senior person in charge;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} with respect to each of the proposed qualified
    person in charge and any proposed alternate qualified person in
    charge,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} their name, date of birth, telephone number and
      email address,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the title of their position at the site,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the name and title of the position of their
      immediate supervisor at the site,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, their profession they practise
      that is relevant to their duties, the name of the province that
      authorizes them to practise it and their authorization number, and

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} their education, training and work experience
      that are relevant to their duties;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the activities that are to be conducted and the
    controlled drugs in respect of which each of the activities is to be
    conducted;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} if the licence is requested to manufacture or
    assemble a product or compound that contains a controlled drug,
    other than a test kit, a list that includes, for each product or
    compound,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product or the name of the
      compound,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that is assigned
      to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the name of the controlled drug in the product
      or compound,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the strength per unit of the controlled drug in
      it, the number of units per package and the number of packages,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} if it is to be manufactured or assembled by or
      for another licensed dealer under a custom order, the name,
      municipal address and dealer's licence number of the other
      licensed dealer, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} if the applicant's name appears on the label of
      the product or compound, a copy of the inner label;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} if the licence is requested in order to produce a
    controlled drug other than a product or compound that contains a
    controlled drug,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name of the controlled drug,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the quantity that the applicant expects to
      produce under their licence and the period during which that
      quantity would be produced, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if it is to be produced for another licensed
      dealer under a custom order, the name, municipal address and
      licence number of the other licensed dealer;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} if the licence is requested for an activity that is
    not described in paragraph (f) or (g), the name of the controlled
    drug for which the activity is to be conducted and the purpose of
    the activity;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the security measures in
    place at the site, determined in accordance with the Security
    Directive; and

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the method for recording
    information that the applicant proposes to use for the purpose of
    section G.02.071.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Documents

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An application for a dealer's licence must be
  accompanied by the following documents:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the applicant is a corporation, a copy of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the certificate of incorporation or other
      constituting instrument, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any document filed with the province in which
      its site is located that states its corporate name and any other
      name registered with the province under which the applicant
      intends to conduct the activities specified in its dealer's
      licence or by which it intends to identify itself;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} individual declarations signed and dated by each of
    the proposed senior person in charge, and qualified person in charge
    and any proposed alternate qualified person in charge, attesting
    that the person is not ineligible for a reason specified in section
    G.02.005;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a document issued by a Canadian police force in
    relation to each person referred to in paragraph (b), indicating
    whether, during the 10 years before the day on which the application
    is submitted, the person was convicted as specified in subparagraph
    G.02.005(a)(i) or received a sentence as specified in subparagraph
    G.02.005(a)(ii);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} if any of the persons referred to in paragraph (b)
    has ordinarily resided in a country other than Canada during the 10
    years before the day on which the application is submitted, a
    document issued by a police force of that country indicating whether
    in that period that person was convicted as specified in
    subparagraph G.02.005(b)(i) or received a sentence as specified in
    subparagraph G.02.005(b)(ii);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} declaration, signed and dated by the proposed
    senior person in charge, attesting that the proposed qualified
    person in charge and any proposed alternate qualified person in
    charge have the knowledge and experience required under paragraphs
    G.02.004(3)(c) and (d); and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} if the proposed qualified person in charge or any
    proposed alternate qualified person in charge does not meet the
    requirement of subparagraph G.02.004(3)(b)(i), either

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the person's diploma, certificate or
      credential referred to in subparagraph G.02.004(3)(b)(ii) or
      (iii), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the education,
      training and work experience that is required under paragraph
      G.02.004(4)(c), together with supporting evidence, such as a copy
      of a course transcript or an attestation by the person who
      provided the training.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the proposed senior person
    in charge; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} all information and documents submitted in
      support of the application are correct and complete to the best of
      their knowledge, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} they have the authority to bind the applicant.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The applicant must, not later than the date specified
  in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide the Minister
  with any information or document that the Minister determines is
  necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208892){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208892.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issuance

**[[G.02.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.007 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section G.02.009, on completion of the review of the licence
application, the Minister must issue a dealer's licence, with or without
terms and conditions, that contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licence number;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name of the licensed dealer, their corporate name
  or the title of the position they hold;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the activities that are authorized and the names of
  the controlled drugs in respect of which each activity may be
  conducted;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address of the site at which the dealer
  may conduct the authorized activities;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the security level at the site, determined in
  accordance with the Security Directive;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the effective date of the licence;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the licence, which must be not
  later than three years after its effective date;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} any terms and conditions that the Minister has
  reasonable grounds to believe are necessary to

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} ensure conformity with the requirements associated
    with the security level that is referred to in paragraph (e), or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety,
    including the risk of a controlled drug being diverted to an illicit
    market or use; and

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the licensed dealer produces a controlled drug,
  the quantity that they may produce and the authorized production
  period.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208908){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208908.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity

**[[G.02.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.008 .sectionLabel}** A dealer's
licence is valid until the expiry date set out in the licence or, if it
is earlier, the date of the suspension or revocation of the licence
under section G.02.027 or G.02.028.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208912){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208912.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.02.008-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.02.008"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Refusal

- **[[G.02.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.009
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must refuse to issue a
  dealer's licence if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant may not apply for a licence under
    section G.02.002;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} during the 10 years before the day on which the
    licence application is submitted, the applicant has contravened

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a provision of the Act, the [Cannabis
      Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or their regulations, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a term or condition of a licence or permit
      issued to the applicant under any regulations made under the Act
      or issued to the applicant under the [Cannabis
      Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or its regulations;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} during the 10 years before the day on which the
    application is submitted, the proposed senior person in charge or
    qualified person in charge or any proposed alternate qualified
    person in charge was convicted as specified in subparagraph
    G.02.005(a)(i) or (b)(i) or received a sentence as specified in
    subparagraph G.02.005(a)(ii) or (b)(ii);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an activity for which the licence is requested
    would contravene an international obligation;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the applicant does not have in place at the site
    the security measures set out in the Security Directive in respect
    of an activity for which the licence is requested;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the method referred to in paragraph G.02.006(1)(j)
    does not permit the recording of information as required under
    section G.02.071;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the applicant has not complied with the
    requirements of subsection G.02.006(4) or the information and
    documents that they have provided are not sufficient to complete the
    review of the licence application;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the applicant has submitted false or misleading information or false
    or falsified documents in or in support of the licence application;

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} information received from a competent authority or
    the United Nations gives the Minister reasonable grounds to believe
    that the applicant has been involved in the diversion of a
    controlled drug to an illicit market or use or has been involved in
    an activity that contravened an international obligation; or

  - [(j)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the issuance of the licence would likely create a risk to public
    health or safety, including the risk of a controlled drug being
    diverted to an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must not refuse to issue a licence under
  paragraph (1)(b) or (h) if the applicant meets the following
  conditions, unless the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  it is necessary to do so to protect public health or safety, including
  to prevent a controlled drug from being diverted to an illicit market
  or use:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the applicant does not have a history of
    non-compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or
    their regulations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the applicant has carried out, or signed an
    undertaking to carry out, the necessary corrective measures to
    ensure compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5)
    and their regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before refusing to issue a licence, the Minister must
  send the applicant a notice that sets out the Minister's reasons and
  gives the applicant an opportunity to be heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208935){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208935.html"}
:::

##### [Renewal of Licence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1208936 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[G.02.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.010
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} To apply to renew a dealer's
  licence, a licensed dealer must submit to the Minister an application
  that contains the information and documents referred to in subsections
  G.02.006(1) and (2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the senior person in charge
    of the site specified in the application; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} all of the information and documents submitted in
      support of the application are correct and complete to the best of
      their knowledge, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} they have the authority to bind the licensed
      dealer.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1208949){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1208949.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.02.010-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.02.010"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Renewal

- **[[G.02.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.011
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section G.02.013, on
  completion of the review of the renewal application, the Minister must
  issue a renewed dealer's licence that contains the information
  specified in section G.02.007.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Terms and conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} When renewing a dealer's licence, the Minister may,
  if he or she has reasonable grounds to believe that it is necessary to
  do so, add a term or condition to it or modify or delete one in order
  to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure conformity with the requirements associated
    with the security level specified in the licence or the new level
    required as a result of the licence renewal; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety, including
    the risk of a controlled drug being diverted to an illicit market or
    use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

##### [Amendment of Licence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1208987 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[G.02.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.014
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Before making a change affecting any
  information referred to in section G.02.007 that is contained in their
  dealer's licence, a licensed dealer must submit to the Minister an
  application to amend the licence that contains a description of the
  proposed amendment, as well as the information and documents referred
  to in section G.02.006 that are relevant to the proposed amendment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the senior person in charge
    of the site specified in the application; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} all of the information and documents submitted in
      support of the application are correct and complete to the best of
      their knowledge, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} they have the authority to bind the licensed
      dealer.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

- **[[G.02.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.015
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section G.02.017, on
  completion of the review of the amendment application, the Minister
  must amend the dealer's licence.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Terms and conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} When amending a dealer's licence, the Minister may,
  if he or she has reasonable grounds to believe that it is necessary to
  do so, add a term or condition to it or modify or delete one in order
  to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure conformity with the requirements associated
    with the security level specified in the licence or the new level
    required as a result of the amendment; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety, including

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity

**[[G.02.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.016 .sectionLabel}** An amended
dealer's licence is valid until the expiry date set out in the licence
or, if it is earlier, the date of the suspension or revocation of the
licence under section G.02.027 or G.02.028.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209012){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209012.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.02.016-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.02.016"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Refusal

- **[[G.02.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.017
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must refuse to amend a
  dealer's licence if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an activity for which the licence amendment is
    requested would contravene an international obligation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not have in place at the
    site the security measures set out in the Security Directive in
    respect of an activity for which the licence amendment is requested;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the method referred to in paragraph G.02.006(1)(j)
    does not permit the recording of information as required by section
    G.02.071;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has not complied with the
    requirements of subsection G.02.014(3) or the information or
    documents that they have provided are not sufficient to complete the
    review of the amendment application;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer has submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of the amendment
    application; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the amendment of the licence would likely create a risk to public
    health or safety, including the risk of a controlled drug being
    diverted to an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must not refuse to amend a licence under
  paragraph (1)(e) if the licensed dealer meets the following
  conditions, unless the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  it is necessary to do so to protect public health or safety, including
  to prevent a controlled drug from being diverted to an illicit market
  or use:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not have a history of
    non-compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or
    their regulations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has carried out, or signed an
    undertaking to carry out, the necessary corrective measures to
    ensure compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5)
    and their regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before refusing to amend a licence, the Minister must
  send the licensed dealer a notice that sets out the Minister's reasons
  and gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard.

##### [Changes Requiring Prior Approval by Minister]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1209030 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[G.02.018]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.018
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must obtain the
  Minister's approval before making any of the following changes by
  submitting a written request to the Minister:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a change affecting the security measures at the
    site specified in the dealer's licence;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the replacement of the senior person in charge;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the replacement of the qualified person in charge;
    or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the replacement or addition of an alternate
    qualified person in charge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information and documents

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must provide the Minister with
  the following with respect to a change referred to in subsection (1):

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a change affecting the security
    measures in place at the site specified in the dealer's licence;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the senior person in charge,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information specified in paragraph
      G.02.006(1)(c), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the declaration specified in paragraph
      G.02.006(2)(b) and the documents specified in paragraphs
      G.02.006(2)(c) and (d); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the qualified person in charge or an
    alternate qualified person in charge,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the information specified in paragraph
      G.02.006(1)(d), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the declarations specified in paragraphs
      G.02.006(2)(b) and (e) and the documents specified in paragraphs
      G.02.006(2)(c), (d) and (f).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2004-238, s. 8
- SOR/2010-222, s. 10

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval

- **[[G.02.019]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.019
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section G.02.020, on
  completion of the review of the application for approval of the
  change, the Minister must approve the change.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Terms and conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} When approving a change, the Minister may, if he or
  she has reasonable grounds to believe that it is necessary to do so,
  add a term or condition to the licence or modify or delete one in
  order to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure conformity with the requirements associated
    with the security level specified in the licence; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety, including
    the risk of a controlled drug being diverted to an illicit market or
    use.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Refusal

- **[[G.02.020]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.020
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must refuse to approve
  the change if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} during the 10 years before the day on which the
    application for approval of the change is submitted, the proposed
    senior person in charge or qualified person in charge or any
    proposed alternate qualified person in charge was convicted as
    specified in subparagraph G.02.005(a)(i) or (b)(i) or received a
    sentence as specified in subparagraph G.02.005(a)(ii) or (b)(ii);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has not complied with the
    requirements of subsection G.02.018(3) or the information or
    documents that they have provided are not sufficient to complete the
    review of the application for approval of the change;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer has submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of the application for
    approval of the change; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the change would likely create a risk to public health or safety,
    including the risk of a controlled drug being diverted to an illicit
    market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must not refuse to approve a change
  under paragraph (1)(c) if the licensed dealer has carried out, or
  signed an undertaking to carry out, the necessary corrective measures
  to ensure compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis
  Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) and their regulations, unless the Minister has
  reasonable grounds to believe that it is necessary to do so to protect
  public health or safety, including to prevent a controlled drug from
  being diverted to an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before refusing to approve a change, the Minister
  must send the licensed dealer a notice that sets out the Minister's
  reasons and gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard in respect of
  them.

##### [Changes Requiring Notice to Minister]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1209072 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prior notice

- **[[G.02.021]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.021
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must notify the
  Minister in writing before

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} making or assembling a product or compound that is
    not set out in the most recent version of the list referred to in
    paragraph G.02.006(1)(f) that has been submitted to the Minister; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} making a change to a product or compound that is
    set out in the list, if the change affects any of the information
    that has previously been submitted.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information and list

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notice must contain the information referred to
  in paragraph G.02.006(1)(f) that is necessary to update the list and
  be accompanied by the revised version of the list.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209081){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209081.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.02.021-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.02.021"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice --- five days

**[[G.02.022]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.022 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must notify the Minister in writing within five days after a
person ceases to act as the qualified person in charge or an alternate
qualified person in charge.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209085){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209085.html"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-G.02.022-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.02.022"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice --- 10 days

- **[[G.02.023]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.023
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must notify the
  Minister in writing within 10 days after one of the following changes
  occurs:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person ceases to act as the senior person in
    charge; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer ceases to manufacture or
    assemble a product or compound that is set out in the most recent
    version of the list referred to in paragraph G.02.006(1)(f) has been
    submitted to the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information and list

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A notice submitted under paragraph (1)(b) must
  specify which information referred to in paragraph G.02.006(1)(f) is
  being changed and be accompanied by the revised version of the list.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209094){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209094.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.02.023-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.02.023"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of cessation of activities

- **[[G.02.024]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.024
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer that intends to
  cease conducting activities at their site --- whether on or before the
  expiry of their licence --- must notify the Minister in writing to
  that effect at least 30 days before ceasing those activities.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content of notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notice must be signed and dated by the senior
  person in charge and contain the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the expected date of the cessation of activities at
    the site;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a description of the manner in which any remaining
    controlled drugs on the site as of that date will be disposed of by
    the licensed dealer, including

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if some or all of them will be sold or provided
      to another licensed dealer that will be conducting activities at
      the same site, the name of that dealer,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if some or all of them will be sold or provided
      to another licensed dealer that will not be conducting activities
      at the same site, the name of that dealer and the municipal
      address of their site, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} if some or all of them will be destroyed, the
      date on which and the municipal address of the location at which
      the destruction is to take place;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address of the location at which the
    licensed dealer's documents will be kept after activities have
    ceased; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name, municipal address, telephone number and,
    if applicable, the email address of a person who the Minister may
    contact for further information after activities have ceased.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Update

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} After having ceased to conduct the activities, the
  licensed dealer must submit to the Minister a detailed update of the
  information referred to in subsection (2) if it differs from what was
  set out in the notice. The update must be signed and dated by the
  senior person in charge.

##### [Changes to Terms and Conditions of Licence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1209112 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Addition of or modification to term or
condition

- **[[G.02.025]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.025
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, at any time other
  than the issuance, renewal or amendment of a dealer's licence, add a
  term or condition to it or modify one if the Minister has reasonable
  grounds to believe that it is necessary to do so to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ensure conformity with the requirements associated
    with the security level specified in the licence; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety, including
    the risk of a controlled drug being diverted to an illicit market or
    use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before adding a term or condition to a licence or
  modifying one, the Minister must send the licensed dealer a notice
  that sets out the Minister's reasons and gives the dealer an
  opportunity to be heard.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Urgent circumstances

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), the Minister may add a term
  or condition to a licence or modify one without prior notice if the
  Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that it is necessary to do
  so to protect public health or safety, including to prevent a
  controlled drug from being diverted to an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Urgent circumstances --- notice

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The addition or modification of a term or condition
  that is made under subsection (3) takes effect as soon as the Minister
  sends the licensed dealer a notice that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sets out the reasons for the addition or
    modification;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, specifies the corrective measures
    that must be carried out and the date by which they must be carried
    out.

##### [Suspension and Revocation of Licence]{.HTitleText4} {#h-1209135 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension

- **[[G.02.027]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.027
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must suspend a dealer's
  licence without prior notice if the Minister has reasonable grounds to
  believe that it is necessary to do so to protect public health or
  safety, including to prevent a controlled drug from being diverted to
  an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The suspension takes effect as soon as the Minister
  sends the licensed dealer a notice that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sets out the reasons for the suspension;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, specifies the corrective measures
    that must be carried out and the date by which they must be carried
    out.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reinstatement of licence

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must reinstate the licence if the
  Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that the suspension is no
  longer necessary.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209147){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209147.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.02.027-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.02.027"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation

- **[[G.02.028]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.028
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  Minister must revoke a dealer's licence if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer may no longer apply for a
    licence under section G.02.002;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer requests the Minister to do so
    or informs the Minister of the loss or theft of the licence or the
    actual or potential unauthorized use of the licence;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer ceases to conduct activities at
    their site before the expiry of their licence;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not take the corrective
    measures specified in an undertaking or notice;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has contravened

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a provision of the Act, the [Cannabis
      Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or their regulations, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a term or condition of a licence or permit
      issued to the dealer under a regulation made under the Act or
      issued to the dealer under the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or
      its regulations;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} during the 10 years before the day on which the
    licence is revoked, the senior person in charge, the qualified
    person in charge or any alternate qualified person in charge was
    convicted as specified in subparagraph G.02.005(a)(i) or (b)(i) or
    received a sentence as specified in subparagraph G.02.005(a)(ii) or
    (b)(ii);

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of an application
    relating to the licence; or

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} information received from a competent authority or
    the United Nations gives the Minister reasonable grounds to believe
    that the licensed dealer has been involved in the diversion of a
    controlled drug to an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must not revoke a dealer's licence for a
  ground set out in paragraph (1)(e) or (g) if the licensed dealer meets
  the following conditions, unless the Minister has reasonable grounds
  to believe that it is necessary to do so to protect public health or
  safety, including to prevent a controlled drug from being diverted to
  an illicit market or use:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not have a history of
    non-compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or
    their regulations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has carried out, or signed an
    undertaking to carry out, the necessary corrective measures to
    ensure compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5)
    and their regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before revoking a licence, the Minister must send the
  licensed dealer a notice that sets out the Minister's reasons and
  gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard.

  ::: HistoricalNote
  - [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209168){.wb-lbx
    ajax-after="1136045-1209168.html"}
  :::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return of licence

**[[G.02.029]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.029 .sectionLabel}** The licensed
dealer must return the original of the licence to the Minister within 15
days after the effective date of the revocation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209172){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209172.html"}
:::

#### [Import Permits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209173 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[G.02.030]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.030
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must submit to the
  Minister, before each importation of a controlled drug, an application
  for an import permit that contains the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name, municipal address and dealer's licence
    number;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the controlled drug to be imported,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name, as specified in the dealer's licence,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is a salt, the name of the salt,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its quantity, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a raw material, its purity and
      its anhydrous content;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the controlled drug is contained in a product to
    be imported,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
      assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the strength per unit of the controlled drug in
      the product, the number of units per package and the number of
      packages;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address, in the country of
    export, of the exporter from whom the controlled drug is being
    obtained;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name of the customs office where the
    importation is anticipated; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} each proposed mode of transportation and any
    proposed country of transit or transhipment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the qualified person in
    charge or an alternate qualified person in charge; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that all of
    the information submitted in support of the application is correct
    and complete to the best of their knowledge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209197){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209197.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issuance

**[[G.02.031]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.031 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section G.02.034, on completion of the review of the import permit
application, the Minister must issue to the licensed dealer an import
permit that contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the permit number;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in subsection G.02.030(1);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the effective date of the permit;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the permit, being the earlier of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a date specified by the Minister that is not more
    than 180 days after its effective date, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the dealer's licence; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} any terms and conditions that the Minister has
  reasonable grounds to believe are necessary to

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety,
    including the risk of a controlled drug being diverted to an illicit
    market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209210){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209210.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity

**[[G.02.032]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.032 .sectionLabel}** An import
permit is valid until the earliest of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date set out in the permit,

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the
  permit under section G.02.037 or G.02.038,

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the
  dealer's licence under section G.02.027 or G.02.028, and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the
  export permit that applies to the controlled drug to be imported and
  that is issued by the competent authority in the country of export.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209218){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209218.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return of permit

**[[G.02.033]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.033 .sectionLabel}** If an import
permit expires, the licensed dealer must return the original of the
permit to the Minister within 15 days after its expiry.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209222){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209222.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Refusal

- **[[G.02.034]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.034
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must refuse to issue an
  import permit if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer is not authorized by their
    dealer's licence to import the relevant controlled drug or their
    licence will expire before the date of importation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the importation would contravene an international obligation;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not have in place at the
    site the security measures set out in the Security Directive in
    respect of the importation;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has not complied with the
    requirements of subsection G.02.030(3) or the information or
    documents that they have provided are not sufficient to complete the
    review of the permit application;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer has submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of the permit
    application;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has been notified that their
    application to renew or amend their licence will be refused;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the importation would contravene the laws of the country of export
    or any country of transit or transhipment; or

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the issuance of the permit would likely create a risk to public
    health or safety, including the risk of a controlled drug being
    diverted to an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before refusing to issue the import permit, the
  Minister must send the licensed dealer a notice that sets out the
  Minister's reasons and gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209237){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209237.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Providing copy of permit

**[[G.02.035]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.035 .sectionLabel}** The holder of
an import permit must provide a copy of the permit to the customs office
at the time of importation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209241){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209241.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Declaration

**[[G.02.036]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.036 .sectionLabel}** The holder of
an import permit must provide the Minister, within 15 days after the day
of release of the controlled drug specified in the permit in accordance
with the [Customs Act](/eng/acts/C-52.6), with a declaration that
contains the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name and the numbers of their dealer's licence
  and the import permit that applies to the controlled drug;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the controlled drug,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name, as set out in the dealer's licence,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is a salt, the name of the salt, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its quantity;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the controlled drug is contained in a product that
  they have imported,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
    assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the strength per unit of the controlled drug in
    the product, the number of units per package and the number of
    packages; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of the customs office from which the
  controlled drug was released and the date of the release.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209255){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209255.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension

- **[[G.02.037]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.037
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must suspend an import
  permit without prior notice if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dealer's licence is suspended;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the suspension is necessary to protect public health or safety,
    including to prevent a controlled drug from being diverted to an
    illicit market or use; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the importation would contravene the laws of the
    country of export or any country of transit or transhipment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The suspension takes effect as soon as the Minister
  sends the licensed dealer a notice that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sets out the reasons for the suspension;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, specifies the corrective measures
    that must be carried out and the date by which they must be carried
    out.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reinstatement of permit

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must reinstate the import permit if the
  Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that the suspension is no
  longer necessary.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209270){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209270.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation

- **[[G.02.038]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.038
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  Minister must revoke an import permit if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer requests the Minister to do so
    or informs the Minister of the loss or theft of the permit or the
    actual or potential unauthorized use of the permit;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not carry out the
    corrective measures specified by the Minister under paragraph
    G.02.037(2)(c) by the specified date;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has contravened a term or
    condition of the permit;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of the application for
    the permit;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} information received from a competent authority or
    the United Nations gives the Minister reasonable grounds to believe
    that the licensed dealer has been involved in the diversion of a
    controlled drug to an illicit market or use; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the dealer's licence has been revoked.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must not revoke an import permit for a
  ground set out in paragraph (1)(d) or G.02.028(1)(e) or (g) if the
  licensed dealer meets the following conditions, unless the Minister
  has reasonable grounds to believe that it is necessary to do so to
  protect public health or safety, including to prevent a controlled
  drug from being diverted to an illicit market or use:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not have a history of
    non-compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or
    their regulations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has carried out, or signed an
    undertaking to carry out, the necessary corrective measures to
    ensure compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5)
    and their regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before revoking an import permit, the Minister must
  send the licensed dealer a notice that sets out the Minister's reasons
  and gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209287){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209287.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return of permit

**[[G.02.039]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.039 .sectionLabel}** If an import
permit is revoked, the licensed dealer must return the original of the
permit to the Minister within 15 days after the effective date of the
revocation.

#### [Export Permits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209292 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[G.02.040]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.040
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must submit to the
  Minister, before each exportation of a controlled drug, an application
  for an export permit that contains the following information and
  document:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name, municipal address and dealer's licence
    number;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the controlled drug to be exported,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name, as specified in the dealer's licence,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is a salt, the name of the salt,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its quantity, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a raw material, its purity and
      its anhydrous content;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the controlled drug is contained in a product to
    be exported,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
      assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the strength per unit of the controlled drug in
      the product, the number of units per package and the number of
      packages;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the importer in
    the country of final destination;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name of the customs office where the
    exportation is anticipated;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} each proposed mode of transportation and any
    proposed country of transit or transhipment; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the import permit issued by the competent
    authority in the country of final destination that sets out the name
    of the importer and the municipal address of their site in that
    country.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the qualified person in
    charge or an alternate qualified person in charge; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that, to the
    best of their knowledge,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the exportation does not contravene the laws of
      the country of final destination or any country of transit or
      transhipment, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all of the information and documents submitted
      in support of the application are correct and complete.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209319){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209319.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issuance

**[[G.02.041]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.041 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section G.02.044, on completion of the review of the export permit
application, the Minister must issue to the licensed dealer an export
permit that contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the permit number;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in paragraphs G.02.040(1)(a)
  to (f);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the effective date of the permit;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the permit, being the earliest of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a date specified by the Minister that is not more
    than 180 days after its effective date,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the dealer's licence, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the import permit issued by
    the competent authority in the country of final destination; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} any terms and conditions that the Minister has
  reasonable grounds to believe are necessary to

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety,
    including the risk of a controlled drug being diverted to an illicit
    market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209333){.wb-lbx

:::

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the

  destination.

#### [Identification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209415 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Name

**[[G.02.050]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.050 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must include their name, as set out in their dealer's licence, on
all the means by which they identify themself in regard to their
activities in relation to controlled drugs, including labels, orders,
shipping documents, invoices and advertising
