#### [Sale of Controlled Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209420 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to another licensed dealer

**[[G.02.051]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.051 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer may sell or provide a controlled drug to another licensed dealer.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209424){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209424.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to pharmacist

- **[[G.02.052]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.052
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), a
  licensed dealer may sell or provide a controlled drug to a pharmacist.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- pharmacist named in
  notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must not sell or provide to a
  pharmacist named in a notice issued under section G.03.017.2 the
  controlled drugs referred to in the notice unless the dealer has
  received a notice of retraction issued under section G.03.017.3.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209431){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209431.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to practitioner

- **[[G.02.053]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.053
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), a
  licensed dealer may sell or provide a controlled drug to a
  practitioner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- practitioner named in
  notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must not sell or provide to a
  practitioner who is named in a notice issued under section G.04.004.2
  the controlled drugs referred to in the notice, unless the dealer has
  received a notice of retraction issued under section G.04.004.3.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209438){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209438.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision to hospital employee

**[[G.02.054]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.054 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer may provide a controlled drug to a hospital employee.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209442){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209442.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to exempted person

**[[G.02.055]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.055 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer may sell or provide a controlled drug to a person who is exempted
under section 56 of the Act with respect to the possession of that drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209446){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209446.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to Minister

**[[G.02.056]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.056 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer may sell or provide a drug to the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209450){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209450.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Written order

**[[G.02.057]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.057 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer may sell or provide a controlled drug under any of sections
G.02.051 to G.02.055 if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dealer has received a written order that
  specifies the name and quantity of the drug to be supplied and is
  signed and dated

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug to be provided to a hospital
    employee or a practitioner in a hospital, by the pharmacist in
    charge of the hospital's pharmacy or by a practitioner authorized by
    the person in charge of the hospital to sign the order, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, by the person to whom the drug
    is to be sold or provided; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the dealer has verified the signature, if it is
  unknown to them.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209458){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209458.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Verbal order

- **[[G.02.058]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.058
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer may sell or
  provide a controlled drug listed in Part II or III of the schedule to
  this Part if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dealer has received a verbal order that
    specifies the name and quantity of the drug to be supplied; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of the provision of the drug to a
    hospital employee or a practitioner in a hospital, the order has
    been placed by the pharmacist in charge of the hospital's pharmacy
    or by a practitioner authorized by the person in charge of the
    hospital to place the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Receipt

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer that has received a verbal order
  from a pharmacist or practitioner must, within five working days after
  filling the order, obtain and keep a receipt that includes

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the signature of the pharmacist or practitioner who
    received the controlled drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the pharmacist or practitioner
    received the controlled drug; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of the controlled drug.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No further sale without receipt

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the licensed dealer has not obtained the receipt
  within five working days, the dealer must not sell or provide a
  controlled drug to the pharmacist or practitioner in accordance with a
  further verbal order received from them until after obtaining the
  receipt.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209472){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209472.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Anticipated multiple sales

- **[[G.02.059]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.059
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer may sell or
  provide a controlled drug more than once in respect of one order if
  the order indicates

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the number of sales or provisions, not exceeding
    four;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the specific quantity for each sale or provision;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the intervals between each sale or provision.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Multiple sales --- insufficient stock

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer may sell or provide a controlled
  drug more than once in respect of one order if, at the time of receipt
  of the order, the dealer temporarily does not have in stock the
  quantity of the drug ordered, in which case the dealer may sell or
  provide against the order the quantity of the drug that the dealer has
  available and deliver the balance later.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209482){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209482.html"}
:::

#### [Packaging and Transportation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209483 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Packaging --- sale and provision

- **[[G.02.060]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.060
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer that sells or
  provides a controlled drug must securely package it in its immediate
  container, which must be sealed in such a manner that the container
  cannot be opened without breaking the seal.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Packaging --- transport and export

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer that transports or exports a
  controlled drug must ensure that its package is sealed in such a
  manner that the package cannot be opened without breaking the seal.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a test kit that
  contains a controlled drug and that has a registration number.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209492){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209492.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transport

- **[[G.02.061]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.061
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must, in taking
  delivery of a controlled drug that they have imported or in making
  delivery of a controlled drug,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} take any measures that are necessary to ensure the
    security of the drug while it is being transported;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (2), use a method of
    transportation that permits an accurate record to be kept of all
    handling of the drug as well as the signatures of every person
    handling it until it is delivered to the consignee;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an imported drug, transport it
    directly to the site specified in their licence after it is released
    under the [Customs Act](/eng/acts/C-52.6); and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug to be exported, transport it
    directly from the site specified in their licence to the customs
    office where it will be exported.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer may have a preparation transported
  by a common carrier.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209503){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209503.html"}
:::

#### [Thefts, Losses and Suspicious Transactions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209504 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Protective measures

**[[G.02.062]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.062 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must take any measures that are necessary to ensure the security
of any controlled drug in their possession and any licence or permit in
their possession.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209508){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209508.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Theft or loss --- licence and permit

**[[G.02.063]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.063 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that becomes aware of a theft or loss of their licence or permit
must provide a written report to the Minister within 72 hours after
becoming aware of it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209512){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209512.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Theft or unexplainable loss ---
controlled drug

**[[G.02.064]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.064 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that becomes aware of a theft of a controlled drug or of a loss
of a controlled drug that cannot be explained on the basis of normally
accepted business activities must

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} provide a written report to a member of a police
  force within 24 hours after becoming aware of the theft or loss; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide a written report to the Minister within 72
  hours after becoming aware of the theft or loss and include a
  confirmation that the report required under paragraph (a) has been
  provided.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209518){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209518.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspicious transaction

- **[[G.02.065]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.065
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must provide a
  written report containing the following information to the Minister
  within 72 hours after becoming aware of a transaction occurring in the
  course of their activities that they have reasonable grounds to
  suspect may be related to the diversion of a controlled drug to an
  illicit market or use:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name, municipal address, telephone number
    and, if the licensed dealer is a corporation, the position held by
    the individual making the report;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the other party
    to the transaction;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} details of the transaction, including its date and
    time, its type, the name and quantity of the controlled drug and, in
    the case of a product or compound, the quantity of every controlled
    drug that it contains;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product that contains the
    controlled drug, other than a test kit, the drug identification
    number that is assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the reasons for those
    suspicions.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Good faith

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No civil proceedings lie against a licensed dealer
  for having provided the report in good faith.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-disclosure

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must not disclose that they have
  provided the report or disclose details of it, with the intent to
  prejudice a criminal investigation, whether or not a criminal
  investigation has begun.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209532){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209532.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Partial protection against
self-incrimination

**[[G.02.066]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.066 .sectionLabel}** A report made
under any of sections G.02.063 to G.02.065, or any evidence derived from
it, is not to be used or received to incriminate the licensed dealer in
any criminal proceeding against them other than a prosecution under
section 132, 136 or 137 of the [Criminal Code](/eng/acts/C-46).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209536){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209536.html"}
:::

#### [Destruction of Controlled Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209537 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction at site

**[[G.02.067]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.067 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that intends to destroy a controlled drug at the site specified
in their licence must ensure that the following conditions are met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer obtains the prior approval of the
  Minister;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the destruction occurs in the presence of two of the
  following persons, at least one of whom must be a person referred to
  in subparagraph (i):

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the senior person in charge, the qualified person
    in charge or an alternate qualified person in charge, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a person who works for or provides services to the
    licensed dealer and holds a senior position;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the destruction is carried out in accordance with a
  method that complies with all federal, provincial and municipal
  environmental protection legislation applicable to the place of
  destruction; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} as soon as the destruction is completed, the person
  who carried out the destruction and each of the two persons referred
  to in paragraph (b) who were present at the destruction sign and date
  a joint declaration attesting that the controlled drug was completely
  destroyed, to which each signatory must add their name in printed
  letters.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209547){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209547.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction elsewhere than at site

**[[G.02.068]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.068 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that intends to destroy a controlled drug elsewhere than at the
site specified in their licence must ensure that the following
conditions are met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer obtains the prior approval of the
  Minister;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer takes any measures that are
  necessary to ensure the security of the controlled drug while it is
  being transported in order to prevent its diversion to an illicit
  market or use;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the destruction is carried out by a person working
  for a business that specializes in the destruction of dangerous goods
  and in the presence of another person working for that business;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the destruction is carried out in accordance with a
  method that complies with all federal, provincial and municipal
  environmental protection legislation applicable to the place of
  destruction; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} as soon as the destruction is completed, the person
  who carried out the destruction provides the licensed dealer with a
  dated declaration attesting that the controlled drug was completely
  destroyed and containing

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address of the place of destruction,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of the controlled drug and,
    if applicable, the brand name and quantity of the product containing
    it or the name and quantity of the compound containing it,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the method of destruction,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the date of destruction, and

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the names in printed letters and signatures of that
    person and the other person who was present at the destruction.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209561){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209561.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for prior approval

- **[[G.02.069]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.069
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must submit to the
  Minister an application that contains the following information in
  order to obtain the Minister's prior approval to destroy a controlled
  drug:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name, municipal address and dealer's licence
    number;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the proposed date of destruction;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address of the place of destruction;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a brief description of the method of destruction;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} if the destruction is to be carried out at the site
    specified in the dealer's licence, the names of the persons proposed
    for the purpose of paragraph G.02.067(b) and information
    establishing that they meet the conditions of that paragraph;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name of the controlled drug and, if applicable,
    the brand name of the product containing it or the name of the
    compound containing it; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the form and quantity of the controlled drug or the
    product or compound containing it and, if applicable, the strength
    per unit of the controlled drug in the product or compound, the
    number of units per package and the number of packages.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the qualified person in
    charge or an alternate qualified person in charge; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the proposed method of destruction complies with
      all federal, provincial and municipal environmental protection
      legislation applicable to the place of destruction, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all of the information submitted in support of
      the application is correct and complete to the best of the
      signatory's knowledge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209581){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209581.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval

**[[G.02.070]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.070 .sectionLabel}** On completion
of the review of the approval application, the Minister must approve the
destruction of the controlled drug unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a destruction that is to be carried
  out at the site specified in the dealer's licence, the persons
  proposed for the purpose of paragraph G.02.067(b) do not meet the
  conditions of that paragraph;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the controlled drug would not be destroyed;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the licensed dealer has submitted false or misleading information or
  false or falsified documents in or in support of the approval
  application;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the controlled drug or a portion of it is required
  for the purposes of a criminal or administrative investigation or a
  preliminary inquiry, trial or other proceeding under any Act or its
  regulations; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the approval would likely create a risk to public health or safety,
  including the risk of the controlled drug being diverted to an illicit
  market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209590){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209590.html"}
:::

#### [Documents]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209591 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Method of recording information

**[[G.02.071]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.071 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must record any information that they are required to record
under this Part using a method that permits an audit of it to be made at
any time.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209595){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209595.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information --- general

**[[G.02.072]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.072 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must record the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any controlled drug
  that the dealer orders, the name of the person who placed the order on
  the dealer's behalf and the date of the order;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any controlled drug
  that the dealer receives, the name and municipal address of the person
  who sold or provided it and the date on which it was received;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a controlled drug that the dealer
  sells or provides,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product or the name of the
    compound containing the controlled drug and the name of the
    controlled drug,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
    assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the form and quantity of the controlled drug and,
    if applicable, the strength per unit of the controlled drug in the
    product or compound, the number of units per package and the number
    of packages,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the person to
    whom it was sold or provided, and

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the date on which it was sold or provided;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any controlled drug
  that the dealer manufactures or assembles and the date on which it was
  placed in stock and, if applicable, the strength per unit of the
  controlled drug in the product or compound, the number of units per
  package and the number of packages;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of any controlled drug that the
  dealer uses in the manufacturing or assembling of a product or
  compound, as well as the brand name and quantity of the product or the
  name and quantity of the compound, and the date on which the product
  or compound was placed in stock;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any controlled drug in
  stock at the end of each month;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any controlled drug
  that the dealer delivers, transports or sends, the name and municipal
  address of the consignee and the date on which it was delivered,
  transported or sent;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any controlled drug
  that the dealer imports, the date on which it was imported, the name
  and municipal address of the exporter, the country of exportation and
  any country of transit or transhipment; and

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any controlled drug
  that the dealer exports, the date on which it was exported, the name
  and municipal address of the importer, the country of final
  destination and any country of transit or transhipment.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209613){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209613.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Verbal order

**[[G.02.073]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.073 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that receives a verbal order for a controlled drug listed in Part
II or III of the schedule to this Part and sells or provides it to a
pharmacist, practitioner or hospital employee must immediately record

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the person who placed the order;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the order was received; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name of the person recording the order.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209620){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209620.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Explainable loss of controlled drug

**[[G.02.074]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.074 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that becomes aware of a loss of a controlled drug that can be
explained on the basis of normally accepted business activities must
record the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the lost controlled drug and, if
  applicable, the brand name of the product or the name of the compound
  containing it;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the form and quantity of the controlled drug and, if
  applicable, the form of the product or compound containing it, the
  strength per unit of the controlled drug in the product or compound,
  the number of units per package and the number of packages;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the dealer became aware of the
  loss; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the explanation for the loss.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209628){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209628.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction

**[[G.02.075]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.075 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must record the following information concerning any controlled
drug that they destroy at the site specified in their licence:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address of the place of destruction;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of the controlled drug
  and, if applicable, the brand name and quantity of the product
  containing the drug or the name and quantity of the compound
  containing the drug;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the method of destruction; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the date of destruction.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209636){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209636.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual report

- **[[G.02.076]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.076
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3),
  a licensed dealer must provide to the Minister, within three months
  after the end of each calendar year, an annual report that contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and total quantity of each
    controlled drug that they receive, produce, sell, provide, import,
    export or destroy during the calendar year, as well as the name and
    total quantity of each controlled drug that they use to manufacture
    or assemble a product or compound;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of each controlled drug
    in physical inventory taken at the site specified in their licence
    at the end of the calendar year; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any controlled drug
    that has been lost or stolen in the course of conducting activities
    during the calendar year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-renewal or revocation within first
  three months

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a licensed dealer's licence expires without being
  renewed or is revoked during the first three months of a calendar
  year, the dealer must provide to the Minister

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} within three months after the end of the preceding
    calendar year, the annual report in respect of that year; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} within three months after the expiry or revocation,
    a report in respect of the portion of the current calendar year
    during which the licence was valid that contains the information
    referred to in subsection (1), in which the quantity in physical
    inventory is to be calculated as of the date of expiry or
    revocation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-renewal or revocation after third
  month

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a licensed dealer's licence expires without being
  renewed or is revoked after the first three months of a calendar year,
  the dealer must provide to the Minister, within three months after the
  expiry or revocation, a report in respect of the portion of the
  calendar year during which the licence was valid that contains the
  information referred to in subsection (1) for that period, in which
  the quantity in physical inventory is to be calculated as of the date
  of expiry or revocation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209650){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209650.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Retention period

**[[G.02.077]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.077 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer and a former licensed dealer must keep any document containing
the information that they are required to record under this Part,
including every declaration and a copy of every report, for a period of
two years following the day on which the last record is recorded in the
document and in a manner that permits an audit of the document to be
made at any time.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209654){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209654.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location

**[[G.02.078]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.078 .sectionLabel}** The documents
must be kept

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a licensed dealer, at the site
  specified in their licence; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a former licensed dealer, at a
  location in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209660){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209660.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Quality of documents

**[[G.02.079]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.02.079 .sectionLabel}** The documents
must be complete and readily retrievable and the information in them
must be legible and indelible.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 1](#1136045-1209664){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136045-1209664.html"}
:::

#### [Record of Controlled Drugs Received]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209668 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2019-171, s. 2

\]
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}General information

- **[[G.03.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A pharmacist, on receipt of a
  controlled drug from a licensed dealer or from another pharmacist,
  shall keep a record of the name and quantity of the controlled drug
  received by them, the name and address of the person who sold or
  provided it and the date it was received.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Record

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The record of information referred to in
  subsection (1) shall be kept

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a manner that permits an audit to be made; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to subsection (3), in a book, register or
    similar record maintained exclusively for controlled drugs.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The record of information referred to in
  subsection (1) may, with respect to a controlled drug listed in Part
  II or III of the schedule to this Part, be kept in a form other than
  that specified in paragraph (2)(b).

#### [Sale of Controlled Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209671 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2019-171, s. 3

\]
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No sale without prescription

**[[G.03.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.002 .sectionLabel}** No pharmacist
shall, except as otherwise provided in this Part, sell or provide a
controlled drug to any person unless the pharmacist has first been
provided with a prescription for it, and

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the prescription is in writing, it has been signed
  and dated by the practitioner issuing the same and the signature of
  the practitioner where not known to the pharmacist, has been verified
  by him; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the prescription is given verbally, the pharmacist
  has taken reasonable precaution to satisfy himself that the person
  giving the prescription is a practitioner.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2004-238, s. 14
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.03.002-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.002"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- pharmacist or
practitioner named in notice

**[[G.03.002.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.002.1 .sectionLabel}** Subject
to section G.03.002.2 and notwithstanding sections G.03.002, G.03.003
and G.03.005, no pharmacist shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} sell or provide a controlled drug, other than a
  preparation, to a pharmacist named in a notice given by the Minister
  under section G.03.017.2;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} sell or provide a preparation to a pharmacist named
  in a notice given by the Minister under section G.03.017.2;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} dispense, sell or provide a controlled drug, other
  than a preparation, to, or pursuant to a prescription or order given
  by, a practitioner named in a notice given by the Minister under
  section G.04.004.2; or

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} dispense, sell or provide a preparation to a
  practitioner or pursuant to a prescription or order given by a
  practitioner named in a notice given by the Minister under section
  G.04.004.2.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-135, ss. 7, 8
- SOR/2004-238, s. 15
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 4(F)](#1136054-1209675){.wb-lbx

:::

Version](section-G.03.002.1-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.002.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- notice of retraction

**[[G.03.002.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.002.2 .sectionLabel}** Section
G.03.002.1 does not apply to a pharmacist to whom the Minister has
issued a notice of retraction of the notice

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} under section G.03.017.3, in respect of a pharmacist
  named in a notice issued by the Minister under section G.03.017.2; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} under section G.04.004.3, in respect of a
  practitioner named in a notice issued by the Minister under section
  G.04.004.2.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-135, s. 4
:::

[Previous
Version](section-G.03.002.2-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.002.2"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to practitioner -- order

- **[[G.03.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A pharmacist may sell or provide a
  controlled drug to a practitioner for use in their practice

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} upon a written order, signed and dated by that
    practitioner, that has been verified if the signature of the
    practitioner is unknown to the pharmacist; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} upon a verbal order specifying the name and

    precautions to satisfy themself that the person making the order is

- [(2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, SOR/2019-171, s. 5\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescription file

**[[G.03.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.004 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall, in respect of controlled drugs sold or provided to a practitioner
under section G.03.003, keep in a special prescription file a record
showing the date, the name and address of the practitioner, and the
quantity and kind of controlled drug sold or provided.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision to hospital

**[[G.03.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.005 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
may provide a controlled drug to a hospital employee or to a
practitioner in a hospital on receipt of a written order signed and
dated by the pharmacist in charge of the hospital's pharmacy or by a
practitioner authorized by the person in charge of the hospital to sign
the order, if the signature of that pharmacist or practitioner is known
to the pharmacist or, if unknown, has been verified by the pharmacist.

::: HistoricalNote

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Refilling prescription

**[[G.03.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.006 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall not refill a prescription for a controlled drug unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the practitioner, at the time that he issued the
  prescription, directed in writing, in the case of a controlled drug
  listed in Part I of the schedule to this Part, or directed in writing
  or orally, in the case of a controlled drug listed in Part II or III
  of the schedule to this Part, that the prescription be refilled, the
  number of times that it may be refilled and the dates for or the
  intervals between refills; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the pharmacist keeps a record of each refilling of a
  prescription.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-427, s. 6
- SOR/97-228, s. 13
:::

Version](section-G.03.006-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.006"){.PITLink}

#### [Records]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209681 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Written order or prescription

**[[G.03.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.007 .sectionLabel}** If, in
accordance with a written order or prescription, a pharmacist dispenses
a controlled drug listed in Part I of the schedule to this Part, other
than a preparation, the pharmacist must immediately enter in a book,
register or similar record maintained for such purposes

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name or initials;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, initials and municipal address of the
  practitioner who issued the order or prescription;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the person named in
  the order or prescription;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of the controlled drug
  dispensed;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the controlled drug was dispensed;
  and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the number assigned to the order or prescription.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-427, s. 7
- SOR/81-359, s. 1(F)
- SOR/97-228, s. 14
- SOR/2004-238
- s\. 19
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 7](#1136059-1209690){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136059-1209690.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.03.007-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.007"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Verbal order or prescription

**[[G.03.008]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.008 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
must, before dispensing a controlled drug in accordance with a verbal
order or prescription, make a written record of it that sets out

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name or initials;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, initials and municipal address of the
  practitioner who issued the order or prescription;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the person named in
  the order or prescription;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of the controlled drug;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the directions for use given with the order or
  prescription;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the controlled drug was dispensed;
  and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the number assigned to the order or prescription.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-550, s. 7
- SOR/2004-238, s. 20
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 7](#1136059-1209700){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136059-1209700.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.03.008-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.008"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}File by date and number

**[[G.03.009]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.009 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
must maintain a special prescription file in which are filed, in
sequence as to date and number, all written orders and prescriptions for
controlled drugs that they have dispensed and the written record of all
controlled drugs that they have dispensed in accordance with a verbal
order or prescription.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 7](#1136059-1209704){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136059-1209704.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.03.009-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.009"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Retention period

**[[G.03.010]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.010 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall retain in his possession for a period of at least two years, any
records which he is required to keep by this Part.

#### [General Obligations of Pharmacist]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209705 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2019-171, s. 8

\]
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Providing information and assisting
inspector

**[[G.03.011]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.011 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} furnish such information respecting the dealings of
  the pharmacist in any controlled drug in such form and at such times
  as the Minister may require;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} make available and produce to an inspector upon
  request his special prescription file together with any books, records
  or documents which he is required to keep;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} permit an inspector to make copies of or to take
  extracts from such files, books, records or documents; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} permit an inspector to check all stocks of controlled
  drugs on his premises.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Loss or theft --- protective measures

**[[G.03.012]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.012 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall take all reasonable steps that are necessary to protect controlled
drugs on his premises or under his control against loss or theft.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-550, s. 8
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.03.012-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.012"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Loss or theft --- report

**[[G.03.013]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.013 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall report to the Minister any loss or theft of a controlled drug
within 10 days of his discovery thereof.

#### [Return, Sale and Transfer]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209708 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2019-171, s. 9

\]
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Written order

**[[G.03.014]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.014 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
may, upon receiving a written order for a controlled drug signed and
dated by

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer who sold or provided that drug to
  them, return that drug to that licensed dealer;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} another pharmacist, sell or provide any quantity of
  that drug to that other pharmacist that is specified in the order as
  being required for emergency purposes;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister, sell or provide to the Minister any
  quantity of that drug, specified in the order, that is required by the
  Minister in connection with his or her duties; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person exempted under section 56 of the Act with
  respect to that controlled drug, sell or provide to that person any
  quantity of that drug that is specified in the order.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/81-359, s. 2
- SOR/85-550, s. 9

:::

[Previous
Version](section-G.03.014-20180404.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.014"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Record

**[[G.03.015]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.015 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall immediately after receiving, selling or providing a controlled
drug under paragraph G.03.014(b) or (c) or subsection G.05.003(4) enter
the details of the transaction in a book, register or other record
maintained for the purpose of recording such transactions.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/85-550, s. 10
- SOR/2004-238, s. 22
:::

[Previous
Version](section-G.03.015-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.015"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to Minister

**[[G.03.016]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.016 .sectionLabel}** A pharmacist
shall forthwith after removing, transporting or transferring a
controlled drug from his place of business to any other place of
business operated by him notify the Minister, setting out the details.

#### [Communication of Information by Minister to Licensing Authority]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209714 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contraventions by pharmacist

**[[G.03.017]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.017 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
must provide in writing any factual information about a pharmacist that
has been obtained under the Act or this Part to the provincial
professional licensing authority that is responsible for the
authorization of the person to practise their profession

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the province in which the pharmacist is or was
  entitled to practise if

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the authority submits to the Minister a written
    request that sets out the pharmacist's name and address, a
    description of the information being requested and a statement that
    the information is required for the purpose of assisting a lawful
    investigation by the authority, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe
    that the pharmacist has

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} contravened a rule of conduct established by the
      authority,

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} been convicted of a designated substance offence,
      or

    - [(C)]{.lawlabel} contravened this Part; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in a province in which the pharmacist is not entitled
  to practise, if the authority submits to the Minister

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a written request that sets out the pharmacist's
    name and address and a description of the information being
    requested, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a document that shows that

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the pharmacist has applied to that authority to
      practise in that province, or

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the authority has reasonable grounds to believe
      that the pharmacist is practising in that province without being
      authorized to do so.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/86-881, s. 1
- SOR/97-228, s. 15
- SOR/2003-135, s. 5
- SOR/2010-222, s. 15
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 11](#1136067-1209728){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136067-1209728.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.03.017-20101021.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.017"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Notice of Prohibition of Sale]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209729 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Request by pharmacist

**[[G.03.017.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.017.1 .sectionLabel}** A
pharmacist may make a written request to the Minister to send to the
persons and authorities specified in subsection G.03.017.2(3) a notice,
issued under section G.03.017.2, advising them that recipients of the
notice must not sell or provide a controlled drug other than a
preparation, a preparation, or both, to that pharmacist.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-135, s. 5
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.03.017.1-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.017.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice by Minister

- **[[G.03.017.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.017.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In the circumstances described in
  subsection (2), the Minister must send a notice to the persons and
  authorities specified in subsection (3) advising them that pharmacists
  practising in the notified pharmacies and licensed dealers must not
  sell or provide to the pharmacist named in the notice a controlled
  drug other than a preparation or a preparation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Circumstances requiring a notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notice must be sent if the pharmacist named in
  the notice has

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} made a request to the Minister in accordance with
    section G.03.017.1 to send the notice;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contravened a rule of conduct established by the
    provincial professional licensing authority of the province in which
    the pharmacist is practising and the authority has requested the
    Minister in writing to send the notice; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} been convicted of a designated substance offence or
    of a contravention of this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recipients

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The notice must be sent to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all licensed dealers;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all pharmacies within the province in which the
    pharmacist named in the notice is entitled to practice and is
    practising;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the provincial professional licensing authority of
    the province in which the pharmacist named in the notice is entitled
    to practise;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} all pharmacies in an adjacent province in which an
    order from the pharmacist named in the notice may be filled; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any provincial professional licensing authority in
    another province that has requested the Minister in writing to send
    the notice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other circumstances

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may send the notice described in
  subsection (1) to the persons and authorities specified in
  subsection (3) if the Minister has taken the measures specified in
  subsection (5) and has reasonable grounds to believe that the
  pharmacist named in the notice

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has contravened a provision of the Act or this
    Part;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has, on more than one occasion, self-administered a
    controlled drug, other than a preparation, contrary to accepted
    pharmaceutical practice;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has, on more than one occasion, self-administered a
    preparation, contrary to accepted pharmaceutical practice;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has, on more than one occasion, provided or
    administered a controlled drug, other than a preparation, to a
    person who is a spouse, common-law partner, parent or child of the
    pharmacist, including a child adopted in fact, contrary to accepted
    pharmaceutical practice;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} has, on more than one occasion, provided or
    administered a preparation to a person who is a spouse, common-law
    partner, parent or child of the pharmacist, including a child
    adopted in fact, contrary to accepted pharmaceutical practice; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} is unable to account for the quantity of controlled
    drug for which the pharmacist was responsible under this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Measures before sending notice

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The measures that must be taken before sending the
  notice are that the Minister has

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} consulted with the provincial professional
    licensing authority of the province in which the pharmacist to whom
    the notice relates is entitled to practise;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} given that pharmacist an opportunity to be heard;
    and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} considered

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the compliance history of the pharmacist in
      respect of the Act and its regulations, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} whether the actions of the pharmacist pose a
      risk to public health or safety, including the risk of the
      controlled drug being diverted to an illicit market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-135, s. 5
- SOR/2010-222, ss. 16, 35(F)
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 12](#1136069-1209790){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136069-1209790.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.03.017.2-20101021.html "Link to previous version of section G.03.017.2"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of retraction

**[[G.03.017.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.03.017.3 .sectionLabel}** The
Minister must provide the licensed dealers, pharmacies and provincial
professional licensing authorities who were sent a notice under
subsection G.03.017.2(1) with a notice of retraction of that notice if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the circumstance described in paragraph

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} provided a letter from the provincial professional
    licensing authority of the province in which the pharmacist is
    entitled to practise, in which the authority consents to the
    retraction of the notice.

### [DIVISION 4]{.HLabel2}[Practitioners]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579745 .Subheading}

#### [Administration of Designated Drugs and Other Controlled Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209798 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

- **[[G.04.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.04.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3)
  and to an exemption granted under section 56 of the Act with respect
  to the administration of the controlled drug specified in the
  exemption, a practitioner must not administer a controlled drug to any
  person or animal.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A practitioner may administer a controlled drug,
  other than a designated drug, to a person or to an animal, if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that person or animal is under their professional
    treatment; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the controlled drug is required for the condition
    for which that person or animal is receiving treatment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Purposes

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A practitioner of medicine, dentistry or veterinary
  medicine or a nurse practitioner may administer a designated drug to a
  person or animal who is under their professional treatment if the
  designated drug is for the treatment of any of the following
  conditions:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of persons,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} narcolepsy,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} hyperkinetic disorders in children,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} epilepsy,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} parkinsonism, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} hypotensive states associated with anesthesia; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of animals, depression of cardiac and
    respiratory centres.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in this section.

  [[administer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[administer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes to prescribe, sell or
      provide a drug. ([administrer]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[designated drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[designated drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any of the following
      controlled drugs:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} amphetamine and its salts;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} benzphetamine and its salts;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} methamphetamine and its salts;

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} phenmetrazine and its salts; or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} phendimetrazine and its salts. ([drogue
        désignée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote

#### [Records]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209825 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Record of controlled drugs sold or
provided

- **[[G.04.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.04.002
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A practitioner who sells or provides
  a controlled drug to a person for self-administration or for
  administration to an animal shall, whether or not the practitioner
  charges for the drug, keep a record showing the name and quantity of
  the controlled drug sold or provided, the name and address of the
  person to whom it was sold or provided and the date on which it was
  sold or provided if the quantity of the controlled drug exceeds

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} three times the maximum daily dosage recommended by
    the manufacturer or assembler of the controlled drug; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} three times the generally recognized maximum daily
    therapeutic dosage for that controlled drug if the manufacturer or
    assembler has not recommended a maximum daily dosage.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Accessibility of record

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A practitioner who is required by this section to
  keep a record shall keep the record in a place, form and manner that
  will permit an inspector readily to examine and obtain information
  from it.

#### [General Obligations of Practitioner]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209829 .Subheading}

::: HistoricalNote
\[

- SOR/2019-171, s. 15

\]
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Requirements

**[[G.04.002A]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.04.002A .sectionLabel}** A
practitioner shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} furnish to the Minister on request such information
  respecting

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the use by the practitioner of controlled drugs
    received --- including the administering, selling or providing of
    the drugs to a person --- , and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the prescriptions for controlled drugs issued by
    the practitioner,

  as the Minister may require;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} produce to an inspector on request any records that
  these Regulations require the practitioner to keep;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} permit an inspector to make copies of such records or
  to take extracts therefrom;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} permit an inspector to check all stocks of controlled
  drugs on the practitioner's premises;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} retain in his possession for at least two years any
  record that these Regulations require him to keep;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} take adequate steps to protect controlled drugs in
  his possession from loss or theft; and

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} report to the Minister any loss or theft of a
  controlled drug within 10 days of the practitioner's discovery of the
  loss or theft.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2004-238, s. 25
:::

#### [Communication of Information by Minister to Licensing Authority]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209832 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contraventions by practitioner

**[[G.04.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.04.004 .sectionLabel}** The Minister
must provide in writing any factual information about a practitioner
that has been obtained under the Act or this Part to the provincial
professional licensing authority responsible for the registration and
authorization of the person to practise their profession

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the province in which the practitioner is or was
  registered and entitled to practise if

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the authority submits to the Minister a written
    request that sets out the practitioner's name and address, a
    description of the information being requested and a statement that
    the information is required for the purpose of assisting a lawful
    investigation by the authority, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe
    that the practitioner has

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} contravened a rule of conduct established by the
      authority,

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} been convicted of a designated substance offence,
      or

    - [(C)]{.lawlabel} contravened this Part; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in a province in which the practitioner is not
  registered and entitled to practise, if the authority submits to the
  Minister

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a written request that sets out the practitioner's
    name and address and a description of the information being
    requested, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a document that shows that

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the practitioner has applied to that authority to
      practise in that province, or

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} the authority has reasonable grounds to believe
      that the practitioner is practising in that province without being
      authorized to do so.

#### [Notice of Prohibition of Sale]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1209847 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Request by practitioner

**[[G.04.004.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.04.004.1 .sectionLabel}** A
practitioner may make a written request to the Minister to send to
licensed dealers and pharmacies a notice, issued under section
G.04.004.2, advising them of one or more of the following requirements:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} recipients of the notice must not sell or provide a
  controlled drug, other than a preparation, to that practitioner;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} recipients of the notice must not sell or provide a
  preparation to that practitioner;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} pharmacists practising in the notified pharmacies
  must not fill a prescription or order for a controlled drug, other
  than a preparation, from that practitioner; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} pharmacists practising in the notified pharmacies
  must not fill a prescription or order for a preparation from that
  practitioner.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-135, s. 6
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.04.004.1-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.04.004.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice by Minister

- **[[G.04.004.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.04.004.2
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In the circumstances described in
  subsection (2), the Minister must send a notice to the persons and
  authorities specified in subsection (3) advising them that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} pharmacists practising in the notified pharmacies
    and licensed dealers must not sell or provide to the practitioner
    named in the notice a controlled drug other than a preparation or a
    preparation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} pharmacists practising in the notified pharmacies
    must not fill a prescription or order from the practitioner named in
    the notice for a controlled drug other than a preparation or a
    preparation; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the prohibitions in both paragraphs (a) and (b)
    apply with respect to the practitioner named in the notice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Circumstances requiring a notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notice must be sent if the practitioner named in
  the notice has

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} made a request to the Minister in accordance with
    section G.04.004.1 to send the notice;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contravened a rule of conduct established by the
    provincial professional licensing authority of the province in which
    the practitioner is practising and the authority has requested the
    Minister in writing to issue the notice; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} been convicted of a designated substance offence or
    of a contravention of this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Recipients

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The notice must be sent to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all licensed dealers;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} all pharmacies within the province in which the
    practitioner named in the notice is registeredand entitled to
    practice and is practising;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the provincial professional licensing authority of
    the province in which the practitioner named in the notice is
    registered and entitled to practise;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} all pharmacies in an adjacent province in which a
    prescription or order from the practitioner named in the notice may
    be filled; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any provincial professional licensing authority in
    another province that has requested the Minister in writing to send
    the notice; and

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other circumstances

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may send the notice described in
  subsection (1) to the persons and authorities specified in
  subsection (3) if the Minister has taken the measures specified in
  subsection (5) and has reasonable grounds to believe that the
  practitioner named in the notice

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} has contravened a provision of the Act or this
    Part;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has, on more than one occasion, self-administered a
    controlled drug, other than a preparation, under a self-directed
    prescription or order or, in the absence of a prescription or order,
    contrary to accepted professional practice;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} has, on more than one occasion, self-administered a
    preparation, under a self-directed prescription or order or, in the
    absence of a prescription or order, contrary to accepted
    professional practice;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} has, on more than one occasion, prescribed,
    provided or administered a controlled drug, other than a
    preparation, to a person who is a spouse, common-law partner, parent
    or child of the practitioner, including a child adopted in fact,
    contrary to accepted professional practice;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} has, on more than one occasion, prescribed,
    provided or administered a preparation to a person who is a spouse,
    common-law partner, parent or child of the practitioner, including a
    child adopted in fact, contrary to accepted professional; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} is unable to account for the quantity of controlled
    drug for which the practitioner was responsible under this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Measures before sending notice

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The measures that must be taken before sending the
  notice are that the Minister has

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} consulted with the provincial professional
    licensing authority of the province in which the practitioner to
    whom the notice relates is registered and entitled to practise;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} given that practitioner an opportunity to be heard

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} considered

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the compliance history of the practitioner in
      respect of the Act and its regulations, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} whether the actions of the practitioner pose a
      risk to public health or safety, including the risk of the
      controlled drug being diverted to an illicit market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/2003-135, s. 6
- SOR/2010-222, ss. 20, 35(F)
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 17](#1136079-1209914){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136079-1209914.html"}
:::

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of retraction

**[[G.04.004.3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.04.004.3 .sectionLabel}** The
Minister must provide the licensed dealers, pharmacies and provincial
professional licensing authorities who were sent a notice under
subsection G.04.004.2(1) with a notice of retraction of that notice if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the circumstance described in paragraph
  G.04.004.2(2)(a), the requirements set out in subparagraphs (b)(i)
  and (ii) have been met and one year has elapsed since the notice was
  sent by the Minister; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in a circumstance described in any of paragraphs
  G.04.004.2(2)(b) and (c) and (4)(a) to (f), the practitioner named in
  the notice has

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} requested in writing that a retraction of the
    notice be sent, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} provided a letter from the provincial professional
    licensing authority of the province in which the practitioner is
    registered and entitled to practise, in which the authority consents
    to the retraction of the notice.

### [DIVISION 5]{.HLabel2}[Hospitals]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579849 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Record --- controlled drugs

- **[[G.05.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.05.001
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who is in charge of a
  hospital shall keep or cause to be kept a record of the following
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of any controlled drug
    received for the hospital by a hospital employee or a practitioner
    in the hospital;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the person from whom any
    controlled drug was received and the date on which it was received;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of any controlled drug used
    in the making or assembling of a product or compound containing that
    controlled drug, the name and quantity of the product or compound
    made or assembled and the date on which the product or compound was
    placed in stock;

  - [(c.1)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of any controlled drug
    produced and the date on which it was placed in stock;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of the patient for whom a controlled drug
    was dispensed;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name of the practitioner ordering or
    prescribing a controlled drug; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the date on which a controlled drug was ordered or
    prescribed and the form and quantity thereof.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Record keeping

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (3) and (4), the record of
  information referred to in subsection (1) shall be kept

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in a manner that permits an audit to be made;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in a book, register or similar record maintained
    exclusively for controlled drugs; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} for a period of at least two years.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- preparation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The information referred to in paragraphs (1)(d)
  to (f) may, with respect to a preparation, be kept in a form other
  than that specified in paragraph (2)(b).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- Part II or III of
  schedule

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The information referred to in subsection (1) may,
  with respect to a controlled drug listed in Part II or III of the
  schedule to this Part, be kept in a form other than that specified in
  paragraph (2)(b).

::: HistoricalNote
- SOR/78-427, s. 8

- SOR/97-228, s. 18
- SOR/2004-238, s. 27
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 18(F)](#1136081-1209922){.wb-lbx

:::

Version](section-G.05.001-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.05.001"){.PITLink}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Providing information and assisting
inspector

**[[G.05.002]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.05.002 .sectionLabel}** A person who
is in charge of a hospital shall

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} furnish such information respecting the use of
  controlled drugs therein, in such form and at such times as the
  Minister may require;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} produce to an inspector any books, records or
  documents required by these Regulations to be kept;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} permit an inspector to make copies thereof or take
  extracts from such books, records and documents; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} permit an inspector to check all stocks of controlled
  drugs in the hospital.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 25(F)](#1136103-1211265){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136103-1211265.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.05.002-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.05.002"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Selling, providing or administering
controlled drug

- **[[G.05.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.05.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No person in charge of a hospital
  shall permit a controlled drug to be sold, provided or administered
  except in accordance with this section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prescription or written order

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of a prescription or a written order
  signed and dated by a practitioner, the person in charge of a hospital
  may permit a controlled drug to be administered to a person or an
  animal under treatment as an in-patient or out-patient of the
  hospital, or to be sold or provided to the person or to the person in
  charge of the animal.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Emergency --- other hospital

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (6), the person in charge of a
  hospital may permit a controlled drug to be provided, for emergency
  purposes, to a hospital employee or a practitioner in another hospital
  on receipt of a written order signed and dated by a pharmacist in the
  other hospital or a practitioner authorized by the person in charge of
  the other hospital to sign the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Emergency --- pharmacist

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (6), the person in charge of a
  hospital may permit a controlled drug to be sold or provided, for
  emergency purposes, to a pharmacist on receipt of a written order
  signed and dated by the pharmacist.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Research purposes

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The person in charge of a hospital may permit a
  controlled drug to be provided to a person employed in a research
  laboratory in that hospital for the purpose of research.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} No person in charge of a hospital shall permit a
  controlled drug to be sold or provided under subsection (3) or (4)
  unless the signature of the pharmacist in the other hospital or of the
  practitioner authorized by the person in charge of the other hospital
  to sign an order is known to the person who sells or provides the
  controlled drug or has been verified.

::: HistoricalNote

- [SOR/2019-171, s. 19(F)](#1136083-1209923){.wb-lbx

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Loss or theft

**[[G.05.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.05.004 .sectionLabel}** A person who
is in charge of a hospital shall take all steps necessary to protect
controlled drugs in the hospital against loss or theft and shall report
to the Minister any loss or theft of a controlled drug within 10 days of
his discovery thereof.

### [DIVISION 6]{.HLabel2}[General]{.HTitleText2} {#h-579884 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Labelling --- drug dispensed in
accordance with prescription

**[[G.06.001]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.06.001 .sectionLabel}** In the case
of a controlled drug that is dispensed by a pharmacist in accordance
with a prescription, section C.01.004 does not apply but the label of
the package in which the controlled drug is contained must include the
following:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the pharmacy or
  pharmacist;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date and number of the prescription;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name of the person for whom the controlled drug
  is dispensed;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of the practitioner;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} directions for use; and

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} any other information that the prescription requires
  be shown on the label.

C.01.004 does not apply to a test kit that contains a controlled drug
and that has a registration number.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Identification or analysis of controlled
drug

- **[[G.06.003]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.06.003
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything in this Part, a
  person may, for the purpose of identification or analysis of a
  controlled drug, provide or deliver the drug to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a practitioner of medicine; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an agent or mandatary of a practitioner of
    medicine, if the agent or mandatary is exempted under section 56 of
    the Act with respect to the possession of that drug for that
    purpose.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agent or mandatary of practitioner of
  medicine

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An agent or mandatary of a practitioner of medicine
  who receives the controlled drug must immediately provide or deliver
  it to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the practitioner; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Practitioner of medicine

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A practitioner of medicine who receives the
  controlled drug must immediately provide or deliver it

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of its identification or analysis,
    to a person exempted under section 56 of the Act with respect to the
    possession of that drug for that purpose; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 20](#1136088-1209968){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136088-1209968.html"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-G.06.003-20060322.html "Link to previous version of section G.06.003"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Advertising

**[[G.06.004]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.06.004 .sectionLabel}** It is
prohibited to

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} advertise a controlled drug to the general public; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} publish any written advertisement respecting a
  controlled drug unless that advertisement displays the following
  symbol in a clear and conspicuous colour and size in the upper left
  quarter of its first page:
  <figure>
  <div class="imageGroupcenter">
  <img src="/images/CRC870img/CRC870_ef005.png"
  alt="The symbol consists of a diamond shape outline in which an uppercase letter C is centred." />
  </div>
  </figure>

  ::: HistoricalNote
  - [SOR/2019-171, s. 20](#1136088-1209974){.wb-lbx
    ajax-after="1136088-1209974.html"}
  :::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Record keeping --- specific cases

**[[G.06.005]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.06.005 .sectionLabel}** Every person
who is exempted under section 56 of the Act with respect to the
possession or administration of a controlled drug and every practitioner
of medicine who has received a controlled drug under subsection
G.06.003(1) or (2) and every agent or mandatary of a practitioner of
medicine who has received a controlled drug under subsection G.06.003(1)
must

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} keep a record of the following information for a
  two-year period beginning on the day on which the record is made:

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of any controlled drug
    purchased or received by them and the date on which it was purchased
    or received,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the person from whom the
    controlled drug was purchased or received, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} details of the use of the controlled drug;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide any information respecting those controlled
  drugs that the Minister may require; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} permit access to the records required to be kept by
  this Part.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 20](#1136088-1209984){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136088-1209984.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Communication of information by Minister
to nursing statutory body

- **[[G.06.006]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.06.006
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may provide to a
  nursing statutory body any information concerning any member of that
  body that has been obtained under this Part, the Act or the [Food and
  Drugs Act](/eng/acts/F-27).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a nurse
  practitioner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply in this section.

  [[member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[member]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any person who is authorized
      by a nursing statutory body to practice
      nursing. ([membre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[nursing statutory body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[nursing statutory body]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any
      provincial professional licensing authority that, in accordance
      with the laws of that province, authorizes a person to practise
      nursing. ([organisme régissant la profession
      d'infirmier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 20](#1136088-1209995){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136088-1209995.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notification of application for order of
restoration

- **[[G.06.007]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-G.06.007
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection 24(1)
  of the Act, notification of an application for an order of restoration
  must be given in writing to the Attorney General by registered mail
  and be mailed not less than 15 days before the date on which the
  application is to be made to a justice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content of notification

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notification must specify

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the justice to whom the application is
    to be made;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the time and place at which the application is to
    be heard;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} details concerning the controlled drug or other
    thing in respect of which the application is to be made; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the evidence on which the applicant intends to rely
    to establish that they are entitled to possession of the controlled
    drug or other thing referred to in paragraph (c).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 20](#1136088-1210006){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136088-1210006.html"}
:::
