#### [Import Permits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1210556 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[J.01.038]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.038
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must submit to the
  Minister, before each importation of a restricted drug, an application
  for an import permit that contains the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name, municipal address and dealer's licence
    number;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the restricted drug to be imported,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name, as specified in the dealer's licence,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is a salt, the name of the salt,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its quantity, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a raw material, its purity and
      its anhydrous content;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the restricted drug is contained in a product to
    be imported,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
      assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the strength per unit of the restricted drug in
      the product, the number of units per package and the number of
      packages;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address, in the country of
    export, of the exporter from whom the restricted drug is being
    obtained;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name of the customs office where the
    importation is anticipated; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} each proposed mode of transportation and any
    proposed country of transit or transhipment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the qualified person in
    charge or an alternate qualified person in charge; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that all of
    the information submitted in support of the application is correct
    and complete to the best of their knowledge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210698){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210698.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issuance

**[[J.01.039]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.039 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section J.01.042, on completion of the review of the import permit
application, the Minister must issue to the licensed dealer an import
permit that contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the permit number;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in subsection J.01.038(1);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the effective date of the permit;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the permit, being the earlier of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a date specified by the Minister that is not more
    than 180 days after its effective date, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the dealer's licence; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} any terms and conditions that the Minister has
  reasonable grounds to believe are necessary to

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety,
    including the risk of a restricted drug being diverted to an illicit
    market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210711){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210711.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity

**[[J.01.040]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.040 .sectionLabel}** An import
permit is valid until the earliest of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date set out in the permit,

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the
  permit under section J.01.045 or J.01.046,

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the
  dealer's licence under section J.01.035 or J.01.036, and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the
  export permit that applies to the restricted drug to be imported and
  that is issued by the competent authority in the country of export.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210719){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210719.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return of permit

**[[J.01.041]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.041 .sectionLabel}** If an import
permit expires, the licensed dealer must return the original of the
permit to the Minister within 15 days after its expiry.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210723){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210723.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Refusal

- **[[J.01.042]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.042
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must refuse to issue an
  import permit if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer is not authorized by their
    dealer's licence to import the relevant restricted drug or their
    licence will expire before the date of importation;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the importation would contravene an international obligation;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not have in place at the
    site the security measures set out in the Security Directive in
    respect of the importation;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has not complied with the
    requirements of subsection J.01.038(3) or the information or
    documents that they have provided are not sufficient to complete the
    review of the permit application;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer has submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of the permit
    application;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has been notified that their
    application to renew or amend their licence will be refused;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the importation would contravene the laws of the country of export
    or any country of transit or transhipment; or

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the issuance of the permit would likely create a risk to public
    health or safety, including the risk of a restricted drug being
    diverted to an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before refusing to issue the import permit, the
  Minister must send the licensed dealer a notice that sets out the
  Minister's reasons and gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210738){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210738.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Providing copy of permit

**[[J.01.043]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.043 .sectionLabel}** The holder of
an import permit must provide a copy of the permit to the customs office
at the time of importation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210742){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210742.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Declaration

**[[J.01.044]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.044 .sectionLabel}** The holder of
an import permit must provide the Minister, within 15 days after the day
of release of the restricted drug specified in the permit in accordance
with the [Customs Act](/eng/acts/C-52.6), with a declaration that
contains the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name and the numbers of their dealer's licence
  and the import permit that applies to the restricted drug;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the restricted drug,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name, as set out in the dealer's licence,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is a salt, the name of the salt, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its quantity;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the restricted drug is contained in a product that
  they have imported,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
    assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the strength per unit of the restricted drug in
    the product, the number of units per package and the number of
    packages; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of the customs office from which the
  restricted drug was released and the date of the release.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210756){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210756.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension

- **[[J.01.045]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.045
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must suspend an import
  permit without prior notice if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dealer's licence is suspended;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the suspension is necessary to protect public health or safety,
    including to prevent a restricted drug from being diverted to an
    illicit market or use; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the importation would contravene the laws of the
    country of export or any country of transit or transhipment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The suspension takes effect as soon as the Minister
  sends the licensed dealer a notice that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sets out the reasons for the suspension;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, specifies the corrective measures
    that must be carried out and the date by which they must be carried
    out.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reinstatement of permit

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must reinstate the import permit if the
  Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that the suspension is no
  longer necessary.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210771){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210771.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation

- **[[J.01.046]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.046
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  Minister must revoke an import permit if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer requests the Minister to do so
    or informs the Minister of the loss or theft of the permit or the
    actual or potential unauthorized use of the permit;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not carry out the
    corrective measures specified by the Minister under paragraph
    J.01.045(2)(c) by the specified date;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has contravened a term or
    condition of the permit;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of the application for
    the permit;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} information received from a competent authority or
    the United Nations gives the Minister reasonable grounds to believe
    that the licensed dealer has been involved in the diversion of a
    restricted drug to an illicit market or use; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the dealer's licence has been revoked.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must not revoke an import permit for a
  ground set out in paragraph (1)(d) or J.01.036(1)(e) or (g) if the
  licensed dealer meets the following conditions, unless the Minister
  has reasonable grounds to believe that it is necessary to do so to
  protect public health or safety, including to prevent a restricted
  drug from being diverted to an illicit market or use:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not have a history of
    non-compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5) or
    their regulations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has carried out, or signed an
    undertaking to carry out, the necessary corrective measures to
    ensure compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5)
    and their regulations.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before revoking an import permit, the Minister must
  send the licensed dealer a notice that sets out the Minister's reasons
  and gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210788){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210788.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return of permit

**[[J.01.047]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.047 .sectionLabel}** If an import
permit is revoked, the licensed dealer must return the original of the
permit to the Minister within 15 days after the effective date of the
revocation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210792){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210792.html"}
:::

#### [Export Permits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1210793 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

- **[[J.01.048]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.048
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must submit to the
  Minister, before each exportation of a restricted drug, an application
  for an export permit that contains the following information and
  document:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name, municipal address and dealer's licence
    number;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the restricted drug to be exported,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name, as specified in the dealer's licence,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is a salt, the name of the salt,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its quantity, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a raw material, its purity and
      its anhydrous content;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the restricted drug is contained in a product to
    be exported,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
      assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the strength per unit of the restricted drug in
      the product, the number of units per package and the number of
      packages;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the importer in
    the country of final destination;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name of the customs office where the
    exportation is anticipated;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} each proposed mode of transportation and any
    proposed country of transit or transhipment; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the import permit issued by the competent
    authority in the country of final destination that sets out the name
    of the importer and the municipal address of their site in that
    country.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the qualified person in
    charge or an alternate qualified person in charge; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that, to the
    best of their knowledge,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the exportation does not contravene the laws of
      the country of final destination or any country of transit or
      transhipment, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all of the information and documents submitted
      in support of the application are correct and complete.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210820){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210820.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Issuance

**[[J.01.049]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.049 .sectionLabel}** Subject to
section J.01.052, on completion of the review of the export permit
application, the Minister must issue to the licensed dealer an export
permit that contains

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the permit number;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the information set out in paragraphs J.01.048(1)(a)
  to (f);

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the effective date of the permit;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the permit, being the earliest of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a date specified by the Minister that is not more
    than 180 days after its effective date,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the dealer's licence, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date of the import permit issued by
    the competent authority in the country of final destination; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} any terms and conditions that the Minister has
  reasonable grounds to believe are necessary to

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} ensure that an international obligation is
    respected, or

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} reduce a risk to public health or safety,
    including the risk of a restricted drug being diverted to an illicit
    market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210834){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210834.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity

**[[J.01.050]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.050 .sectionLabel}** An export
permit is valid until the earliest of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the expiry date set out in the permit,

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the
  permit under section J.01.055 or J.01.056,

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date of the suspension or revocation of the
  dealer's licence under section J.01.035 or J.01.036, and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the date of the expiry, suspension or revocation of
  the import permit that applies to the restricted drug to be exported
  and that is issued by the competent authority in the country of final
  destination.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210842){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210842.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return of permit

**[[J.01.051]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.051 .sectionLabel}** If an export
permit expires, the licensed dealer must return the original of the
permit to the Minister within 15 days after its expiry.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210846){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210846.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Refusal

- **[[J.01.052]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.052
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must refuse to issue an
  export permit if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer is not authorized by their
    dealer's licence to export the relevant restricted drug or their
    dealer's licence will expire before the date of export;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the exportation would contravene an international obligation;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has not complied with the
    requirements of subsection J.01.048(3) or the information or
    documents that they have provided are not sufficient to complete the
    review of the permit application;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer has submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of the permit
    application;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has been notified that their
    application to renew or amend their licence will be refused;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the exportation would not be in conformity with the import permit
    issued by the competent authority of the country of final
    destination;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the exportation would contravene the laws of the country of final
    destination or any country of transit or transhipment; or

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the issuance of the permit would likely create a risk to public
    health or safety, including the risk of a restricted drug being
    diverted to an illicit market or use.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Before refusing to issue the export permit, the
  Minister must send the licensed dealer a notice that sets out the
  Minister's reasons and gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210861){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210861.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Providing copy of permit

**[[J.01.053]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.053 .sectionLabel}** The holder of
an export permit must provide a copy of the permit to the customs office
at the time of exportation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210865){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210865.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Declaration

**[[J.01.054]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.054 .sectionLabel}** The holder of
an export permit must provide the Minister, within 15 days after the day
of export of the restricted drug specified in the permit, with a
declaration that contains the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name and the numbers of their dealer's licence
  and the export permit that applies to the restricted drug;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} with respect to the restricted drug,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} its name, as specified in the dealer's licence,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if it is a salt, the name of the salt, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} its quantity;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} if the restricted drug is contained in a product that
  they have exported,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
    assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the strength per unit of the restricted drug in
    the product, the number of units per package and the number of
    packages; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name of the customs office from which the
  restricted drug was exported and the date of export.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210879){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210879.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspension

- **[[J.01.055]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.055
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must suspend an export
  permit without prior notice if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the dealer's licence is suspended;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the suspension is necessary to protect public health or safety,
    including to prevent a restricted drug from being diverted to an
    illicit market or use; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the exportation would contravene the laws of the
    country of final destination or any country of transit or
    transhipment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The suspension takes effect as soon as the Minister
  sends the licensed dealer a notice that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sets out the reasons for the suspension;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} if applicable, specifies the corrective measures
    that must be carried out and the date by which they must be carried
    out.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reinstatement of permit

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must reinstate the export permit if the
  Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that the suspension is no
  longer necessary.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210894){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210894.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation

- **[[J.01.056]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.056
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), the
  Minister must revoke an export permit if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer requests the Minister to do so
    or informs the Minister of the loss or theft of the permit or the
    actual or potential unauthorized use of the permit;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not carry out the

    J.01.055(2)(c) by the specified date;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has contravened a term or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
    the licensed dealer submitted false or misleading information or
    false or falsified documents in or in support of the application for
    the permit;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} information received from a competent authority or

    that the licensed dealer has been involved in the diversion of a
    restricted drug to an illicit market or use; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the dealer's licence has been revoked.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister must not revoke an export permit for a
  ground set out in paragraph (1)(d) or J.01.036(1)(e) or (g) if the

  has reasonable grounds to believe that it is necessary to do so to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer does not have a history of

    their regulations; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer has carried out, or signed an

    ensure compliance with the Act, the [Cannabis Act](/eng/acts/C-24.5)

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Before revoking an export permit, the Minister must
  send the licensed dealer a notice that sets out the Minister's reasons
  and gives the dealer an opportunity to be heard.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210911){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210911.html"}
:::

**[[J.01.057]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.057 .sectionLabel}** If an export
permit is revoked, the licensed dealer must return the original of the
permit to the Minister within 15 days after the effective date of the
revocation.

- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210915){.wb-lbx

#### [Identification]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1210916 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Name

**[[J.01.058]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.058 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must include their name, as set out in their dealer's licence, on
all the means by which they identify themself in regard to their
activities in relation to restricted drugs, including labels, orders,
shipping documents, invoices and advertising.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210920){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210920.html"}
:::

#### [Sale of Restricted Drugs]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1210921 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to institution

- **[[J.01.059]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.059
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite section C.08.002 and subject
  to subsections (3) and (4), a licensed dealer may sell a restricted
  drug to an institution for one of the following purposes if the
  institution submits to the dealer or the Minister an application to
  purchase the drug and the Minister issues a prior written
  authorization for the sale:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} clinical testing in the institution by qualified
    investigators for the purpose of determining the hazards and
    efficacy of the drug; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} laboratory research in the institution by qualified
    investigators.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content of application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must contain the following
  information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and the municipal address of the
    institution;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the names and qualifications of the qualified
    investigators;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name, form, quantity and strength per unit of
    the restricted drug being requested;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} details of the proposed use of the drug; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the licensed
    dealer from whom the institution proposes to purchase the drug.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to licensed dealer

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the institution submits the application to the
  licensed dealer, the dealer must provide a copy of it to the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorization by Minister

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} After reviewing the application received from the
  institution or the copy of it received from the licensed dealer, the
  Minister may, subject to any terms and conditions that the Minister
  has reasonable grounds to believe are necessary, authorize in writing

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sale by the licensed dealer to the institution
    of the restricted drug applied for in the form, quantity and
    strength per unit specified by the Minister; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the possession of the restricted drug by qualified
    investigators for clinical testing of the drug in the institution
    for the purpose of determining its hazards and efficacy or to
    conduct laboratory research with the drug in the institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authorized use only

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The institution must use the restricted drug only in
  accordance with the written authorization.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210943){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210943.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sale to Minister

**[[J.01.060]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.060 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer may sell or provide a restricted drug to the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210947){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210947.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provision for identification or analysis

- **[[J.01.061]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.061
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything in this Part, a
  person may, for the purpose of identification or analysis of a
  restricted drug, provide or deliver it to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a practitioner of medicine; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an agent or mandatary of a practitioner of
    medicine, if the agent or mandatary has been exempted under section
    56 of the Act with respect to the possession of that restricted drug
    for that purpose.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agent or mandatary of practitioner of
  medicine

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An agent or mandatary of a practitioner of medicine
  who receives the restricted drug must immediately provide or deliver
  it to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the practitioner; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Practitioner of medicine

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A practitioner of medicine who receives the
  restricted drug must immediately provide or deliver it

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purpose of its identification or analysis,
    to a person exempted under section 56 of the Act with respect to the
    possession of that restricted drug for that purpose; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to the Minister.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210962){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210962.html"}
:::

#### [Packaging, Labelling and Transportation]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1210963 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Packaging --- sale and provision

- **[[J.01.062]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.062
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer that sells or
  provides a restricted drug must securely package it in its immediate
  container, which must be sealed in such a manner that the container
  cannot be opened without breaking the seal.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Packaging --- transport and export

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer that transports or exports a
  restricted drug must ensure that its package is sealed in such a
  manner that the package cannot be opened without breaking the seal.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a test kit that
  contains a restricted drug and that has a registration number.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210972){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210972.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Labelling

- **[[J.01.063]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.063
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer that sells or
  provides a restricted drug must ensure that its package is labelled so
  that its inner and outer labels show

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the proper name or, if there is no proper name, the
    name of the drug;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the net contents of the package;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the unit strength of the drug and the number of
    units per package, if applicable;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the lot number of the drug;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the expression "Restricted Drug"; and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the manufacturer
    or assembler of the drug.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a test kit that
  contains a restricted drug and that has a registration number.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The labelling requirements set out in section
  C.01.004 do not apply to a restricted drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210987){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210987.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transport

**[[J.01.064]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.064 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must, in taking delivery of a restricted drug that they have
imported or in making delivery of a restricted drug,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} take any measures that are necessary to ensure the
  security of the drug while it is being transported;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} use a method of transportation that permits an
  accurate record to be kept of all handling of the drug as well as of
  the signatures of every person handling it until it is delivered to
  the consignee;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an imported drug, transport it
  directly to the site specified in their licence after it is released
  under the [Customs Act](/eng/acts/C-52.6); and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a drug to be exported, transport it
  directly from the site specified in their licence to the customs
  office where it will be exported.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1210995){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1210995.html"}
:::

### [Thefts, Losses and Suspicious Transactions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1210996 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Protective measures --- licences and
permits

**[[J.01.065]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.065 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must take any measures that are necessary to ensure the security
of any licence or permit in their possession.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211043){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211043.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Protective measures --- restricted drugs

**[[J.01.066]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.066 .sectionLabel}** The following
persons must take any measures that are necessary to ensure the security
of any restricted drugs in their possession:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} a licensed dealer;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} an institution;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} a qualified investigator who possesses the restricted
  drug for the purpose of clinical testing or laboratory research in an
  institution; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person exempted under section 56 of the Act with
  respect to the possession of the restricted drug.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211051){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211051.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Theft or loss --- licences and permits

**[[J.01.067]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.067 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that becomes aware of a theft or loss of their licence or permit
must provide a written report to the Minister within 72 hours after
becoming aware of it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211055){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211055.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Theft or loss --- restricted drugs

- **[[J.01.068]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.068
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2), any
  person referred to in section J.01.066 who becomes aware of a theft or
  loss of a restricted drug must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} provide a written report to a member of a police
    force within 24 hours after becoming aware of the theft or loss; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide a written report to the Minister within 72
    hours after becoming aware of the theft or loss and include a
    confirmation that the report required under paragraph (a) has been
    provided.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Explainable loss --- licensed dealer

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply to a licensed dealer
  that becomes aware of a loss of a restricted drug that can be
  explained on the basis of normally accepted business activities.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211064){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211064.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Suspicious transaction

- **[[J.01.069]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.069
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must provide a
  written report containing the following information to the Minister
  within 72 hours after becoming aware of a transaction occurring in the
  course of their activities that they have reasonable grounds to
  suspect may be related to the diversion of a restricted drug to an
  illicit market or use:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name, municipal address, telephone number
    and, if the licensed dealer is a corporation, the position held by
    the individual making the report;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the other party
    to the transaction;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} details of the transaction, including its date and
    time, its type, the name and quantity of the restricted drug and, in
    the case of a product or compound, the quantity of every restricted
    drug that it contains;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a product that contains the
    restricted drug, other than a test kit, the drug identification
    number that is assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if
    any; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a detailed description of the reasons for those
    suspicions.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Good faith

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} No civil proceedings lie against a licensed dealer
  for having provided the report in good faith.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-disclosure

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must not disclose that they have
  provided the report or disclose details of it, with the intent to
  prejudice a criminal investigation, whether or not a criminal
  investigation has begun.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211078){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211078.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Partial protection against
self-incrimination

**[[J.01.070]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.070 .sectionLabel}** A report made
under any of sections J.01.067 to J.01.069, or any evidence derived from
it, is not to be used or received to incriminate the licensed dealer in
any criminal proceeding against them other than a prosecution under
section 132, 136 or 137 of the [Criminal Code](/eng/acts/C-46).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211082){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211082.html"}
:::

### [Destruction of Restricted Drugs]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1211083 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction at site

**[[J.01.071]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.071 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that intends to destroy a restricted drug at the site specified
in their licence must ensure that the following conditions are met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer obtains the prior approval of the
  Minister;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the destruction occurs in the presence of two of the
  following persons, at least one of whom must be a person referred to
  in subparagraph (i):

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the senior person in charge, the qualified person
    in charge or an alternate qualified person in charge, and

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a person who works for or provides services to the
    licensed dealer and holds a senior position;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the destruction is carried out in accordance with a
  method that complies with all federal, provincial and municipal
  environmental protection legislation applicable to the place of
  destruction; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} as soon as the destruction is completed, the person
  who carried out the destruction and each of the two persons referred
  to in paragraph (b) who were present at the destruction sign and date
  a joint declaration attesting that the restricted drug was completely
  destroyed, to which each signatory must add their name in printed
  letters.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211093){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211093.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction elsewhere than at site

**[[J.01.072]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.072 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that intends to destroy a restricted drug elsewhere than at the
site specified in their licence must ensure that the following
conditions are met:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer obtains the prior approval of the
  Minister;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the licensed dealer takes any measures that are
  necessary to ensure the security of the restricted drug while it is
  being transported in order to prevent its diversion to an illicit
  market or use;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the destruction is carried out by a person working
  for a business that specializes in the destruction of dangerous goods
  and in the presence of another person working for that business;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the destruction is carried out in accordance with a
  method that complies with all federal, provincial and municipal
  environmental protection legislation applicable to the place of
  destruction; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} as soon as the destruction is completed, the person
  who carried out the destruction provides the licensed dealer with a
  dated declaration attesting that the restricted drug was completely
  destroyed and containing

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address of the place of destruction,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of the restricted drug and,
    if applicable, the brand name and quantity of the product containing
    it or the name and quantity of the compound containing it,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the method of destruction,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the date of destruction, and

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the names in printed letters and signatures of that
    person and the other person who was present at the destruction.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211107){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211107.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application for prior approval

- **[[J.01.073]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.073
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A licensed dealer must submit to the
  Minister an application that contains the following information in
  order to obtain the Minister's prior approval to destroy a restricted
  drug:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} their name, municipal address and dealer's licence
    number;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the proposed date of destruction;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address of the place of destruction;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a brief description of the method of destruction;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} if the destruction is to be carried out at the site
    specified in the dealer's licence, the names of the persons proposed
    for the purpose of paragraph J.01.071(b) and information
    establishing that they meet the conditions of that paragraph;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name of the restricted drug and, if applicable,
    the brand name of the product containing it or the name of the
    compound containing it; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the form and quantity of the restricted drug or the
    product or compound containing it and if applicable, the strength
    per unit of the restricted drug in the product or compound, the
    number of units per package and the number of packages.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Signature and attestation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The application must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} be signed and dated by the qualified person in
    charge or an alternate qualified person in charge; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} include an attestation by that person that

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the proposed method of destruction complies with
      all federal, provincial and municipal environmental protection
      legislation applicable to the place of destruction, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} all of the information submitted in support of
      the application is correct and complete to the best of the
      signatory's knowledge.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional information and documents

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The licensed dealer must, not later than the date
  specified in the Minister's written request to that effect, provide
  the Minister with any information or document that the Minister
  determines is necessary to complete the review of the application.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211127){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211127.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval

**[[J.01.074]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.074 .sectionLabel}** On completion
of the review of the application for approval, the Minister must approve
the destruction of the restricted drug unless

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a destruction that is to be carried
  out at the site specified in the dealer's licence, the persons
  proposed for the purpose of paragraph J.01.071(b) do not meet the
  conditions of that paragraph;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the restricted drug would not be destroyed;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the licensed dealer has submitted false or misleading information or
  false or falsified documents in or in support of the approval
  application;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the restricted drug or a portion of it is required
  for the purposes of a criminal or administrative investigation or a
  preliminary inquiry, trial or other proceeding under any Act or its
  regulations; or

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the Minister has reasonable grounds to believe that
  the approval would likely create a risk to public health or safety,
  including the risk of the restricted drug being diverted to an illicit
  market or use.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211136){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211136.html"}
:::

### [Documents]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1211137 .Subheading}

#### [Licensed Dealers]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1211138 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Method of recording information

**[[J.01.075]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.075 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must record any information that they are required to record
under this Part using a method that permits an audit of it to be made at
any time.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211146){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211146.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information --- general

**[[J.01.076]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.076 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must record the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any restricted drug
  that the dealer orders, the name of the person who placed the order on
  the dealer's behalf and the date of the order;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any restricted drug
  that the dealer receives, the name and municipal address of the person
  who sold or provided it and the date on which it was received;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a restricted drug that the dealer
  sells or provides,

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the brand name of the product or the name of the
    compound containing the restricted drug and the name of the
    restricted drug,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the drug identification number that has been
    assigned to the product under section C.01.014.2, if any,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the form and quantity of the restricted drug and,
    if applicable, the strength per unit of the restricted drug in the
    product or compound, the number of units per package and the number
    of packages,

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the name and municipal address of the person to
    whom it was sold or provided, and

  - [(v)]{.lawlabel} the date on which it was sold or provided;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any restricted drug
  that the dealer manufactures or assembles and the date on which it was
  placed in stock and, if applicable, the strength per unit of the
  restricted drug in the product or compound, the number of units per
  package and the number of packages;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of any restricted drug that the
  dealer uses in the manufacturing or assembling of a product or
  compound, as well as the brand name and quantity of the product or the
  name and quantity of the compound, and the date on which the product
  or compound was placed in stock;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any restricted drug in
  stock at the end of each month;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any restricted drug
  that the dealer delivers, transports or sends, the name and municipal
  address of the consignee and the date on which it was delivered,
  transported or sent;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any restricted drug
  imported, the date on which it was that the dealer imports, the name
  and municipal address of the exporter, the country of exportation and
  any country of transit or transhipment; and

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any restricted drug
  that the dealer exports, the date on which it was exported, the name
  and municipal address of the importer, the country of final
  destination and any country of transit or transhipment.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211164){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211164.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Explainable loss of restricted drug

**[[J.01.077]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.077 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer that becomes aware of a loss of a restricted drug that can be
explained on the basis of normally accepted business activities must
record the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the lost restricted drug and, if
  applicable, the brand name of the product or the name of the compound
  containing it;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the form and quantity of the restricted drug and, if
  applicable, the form of the product or compound containing it, the
  strength per unit of the restricted drug in the product or compound,
  the number of units per package and the number of packages;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the date on which the dealer became aware of the
  loss; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the explanation for the loss.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211172){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211172.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Destruction

**[[J.01.078]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.078 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer must record the following information concerning any restricted
drug that they destroy at the site specified in their licence:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the municipal address of the place of destruction;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of the restricted drug
  and, if applicable, the brand name and quantity of the product
  containing the drug or the name and quantity of the compound
  containing the drug;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the method of destruction; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the date of destruction.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211180){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211180.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annual report

- **[[J.01.079]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.079
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (3),
  a licensed dealer must provide to the Minister, within three months
  after the end of each calendar year, an annual report that contains

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and total quantity of each
    restricted drug that they receive, produce, sell, provide, import,
    export or destroy during the calendar year, as well as the name and
    total quantity of each restricted drug that they use to manufacture
    or assemble a product or compound;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of each restricted drug
    in physical inventory taken at the site specified in their licence
    at the end of the calendar year; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the name, form and quantity of any restricted drug
    that has been lost in the course of conducting activities during the
    calendar year.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-renewal or revocation within first
  three months

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a licensed dealer's licence expires without being
  renewed or is revoked during the first three months of a calendar
  year, the dealer must provide to the Minister

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} within three months after the end of the preceding
    calendar year, the annual report in respect of that year; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} within three months after the expiry or revocation,
    a report in respect of the portion of the current calendar year
    during which the licence was valid that contains the information
    referred to in subsection (1), in which the quantity in physical
    inventory is to be calculated as of the date of expiry or
    revocation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-renewal or revocation after third
  month

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If a licensed dealer's licence expires without being
  renewed or is revoked after the first three months of a calendar year,
  the dealer must provide to the Minister, within three months after the
  expiry or revocation, a report in respect of the portion of the
  calendar year during which the licence was valid that contains the
  information referred to in subsection (1) for that period, in which
  the quantity in physical inventory is to be calculated as of the date
  of expiry or revocation.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211194){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211194.html"}
:::

#### [Institutions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1211195 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Method of recording information

**[[J.01.080]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.080 .sectionLabel}** An
institution must record any information that it is required to record
under this Part using a method that permits an audit of the information
to be made at any time.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211199){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211199.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[J.01.081]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.081 .sectionLabel}** An
institution must record the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of any restricted drug that the
  institution orders, the name of the person who placed the order on the
  institution's behalf and the date of the order;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of any restricted drug that the
  institution receives as well as the name and municipal address of the
  licensed dealer that sold or provided it and the date on which it was
  received;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} details of the use of restricted drugs in the
  institution;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} the names and qualifications of every person who
  makes use of a restricted drug in the institution; and

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} all clinical data with respect to the use of every
  restricted drug received by the institution.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211208){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211208.html"}
:::

#### [Drug Received for Identification and Analysis]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1211209 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Method of recording information

**[[J.01.082]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.082 .sectionLabel}** A person who
records information in accordance with section J.01.083 must do so using
a method that permits an audit of the information to be made at any
time.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211213){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211213.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

**[[J.01.083]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.083 .sectionLabel}** A person who
receives a restricted drug in accordance with section J.01.061 must
record the following information:

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and quantity of the restricted drug, as well
  as the name and municipal address of the person who provided it to
  them and the date on which it was received;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} details regarding the identification or analysis of
  the restricted drug; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the names of the persons who handled the restricted
  drug during the process of identifying or analyzing it.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211220){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211220.html"}
:::

#### [Record Keeping]{.HTitleText3} {#h-1211221 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Retention period

**[[J.01.084]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.084 .sectionLabel}** A licensed
dealer, a former licensed dealer, an institution and a person referred
to in section J.01.083 must keep any document containing the information
that they are required to record under this Part, including every
declaration and a copy of every report, for a period of two years
following the day on which the last record is recorded in the document
and in a manner that permits an audit of the document to be made at any
time.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211225){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211225.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Location

**[[J.01.085]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.085 .sectionLabel}** The documents
must be kept

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a licensed dealer, at the site
  specified in their licence;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an institution, at the institution;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a person referred to in section
  J.01.083, at a location in Canada; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a former licensed dealer, at a
  location in Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211233){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211233.html"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Quality of documents

**[[J.01.086]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.086 .sectionLabel}** The documents
must be complete and readily retrievable and the information in them
must be legible and indelible.

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211237){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211237.html"}
:::

### [Notification of Application for Order of Restoration]{.HTitleText2} {#h-1211238 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Written notification

- **[[J.01.087]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-J.01.087
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of subsection 24(1)
  of the Act, notification of an application for an order of restoration
  must be given in writing to the Attorney General by registered mail
  and be mailed at least 15 days before the date on which the
  application is to be made to a justice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Content of notification

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The notification must specify

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the justice to whom the application is
    to be made;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the time and place at which the application is to
    be heard;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} details concerning the restricted drug or other
    thing in respect of which the application is to be made; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the evidence on which the applicant intends to rely
    to establish that they are entitled to possession of the restricted
    drug or other thing referred to in paragraph (c).

::: HistoricalNote
- [SOR/2019-171, s. 22](#1136092-1211249){.wb-lbx
  ajax-after="1136092-1211249.html"}
:::

alt="This figure shows a nutrition symbol for the principal display panel that indicates that a prepackaged product is high in saturated fat, sugars and sodium. This symbol is bilingual, with the English text shown first, followed by the French text. There is a white rectangular box outlined by a thin black line. At the top of the box is a heading composed of the words “High in” followed by a forward slash and the words “Élevé en” in black, bold, lower case letters, except that the first letter of the words “High” and “Élevé” are in upper case. Under the heading is a left-justified black magnifying glass with three bars stacked to its right. There is a small amount of white space between the magnifying glass and the left side of the three bars. This left side forms a concave curve that follows the curvature of the magnifying glass. There is a small amount of white space between each bar, as well as between the right side of the bars and the thin black line that outlines the box. The second bar is black and contains the word “Sugars” above the word “Sucres” in white, bold, lower case letters, except that the first letter of each word is in upper case. #### [Bilingual Standard Format]{.HTitleText2} {#bilingual-standard-format .SchedHeadL2}

<figure>
<div class="imageGroupleft">
<img src="/images/CRC870img/CRC870_e059.jpg"
alt="This figure shows a supplemented food caution identifier for the principal display panel of a prepackaged product. This identifier is bilingual, with the English text shown first, followed by the French text. There is a white rectangular box outlined by a thin black line. Centred vertically on the left side of the box is a black exclamation mark. To the right of the exclamation mark is a horizontal bar. There is a small amount of white space between the exclamation mark and the bar as well as between the end of the bar and the thin black line that outlines the box. The bar is black and contains the word “Supplemented” followed by a forward slash and the word “Supplémenté”, with both words in white, bold, lower case letters, except that the first letter of each word is in upper case. Centred below the black bar are the words “Health Canada” followed by a forward slash and the words “Santé Canada”, with all words in black lower case letters, except that the first letter of each word is in upper case." />
</div>
<figcaption><p>BS</p></figcaption>
</figure>

#### [Bilingual Compact Format]{.HTitleText2} {#bilingual-compact-format .SchedHeadL2}

<figure>
<div class="imageGroupleft">
<img src="/images/CRC870img/CRC870_e060.jpg"
alt="This figure shows a supplemented food caution identifier for the principal display panel of a prepackaged product. This identifier is bilingual, with the English text shown first, followed by the French text. There is a white rectangular box outlined by a thin black line. At the top left of the box is a black exclamation mark. To the right of the exclamation mark is a horizontal bar. There is a small amount of white space between the exclamation mark and the bar as well as between the end of the bar and the thin black line that outlines the box. The bar is black and contains two lines of text in white, bold, lower case letters, except that the first letter of each word is in upper case. On the first line is the word “Supplemented” and on the second line is the word “Supplémenté”. Centred below the black bar are two lines of text in black lower case letters, except that the first letter of each word is in upper case. On the first line are the words “Health Canada” and on the second line are the words “Santé Canada”." />
</div>
<figcaption><p>BC</p></figcaption>
</figure>

## RELATED PROVISIONS {#related-provisions .scheduleTitleText}

- --- SOR/97-12, s. 66

  - [66]{.lawlabel} Packages of drugs that are labelled in accordance
    with Part C of the [Food and Drug
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), as those Regulations
    read on December 31, 1996, are not required to comply with the
    labelling requirements in these Regulations until January 1, 1999.

- --- SOR/98-423, s. 10

  - [10]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of sections 11 to 13,
    [[Director]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in section
    A.01.010 of the Food and Drugs Regulations.

- --- SOR/98-423, s. 11

  - [11]{.lawlabel} Despite sections 1 and 7 to 9, if a numbered
    certificate of registration has been issued in respect of a drug but
    a drug identification number has not been assigned under section
    C.01.014.2 of the [Food and Drug
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), as amended by section
    4 of these Regulations, or under section 12 of these Regulations,
    then section C.01.001A, paragraphs C.01.015(2)(b) and C.01.062(5)(b)
    and Division 10 and the schedule and the table to Division 10 of
    Part C of the [Food and Drug
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), as they read
    immediately before the coming into force of these Regulations,
    remain in force in respect of that drug until October 1, 1998,
    except to the extent that they require information that is not
    required by those provisions as amended by these Regulations.

- --- SOR/98-423, s. 12

  - - [12]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite these Regulations and
      subject to subsection (3), if the conditions set out in
      subsection (2) are satisfied, the Director shall, until October 1,
      1998, provide to a manufacturer or importer referred to in
      paragraph (2)( c),

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the information referred to in section
        C.01.014.3 of the [Food and Drug
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) as amended by
        section 5 of these Regulations has not been submitted in respect
        of the drug, the document referred to in subsection
        C.01.014.2(1) of the [Food and Drug
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), as amended by
        section 4 of these Regulations; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other case,

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a drug identification number for the drug
          preceded by the letters "DIN", or

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} where there are two or more brand names for
          the drug, the drug identification numbers assigned by the
          Director for the drug, each of which pertains to one of the
          brand names and is preceded by the letters "DIN".

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} The conditions referred to in subsection (1) are:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a numbered certificate of registration has been
        issued for the drug under subsection C.10.004(1) of the [Food
        and Drug Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) as it
        read before the coming into force of these Regulations;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the numbered certificate of registration has
        not been cancelled under section C.10.008 of the [Food and Drug
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) as it read
        immediately before the coming into force of these Regulations;
        and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} prior to September 1, 1998, the manufacturer or
        importer has submitted to the Director

        - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the name of the drug for which a drug
          identification number is to be issued, and

        - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the information referred to in subsection
          C.01.014.1(2) of the [Food and Drug
          Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870).

    - [(3)]{.lawlabel} If more than one numbered certificate of
      registration has been issued for a drug on the sole basis of a
      difference in colour, flavour or fragrance, a single drug
      identification number shall be assigned in respect of the drug.

- --- SOR/98-423, s. 13

  - [13]{.lawlabel} Despite section 4 of these Regulations and subject
    to section C.10.005 of the [Food and Drug
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) as that section read
    immediately before the coming into force of these Regulations, the
    Director may, until September 30, 1998, issue a numbered certificate
    of registration, if

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the manufacturer expressly requests that a
      numbered certificate of registration be issued for the drug; and

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} its application was accepted by the Director for
      review before the coming into force of these Regulations.

- --- SOR/98-423, s. 14

  - [14]{.lawlabel} Despite section 2, a manufacturer may, until
    September 30, 2000, label a drug with the label that was in use on
    September 30, 1998.

- --- SOR/2001-203, s. 11

  - [11]{.lawlabel} An application concerning the sale of a drug for
    human use for the purposes of a clinical trial that is received
    under Division 8 of the [Food and Drug
    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) before September 1,
    2001 is subject to those Regulations and any procedures established
    under those Regulations as they read at the time the application was
    received.

- --- SOR/2003-11, s. 38

  - - [38]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The following definitions apply
      in this section.

      [[former Regulations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[former Regulations]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the [Food and
          Drug Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) as they
          read immediately before the day on which these Regulations
          come into force. ([règlement antérieur]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

      [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[manufacturer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as
          in section A.01.010 of the [Food and Drug
          Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870). ([fabricant]{.DefinedTermLink
          lang="fr"})

      [[prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

      :   [[prepackaged product]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same
          meaning as in section B.01.001 of the [Food and Drug
          Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870). ([produit
          préemballé]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite sections 1 to 37 and subject to
      subsection (3), the former Regulations continue to apply to a
      prepackaged product that is labelled in accordance with the former
      Regulations until the day that is three years after the day on
      which these Regulations come into force, unless the label of the
      product, or any advertisement for the product that is made or
      placed by or on the direction of the manufacturer of the product,
      contains

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a statement or claim set out in column 4 of any
        of items 15, 16 and 22 to 26 of the table following section
        B.01.513 of the [Food and Drug
        Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), as enacted by
        section 20 of these Regulations;

      Part C of those Regulations apply in respect of the submission or
      supplement.

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} The authorization is revoked if the manufacturer
      does not file a new drug submission under section C.08.002 of the
      [Food and Drug Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), or a
      supplement, for the new drug within one of the following periods,
      as applicable:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an authorization that was issued
        before the day on which this section comes into force, 90 days
        after the day on which this section comes into force; or

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an authorization that is issued
        on or after the day on which this section comes into force, 90
        days after the day on which the authorization is issued.

    - [(3)]{.lawlabel} If the manufacturer files a new drug submission
      under section C.08.002 of the [Food and Drug
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), or a supplement,
      for the new drug within the applicable period set out in paragraph
      (2)(a) or (b), the authorization is revoked when one of the
      following circumstances occurs:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the Minister issues a notice of compliance
        under section C.08.004 of those Regulations in respect of the
        submission or supplement;

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the Minister issues a notice to the
        manufacturer under paragraph C.08.004(1)(b) of those Regulations
        in respect of the submission or supplement and the manufacturer
        does not amend the submission or supplement in accordance with
        subsection C.08.004(2) of those Regulations, the period referred
        to in subsection C.08.004(2) expires;

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the Minister issues a notice to the
        manufacturer under paragraph C.08.004(3)(b) of those Regulations
        in respect of the submission or supplement.

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 21

  - - [21]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} The drug identification number
      that was assigned under subsection 7(1) of the ISAD Interim Order
      in relation to a new drug that is referred to in section 20
      continues to be assigned for the distinct combination of dosage
      form, strength and route of administration of the new drug.

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} A reference in Divisions 1 and 1A of Part C of
      the [Food and Drug Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870)
      --- other than in sections C.01.050, C.01.052, C.01.053 and
      C.01A.003 --- to a drug identification number is deemed to include
      a reference to the drug identification number that is referred to
      in subsection (1).

    - [(3)]{.lawlabel} A reference in section C.01A.003 of the [Food and
      Drug Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) to a
      distributor who holds a drug identification number is deemed to
      include a reference to the manufacturer who is referred to in
      section 20.

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 22

  - [22]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer who is referred to in section 20
    shall, within 15 days after the day on which the new drug is first
    sold in Canada, notify the Minister, in writing, of the date of that
    first sale, unless the manufacturer has already done so under
    section 8 of the ISAD Interim Order.

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 23

  - [23]{.lawlabel} The manufacturer who is referred to in section 20
    shall, within 15 days after the day on which the manufacturer
    permanently discontinues the sale in Canada of the new drug, notify
    the Minister, in writing, of the date on which the sale was
    permanently discontinued, unless the manufacturer has already done
    so under section 9 of the ISAD Interim order.

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 24

  - [24]{.lawlabel} Despite the definition
    [[drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section C.01.014.8 of the [Food
    and Drug Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), sections
    C.01.014.9 and C.01.014.10 of those Regulations apply, with any
    necessary modifications, to the manufacturer who is referred to in
    section 20 in respect of the new drug.

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 25

  - - [25]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2),
      sections 20 to 24 cease to apply to a new drug that is referred to
      in section 20 90 days after the day on which this section comes
      into force.

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} If the manufacturer who is referred to in section
      20 files, for the new drug, a new drug submission under section
      C.08.002 of the [Food and Drug
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) or a supplement,

      comes into force, sections 20 to 24 cease to apply to the new drug
      when one of the circumstances referred to in paragraphs 19(3)(a)
      to (c) occurs.

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 26

  - - [26]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 1(3) of the
      ISAD Interim Order, for the purposes of the definition
      [[innovative drug]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in subsection
      C.08.004.1(1) of the [Food and Drug
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870), a medicinal
      ingredient is not considered to be approved in a drug by reason of
      the Minister having issued or amended an authorization under the
      ISAD Interim Order in respect of a COVID-19 drug that contains the
      medicinal ingredient.

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) ceases to apply on the day on
      which the ISAD Interim Order ceases to have effect.

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 27

  - - [27]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Any terms and conditions of an
      establishment licence --- other than those that are imposed by the
      Minister under the ISAD Interim Order --- are deemed to be imposed
      by the Minister under subsection C.01A.008(4) of the [Food and
      Drug Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870).

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any terms and conditions of an establishment
      licence that are imposed by the Minister under the ISAD Interim
      Order are deemed to be imposed by the Minister under section
      C.01A.012.1 of the [Food and Drug
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870).

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 28

  - - [28]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 26(1) of the
      ISAD Interim Order, any establishment licence that is referred to
      in that subsection is not cancelled immediately before the ISAD
      Interim Order ceases to have effect if the holder of the
      establishment licence notifies the Minister in writing, before the
      day on which the ISAD Interim Order ceases to have effect, of
      their intention to continue to conduct activities in respect of
      the COVID-19 drug under the establishment licence.

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection 26(2) of the ISAD Interim
      Order, any amendment that is referred to in that subsection to an
      establishment licence continues to have effect after the ISAD
      Interim Order ceases to have effect if the holder of the
      establishment licence notifies the Minister in writing, before the
      day on which the ISAD Interim Order ceases to have effect, of
      their intention to continue to conduct activities in respect of
      the COVID-19 drug under the amended establishment licence.

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 29

  - [29]{.lawlabel} Information and material in respect of a designated
    COVID-19 drug that were provided under paragraphs 28(1)(a) and (b)

- --- SOR/2021-45, s. 30

    Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) applies, with any
    necessary modifications, in respect of a designated COVID-19 drug

- --- SOR/2021-57, s. 25

  - - [25]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[new

- --- SOR/2021-199, s. 9

- --- SOR/2021-199, s. 10

- --- SOR/2021-199, s. 12

  - - [12]{.lawlabel} [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (2),
      subsections C.10.008(1) and (2) of the [Food and Drug
      Regulations](/eng/regulations/C.R.C.,_c._870) apply in respect of
      a designated biocide that was imported under the Exceptional
      Importation and Shortages Interim Order No. 2.

    - [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), that
      subsection C.10.008(1) is to be read without reference to

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sections A.01.015 and A.01.017 in paragraph
        C.10.008(1)(a);

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} sections C.01.040.3 to C.01.049.1 in
        subparagraph C.10.008(1)(b)(i);

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} subparagraph C.10.008(1)(b)(ii); and

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} sections C.10.009 to C.10.011 in subparagraph
        C.10.008(1)(b)(iii).

    - [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) ceases to apply on December 31,
      2022 in respect of the sale of a designated biocide, other than at
      retail sale, that was imported under the Exceptional Importation
      and Shortages Interim Order No. 2.

    - [(4)]{.lawlabel} An importer must not sell a designated biocide
      that they imported under that Interim Order unless they ensure
      that the information referred to in paragraph 12(2)(d) of that
      Interim Order is available in English and French and in a manner
